model_requirements.description: Clinical Trials is a specialized industry that designs, manages, and monitors clinical research studies for pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors, providing data analytics, regulatory expertise, and patient recruitment to accelerate drug development.

model.name: Clinical_Trials
model.description: Clinical Trials is a specialized industry that designs, manages, and monitors clinical research studies for pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors, providing data analytics, regulatory expertise, and patient recruitment to accelerate drug development.

domains.name: study
domains.description: Core operational domain managing clinical study protocols, design, phases, objectives, endpoints, inclusion/exclusion criteria, visit schedules, and study lifecycle from protocol development through database lock.
domains.references: ICH GCP E6(R3); CDISC Protocol Representation Model

products.name: protocol
products.description: Master record for the clinical study protocol including all formal amendments (version history). Captures protocol number, version, title, phase, therapeutic area, indication, investigational product, study design parameters (allocation method

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the clinical study protocol record in the lakehouse. Primary key for the protocol data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: indication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.indication. Business justification: Protocol has indication as free text. Linking to the canonical indication product ensures MedDRA coding consistency, supports regulatory dossier assembly by indication, and enables
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that owns and funds the clinical study. Links to the sponsor master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: sponsor_regulatory_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.regulatory_strategy. Business justification: Protocols are developed in alignment with the sponsor's regulatory strategy (submission pathway, health authority requirements, special designations).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.therapeutic_area. Business justification: Protocol has therapeutic_area as a free-text denormalized column. Linking to the canonical therapeutic_area product enforces MedDRA/CDISC TA coding consistency, enables portfolio
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method by which participants are assigned to study arms. 'Randomized' indicates use of RTSM/IRT for random assignment; 'non-randomized' indicates assignment by investigator or other non-random method.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ClinicalTrials.gov

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol amendment was formally issued or approved. Null for the original protocol version. Used to establish the amendment timeline and regulatory notification deadlines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for the protocol amendment (e.g., Amendment 1, Amendment 2). Null for the original protocol version. Used to track the amendment history and link to regulatory submission records in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA Variation Regulation

attributes.name: amendment_rationale
attributes.description: Formal justification for the protocol amendment describing the scientific, safety, or operational reasons for the change. Required for regulatory submissions and IRB/IEC notifications. Stored in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the protocol amendment per regulatory definitions. 'Substantial' amendments require prior regulatory authority and IRB/IEC approval before implementation; 'non-substantial' require notification only; 'administrative' are clerical
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; MHRA Clinical Trials Regulations

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol version received final sponsor and/or regulatory/IRB/IEC approval, making it the operative protocol for study conduct. Tracked in Veeva Vault quality management workflow. Establishes the effective date for GCP compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this protocol record was first created in the source system or ingested into the lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; ALCOA+ Data Integrity; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: dsmb_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol mandates the establishment of a Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent safety oversight and interim analysis review.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006); ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; EMA Guideline on DMC

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Required Flag

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.description: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) number or Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) number assigned under EU CTR 536/2014. Required for all clinical trials conducted in the EU/EEA.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EudraCT/CTIS Registration; EMA Transparency Policy

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_declaration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol includes a formal declaration of compliance with ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements. Required for all interventional clinical trials. Tracked in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA GCP Regulations

attributes.name: ich_compliance_declaration
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Compliance Declaration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol formally declares compliance with applicable ICH guidelines (E6, E8, E9, E10, etc.). Distinct from GCP declaration; covers the broader ICH guideline framework including statistical and design standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8(R1); ICH E9(R1); ICH E10; FDA/EMA/PMDA ICH Implementation

tag_set.value: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Compliance Declaration

attributes.name: intervention_model
attributes.description: Describes the strategy for assigning interventions to participants. Determines the statistical analysis plan (the source system) structure, number of arms, and eCRF design in Medidata Rave. Aligns with CDISC SDTM ARM domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9(R1) Addendum; ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_status
attributes.description: Status of the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) notification or approval for this protocol version or amendment. Tracks compliance with ethics review requirements across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: is_adaptive_design
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study employs an adaptive design allowing pre-specified modifications to the trial or statistical procedures based on interim data analysis. Triggers additional regulatory review requirements and DSMB/DMC oversight obligations.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs for Clinical Trials (2019); EMA Reflection Paper on Adaptive Designs; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: is_pediatric
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study includes a pediatric population (subjects under 18 years). Triggers Pediatric Investigation Plan (PIP) requirements under EMA and Pediatric Study Plan (PSP) under FDA PREA/BPCA, and specific ICF/assent requirements.
attributes.references: FDA PREA/BPCA; EMA Pediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006; ICH E11(R1)

attributes.name: masking_type
attributes.description: Level of blinding applied to the study to minimize bias. Specifies which parties (participant, investigator, outcomes assessor, data analyst) are blinded to treatment assignment. Critical for RTSM/IRT configuration and unblinding procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; CDISC SDTM IG; ClinicalTrials.gov; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known, sponsor-assigned unique alphanumeric identifier for the clinical study protocol (e.g., ABC-2024-001). Used across all regulatory submissions, site documents, and operational systems as the primary business key.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; CDISC SDTM STUDYID

attributes.name: number_of_arms
attributes.description: Total count of treatment arms (groups) defined in the protocol. Drives RTSM randomization configuration, eCRF arm assignment, and statistical analysis plan (the source system) structure. Must be consistent with the intervention model.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; Oracle Clinical One Study Design

attributes.name: planned_duration_months
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the study in months from first subject first visit (FSFV) to last subject last visit (LSLV) or database lock (DBL), as specified in the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; Oracle Siebel CTMS Study Timeline

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of last subject last visit (LSLV) or database lock (DBL) as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for resource planning, regulatory submission timelines, and study close-out activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; WHO ICTRP Registration

attributes.name: planned_sample_size
attributes.description: Total number of subjects planned for enrollment across all study sites and arms as specified in the protocol. Derived from the statistical power calculation in the the source system.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of first subject first visit (FSFV) or study initiation as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for milestone tracking, site activation planning, and regulatory submission timelines in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; WHO ICTRP Registration

attributes.name: primary_endpoint
attributes.description: The principal outcome measure used to evaluate the primary objective of the study. Defines the variable, measurement method, timepoint, and population. Drives eCRF design in Medidata Rave and the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: primary_objective
attributes.description: Formal statement of the primary scientific objective of the study as defined in the protocol. Describes the main question the study is designed to answer. Directly linked to the primary endpoint and powers the sample size calculation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.2; ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: primary_purpose
attributes.description: The primary reason for conducting the clinical study. Determines regulatory pathway, endpoint requirements, and IRB/IEC review criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: registry_identifier
attributes.description: Public clinical trial registry identifier such as ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number (e.g., NCT12345678) or WHO ICTRP identifier. Required by ICMJE for publication eligibility and by FDA/EMA for transparency. Sourced from the source system
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP; ClinicalTrials.gov (42 CFR Part 11); ICMJE Clinical Trial Registration Policy; FDA FDAAA 801

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory authority submission for this protocol version or amendment (e.g., IND amendment to FDA, CTA variation to EMA/MHRA). Tracks compliance with regulatory notification and approval requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; ICH E6(R2); MHRA Clinical Trials Regulations

attributes.name: secondary_objectives
attributes.description: Summary of secondary scientific objectives of the study as defined in the protocol. Describes additional questions the study is designed to address beyond the primary objective. Linked to secondary endpoints in the the source system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.2; ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: short_title
attributes.description: Abbreviated or lay-language title of the clinical study used in operational communications, CTMS displays, patient-facing materials, and internal reporting. Distinct from the full regulatory title.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP Registration Data Set; ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration

attributes.name: source_system_identifier
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating operational system (the source system study ID or Veeva Vault document ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record for audit and reconciliation
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: protocol_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the protocol version. 'draft' indicates under development; 'approved' indicates IRB/IEC and sponsor approval obtained; 'amended' indicates a formal amendment is in effect; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: ICH-defined phase of clinical development for the investigational product. Determines regulatory requirements, sample size expectations, and study design complexity. 'Not Applicable' used for non-IND studies such as device or observational studies.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1) General Considerations for Clinical Studies; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.21; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_population_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the target patient population for the study, including disease characteristics, demographic parameters, and key eligibility criteria summary. Used in IRB/IEC submissions, regulatory filings, and patient recruitment materials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the study design indicating whether participants receive an intervention or are observed. Determines applicable regulatory framework, IRB review requirements, and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full official title of the clinical study protocol as it appears on the protocol document and regulatory submissions. Used in IRB/IEC submissions, clinical trial registries, and the Clinical Study Report (CSR).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; WHO ICTRP Registration Data Set; ClinicalTrials.gov

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this protocol record in the source system or lakehouse. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; ALCOA+ Data Integrity; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the protocol document (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, 3.1). Combined with protocol_number, uniquely identifies a specific iteration of the protocol. Incremented with each formal amendment. Sourced from Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

products.name: study_protocol_amendment
products.description: Tracks all formal amendments to an approved clinical study protocol. Records amendment number, amendment date, amendment type (substantial/non-substantial), description of changes, rationale, regulatory submission status per health authority (FDA, EMA

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol amendment record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: amendment_regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Protocol amendments are submitted as IND amendments or CTA variations filed in regulatory binders.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: amendment_tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Each protocol amendment generates a TMF essential document (DIA TMF Zone 4). Amendment tracking and TMF completeness assessments require linking the amendment record to its filed TMF
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: authored_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6 R2 require electronic records to identify the author of protocol amendments by authenticated identity.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_one_amendment_id
attributes.description: The native amendment identifier from the source system study design system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational source system.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One System of Record; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: document_icf_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_icf_version. Business justification: GCP requires that when an amendment triggers ICF updates (icf_version_updated_flag, reconsent_required_flag), the specific new ICF version is traceable to the amendment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.sponsor_contact. Business justification: Protocol amendments require formal sponsor approval from a specific sponsor contact.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Regulatory affairs teams must link each internal study amendment record to its corresponding regulatory submission record in the regulatory domain.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study to which this protocol amendment belongs. Links the amendment to the study master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: affected_sections
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or free-text enumeration of protocol section numbers and titles modified by this amendment (e.g., '5.1 Inclusion Criteria, 8.3 Visit Schedule, 10.2 Safety Monitoring'). Enables targeted review by site staff.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; Veeva Vault eTMF Document Metadata

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment was formally authored or finalized by the sponsor. This is the document date, distinct from submission or approval dates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: amendment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing all changes introduced by this amendment, including modified sections, added or removed procedures, and updated criteria. Serves as the primary change log for regulatory and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the protocol amendment. Tracks progression from internal drafting through regulatory approval and implementation. 'Superseded' indicates a later amendment has replaced this one.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault Lifecycle States; Oracle Clinical One Amendment Workflow

attributes.name: amendment_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the primary purpose or scope of the amendment (e.g., 'Addition of New Safety Monitoring Criteria'). Used in regulatory submissions and internal tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the amendment per regulatory definitions. 'Substantial' amendments require prior health authority and ethics committee approval before implementation. 'Non-substantial' amendments may be implemented with notification only.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the sponsor representative (e.g., Chief Medical Officer, Head of Regulatory Affairs) who provided final internal approval for the amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.2; GCP SOP Requirements; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Primary category of change introduced by the amendment. Used for analytics, regulatory reporting, and impact triage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: eligibility_criteria|dosing_regimen|visit_schedule|safety_monitoring|endpoint|statistical|icf|administrative|other —
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC Protocol Representation Model; FDA Amendment Classification Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this amendment record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: dsmb_dmc_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was triggered by a formal recommendation from the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC). Requires documentation of the DSMB/DMC meeting minutes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17; FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: edc_configuration_updated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (Medidata Rave) has been updated to reflect the protocol changes introduced by this amendment. Critical for data integrity and eCRF alignment.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the amended protocol becomes operative at clinical sites. Sites must implement protocol changes on or after this date. May differ from approval date if a transition period is granted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: ema_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the amendment was submitted to the European Medicines Agency (EMA) or relevant national competent authority under EU CTR 536/2014. Null if no EU sites are involved.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: ema_submission_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory submission status with the European Medicines Agency (EMA) or relevant EU national competent authority for this amendment.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation

attributes.name: fda_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the amendment was submitted to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as an IND amendment. Null if the study is not conducted under a U.S. IND.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; IND Amendment Requirements

attributes.name: fda_submission_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory submission status with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). 'On_clinical_hold' indicates FDA has placed a hold pending resolution of safety concerns.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: icf_version_updated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Updated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment necessitates a new version of the Informed Consent Form (ICF). When true, a new ICF document version must be created and approved before re-consent activities begin.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; Clinpal eConsent System

tag_set.value: Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Updated Flag

attributes.name: impact_assessment_summary
attributes.description: Structured narrative summarizing the assessed impact of the amendment on study operations, subject safety, data integrity, site procedures, and timelines. Produced during the amendment review process.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Protocol Amendments; GCP SOP Requirements

attributes.name: implementation_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which all active clinical sites must have fully implemented the amendment. Used for monitoring follow-up and escalation planning in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; GCP Monitoring Requirements; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead or central IRB/IEC granted approval for the amendment. For substantial amendments, implementation cannot proceed until this approval is received.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of this amendment. Required for GCP compliance at all participating sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations

attributes.name: irb_iec_status
attributes.description: Current review and approval status from the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). 'Approved_with_conditions' requires sponsor response before full approval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: pmda_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the amendment was submitted to Japan's Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA). Null if no Japan sites are involved.
attributes.references: PMDA Clinical Trial Notification Requirements; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: pmda_submission_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory submission status with Japan's Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA) for this amendment.
attributes.references: PMDA Clinical Trial Notification Requirements; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: previous_protocol_version
attributes.description: The protocol version number that was in effect immediately before this amendment was applied. Enables version chain traceability for audit and regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: Scientific, safety, or operational justification for the amendment. Required by health authorities to assess the necessity and appropriateness of protocol changes. Sourced from the source system and Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: reconsent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrolled subjects must provide updated Informed Consent Form (ICF) signatures due to material changes introduced by this amendment. Drives re-consent workflow in Clinpal eConsent.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: safety_driven_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was initiated primarily due to a safety signal, Serious Adverse Event (SAE), SUSAR, or DSMB/DMC recommendation. Safety-driven amendments may require expedited regulatory review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Safety Reporting Guidelines; DSMB Charter Requirements

attributes.name: sap_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires an update to the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system). Changes to primary/secondary endpoints, analysis populations (ITT, PP), or statistical methods trigger the source system
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E9(R1) Estimands; CDISC ADaM; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor's internal governance (e.g., medical, regulatory, and legal sign-off) formally approved the amendment prior to external submission.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.2; GCP SOP Requirements

attributes.name: subject_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment has a direct impact on currently enrolled subjects (e.g., changes to dosing, visit schedule, eligibility criteria, or safety monitoring). True triggers mandatory re-consent assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance on Re-consent

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this amendment record in the lakehouse silver layer. Required for change data capture, audit trail, and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_code
attributes.description: The document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault eTMF to the amendment document. Enables direct cross-reference to the source document management system for audit trail and TMF completeness tracking.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; TMF Reference Model

products.name: study
products.description: Top-level master entity representing a clinical trial as a business and operational unit. Captures the unique study identifier (sponsor study number, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number, EudraCT number), study title, acronym, therapeutic area, indication

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the clinical study record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the study_study entity. Sourced from the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: indication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.indication. Business justification: study_study carries indication as free text. The canonical indication product provides MedDRA-coded reference data required for regulatory submission grouping, competitive intelligence
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.sponsor_contact. Business justification: Each study has a designated sponsor primary contact (medical monitor, project lead).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_study_cro_org_organization_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Contract Research Organization (CRO) assigned to manage or support the clinical study on behalf of the sponsor. Nullable when the sponsor conducts the study internally. Sourced from the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.therapeutic_area. Business justification: study_study carries therapeutic_area as free text. The canonical therapeutic_area product is the authoritative reference for CTMS portfolio dashboards, regulatory strategy grouping

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this epoch definition was sourced (e.g., the source system Medidata Rave). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5

attributes.name: epoch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the epoch definition within the study protocol. DRAFT indicates under development; ACTIVE indicates approved and in use; AMENDED indicates modified by protocol amendment; SUPERSEDED indicates replaced by a newer version
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: treatment_arm_specific
attributes.description: Indicates whether this epoch applies to a specific treatment arm only (True) or is common across all arms of the study (False). Relevant for crossover and multi-arm study designs.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: epoch_type
attributes.description: The epoch type of the epoch.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this epoch record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5.3

attributes.name: washout_epoch
attributes.description: Indicates whether this epoch is a washout period during which prior treatment effects are expected to dissipate before the next treatment period. Used in crossover study design analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: window_after_days
attributes.description: Allowable number of days after the planned epoch start date within which the epoch transition is considered protocol-compliant. Used for protocol deviation assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: window_before_days
attributes.description: Allowable number of days before the planned epoch start date within which the epoch transition is considered protocol-compliant. Used for protocol deviation assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Medidata Rave EDC

products.name: study_protocol_milestone
products.description: Study-level milestone - distinct concept, separate owner from regulatory_milestone and program_milestone.
products.reference: CTMS Study Milestone Tracking / ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: study_protocol_milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each study milestone record in the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS). Primary key for the study_milestone data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (e.g., Project Manager, CRA, Regulatory Affairs Lead) who is personally accountable for driving this milestone to completion. Links to the workforce/employee master.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: organization_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.sponsor_contact. Business justification: Contractual milestones require sponsor contact accountability for achievement confirmation and payment authorization.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization associated with this milestone. Enables sponsor-level milestone reporting and portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: predecessor_study_protocol_milestone_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the milestone that must be achieved before this milestone can begin. Enables dependency chain modeling for critical path analysis and schedule impact assessment.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: program_development_milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.program_milestone. Business justification: Study-level milestones (e.g., FPI, DBL) are governed by and contribute to program-level milestones in critical path analysis and integrated program timelines.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: study_milestone has protocol_version as a STRING but no FK to protocol. Study milestones (e.g., Protocol Final, First Patient In, Database Lock) are associated with specific protocol versions
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sponsor_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.engagement. Business justification: Study milestones are contractual commitments tracked within the CRO-sponsor engagement. Milestone achievement drives payment triggers and governance reporting at the engagement level.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study to which this milestone belongs. Links the milestone to the study protocol and overall study lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the protocol amendment that introduced or modified this milestone. Null if the milestone was defined in the original protocol. Supports change impact traceability per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: achievement_confirmed_by
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual who formally confirmed and recorded the milestone as achieved in the CTMS. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity requirements and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: achievement_confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the milestone achievement was formally confirmed and recorded in the CTMS. Distinct from actual_date (the business event date) — this is the system confirmation timestamp per ALCOA+ requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the milestone was actually achieved. Null if the milestone has not yet been reached. Compared against planned_date to compute schedule variance for sponsor reporting and KPI tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: actual_enrollment_count
attributes.description: For enrollment-type milestones, the actual number of subjects enrolled at the time of milestone achievement. Compared against target_enrollment_count to assess enrollment performance at key study milestones.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The approved baseline date for the milestone, set at study kick-off or after a formal re-baseline event. Preserved as an immutable reference point even when planned_date is revised, enabling true baseline vs. current schedule variance analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, sponsor communications, or contextual information related to the milestone. Supports collaborative tracking and audit documentation in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: completion_criteria
attributes.description: Formal, measurable criteria that must be satisfied for the milestone to be considered achieved (e.g., '100% of target sites activated', 'All CRFs locked and queries resolved'). Supports objective milestone verification.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this milestone record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: ctms_milestone_ref
attributes.description: Native milestone identifier from the the source system source system. Preserved for cross-system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this milestone record originated (e.g., the source system the source system manual entry). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Databricks Lakehouse

attributes.name: dependency_type
attributes.description: Type of scheduling dependency between this milestone and its predecessor (e.g., Finish-to-Start means the predecessor must finish before this milestone can start). Supports critical path method (CPM) scheduling in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: The current best-estimate date for milestone achievement, updated dynamically as study conditions evolve. Distinct from planned_date (baseline) and actual_date (confirmed). Supports rolling forecast reporting to sponsors.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_contractual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is tied to a contractual obligation with the sponsor (e.g., payment trigger, deliverable deadline). Contractual milestones are tracked for financial and legal compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA; SOX

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone lies on the critical path of the study schedule. Critical path milestones directly impact the overall study completion date and receive heightened monitoring attention from the sponsor and CRO.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_regulatory_milestone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone has a direct regulatory reporting obligation (e.g., IND submission, first patient enrolled notification, DBL, NDA/BLA submission). Regulatory milestones trigger compliance tracking and health authority notifications.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lead_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of days of lead (negative) or lag (positive) applied to the dependency relationship with the predecessor milestone. Allows scheduling flexibility where a milestone can start before or must wait after its predecessor.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: milestone_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the milestone for portfolio-level reporting and sponsor dashboards. Distinguishes operational milestones (site activation, monitoring) from regulatory (IND, NDA/BLA submissions) and data management (DBL, CSR) milestones.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: milestone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the milestone within the study (e.g., FPFV, LPLV, DBL, CSR_SUBMIT). Used as the business identifier in CTMS and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the milestone, including entry/exit criteria, acceptance conditions, and any special instructions. Provides context beyond the milestone_name for operational teams and auditors.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the milestone (e.g., 'First Patient First Visit', 'Last Patient Last Visit', 'Database Lock', 'Clinical Study Report Submission'). Used in sponsor dashboards and CTMS timeline views.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the milestone indicating whether it has been achieved, is pending, is delayed relative to plan, has been waived, or cancelled. Core field for CTMS timeline tracking and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the milestone by its operational or regulatory function. Drives reporting groupings and critical path analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether achievement of this milestone triggers a formal notification to the sponsor, health authority, IRB/IEC, or other stakeholder. Drives automated alert workflows in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the milestone achievement notification was dispatched to the relevant stakeholders. Null if notification has not yet been sent. Supports compliance audit trails for regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled calendar date by which this milestone was expected to be achieved, as defined in the study protocol or project plan. Used as the baseline for variance calculations and critical path analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: The organizational unit or role accountable for achieving this milestone (e.g., Sponsor, CRO, Site, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs). Used for accountability tracking and escalation routing in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this milestone within the study's overall milestone schedule. Defines the logical ordering of milestones for timeline visualization and Gantt chart rendering in CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: Clinical development phase of the study at the time this milestone is defined (Phase 1, 2, 3, 4). Contextualizes the milestone within the drug development lifecycle for portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E8; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: target_enrollment_count
attributes.description: For enrollment-type milestones (e.g., FPFV, 50% enrollment, LPLV), the target number of subjects to be enrolled at the time of milestone achievement. Provides quantitative context for enrollment milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this milestone record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: variance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the planned_date and the actual_date (or forecast_date if not yet achieved). Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate early completion. Used for sponsor KPI reporting and study performance analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: variance_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for any deviation between the planned and actual/forecast milestone date. Required when variance_days is non-zero. Supports root cause analysis and CAPA tracking per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; CAPA guidelines

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized coded classification of the variance reason to enable aggregate analysis across studies and portfolios. Complements the free-text variance_reason field.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or role of the authorized individual who approved the milestone waiver. Required when milestone_status is 'waived'. Supports GCP compliance and sponsor governance documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: waiver_justification
attributes.description: Documented rationale for waiving a milestone when milestone_status is 'waived'. Required for regulatory audit trail and sponsor approval. Captures the business or scientific justification for the waiver decision.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

products.name: country
products.description: Manages the countries in which a clinical study is conducted including country-level enrollment planning. Records country code (ISO 3166), country name, regulatory authority, CTA/IND submission and approval dates, approval status, first site activation

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the study-country record. Primary key for the study_country data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cta_regulatory_binder_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: document_icf_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_icf_version. Business justification: Each country requires a country-specific ICF version (language, local regulatory requirements). study_country.icf_version_required tracks this need.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country Lead Clinical Research Associate (CRA) ID
attributes.description: Reference to the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or Country Manager designated as the primary point of contact for all sites and regulatory activities in this country. Sourced from the source system and the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday HCM

tag_set.value: Country Lead Clinical Research Associate (CRA) ID

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing regulatory authority responsible for clinical trial oversight in this country (e.g., FDA for US, EMA/national competent authority for EU member states, PMDA for Japan). Links to the health_authority reference product.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); PMDA

attributes.name: sponsor_regulatory_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.regulatory_strategy. Business justification: Country-level CTA submissions and regulatory approvals are governed by the sponsor's regional regulatory strategy.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study for which this country-level record is maintained. Links the country configuration to the study protocol.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: activated_site_count
attributes.description: Actual number of investigative sites that have been activated and authorized to enroll subjects in this country. Compared against planned_site_count for country-level site activation KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Overall operational activation status of the country within the study lifecycle, distinct from enrollment_status. Reflects the country's readiness and operational state as tracked in the source system and the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: actual_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Actual number of subjects enrolled (consented and randomized or screened) in this country to date. Compared against planned_enrollment_target for enrollment performance reporting in Medidata Rave and the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: actual_screened_count
attributes.description: Actual number of subjects screened at sites in this country to date. Used to calculate the realized screen failure rate and to assess enrollment efficiency.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated for all study activities in this country, expressed in the country's local currency (see currency_code). Sourced from the source system accounting and used for country-level financial performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; ICH E6(R2); SOX

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code identifying the country where the clinical study is conducted (e.g., US, DE, JP). Used as the primary geographic identifier for regulatory and enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this study-country record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cta_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority granted approval for the clinical trial to proceed in this country. Milestone used for site activation planning and regulatory timeline KPI reporting.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2); MHRA; Health Canada

attributes.name: cta_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the CTA or IND application with the national regulatory authority. Drives regulatory hold flags and country activation readiness assessments.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2); EMA

attributes.name: cta_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Clinical Trial Authorization (CTA) or Investigational New Drug (IND) application was submitted to the national regulatory authority for this country. Tracked in Veeva Vault for regulatory timeline management.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the country (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Used for country-level budget planning, site payment processing, and financial reporting in the source system
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: data_privacy_framework
attributes.description: Primary data privacy regulatory framework applicable to subject data collected in this country (e.g., GDPR for EU, HIPAA for US, PIPEDA for Canada, APPI for Japan). Drives data handling, consent, and transfer requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR; HIPAA; PIPEDA; APPI; LGPD; ICH E6(R2); ISO 14155

attributes.name: dropout_rate_assumption
attributes.description: Assumed proportion of enrolled subjects expected to withdraw or be lost to follow-up in this country, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 = 10%). Used in sample size and enrollment buffer calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); ICH E9; SAS Drug Development; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: enrollment_closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which enrollment was formally closed in this country, either due to target achievement, regulatory hold, or study termination. Distinct from last_subject_enrolled_date as it reflects the administrative closure decision.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: enrollment_rate_assumption
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enrollment Rate Assumption (Subjects per Site per Month)
attributes.description: Assumed average number of subjects enrolled per active site per month in this country, used in enrollment forecasting and timeline modeling. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.5000 subjects/site/month).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAS Drug Development

tag_set.value: Enrollment Rate Assumption (Subjects per Site per Month)

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment lifecycle status for this country within the study. Drives enrollment forecasting, site activation planning, and country-level feasibility reporting in the source system and Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) Number
attributes.description: EudraCT number assigned by the European Medicines Agency (EMA) for clinical trials conducted in EU/EEA member states. Required for EU CTR compliance and EudraCT/CTIS registration. Applicable only for EU countries.

tag_set.value: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) Number

attributes.name: feasibility_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the country-level feasibility assessment was completed and the feasibility_score was assigned. Used to track the currency of feasibility data for enrollment planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: feasibility_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score (typically 0–100) representing the overall feasibility assessment rating for conducting the study in this country, based on site availability, patient population, regulatory environment, and infrastructure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: first_site_activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first investigative site in this country was activated and authorized to enroll subjects. Key milestone for country-level startup timeline KPI reporting in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: first_subject_enrolled_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first subject was enrolled (consented and randomized or screened) at any site within this country. Marks the start of active enrollment for country-level timeline tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: icf_version_required
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Informed Consent Form (ICF) approved by the national IRB/IEC and regulatory authority for use in this country. Ensures sites use the correct country-specific ICF version as tracked in Clinpal and Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014; Clinpal

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Date
attributes.description: Date on which the national or central IRB/IEC granted ethical approval for the study to proceed in this country. Required before any subject enrollment can commence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP; GDPR Article 9

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Date

attributes.name: irb_iec_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Submission Date
attributes.description: Date on which the study protocol and informed consent materials were submitted to the national or central Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) for ethical review in this country.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP; EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Submission Date

attributes.name: last_subject_enrolled_date
attributes.description: Date on which the last subject was enrolled in this country. Used to calculate country-level enrollment duration and to trigger enrollment completion milestones.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: local_language_code
attributes.description: Primary local language code for the country using IETF BCP 47 format (e.g., de-DE, ja-JP, fr-FR). Drives Informed Consent Form (ICF) translation requirements and eCRF localization in Clinpal and Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Clinpal; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: local_regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Country-specific regulatory reference or dossier number assigned by the national competent authority upon CTA/IND submission or approval (e.g., EudraCT number for EU, IND number for US, CTN for Australia). Stored in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; TGA CTN; Health Canada; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Full English name of the country as defined by ISO 3166-1 (e.g., United States, Germany, Japan). Used for display in regulatory submissions, reports, and dashboards.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FDA; EMA; PMDA

attributes.name: national_registry_number
attributes.description: Country-specific clinical trial registry number assigned by the national registry (e.g., ISRCTN, UMIN for Japan, CTRI for India). Distinct from EudraCT and ClinicalTrials.gov identifiers. Required for WHO ICTRP compliance.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP; ICMJE; ISO 14155; Health Canada

attributes.name: planned_enrollment_target
attributes.description: Target number of subjects planned to be enrolled in this country as defined in the study protocol and country feasibility assessment. Drives enrollment forecasting and country-level resource allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_screen_count
attributes.description: Planned number of subjects to be screened in this country, derived from the planned enrollment target and the assumed screen failure rate. Used for site capacity planning and patient recruitment forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_site_count
attributes.description: Number of investigative sites planned to be activated in this country as defined in the study feasibility assessment and country-level enrollment plan. Used for resource planning and site activation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory hold (e.g., FDA Clinical Hold under 21 CFR 312.42, or equivalent national authority hold) is currently in effect for this country, preventing or suspending subject enrollment.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.42; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 35; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_lift_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory hold was lifted by the national authority, allowing enrollment to resume. Null if the hold is still in effect.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.42; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_reason

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_start_date

attributes.name: active_substance
attributes.description: Name of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) or active substance in the investigational product. May differ from the INN for novel compounds. Used in IMPD/IND CMC sections, pharmacovigilance, and SDTM datasets.
