products.name: site_selection_committee
products.description: Master reference table for site_selection_committee. Referenced by committee_id.

attributes.name: site_selection_committee_id
attributes.description: Primary key for site_selection_committee

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the governing SOP document that defines the committees operational processes, decision workflows, and documentation requirements.

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that the committee serves or is aligned with.

attributes.name: parent_site_selection_committee_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on site_selection_committee (parent_site_selection_committee_id)

attributes.name: chairperson_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the committee chairperson for official communications regarding site selection activities.

attributes.name: chairperson_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual serving as chairperson of the site selection committee, responsible for leading deliberations and final recommendations.

attributes.name: charter_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current committee charter became effective, establishing the committees authority and operating procedures.

attributes.name: charter_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current committee charter expires and requires renewal or re-authorization. Nullable for open-ended charters.

attributes.name: charter_version
attributes.description: Version number of the committee charter document that defines the committees scope, authority, and operating procedures.

attributes.name: committee_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier code for the site selection committee, used across CTMS and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: committee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the committee by its organizational scope and permanence. Standing committees are permanent; ad hoc are formed for specific studies.

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_policy
attributes.description: Reference to the conflict of interest policy that committee members must adhere to when evaluating sites, ensuring unbiased selection decisions.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary country jurisdiction under which the committee operates, if regionally scoped.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this committee record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the committee was formally dissolved or deactivated. Null for currently active committees.

attributes.name: diversity_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the committee enforces patient population diversity requirements in site selection to ensure representative enrollment.

attributes.name: escalation_authority
attributes.description: Name or role of the governance body or individual to whom the committee escalates contested or high-risk site selection decisions.

attributes.name: feasibility_scoring_model
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quantitative scoring model applied during site feasibility assessments (e.g., weighted scorecard, risk-based model).

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: Date when the site selection committee was formally established and authorized to begin operations.

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the committee mandates verified GCP compliance as a prerequisite for site selection consideration.

attributes.name: irb_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the committee requires evidence of IRB/IEC approval or conditional approval before a site can be selected.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter code for the primary language used in committee deliberations and documentation.

attributes.name: last_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent committee meeting, used for tracking activity and ensuring the committee remains operationally current.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this committee record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: max_sites_per_review
attributes.description: Maximum number of candidate sites the committee can evaluate in a single review cycle, reflecting operational capacity constraints.

attributes.name: meeting_frequency
attributes.description: Standard cadence at which the committee convenes to review site feasibility assessments and make selection decisions.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Total number of current voting and non-voting members serving on the site selection committee.

attributes.name: minimum_enrollment_target
attributes.description: Minimum patient enrollment capacity threshold that a site must demonstrate during feasibility to be considered by the committee.

attributes.name: site_selection_committee_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the site selection committee, typically reflecting the therapeutic area or program it serves.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned committee meeting for site selection review activities.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or remarks about the committee, including special mandates, historical context, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: pi_qualification_criteria
attributes.description: Summary description of the minimum qualifications, experience, and credentials required of a Principal Investigator for site approval by this committee.

attributes.name: quorum_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of voting members required to be present for the committee to make binding site selection decisions.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Geographic region of responsibility for the committee's site selection activities.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_framework
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the risk-based quality management framework used by the committee to evaluate site-level risks during selection.

attributes.name: selection_criteria_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the standardized site selection criteria framework currently used by the committee for evaluating investigational sites.

attributes.name: site_selection_committee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the site selection committee indicating its operational readiness to conduct site evaluations.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic area or disease indication that the committee focuses on for site selection decisions (e.g., oncology, cardiology, neurology).

attributes.name: total_sites_approved
attributes.description: Cumulative count of investigational sites that have been approved for selection by this committee since its formation.

attributes.name: total_sites_reviewed
attributes.description: Cumulative count of investigational sites that have been formally reviewed by this committee since its formation.

attributes.name: voting_method
attributes.description: Decision-making methodology used by the committee to approve or reject site candidates during selection deliberations.

domains.name: subject
domains.description: SSOT for trial participants (subjects/patients) across all studies. Owns subject enrollment, demographics, randomization assignments via IRT/RTSM, treatment arms, visit compliance, protocol deviations, and subject disposition from screening through study
domains.references: ICH GCP E6(R3); CDISC SDTM DM Domain; GDPR; HIPAA

products.name: trial_subject
products.description: Core master entity representing a unique trial participant (subject/patient) screened or enrolled in a clinical study. Serves as the SSOT for subject identity including screening number, subject number, randomization number, demographic profile (age, sex

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a trial subject record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the trial_subject entity. All subject-level transactional records in the subject domain reference this identifier.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — USUBJID domain conventions; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_arm. Business justification: SDTM ACTARM/ARM derivation and enrollment-by-arm reporting require linking each subject to their assigned study_arm.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Regulatory compliance requires every enrolled subject to be traceable to the active CTA for their country.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 and ICH E6(R2) require that each enrolled subject is traceable to the specific IRB/IEC approval governing their enrollment, including approved ICF version and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study in which this subject is enrolled or screened. Links the subject to the parent study master record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — STUDYID; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which this subject was screened or enrolled. Supports site-level enrollment analytics and monitoring.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — SITEID; ICH E6(R2) GCP §4

attributes.name: age_at_enrollment
attributes.description: Subject's age in years at the time of enrollment or first dose, calculated from date of birth and enrollment date. Used for eligibility verification, demographic reporting, and subgroup analyses.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — AGE; ICH E6(R2); FDA Demographic Subgroup Analyses Guidance

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject completed all required study procedures per protocol, including end-of-study visit. Used for subject disposition reporting, CSR preparation, and database lock readiness assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain — DSDTC (completion); ICH E3 CSR Structure; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the investigational site where the subject is enrolled. Used for geographic stratification, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and multi-regional trial reporting. Corresponds to CDISC SDTM DM COUNTRY variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — COUNTRY; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the trial subject record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18.4; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: data_lock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's data has been locked as part of the Database Lock (DBL) process, preventing further modifications to the subject's eCRF data. True = subject data locked; False = data still open for entry or query resolution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; CDISC DMP; Medidata Rave EDC lock functionality; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Subject's date of birth used to calculate age at screening, enrollment, and key study milestones. Classified as restricted PHI/PII. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — BRTHDTC; HIPAA Safe Harbor De-identification; GDPR Article 9; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject met all inclusion and exclusion criteria as assessed during screening. True = all eligibility criteria confirmed met; False = one or more criteria not met. Sourced from the source system eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Clinical One eligibility module; CDISC SDTM IE domain

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was formally enrolled in the study following confirmation of eligibility criteria. Distinct from screening date and randomization date. Used for enrollment tracking, site performance KPIs, and study timeline reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM; ICH E6(R2) §4.3; Oracle Siebel CTMS enrollment milestone tracking

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subject within the study, reflecting their progression from screening through completion or withdrawal. Drives subject disposition reporting and ITT/PP population flags.
attributes.tags: implements=SDTM DS.DSDECOD, standard=FHIR, implements=FHIR ResearchSubject.status, standard_element=ResearchSubject.status
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain — DSDECOD; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: ethnicity
attributes.description: Subject's self-reported ethnic origin as collected at screening, coded per CDISC SDTM controlled terminology. Distinct from race per FDA demographic reporting requirements. Used in regulatory demographic summary tables.
attributes.value_regex: HISPANIC OR LATINO|NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO|NOT REPORTED|UNKNOWN
attributes.tags: PII, implements=SDTM DM.ETHNIC, pii_health, standard=SDTM, pii=true, pii_field_type=health, restricted, standard_element=DM.ETHNIC, pii_special_category_gdpr_article_9, gdpr_article9_special_category
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — ETHNIC; FDA Guidance on Collection of Race and Ethnicity Data; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: first_dose_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject received the first dose of investigational product. Used as the reference anchor for treatment-emergent adverse event (TEAE) analysis, PK sampling schedules, and per-protocol population definitions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain — EXSTDTC; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on TEAE Analysis; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: itt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system). True = subject is in ITT population; False = excluded.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles §5.2; CDISC ADaM ADSL — ITTFL; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; SAP conventions

attributes.name: last_dose_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject received the last dose of investigational product. Used to define the end of the treatment-emergent window for adverse event analysis and to calculate treatment duration. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC exposure domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain — EXENDTC; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on TEAE Analysis

attributes.name: pp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system). Subjects may be excluded from PP due to major protocol deviations, insufficient drug exposure, or
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles §5.2; CDISC ADaM ADSL — PPROTFL; FDA Guidance on Estimands; SAP conventions

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has at least one recorded protocol deviation during the study. True = one or more deviations recorded; False = no deviations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; CDISC SDTM DV domain; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: race
attributes.description: Subject's self-reported racial category as collected at screening, coded per CDISC SDTM controlled terminology and FDA demographic reporting requirements. Used for regulatory demographic tables and diversity reporting.
attributes.tags: implements=SDTM DM.RACE, pii_health, standard=SDTM, standard_element=DM.RACE, pii=true, pii_field_type=health, restricted, pii_special_category_gdpr_article_9, gdpr_article9_special_category
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — RACE; FDA Guidance on Collection of Race and Ethnicity Data; 21 CFR Part 312.33; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: randomization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was randomized to a treatment arm via the IRT/RTSM system. Defines the start of the treatment period and is used as the reference date for TEAE analysis windows and ITT population inclusion. Null for screen-failed subjects.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — RANDFL; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: Unique number assigned to a subject at the point of randomization via the IRT/RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM or the source system Determines treatment arm assignment and links to investigational product supply allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM DM — RANDFL; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; RTSM system conventions

attributes.name: safety_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the safety analysis population (typically all randomized subjects who received at least one dose of investigational product). Used for adverse event incidence tables and safety reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles §5.2; CDISC ADaM ADSL — SAFFL; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: screen_failure_reason
attributes.description: Reason why a screened subject did not proceed to enrollment, coded per protocol-defined eligibility criteria categories (e.g., INCLUSION CRITERIA NOT MET, EXCLUSION CRITERIA MET, SUBJECT WITHDREW CONSENT, INVESTIGATOR DECISION).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E6(R2) §4.3; Oracle Clinical One eligibility assessment module

attributes.name: screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject first underwent screening procedures for the study, including signing of the Informed Consent Form (ICF). Marks the start of the subject's participation timeline. Sourced from the source system and Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — DMDTC (screening); ICH E6(R2) §4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: screening_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a potential subject at the point of screening, prior to randomization or enrollment confirmation. Used to track pre-enrollment eligibility assessments. Sourced from the source system and Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — SUBJID (screening phase); ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: serious_adverse_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has experienced at least one Serious Adverse Event (SAE) during the study. True = one or more SAEs reported; False = no SAEs.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; CDISC SDTM AE domain — AESER

attributes.name: sex
attributes.description: Biological sex of the subject as recorded at screening. Coded per CDISC SDTM controlled terminology (M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown, UNDIFFERENTIATED). Used for demographic reporting, eligibility criteria verification, and PK/PD subgroup analyses.
attributes.tags: implements=SDTM DM.SEX, pii_health, standard=SDTM, standard_element=DM.SEX, pii=true, pii_field_type=health, restricted
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — SEX; CDISC Controlled Terminology CT v2023-09-29; ICH E6(R2); FDA Demographic Subgroup Analyses Guidance

attributes.name: source_subject_key
attributes.description: The native primary key or identifier for this subject record in the originating operational system (e.g., Medidata Rave subject OID, the source system patient ID).
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18.4; Medidata Rave EDC subject OID conventions

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned unique subject identifier within the study, typically formatted as site-subject (e.g., 001-0042). This is the primary operational identifier used across EDC, CTMS, and regulatory submissions. Corresponds to SUBJID in CDISC SDTM DM domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — SUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: subject_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this subject record was sourced or is mastered (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC, the source system the source system Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ALCOA+ compliance tracing.
attributes.value_regex: Medidata Rave|Oracle Clinical One|Oracle Siebel CTMS
attributes.tags: PII, implements=SDTM DM.SUBJID, pii_field_type=subject_identifier, pii_identifier, standard=SDTM, standard_element=DM.SUBJID
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18

attributes.name: unique_subject_identifier
attributes.description: Globally unique subject identifier combining sponsor, study, and subject number (e.g., SPONSOR-STUDY-001-0042). Mandatory CDISC SDTM variable used across all regulatory submission datasets to unambiguously identify a subject across studies and submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — USUBJID; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; ICH E3

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the trial subject record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail compliance. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18.4; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject withdrew from the study or was discontinued, if applicable. Null for subjects who completed the study. Used in subject disposition analysis and survival/time-to-event analyses.

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18

products.name: subject_visit
products.description: Single owner of a subject's protocol-scheduled study visit (clinical visit).

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each subject visit record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the subject_visit data product.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV Domain; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: agreement_billing_milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.billing_milestone. Business justification: Billing milestones in study contracts are triggered by specific subject visit events (FPFV, LPLV, visit count targets). billing_milestone has visit_count_target confirming this.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: GCP requires visit-level consent verification (subject_visit.informed_consent_verified already exists).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_form_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Form ID
attributes.description: Reference to the Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) visit form in the EDC system (Medidata Rave) associated with this visit. Links visit scheduling metadata to the data collection form for completeness tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave EDC

tag_set.value: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Form ID

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) responsible for monitoring this visit or the associated monitoring visit. Used for monitoring accountability and workload tracking in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: A subject visit is performed within the context of a specific enrollment. One enrollment has many visits.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_epoch. Business justification: Each subject visit occurs within a study epoch. FK to study_epoch enables epoch-level visit compliance analysis, SDTM SV epoch derivation, and epoch-based data review in EDC.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial participant (subject/patient) who performed or missed this visit. Core party reference for the transaction.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA; GDPR

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) or sub-investigator who conducted or supervised this visit at the investigational site. Required for regulatory accountability per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where this visit was conducted or was scheduled to occur. Supports site-level visit compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_visit_schedule. Business justification: Each subject visit is an instance of a planned visit in study_visit_schedule. This FK enables visit window compliance reporting (planned vs actual day), protocol deviation
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_visit_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the subject attended the visit and assessments were performed. Maps to SVSTDTC in CDISC SDTM SV domain. Null if the visit was missed or not yet conducted. Principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV.SVSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: actual_visit_end_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the visit concluded, applicable for multi-day visits or inpatient stays. Maps to SVENDTC in CDISC SDTM SV domain. Null for single-day visits.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV.SVENDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subject visit record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_entry_status
attributes.description: Status of eCRF data entry for this visit in the EDC system (Medidata Rave), indicating whether data collection has been initiated, is in progress, completed, locked, or frozen. Used for data management tracking and database lock readiness assessment.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: days_from_planned
attributes.description: Signed integer representing the deviation in days between the actual visit date and the planned visit date (actual minus planned). Negative values indicate early visits; positive values indicate late visits. Zero indicates on-schedule.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM SV Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the visit in minutes from check-in to check-out as recorded in the CTMS or EDC. Used for site capacity planning, resource utilization analysis, and subject burden assessment.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: early_termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for early termination of the visit or the subject's participation, applicable when visit_type is 'early_termination'. Captures clinical, safety, or administrative reasons per protocol requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: informed_consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid, signed Informed Consent Form (ICF) was confirmed on file prior to this visit (True) or not (False). Critical GCP compliance requirement; absence may constitute a major protocol deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: is_scheduled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this visit was a protocol-scheduled visit (True) or an unscheduled/ad-hoc visit not defined in the protocol schedule of assessments (False). Unscheduled visits may indicate safety events or protocol deviations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_unblinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment assignment was unblinded at or prior to this visit (True) or the subject remained blinded (False). Relevant for double-blind studies and impacts data integrity assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: missed_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why a scheduled visit was missed by the subject (e.g., subject unavailable, adverse event, travel, withdrew consent, site closure). Populated only when visit_status is 'missed'.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM SV Domain

attributes.name: missed_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized coded value for the reason a scheduled visit was missed, aligned with sponsor or protocol-defined coding scheme. Complements missed_reason free text for structured analytics and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM SV Domain; MedDRA

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text clinical or operational notes recorded by the site staff or CRA regarding this visit, including observations about subject condition, procedural issues, or site-specific circumstances. Sourced from the source system or Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: planned_visit_date
attributes.description: The target date on which the visit was scheduled to occur per the protocol-defined visit schedule, calculated from the subject's reference date (e.g., randomization date or first dose date). Used to compute visit window compliance.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV.SVSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this visit resulted in a protocol deviation (True), such as a visit outside the allowed window, missed required assessments, or procedural non-compliance. Triggers downstream protocol deviation record creation in the compliance domain.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: query_count
attributes.description: Number of open data discrepancy queries (DCFs) associated with this visit's eCRF data in the EDC system. Used for data quality monitoring and site performance tracking. Non-zero values may block database lock.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: source_system_visit_key
attributes.description: The native primary key or unique identifier for this visit record in the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave visit OID, Siebel CTMS visit row ID).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM SV Domain

attributes.name: study_day
attributes.description: The relative study day on which the visit occurred, calculated from the subject's reference start date per CDISC convention (Day 1 = reference date; Day -1 = day before; no Day 0). Maps to SVSTDY in CDISC SDTM SV domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV.SVSTDY; CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this subject visit record in the source system or Silver layer. Required for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: visit_code
attributes.description: Protocol-defined alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the visit within the study schedule (e.g., SCR, BL, V01, V02, ET, EOS). Maps to VISITNUM/VISIT in CDISC SDTM SV domain. Used as the externally-known business identifier for the visit.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV.VISIT; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: visit_number
attributes.description: Sequential numeric identifier for the visit as defined in the study protocol schedule of assessments. Maps directly to VISITNUM in CDISC SDTM SV domain. Used for ordering visits chronologically within a subject's participation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV.VISITNUM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: visit_status
attributes.description: Current completion status of the visit indicating whether the subject attended and completed all required assessments, missed the visit entirely, partially completed assessments, had the visit rescheduled, or the visit was cancelled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the visit by its role in the study protocol lifecycle. Drives SDTM SV domain population and visit compliance analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: screening|baseline|treatment|follow_up|unscheduled|early_termination|end_of_study — promote to
attributes.tags: implements=USDM Encounter.type, codelist=VISITTYPE, governing_standard=CDISC CT, standard=USDM, standard_element=Encounter.type
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SV Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: week
attributes.description: The nominal study week associated with this visit as defined in the protocol schedule of assessments (e.g., Week 1, Week 4, Week 12). Used for time-point labeling in biostatistical analyses and ADaM dataset derivations.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; CDISC SDTM SV Domain; ICH E9

attributes.name: window_close_date
attributes.description: The latest acceptable date for the visit to occur per the protocol-defined visit window (planned date plus the allowed late deviation in days). Used to determine visit window compliance status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM SV Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: window_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual visit date fell within the protocol-defined visit window, occurred early (before window open), occurred late (after window close), was missed entirely, or is not applicable (e.g., unscheduled visits).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM SV Domain

attributes.name: window_open_date
attributes.description: The earliest acceptable date for the visit to occur per the protocol-defined visit window (planned date minus the allowed early deviation in days). Used to determine visit window compliance status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM SV Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

products.name: subject_deviation
products.description: Transactional record of a protocol deviation identified for a subject, capturing deviation category (major, minor, important), deviation type code, description, date of occurrence, date identified, root cause, impact on subject safety and data integrity
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; CDISC SDTM DV (Protocol Deviations) domain

attributes.name: subject_deviation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol deviation record associated with a trial subject. Primary key for the subject_deviation data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.program_amendment. Business justification: Regulatory traceability requires mapping subject deviations to the protocol amendment version in effect at occurrence.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record in MasterControl that was initiated as a result of this deviation. Enables traceability between deviations and the quality management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 9001

attributes.name: compliance_deviation_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.deviation_classification. Business justification: GCP compliance requires every subject deviation to be classified against a standard taxonomy to determine regulatory reporting obligations, CAPA triggers, and CSR
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: detected_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: GCP and ICH E6 require protocol deviations to be attributed to the staff member who detected them for CAPA initiation, regulatory inspection readiness, and sponsor oversight reports.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Protocol deviations are assessed against the specific SOP that was violated or not followed.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Protocol deviations are enrollment-specific events — they occur within the context of a subject's participation in a specific study enrollment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ethics_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_submission. Business justification: Subject deviations with irb_iec_reportable_flag=true must be reported to the IRB/IEC via a formal ethics submission.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the deviation occurred. Used for site-level deviation trending, monitoring, and risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: laboratory_lab_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Protocol deviations are frequently identified through abnormal lab results (e.g., subject continued dosing despite creatinine exceeding stopping rule).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: A subject deviation is assessed against the protocol version in effect at the time of occurrence.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: site_file_document_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deviation Site File Document Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.site_file_document. Business justification: Deviation reports and supporting documentation must be filed in the Investigator Site File as GCP-required essential documents.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

tag_set.value: Deviation Site File Document Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this deviation was identified. Links the deviation to the governing protocol and sponsor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DV Domain

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Deviations are assessed against the protocol amendment in effect at occurrence.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: Protocol deviations are frequently identified at or associated with a specific study visit.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) for whom this protocol deviation was recorded. Core party reference linking the deviation to the enrolled participant.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; CDISC SDTM DV Domain

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the deviation record was formally closed in the quality management system. Provides higher precision than resolution_date for audit and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or contextual notes related to the deviation that do not fit into structured fields. May include reviewer notes, sponsor feedback, or monitoring observations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the immediate corrective action taken to address the deviation and prevent recurrence at the subject or site level. Distinct from the formal CAPA process which is tracked separately in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this deviation record was first created in the source system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation compromised the integrity of study data collected from the subject. Informs decisions on data exclusion, sensitivity analyses, and per-protocol (PP) population definitions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; CDISC

attributes.name: deviation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the deviation by severity and impact. 'Major' deviations significantly affect subject safety or data integrity; 'important' deviations may affect subject rights or study data; 'minor' deviations have minimal impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific deviation that occurred, including what protocol requirement was not met, the circumstances, and any relevant context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the deviation record as assigned by the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) or MasterControl. Used for cross-system referencing, regulatory submissions, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl

attributes.name: deviation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the deviation record. Tracks progression from initial identification through review, resolution, and closure. Drives operational dashboards and compliance monitoring in the source system and MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the deviation was first identified or discovered, which may differ from the occurrence date. Used to calculate detection lag and assess monitoring effectiveness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study. Separate from regulatory authority reportability. True = must report to IRB/IEC.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportability Flag

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred. This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the date the deviation was identified or reported. Critical for ALCOA+ compliance and regulatory timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVSTDTC

attributes.name: pi_aware_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was informed of the deviation. Used to track compliance with site notification requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: pi_aware_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) at the site has been made aware of this deviation. True = PI has been informed. Required for GCP compliance as the PI bears ultimate responsibility for conduct of the trial at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; FDA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section, clause, or requirement number within the approved study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., 'Section 6.3.2 - Inclusion Criteria'). Enables precise traceability to the protocol document.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA Protocol Deviation Guidance; CDISC SDTM DV Domain

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.), IRB/IEC, or sponsor per applicable regulations and the study protocol. True = reportable; False = not reportable. Drives regulatory submission workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority as applicable. Used to track compliance with reporting timelines mandated by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally resolved and closed in the quality management system. Used to calculate time-to-resolution metrics and assess site responsiveness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Narrative description of the underlying root cause of the deviation as determined through investigation. Used to inform corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and systemic quality improvement. Captured in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause to enable trending and systemic analysis across deviations. Categories align with standard quality management frameworks used in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain to which this deviation maps for regulatory submission. Protocol deviations are mapped to the DV (Protocol Deviations) domain per CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD Submission Standards; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (the source system or MasterControl). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor was formally notified of the deviation. Used to verify compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this deviation. True = sponsor has been notified. Required per GCP obligations for sponsor oversight of investigational sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subject_continuation_decision
attributes.description: Decision regarding the subject's continued participation in the study following the deviation. Informs subject disposition tracking and intent-to-treat (ITT) and per-protocol (PP) population assignments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.3; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: subject_rights_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation affected the rights or well-being of the trial subject, including informed consent procedures, privacy protections, or voluntary participation rights.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 2; Declaration of Helsinki; OHRP; GDPR; HIPAA

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation had an impact on subject safety. 'None' indicates no safety impact; 'potential' indicates possible but unconfirmed impact; 'confirmed' indicates a verified safety impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific type of protocol deviation (e.g., eligibility criteria violation, missed visit, incorrect dosing, prohibited medication use, consent procedure deviation).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVCAT/DVTERM

attributes.name: type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the deviation_type_code, providing a plain-language description of the deviation type for reporting and review purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVTERM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this deviation record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

products.name: disposition

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: A disposition milestone (completion, withdrawal, screen failure) is a formal event within a specific enrollment.

attributes.name: estimand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.estimand. Business justification: ICH E9(R1) estimand framework requires disposition events (treatment discontinuation, death) to be classified as intercurrent events per the estimand's ICE strategy.

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_id

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DV Domain; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: randomization_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.randomization_assignment. Business justification: Disposition records for randomized subjects should reference the specific randomization assignment that was active at the time of disposition.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Subject disposition records (withdrawal, completion, death) must be attributed to the staff member who recorded them for SDTM DS domain audit trail, regulatory submission, and GCP

attributes.description: The date and time at which the status transition was formally approved or electronically signed by the authorized user. Distinct from transition_timestamp (when the event occurred) and created_timestamp (when the record was created).
