attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional clinical or administrative comments related to this status transition, entered by the site staff or sponsor. Supports contextual documentation for audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this status history record was first created in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: disposition_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the disposition event type associated with this status transition. Used for regulatory reporting in the CDISC SDTM DS domain and for subject flow summaries in Clinical Study Reports (CSRs).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS.DSCAT; ICH E3 Section 10.2; FDA Guidance on CSR

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition required prior approval from the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) (e.g., re-consent due to protocol amendment). True = IRB/IEC approval was required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's treatment assignment was blinded at the time of this status transition. True = blinded (treatment identity concealed); False = unblinded (treatment identity known).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.7; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: is_terminal_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new_status represents a terminal (end-state) disposition for the subject in this study. True = the subject has reached a final state (completed, withdrawn, screen-failed, lost-to-follow-up) with no further expected transitions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E3; FDA Guidance on CSR

attributes.name: itt_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject was included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population at the time of this status transition. Supports biostatistical analysis population tracking per the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; SAP

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The subject's enrollment lifecycle status after this transition event. Represents the current state the subject entered as a result of this change. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E6(R2); Oracle Clinical One Subject Status

attributes.name: pp_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject was included in the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population at the time of this status transition. Supports biostatistical analysis population tracking per the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM; FDA Guidance; SAP

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The subject's enrollment lifecycle status immediately before this transition event. Together with new_status, defines the state transition vector for longitudinal subject flow analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E6(R2); Oracle Clinical One Subject Status

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation (PD) was associated with or triggered this status transition. True = a protocol deviation is linked to this transition event. Supports GCP compliance monitoring and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; GCP

attributes.name: safety_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject was included in the safety analysis population at the time of this status transition (i.e., received at least one dose of investigational product). Supports safety reporting and TEAE analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting; CTCAE

attributes.name: screen_failure_reason
attributes.description: Specific reason why the subject failed screening and did not proceed to enrollment. Populated only when new_status = 'screen-failed'. Used for site feasibility analysis, protocol amendment decisions, and enrollment optimization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DS domain; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: source_system_record_key
attributes.description: The native primary key or unique identifier of this status transition record in the originating source system (the source system or Medidata Rave). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_day
attributes.description: The relative study day on which the status transition occurred, calculated from the subject's reference start date (typically first dose date). Negative values indicate pre-treatment days. Aligns with CDISC SDTM timing variable conventions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM General Observation Class; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric subject identifier assigned at enrollment (e.g., site-sequential number such as '001-001'). Used in regulatory submissions, eCRFs, and audit trails to identify the participant without revealing personal identity.
attributes.tags: PII, implements=SDTM DM.SUBJID, pii_field_type=subject_identifier, pii_identifier, standard=SDTM, pii=true, restricted, standard_element=DM.SUBJID
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DM.SUBJID; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA §164.514

attributes.name: transition_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the subject's status transition occurred in the real-world clinical context. This is the principal business event date used for enrollment timelines, regulatory reporting, and subject flow analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DS.DSSTDTC; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: transition_reason
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the clinical or administrative reason for the subject status change (e.g., 'Subject met all inclusion/exclusion criteria', 'Subject withdrew consent', 'Adverse event led to discontinuation').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DS.DSDECOD; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: transition_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized coded value for the transition reason, aligned with CDISC SDTM DS domain disposition event codes (e.g., 'COMPLETED', 'WITHDRAWAL BY SUBJECT', 'ADVERSE EVENT', 'SCREEN FAILURE'). Enables structured analysis and regulatory submission mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS.DSDECOD; MedDRA; ICH E3

attributes.name: transition_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal number of this status transition within the subject's complete enrollment lifecycle history. Enables chronological ordering of all transitions for a given subject within a study. Starts at 1 for the first recorded transition.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone) at which the subject status transition was recorded in the source system (the source system or Medidata Rave). Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation standards.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM DS.DSSTDTC

attributes.name: triggered_by_system
attributes.description: Identifies whether the status transition was triggered by a human user or an automated system process, and which source system initiated it (the source system Medidata Rave, IRT/RTSM). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: triggered_by_user_role
attributes.description: The clinical role of the user who triggered this status transition (e.g., CRC - Clinical Research Coordinator, CRA - Clinical Research Associate, PI - Principal Investigator). Supports audit trail completeness and role-based accountability per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this status history record was last modified in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and data quality monitoring per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ standards.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Specific reason for subject withdrawal or discontinuation from the study. Populated when new_status is 'withdrawn' or 'discontinued'. Categorized per CDISC SDTM DS domain controlled terminology (e.g., 'ADVERSE EVENT', 'WITHDRAWAL BY SUBJECT', 'LOST TO
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS.DSDECOD; ICH E3 Section 10.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

products.name: subject_contact
products.description: Canonical contact entity for trial subject emergency contacts, next of kin, and legally authorized representatives. Sponsor organization contacts reference sponsor.sponsor_contact; this entity is reserved for subject-related contacts only.
products.reference: GDPR Article 5; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP subject identification

attributes.name: subject_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the subject contact record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: consent_icf_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the version of the Informed Consent Form (ICF) under which the subject's contact data privacy consent was obtained. Ensures traceability of consent to the specific ICF version approved by the IRB/IEC.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR Article 7; Clinpal

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the subject is enrolled. Used to scope contact data to the correct site for monitoring and follow-up.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: primary_subject_primary_organization_contact_id
attributes.description: Optional reference to the canonical sponsor contact record when a subject contact is also a sponsor contact (resolves contact duplicate by making sponsor.sponsor_contact the canonical owner).

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this subject is enrolled. Scopes the contact record to a specific trial.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) whose contact information is stored in this record. Links to the subject master entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: type_codelist_term_id
attributes.description: foreign key to shared contact type reference

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the subject's home address (street number and street name). Used for postal communications, visit logistics, and safety follow-up mailings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the subject's home address (apartment, suite, unit, floor, or building name). Supplements address_line1 for complete postal address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: address_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject's home address was last verified by site staff. Supports ALCOA+ data quality requirements and ensures contact information is current for safety follow-up.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: address_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's home address has been verified by site staff or through an address validation service. True = address confirmed; False = address unverified or pending confirmation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the subject's home address. Used for geographic analysis of subject distribution and postal communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject granted consent for contact communications. Required for GDPR and HIPAA audit trails to demonstrate lawful basis for processing contact data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Clinpal

attributes.name: consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has provided explicit consent to be contacted for study-related communications (visit reminders, follow-up calls). True = consent granted; False = consent not granted or withdrawn.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Clinpal

attributes.name: consent_withdrawn_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject withdrew consent for contact communications. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Once populated, all non-safety-critical outreach must cease per GDPR right to withdraw.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 & 17; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subject contact record. 'active' indicates the contact details are current and in use; 'inactive' indicates superseded or no longer valid; 'withdrawn' indicates the subject has withdrawn consent for contact
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.526; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the subject's home address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA) and communication rules.
attributes.tags: PII, implements=SDTM DM.COUNTRY, pii_address, standard=SDTM, pii_field_type=address, restricted, standard_element=DM.COUNTRY
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subject contact record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Hard stop flag indicating the subject must not be contacted under any circumstances (excluding mandatory safety communications). True = do not contact; False = contact permitted per consent settings. Overrides all other contact preferences.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 & 21; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contact record is considered valid and active. Supports temporal versioning of contact information to maintain a history of address and phone changes over the course of a long-running trial.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5(1)(d) accuracy principle

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the subject. Used for electronic communications including visit reminders, eConsent notifications, and patient engagement via Clinpal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; 21 CFR Part 11; Clinpal

attributes.name: email_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has specifically consented to receive communications via email. True = email contact permitted; False = email contact not permitted. Distinct from general contact consent as email may carry additional regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; CAN-SPAM Act; Clinpal

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the subject's designated emergency contact person. Used by site staff to reach a responsible party in the event of a serious adverse event (SAE) or medical emergency.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the subject's emergency contact. Used exclusively for safety-related communications and serious adverse event (SAE) follow-up.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact person to the subject (e.g., spouse, parent, legal guardian). Provides context for site staff when initiating emergency communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent successful contact with the subject. Used to track subject engagement, identify subjects at risk of dropout, and support visit compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; CTMS KPI reporting

attributes.name: last_contact_method
attributes.description: Communication channel used during the most recent successful contact with the subject. Supports analysis of effective outreach strategies and visit compliance improvement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by site staff regarding the subject's contact preferences, special communication instructions, or relevant context (e.g., best time to call, language interpreter required).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the subject's home address. Used for geographic analysis, site feasibility, and postal communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Subject's stated preference for how they wish to be contacted by the site or sponsor. Governs outreach channel selection for visit reminders and safety follow-up. 'no_contact' indicates the subject has requested no proactive outreach.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Clinpal

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time
attributes.description: Subject's preferred time of day to be contacted. Supports scheduling of outreach calls and reminders to maximize response rates and respect subject preferences.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Clinpal; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code representing the subject's preferred language for communications (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'zh-CN'). Ensures communications are delivered in the subject's native language to support informed participation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR Article 7; Clinpal

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the subject. Used for visit reminders, recruitment follow-up, and safety follow-up communications. Stored in international format where possible.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: primary_phone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary phone number (e.g., mobile, home, work). Informs the appropriate time and method for outreach.
attributes.references: Clinpal; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact record indicating the role of the contact in relation to the subject. 'primary' is the subject themselves; 'secondary' is an alternate contact; 'emergency' is for emergency use only; 'caregiver' is a designated caregiver
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: safety_contact_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether safety-critical communications (e.g., SAE follow-up, urgent safety notifications) are permitted even when do_not_contact_flag is True. True = safety contact allowed regardless of general consent; False = all contact restricted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.11; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 41

attributes.name: secondary_phone
attributes.description: Alternate telephone number for the subject, used when the primary phone is unreachable. Supports visit compliance and safety follow-up.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: secondary_phone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the secondary phone number (e.g., mobile, home, work).
attributes.references: Clinpal; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sms_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has specifically consented to receive communications via SMS/text message. True = SMS contact permitted; False = SMS contact not permitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); Clinpal

attributes.name: source_system_contact_key
attributes.description: Natural key or unique identifier of this contact record in the originating source system (Clinpal or the source system Enables bidirectional traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the subject's home address. Supports regulatory reporting and geographic stratification of subject populations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this subject contact record. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles. Tracks when contact details were last updated by site staff.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5(2)

products.name: stipend_payment
products.description: Transactional record of subject stipend and reimbursement payments issued to trial participants for visit attendance, travel expenses, and participation costs per IRB/IEC-approved payment schedule.
products.reference: FDA Guidance on Financial Disclosure; ICH E6(R2) GCP 4.8.10 (compensation to subjects)

attributes.name: stipend_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each stipend or reimbursement payment record issued to a trial participant. Primary key of this table.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: agreement_investigator_grant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.investigator_grant. Business justification: Investigator grants define IRB-approved stipend amounts and payment schedules for subjects.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: IRB-approved stipend payments require documented approval by a named study staff member (CRC/study coordinator) for audit trail, IRB compliance, and financial reconciliation reports.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: change_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.change_order. Business justification: Change orders can revise subject reimbursement amounts, payment schedules, or add new payment categories.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: IRB regulations require stipend payments only to subjects consented under an IRB-approved ICF version containing the approved payment schedule.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subject enrollment record, linking the payment to the subject's study participation context including treatment arm and randomization assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: ethics_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_approval. Business justification: IRB/IEC must approve subject compensation amounts and schedules as part of ethics review.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which the subject is enrolled and where the associated visit or activity generating this payment occurred.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: IRB/IEC approvals specify the maximum allowable stipend amounts and payment schedules for subject participation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: patient_stipend_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.patient_stipend. Business justification: Stipend reconciliation process: the CTMS operational stipend_payment record must be matched to the finance.patient_stipend accounting record for month-end close, IRB compliance
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: IRB-approved stipend schedules are tied to specific protocol versions; payments must be validated against the IRB-approved amount for that protocol version.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: site_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.site_agreement. Business justification: Subject stipend payments are governed by the site agreement's per-patient fee schedule and payment terms.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study under which this stipend payment was issued. Links the payment to the governing protocol and IRB/IEC-approved payment schedule.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific study visit that triggered this stipend or reimbursement payment, enabling reconciliation of payments against visit attendance records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supporting receipt or expense documentation submitted by the subject to substantiate a reimbursement claim (e.g., travel receipts, parking tickets). Links to the document management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial participant (subject/patient) who received this stipend or reimbursement payment. Core party reference for this transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was formally approved by the authorized approver (e.g., site coordinator, sponsor representative) prior to disbursement. Supports audit trail and approval workflow compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Amount formally authorized for disbursement following review and approval, which may differ from the requested amount if partial approval was granted or adjustments were made during the approval workflow.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Payments to Research Subjects; IRB/IEC approval

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was confirmed as received and settled by the subject (e.g., check cashed, ACH settled, card loaded). Used for financial reconciliation and outstanding payment tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Greenphire ClinCard; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: clincard_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the Greenphire ClinCard payment platform for this disbursement. Used for reconciliation between the clinical trial management system and the ClinCard payment processor.
attributes.references: Greenphire ClinCard platform; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stipend payment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance requirements for clinical trial data.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctms_payment_key
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Payment Key
attributes.description: Source system record identifier from the source system for this payment record. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CTMS source system.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

tag_set.value: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Payment Key

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Required for multi-country studies to support financial reconciliation and tax reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: irb_approved_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board (IRB) Approved Payment Amount
attributes.description: The maximum per-visit or per-activity payment amount as approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) for this study.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; ICH E6(R2) GCP; IRB/IEC approval; OHRP guidance

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board (IRB) Approved Payment Amount

attributes.name: irb_payment_schedule_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board (IRB) Payment Schedule Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the IRB/IEC-approved payment schedule that governs this payment. Ensures traceability to the specific approved schedule in effect at the time of payment, supporting regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; ICH E6(R2) GCP; IRB/IEC approval documentation

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board (IRB) Payment Schedule Version

attributes.name: over_irb_threshold_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Over Institutional Review Board (IRB) Threshold Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment exceeds the IRB/IEC-approved maximum payment amount for the associated visit or activity type. True triggers a compliance review workflow to ensure undue inducement rules are not violated.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; ICH E6(R2) GCP; OHRP guidance; IRB/IEC approval

attributes.name: payment_amount

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the payment was issued/disbursed to the subject. This is the principal business event date for this transaction, used for tax year determination and financial reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525; FDA Guidance on Payments to Research Subjects; ALCOA+

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument used to disburse the payment to the subject. 'check' = paper check; 'ach' = Automated Clearing House bank transfer; 'gift_card' = retail gift card; 'prepaid_debit_card' = reloadable prepaid card (e.g., Greenphire ClinCard); 'clincard' =
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Payments to Research Subjects; IRB/IEC approval; Greenphire ClinCard

attributes.name: payment_notes

attributes.name: payment_processor

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stipend payment. 'pending' = awaiting approval; 'approved' = authorized but not yet disbursed; 'issued' = disbursed to subject; 'cleared' = confirmed received/settled; 'voided' = cancelled and reversed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Greenphire ClinCard

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment purpose. 'stipend' = compensation for time and inconvenience; 'travel_reimbursement' = transport costs; 'meal_allowance' = food costs; 'lodging_reimbursement' = overnight accommodation; 'parking_reimbursement' = parking fees
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Payments to Research Subjects; ICH E6(R2) GCP; IRB/IEC approval

attributes.name: reimbursement_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject or site submitted the reimbursement request or expense claim. Used to track processing turnaround time and ensure timely payment per protocol commitments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Greenphire ClinCard

attributes.name: subject_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the subject's country of residence at the time of payment. Determines applicable tax reporting requirements, withholding rules, and regulatory jurisdiction for the payment.

attributes.name: tax_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is subject to tax reporting obligations (e.g., IRS Form 1099-MISC for US subjects). True when the cumulative annual payments to the subject meet or exceed the IRS reporting threshold ($600 USD).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525; IRS Form 1099-MISC; 26 USC Section 6041

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which this payment was issued, used for IRS 1099 reporting period assignment and annual tax reporting aggregation for US subjects.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525; IRS Form 1099-MISC; 26 USC Section 6041

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this stipend payment record. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail compliance per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: visit_type_at_payment
attributes.description: Type of study visit associated with this payment (e.g., screening, baseline, treatment, follow-up, unscheduled). Captured at payment time to support payment schedule compliance analysis independent of visit record changes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was voided or cancelled. Populated only when payment_status is 'voided'. Required for financial reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the payment was voided (e.g., duplicate payment, subject withdrew, incorrect amount, payment returned). Required when void_date is populated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the gross payment for tax purposes (e.g., backup withholding for US subjects who have not provided a valid TIN/SSN). Net payment to subject equals payment_amount minus withholding_amount.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 505; 26 USC Section 3406; IRS Form W-9

attributes.name: ytd_payment_total
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all stipend and reimbursement payments made to this subject within the current calendar year across all studies, as of this payment. Used for IRS 1099 threshold tracking and tax reporting compliance for US subjects.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525; IRS Form 1099-MISC; 26 USC Section 6041

attributes.name: inclusion_flag

attributes.name: interim_analysis_number

attributes.name: reviewer_role

products.name: demographic

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: SDTM DM domain requires ARM and ACTARM per subject derived from the canonical treatment_arm definition.

attributes.name: study_site_id

attributes.name: trial_subject_id

attributes.name: country

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the demographic record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.

attributes.name: data_entry_status
attributes.description: Current data entry and verification status of the demographic eCRF form in the EDC system. Tracks completeness and readiness for database lock (DBL) and SDTM submission.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which the demographic data was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across the lakehouse pipeline.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Subject's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to calculate age at key study milestones and to verify age-based eligibility criteria. May be partially masked (year only) per privacy regulations.

attributes.name: dm_sequence_number

attributes.name: edc_subject_key
attributes.description: Source system record key for the subject's demographic record in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Enables traceability from the silver layer back to the source EDC record for SDV and audit purposes.

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: epoch
attributes.description: The study epoch (e.g., SCREENING, TREATMENT, FOLLOW-UP) during which the demographic data was collected, per CDISC SDTM Trial Epochs dataset. Used for temporal context in multi-epoch study designs.

attributes.name: first_exposure_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's first exposure to the investigational product (IP). Defines the start of the treatment period and is the reference date for study day calculations in CDISC SDTM DM domain.

attributes.name: gender_identity

attributes.name: height_cm

attributes.name: informed_consent_date

attributes.name: last_exposure_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's last exposure to the investigational product (IP). Used to define the end of the treatment period and calculate treatment duration for safety and efficacy analyses.

attributes.name: lock_status
attributes.description: Lock status of the demographic eCRF record in the EDC system. LOCKED records cannot be modified without an audit-trailed unlock. FROZEN records are pending final database lock (DBL).

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol in effect at the time the demographic data was collected. Ensures traceability of demographic assessments to the applicable protocol amendment.

attributes.name: query_open_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more open data queries (discrepancies) exist against this demographic record in the EDC system. True = at least one unresolved query; False = no open queries. Used for data cleaning tracking.

attributes.name: race_other_description

attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the staff member (e.g., site coordinator, investigator) who witnessed the consent signing. Required for GCP compliance when the subject is illiterate or consent is obtained verbally. Belongs to the signing event.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject signed this specific ICF version. Belongs to the consent event, not to the subject master or the ICF document master. Moved from trial_subject.icf_date (which only captured the latest consent date).

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which consent was obtained for this signing event (e.g., paper, eConsent platform, verbal with witness). Belongs to the individual signing event, not to the subject or the ICF version document.

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of this specific consent signing event. A subject may have a signed status for an earlier ICF version and a pending status for a newer version requiring re-consent. Belongs to the individual consent event record.

attributes.name: icf_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject signed the most recent version of the Informed Consent Form (ICF). Must precede any study-related screening procedures. Used for GCP compliance verification and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7; Clinpal eConsent system

attributes.name: icf_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has signed a valid Informed Consent Form (ICF) prior to any study-related procedures. Mandatory regulatory requirement. True = ICF signed and on file; False = ICF not yet signed or consent withdrawn.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: icf_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Informed Consent Form signed by the subject. Tracks which IRB/IEC-approved consent version was used. Critical for re-consent tracking when protocol amendments require updated ICF versions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; IRB/IEC approval records; Veeva Vault document versioning

attributes.name: reconsent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent event was a re-consent (true) due to a protocol amendment or new safety information, or an initial consent (false) at enrollment. Belongs to the signing event, not to the subject or the ICF version.

attributes.name: expectedness

attributes.name: follow_up_number

attributes.name: initial_report_date

attributes.name: meddra_llt_code
attributes.description: The MedDRA Lowest Level Term (LLT) code that most closely matches the verbatim SAE term. The LLT is the most granular level of MedDRA coding and is used to preserve the original reported term in a coded format.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AELLT

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.description: The MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) code assigned to the SAE. The PT is the primary level of MedDRA used for regulatory reporting and is the standard coded term submitted in ICSRs and clinical study reports.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AEDECOD; ICH E2B(R3)

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.description: The MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) code assigned to the SAE during medical coding. Represents the highest level of the MedDRA hierarchy, used for regulatory submissions and safety signal detection.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AESOC

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.description: The version of the MedDRA dictionary used to code this SAE (e.g., '26.0', '26.1'). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure reproducibility of coding and compliance with current dictionary standards.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; ICH E2B(R3); CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: The full medical narrative describing the SAE, including clinical course, relevant medical history, concomitant medications, investigational product details, and the investigator's assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 6; ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 312.32; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the serious adverse event first began or was first observed by the subject or investigator. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for the SAE transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; CDISC SDTM AE.AESTDTC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The clinical outcome of the serious adverse event at the time of the most recent report. 'recovered_with_sequelae' indicates the subject recovered but with lasting effects. 'fatal' must align with seriousness_death = true.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) Element C.1.7; CDISC SDTM AE.AEOUT; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: regulatory_report_due_date
attributes.description: The calculated deadline by which the expedited regulatory report (e.g., IND Safety Report, SUSAR notification) must be submitted to the relevant health authority.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of safety report generated for this SAE. 'expedited' = 7/15-day SUSAR or IND safety report; 'periodic' = included in DSUR/PSUR; 'spontaneous' = post-marketing spontaneous report; 'literature' = identified from published literature.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2C(R2) DSUR; EMA GVP Module VI; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: reporting_authority
attributes.description: The health authority or regulatory body to which the SAE/SUSAR report was submitted (e.g., 'FDA', 'EMA', 'MHRA', 'PMDA', 'TGA', 'Health Canada'). May contain multiple authorities if reported to more than one.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GVP Module VI; MHRA; PMDA

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the serious adverse event resolved, stabilized, or the subject died. Null if the event is ongoing at the time of reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE.AEENDTC; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: sae_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SAE case in the source system 'initial' = first report received; 'follow_up' = additional information received; 'closed' = case fully resolved and closed; 'nullified' = case determined not to meet SAE criteria and voided.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: sae_term
attributes.description: The verbatim (as-reported) description of the serious adverse event as recorded by the investigator or site staff in the source document or eCRF. This is the raw, uncoded term prior to MedDRA coding.

attributes.name: seriousness_congenital_anomaly

attributes.name: seriousness_disability

attributes.name: seriousness_hospitalization

attributes.name: seriousness_life_threatening
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of being immediately life-threatening (i.e., the subject was at immediate risk of death at the time of the event).

attributes.name: seriousness_medically_important

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code

attributes.name: meddra_version

attributes.name: narrative

attributes.name: onset_date

attributes.name: outcome

attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: reporting_clock_start_date

attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: reporting_status

attributes.name: route_of_administration

attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM EX domain; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; WHO-DD

attributes.name: seriousness_criteria

attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 1; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: submission_report_type

attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

products.name: ae_meddra_coding

attributes.name: coded_date

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: coded_timestamp

attributes.name: coding_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment entered by the coder to document coding rationale, ambiguities, or special considerations for this MedDRA assignment. Supports coding consistency reviews and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DM Best Practices; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: coding_method
attributes.description: Indicates how the MedDRA code was assigned: 'auto' for system-generated auto-coding by the source system 'manual' for coder-assigned coding, 'auto_confirmed' for auto-coded and confirmed by a coder, 'recoded' for a previously coded term that was

attributes.name: coding_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the MedDRA coding assignment. 'pending' indicates awaiting coding, 'coded' indicates a code has been assigned, 'confirmed' indicates QC-approved, 'rejected' indicates coding was rejected and requires rework, 'under_review'

attributes.name: confirmed_date

tag_set.value: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Version

attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; CDISC SDTM AESER

attributes.name: dsmb_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Review Date
attributes.description: The date on which the DSMB/DMC formally reviewed this causality assessment during a scheduled or ad hoc safety review meeting.

attributes.name: dsmb_reviewed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reviewed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this causality assessment was reviewed by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) as part of a formal safety review. Supports DSMB/DMC meeting documentation and regulatory oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; FDA Guidance on DMC; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reviewed Flag

attributes.name: expectedness
attributes.description: Determination of whether the adverse event is listed in the current Investigator's Brochure (IB) or Reference Safety Information (RSI) as a known effect of the investigational product. Drives SUSAR classification and expedited reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: expedited_report_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this causality assessment triggers an obligation for expedited regulatory reporting (7-day or 15-day report) to health authorities such as FDA, EMA, or PMDA based on SUSAR classification.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_revised
attributes.description: Indicates whether this causality assessment is a revision of a previously submitted assessment. True when the assessor has changed their causality determination after initial submission, triggering regulatory follow-up reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: rationale_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text clinical narrative provided by the assessor explaining the reasoning behind the causality determination. Includes consideration of temporal relationship, biological plausibility, dechallenge/rechallenge results, and alternative explanations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: rechallenge_result
attributes.description: Outcome observed when the investigational product was re-administered (rechallenged) after the adverse event resolved. A positive rechallenge (AE recurred) provides strong evidence of causal relationship. Captured per ICH E2A causality criteria.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Assessment Criteria; CIOMS

attributes.name: report_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated deadline date by which the expedited regulatory report (SUSAR/IND safety report) must be submitted to health authorities. Derived from the date of first awareness plus the applicable reporting timeline.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reporting_timeline_days
attributes.description: The applicable expedited reporting timeline in calendar days from the date of first awareness of the SUSAR (typically 7 days for fatal/life-threatening or 15 days for other serious unexpected reactions). Drives compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 4; FDA 21 CFR 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision version number for this causality assessment. Starts at 1 for the original assessment and increments with each revision. Enables audit trail tracking of assessment changes over the case lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Argus Safety versioning

attributes.name: signal_detection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this causality assessment has been flagged for inclusion in pharmacovigilance signal detection analysis within the source system Supports aggregate safety review and cumulative causality trend monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E2E; EMA GVP Module IX; FDA Guidance on Signal Detection

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the source system (the source system case assessment ID or Medidata Rave record ID) for this causality assessment. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+ principles; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: sponsor_causality_category
attributes.description: The Sponsor Medical Monitor's independent causality determination, captured separately from the investigator's assessment. When sponsor_causality_override is True,
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: sponsor_causality_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Sponsor Medical Monitor's causality determination differs from (overrides) the Investigator's assessment. When True, both assessments are retained and the sponsor's determination governs regulatory reporting obligations per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.32

attributes.name: susar_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adverse event has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) based on the combination of seriousness, causality (at least possible), and unexpectedness criteria.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

tag_set.value: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag

attributes.name: temporal_relationship
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the timing between investigational product administration and adverse event onset is consistent with a causal relationship. A key criterion in WHO and ICH causality assessment frameworks.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Assessment Criteria; CIOMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this causality assessment record was most recently modified in the source system. Tracks the latest change for audit trail compliance and Silver layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: who_dd_drug_code

attributes.name: argus_case_number

attributes.name: authoring_date
attributes.description: Date on which the safety narrative was initially authored or drafted. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and version history tracking.

attributes.name: case_summary
attributes.description: High-level executive summary of the safety case, synthesizing the patient description, event, treatment, and outcome into a concise paragraph suitable for inclusion in the ICSR narrative field of E2B(R3) submissions.

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety case for which this narrative is written. SAE = Serious Adverse Event; SUSAR = Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction; AE = Adverse Event; AESI = Adverse Event of Special Interest.

attributes.name: causality_assessment
attributes.description: Medical monitor's or investigator's assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the adverse event. Used in regulatory reporting and signal detection.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) Section C.2.r.4; WHO-UMC causality categories; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety narrative record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: ctcae_grade

attributes.name: ctcae_version

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the onset, nature, severity, and clinical course of the adverse event or serious adverse event, including signs, symptoms, and diagnostic findings. Core narrative section for ICSR submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3) Section C.2; ICH E2A; FDA MedWatch 3500A; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: expedited_report_due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the expedited safety report (ICSR) must be submitted to health authorities. Calculated from the date of first awareness per ICH E2A (7-day for fatal/life-threatening; 15-day for other serious unexpected).
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expedited_report_submitted_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the expedited safety report (ICSR) was submitted to the relevant health authority via eCTD/E2B(R3) format. Used to verify compliance with regulatory reporting timelines.

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the narrative was authored under blinded conditions (True) or after unblinding of treatment assignment (False). Critical for maintaining study integrity in double-blind trials; blinded narratives must not reveal treatment allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding; EMA Reflection Paper on Blinding

attributes.name: meddra_llt_code
attributes.description: MedDRA Lowest Level Term code representing the verbatim adverse event term as coded. Provides the most granular level of MedDRA coding for source data traceability.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AELLT

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term code for the primary adverse event. Eight-digit numeric code at the PT level of the MedDRA hierarchy, used as the standard coding for regulatory submissions and pharmacovigilance.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AEPTCD

attributes.name: meddra_pt_term
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term text (e.g., 'Atrial fibrillation') for the primary adverse event. Human-readable label used in narrative text and regulatory reports.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AEDECOD

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class code for the primary adverse event term. Eight-digit numeric code representing the highest level of the MedDRA hierarchy used for regulatory reporting and signal detection.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AESOCCD

attributes.name: meddra_soc_term
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class term (e.g., 'Cardiac disorders') corresponding to the SOC code. Used for narrative labeling and regulatory submission display.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AESOC

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding the adverse event terms in this narrative (e.g., '26.1'). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure reproducibility of coding.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE.AEMEDDRA

attributes.name: medical_monitor_commentary
attributes.description: Clinical commentary and causality assessment provided by the medical monitor, including their opinion on the relationship between the investigational product and the adverse event, and any recommendations for protocol amendments or safety actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: medical_monitor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the medical monitor or safety physician who reviewed and approved the safety narrative. Required for regulatory audit trail and ICSR submission accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: outcome_description
attributes.description: Narrative section describing the resolution or current status of the adverse event, including recovery details, sequelae, or death information. Corresponds to the outcome field in E2B(R3) regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3) Section C.2.r.8; ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE.AEOUT

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notified
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of regulatory authorities to which this safety report was submitted (e.g., FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA). Supports multi-jurisdictional compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA regulations

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this narrative supports an initial expedited report, a follow-up report with updated information, or a final report closing the case. Drives regulatory submission timelines under ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the medical monitor or safety physician completed their clinical review of the narrative. Distinct from the authoring date; marks the transition from draft to reviewed status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Argus Safety workflow; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: seriousness_criteria
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ICH E2A seriousness criteria met by the adverse event (e.g., death|life_threatening|hospitalization|disability|congenital_anomaly|medically_significant). Determines expedited reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) Section C.2.r.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or path to the source documents (e.g., hospital records, lab reports, investigator notes) used to author this narrative, as stored in Veeva Vault eTMF. Supports SDV and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: narrative_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the safety narrative document. Tracks progression from initial authoring through medical monitor review and approval to regulatory submission. 'superseded' indicates a newer version has replaced this record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Argus Safety workflow; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: subject_description
attributes.description: Structured narrative section describing the patient's relevant medical history, demographics (age, sex, weight), concomitant medications, and pre-existing conditions relevant to the adverse event. Contains protected health information (PHI).

attributes.name: treatment_description
attributes.description: Narrative section describing the investigational product(s) and concomitant medications administered, including dose, route, frequency, start and stop dates, and any dose modifications or interruptions relevant to the adverse event.

attributes.name: unblinding_date

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.description: Date on which the signal evaluation was formally referred to the DSMB or DMC for independent safety review. Populated only when is_dsmb_dmc_referral is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Referral Date

attributes.name: evaluation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal signal evaluation was completed and conclusions were finalized. Marks the end of the evaluation lifecycle for this cycle.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; Oracle Argus Safety Signal Management

attributes.name: evaluation_cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential cycle number for this evaluation of the signal (e.g., 1 for initial evaluation, 2 for re-evaluation after new data). Supports tracking of iterative evaluation rounds for the same signal.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX Signal Management; ICH E2E

attributes.name: evaluation_initiated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal signal evaluation process was initiated. Serves as the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this transaction, marking the start of the regulatory evaluation clock.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting; ICH E2E

attributes.name: evaluation_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome determination of the signal evaluation cycle. Indicates whether the signal was confirmed as a new safety finding, refuted by the evidence, or requires ongoing monitoring.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; CIOMS VIII

attributes.name: evaluation_plan_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the evaluation plan, including the scope of data to be reviewed, analytical approach, and objectives for this evaluation cycle.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the signal evaluation workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through completion. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E Pharmacovigilance Planning; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: expedited_report_due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the expedited safety report (e.g., SUSAR) must be submitted to the relevant authority. Calculated from the awareness date per ICH E2A timelines (7 or 15 calendar days).
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: expedited_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signal evaluation triggers an expedited regulatory reporting obligation (e.g., SUSAR 7-day or 15-day report). True = expedited reporting required.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: health_authority_query_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) for any formal query or request for information related to this signal evaluation. Enables traceability of regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GVP Module IX; MHRA; ICH E2E

attributes.name: investigational_product_name
attributes.description: Name of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or drug substance associated with the safety signal under evaluation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GVP Module IX

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the current active version of the signal evaluation. True = current version; False = superseded version. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) pattern in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Principles; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: is_dsmb_dmc_referral
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Referral Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signal evaluation has been referred to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent review. True = referred; False = not referred.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Referral Flag

attributes.name: is_susar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the safety signal under evaluation has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR), triggering specific expedited reporting obligations under ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; EMA GVP Module VI; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Code
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term code representing the primary adverse event or medical concept under evaluation. Used for standardized coding and regulatory reporting alignment.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE Domain

tag_set.value: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Code

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Code
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class code for the primary adverse event under evaluation. Supports aggregate safety reporting by organ system.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; EMA GVP Module IX

tag_set.value: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Code

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Version
attributes.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding the signal evaluation (e.g., 26.0). Ensures reproducibility and regulatory traceability of coding decisions.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM

tag_set.value: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Version

attributes.name: protocol_amendment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signal evaluation has resulted in a recommendation to amend the study protocol (e.g., dose modification, additional safety monitoring, exclusion criteria update).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA GVP Module IX; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_action_justification
attributes.description: Narrative justification for the recommended regulatory action, documenting the clinical and scientific rationale supporting the recommendation.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; ICH E2E

attributes.name: regulatory_action_recommended
attributes.description: Formal regulatory action recommended as an outcome of this signal evaluation. Options include label update, Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (DHPC), study suspension, protocol amendment, Risk Management Plan (RMP) update, or urgent safety
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; ICH E2E; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notified
attributes.description: Identifies the primary regulatory authority notified as part of this signal evaluation outcome. For multi-authority notifications, use 'multiple' and document details in the regulatory action justification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GVP Module IX; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: risk_minimization_measure
attributes.description: Risk minimization measure recommended or implemented as a result of this signal evaluation. Supports Risk Management Plan (RMP) updates and regulatory commitments.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module XVI Risk Minimisation Measures; ICH E2E; FDA REMS

attributes.name: signal_detection_method
attributes.description: Statistical or clinical methodology used to detect the safety signal prior to this evaluation. Examples include disproportionality analysis (PRR, ROR), data mining algorithms, or clinical case series review.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; CIOMS VIII Signal Detection

attributes.name: signal_source
attributes.description: Origin of the safety signal that triggered this evaluation. Identifies whether the signal arose from spontaneous adverse event reports, clinical trial data, published literature, a regulatory authority communication, or DSMB/DMC review.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this signal evaluation record was last modified. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this evaluation record, incremented each time the evaluation is updated or revised. Supports audit trail and version control per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: dsmb_review

attributes.name: dsmb_charter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.dsmb_charter. Business justification: A DSMB review is conducted under a specific charter version that defines stopping rules, alpha spending, and quorum requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dsmb_meeting_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.dsmb_meeting. Business justification: safety.dsmb_review and biostatistics.dsmb_meeting represent the same real-world DSMB event from safety and statistical perspectives respectively.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: interim_analysis_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal interim analysis record associated with this DSMB/DMC review, if applicable. Links safety governance to the statistical interim analysis conducted per the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs for Clinical Trials; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: organization_id
