attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: ALCOA+ attributability requires that every data entry is traceable to a valid consent record. Regulatory inspectors verify that audit trail entries were made under active consent.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: data_entry_session_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the EDC user session during which the data change was performed. Supports security audit, concurrent session analysis, and 21 CFR Part 11 access control review.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(d); Medidata Rave EDC; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: discrepancy_query_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the data query (discrepancy) in the EDC system that triggered this data change, if applicable. Links the audit entry to the query management workflow in Medidata Rave for query-driven change traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: dispensing_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.dispensing_record. Business justification: ALCOA+ compliance requires that audit trail entries for dispensing-related EDC field changes are traceable to the RTSM dispensing record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_field_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_field. Business justification: alcoa_audit_entry captures field-level data changes. ecrf_field is the master field definition.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_form_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_form. Business justification: alcoa_audit_entry captures audit trail entries for data changes on specific eCRF forms. ecrf_form is the master form definition.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: field_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.field_entry. Business justification: ALCOA+ audit trail entries track changes to clinical data. The field_entry product captures atomic-level data entries.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: laboratory_lab_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP require complete audit trails linking every eCRF data change to the source record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this data change occurred. Links the audit entry to the governing study protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the data change originated. Supports site-level audit and monitoring activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: ICH E6 R2 GCP requires ALCOA-compliant audit trails for randomization-related data entries to be traceable to the subject's randomization record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) whose clinical data record was modified. Central linkage for subject-level audit trail review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of data action performed on the eCRF record: CREATE (initial data entry), UPDATE (modification of existing value), DELETE (removal), LOCK (record locked), UNLOCK (record unlocked), SIGN (electronic signature applied), VERIFY (source data verification
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: alcoa_overall_status
attributes.description: Aggregated ALCOA+ compliance status for this audit entry based on evaluation of all nine ALCOA+ attribute flags. COMPLIANT = all flags are True; NON_COMPLIANT = one or more flags are False; UNDER_REVIEW = compliance assessment is pending or in dispute.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; EMA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Protocol-specified coded reason for the data change (e.g., TRANSCRIPTION_ERROR, PROTOCOL_DEVIATION, QUERY_RESOLUTION, MEDICAL_REVIEW). Required for all UPDATE and DELETE actions per GCP and ALCOA+ Accurate requirement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4.9.3; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; GCP

attributes.name: change_reason_text
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation provided by the user for the data change, supplementing the coded reason. Required for UPDATE and DELETE actions to satisfy ALCOA+ Accurate and Attributable requirements. Must be entered at time of change.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4.9.3; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e)

attributes.name: data_entry_lag_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes elapsed between the clinical event date/time (as recorded in the eCRF) and the event_timestamp of this audit entry. Used to assess Contemporaneous compliance — large lags may indicate ALCOA+ violations requiring investigation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Contemporaneous; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: dbl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry was created after the Database Lock (DBL) event for the associated study. Post-lock entries require special authorization and are flagged for regulatory scrutiny. True = post-lock entry; False = pre-lock entry.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC; FDA Guidance on DBL; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: ecrf_version
attributes.description: Version of the eCRF form design active in the EDC system at the time of the data change. Supports traceability of data collected under different form versions across protocol amendments.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: edc_record_reference
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier of the specific eCRF record (data point) within Medidata Rave EDC that was created or modified. Provides direct traceability to the source data record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: edc_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the EDC system that generated this audit entry (e.g., Medidata Rave). Supports multi-system audit trail consolidation and system-level traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Available

attributes.name: edc_system_version
attributes.description: Version of the EDC software at the time the audit entry was generated. Required for regulatory inspection readiness to demonstrate system validation status at the time of data entry.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); ICH E6(R2) §5.5.3; GAMP 5

attributes.name: esignature_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the electronic signature applied to this audit entry, where applicable (e.g., for SIGN action types or investigator-verified records). Links to the 21 CFR Part 11 compliant e-signature record in Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: esignature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the electronic signature was applied to this record, where applicable. Distinct from the event_timestamp (data change time). Required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance on signed records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated, non-editable timestamp recording the exact date and time the data change event occurred in the EDC system. Satisfies the Contemporaneous requirement of ALCOA+. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §5.5.3; ALCOA+

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the workstation or device from which the EDC user performed the data change. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 access control audit and security investigation. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(d); GDPR Article 4; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: is_accurate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Accurate requirement of ALCOA+: the data value is correct, and any change is accompanied by a valid change reason. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_attributable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Attributable requirement of ALCOA+: the data change is traceable to the individual who made it (user_identifier is populated and valid). True = compliant; False = compliance gap requiring remediation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Available requirement of ALCOA+: the record is accessible for review by authorized personnel and regulatory inspectors throughout the required retention period. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(c); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Complete requirement of ALCOA+: all required fields for this data change are populated with no missing mandatory data. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_consistent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Consistent requirement of ALCOA+: the data change is internally consistent with other related data points and does not introduce contradictions within the subject record.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_contemporaneous
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Contemporaneous requirement of ALCOA+: the event_timestamp reflects the actual time of data entry or change, not a backdated or delayed entry. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_enduring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Enduring requirement of ALCOA+: the record is stored in a durable, non-erasable medium and will be retained for the required regulatory retention period. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(c); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_legible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Legible requirement of ALCOA+: the data values (original and new) are readable and interpretable. True = compliant; False = compliance gap (e.g., corrupted or unreadable data).
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_original
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Original requirement of ALCOA+: the data represents the first recorded observation or a properly documented change from the original. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The data value entered or updated in the eCRF field as a result of this change event. NULL for DELETE actions. Satisfies the Accurate requirement of ALCOA+ by capturing the current authoritative value.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) §4.9.3

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: The data value that existed in the eCRF field before the change was applied. NULL for CREATE actions. Satisfies the Original requirement of ALCOA+ by preserving the prior state of the data.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) §4.9.3

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit entry record was written to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp (the EDC system event time). Supports data pipeline lineage and ingestion audit.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; ALCOA+ Enduring

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of Source Data Verification (SDV) for the data change captured in this audit entry. NOT_REQUIRED = SDV not mandated per monitoring plan; PENDING = awaiting CRA review; VERIFIED = CRA confirmed data matches source; FAILED = discrepancy found during
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+

attributes.name: sdv_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when Source Data Verification was completed for this audit entry. Populated only when sdv_status is VERIFIED or FAILED. Supports monitoring visit reporting and SDV coverage metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sdv_user_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the CRA or authorized user who performed Source Data Verification for this audit entry. Provides attribution for the SDV action per GCP monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: study_protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol in effect at the time of the data change. Ensures the audit entry is contextualized against the correct protocol amendment, supporting protocol deviation analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: Role of the EDC user at the time of the data change (e.g., CRC - Clinical Research Coordinator, CRA - Clinical Research Associate, PI - Principal Investigator, DATA_MANAGER). Captured at event time to support role-based audit analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; GCP; ALCOA+ Attributable

attributes.name: visit_name
attributes.description: Name of the study visit (e.g., Screening, Week 4, End of Treatment) associated with the eCRF record that was modified. Contextualizes the data change within the study schedule of events.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: ip_address

attributes.name: is_double_data_entry

attributes.name: is_source_data_verified

attributes.name: is_training_mode

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale setting (language and country) of the user interface during this data entry session (e.g., en_US, ja_JP), relevant for multi-regional trials.

attributes.name: lock_timestamp

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether data entered during this session was flagged as a potential protocol deviation requiring further review.

attributes.name: queries_generated_count
attributes.description: Number of data queries (discrepancies) automatically generated by edit checks during this session, requiring resolution.

attributes.name: save_count
attributes.description: Number of times the user saved data during this session, indicating session complexity and user behavior patterns.

attributes.name: session_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the data entry session, used for audit trail references and query management communications.

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Classification of the data entry session indicating the nature of the data entry activity being performed.

attributes.name: signature_status
attributes.description: Status of the electronic signature applied to the data entered during this session, per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the electronic signature was applied to the data entered in this session.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the data entry session was initiated by the user in the EDC system. This is the principal business event timestamp.

attributes.name: data_entry_session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the data entry session indicating whether it is active, completed, or terminated.

attributes.name: timezone_offset
attributes.description: UTC timezone offset of the user's location during the data entry session, critical for accurate timestamp reconciliation in global trials.

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: Role of the user performing data entry during this session, determining access permissions and workflow routing.

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR §312; GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; ISO 15189

attributes.name: disposition_status

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: fasting_status
attributes.description: Fasting status at collection; implements SDTM --FAST (CDISC CT NY codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBFAST Variable; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: has_deviation
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation or collection irregularity was recorded for this specimen collection event. True = deviation present; False = no deviation. Triggers downstream deviation management workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: hemolysis_grade
attributes.description: Visual or instrument-assessed grade of hemolysis (red blood cell rupture) in the collected blood specimen. Hemolysis can interfere with laboratory assay results and may require recollection.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI EP7-A2; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: is_unscheduled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specimen collection was an unscheduled (ad hoc) event not defined in the original study protocol visit schedule. True = unscheduled; False = protocol-scheduled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM VISITDY; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: lipemia_grade
attributes.description: Visual or instrument-assessed grade of lipemia (excess lipids causing turbidity) in the collected specimen. Lipemia can interfere with photometric assay results.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI EP7-A2; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: nominal_time_point
attributes.description: Protocol-defined nominal time point label for PK/PD sample collection (e.g., 'Pre-dose', '0.5h', '1h', '2h', '4h', '8h', '24h'). Used to align actual collection times to protocol-scheduled PK sampling windows.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PCTPTNOM Variable; FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: processing_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which pre-analytical processing of the specimen was completed at the collection site (e.g., centrifugation, aliquoting). Used to calculate processing turnaround time and assess sample integrity.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189

attributes.name: recollection_reason
attributes.description: Reason why a repeat specimen collection is required. Populated when recollection_required = True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insufficient_volume|hemolysis|lipemia|clotted|mislabeled|lost_in_transit|expired_kit|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM LB Domain

attributes.name: recollection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a repeat specimen collection is required due to inadequate sample, collection deviation, or laboratory rejection. True = recollection needed; False = no recollection required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: sample_adequacy
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the collected specimen volume and quality are sufficient to perform all protocol-required laboratory analyses. Determined at the time of collection or upon receipt at the laboratory.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM LB Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: scheduled_collection_timestamp
attributes.description: The protocol-defined date and time at which the specimen collection was planned to occur per the study visit schedule. Used to calculate collection timing deviations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TV Domain; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Specimen type; implements SDTM --SPEC (CDISC CT SPECTYPE codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBSPEC Variable; CDISC Controlled Terminology

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the specimen was stored at the collection site prior to shipment to the central laboratory. Deviations from protocol-specified storage conditions may compromise sample integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance

attributes.name: time_from_dose_hours
attributes.description: Elapsed time in hours between the subject's most recent investigational product dose and the specimen collection. Critical for PK (Pharmacokinetics) and DMPK (Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics) sample timing analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain (Pharmacokinetics Concentrations); FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: tube_count
attributes.description: The total number of tubes, vials, or containers collected during this specimen collection event. Used for chain-of-custody tracking and sample accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specimen collection record was last modified. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: volume_collected_ml
attributes.description: Total volume of specimen collected from the subject, expressed in millilitres (mL). Critical for PK/PD studies and for verifying adequacy of sample for planned assays.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBVOL; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume collected. Typically mL for blood/urine, but may be µL for microsampling or g for tissue. Ensures unambiguous interpretation of volume_collected_ml.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBVOLU; CDISC Controlled Terminology; SI Units

products.name: specimen_shipment
products.description: Transactional record tracking the shipment of specimens from a clinical site to a central or reference laboratory. Captures shipment manifest ID, origin site, destination lab facility, courier name, tracking number, shipment date/time, expected arrival
products.reference: IATA P650; CDISC SDTM SD Domain

attributes.name: specimen_shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the specimen shipment record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination central or reference laboratory facility receiving the shipment. Supports routing and receipt confirmation.
attributes.references: CLIA; CAP Accreditation; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: service_level_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.service_level_agreement. Business justification: Specimen shipment SLAs govern receipt confirmation turnaround, temperature excursion notification, and rejection reporting timelines.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_manifest_id
attributes.description: Externally assigned manifest identifier accompanying the shipment package, used to reconcile specimens at the receiving laboratory. Typically generated by the CTMS or laboratory information system.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study under which the specimens were collected and shipped. Links shipment to the sponsoring protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical site (origin) from which the specimens were dispatched. Supports chain-of-custody traceability back to the collecting site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date and time at which the receiving laboratory confirmed physical receipt of the shipment. Used to calculate transit duration and assess specimen integrity against stability windows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; CDISC LAB

attributes.name: airbill_number
attributes.description: Air waybill or bill of lading number issued by the carrier for international or air freight shipments. Required for customs clearance and IATA dangerous goods documentation.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IATA P650; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the specimens included in this shipment were collected from study subjects. Used to calculate specimen age at receipt and assess stability compliance.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB domain; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or observations recorded by site staff, courier, or laboratory personnel regarding the shipment (e.g., packaging condition on arrival, partial delivery notes).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: courier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier or courier service responsible for transporting the shipment (e.g., World Courier, FedEx Clinical, Marken). Supports vendor performance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: courier_service_level
attributes.description: Service tier selected for the shipment (e.g., overnight, two-day, international priority). Determines expected transit time and cost classification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this specimen shipment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: customs_declaration_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the customs or import/export declaration filed for international specimen shipments. Required for cross-border regulatory compliance and specimen release at destination.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; Health Canada; TGA

attributes.name: destination_lab_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the receiving central or reference laboratory. Denormalized for manifest documentation and rapid chain-of-custody reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; CAP accreditation; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: dry_ice_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of dry ice (in kilograms) included in the shipment package. Required for IATA dangerous goods declaration when dry ice is used as a refrigerant. Applicable only when temperature_condition = dry_ice.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations Section 2.7; IATA P650

attributes.name: excursion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes during which the shipment temperature was outside the acceptable range. Used by the laboratory to assess specimen viability and document deviation impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: excursion_max_temp_c
attributes.description: Highest temperature (in degrees Celsius) recorded by the temperature monitor/data logger during transit. Populated only when a temperature excursion is detected. Supports specimen impact assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: excursion_min_temp_c
attributes.description: Lowest temperature (in degrees Celsius) recorded by the temperature monitor/data logger during transit. Populated only when a temperature excursion is detected. Supports specimen impact assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the shipment is expected to arrive at the destination laboratory, as agreed with the courier at time of dispatch. Used to trigger overdue alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains materials classified as hazardous (e.g., Category B biological substances, dry ice). True = hazardous declaration required; False = non-hazardous. Drives IATA dangerous goods documentation requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IATA P650; UN 3373 (Category B biological substances)

attributes.name: import_permit_number
attributes.description: Regulatory import permit or authorization number required for cross-border shipment of biological specimens in certain jurisdictions. Ensures compliance with national biosafety and import regulations.
attributes.references: IATA P650; EU CTR 536/2014; Health Canada; TGA; PMDA

attributes.name: lab_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated contact person at the receiving laboratory responsible for accepting and processing the shipment. Used for courier delivery confirmation and discrepancy resolution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: origin_site_number
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned or regulatory site number of the clinical site dispatching the specimens. Denormalized for chain-of-custody documentation and regulatory audit trail without requiring a join.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging used for the shipment, indicating the thermal protection and containment method. Relevant for regulatory compliance with IATA P650 and specimen integrity documentation.
attributes.references: IATA P650 (biological substances); IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: protocol_visit_name
attributes.description: Name or label of the study protocol visit (e.g., Day 1, Week 4, End of Treatment) associated with the specimen collection event. Supports SDTM domain mapping and visit-level reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: receipt_confirmed_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the laboratory staff member who confirmed receipt of the shipment. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: received_specimen_count
attributes.description: Actual number of specimens confirmed by the receiving laboratory upon opening the shipment. Compared against specimen_count to identify discrepancies or missing specimens.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the shipment was rejected at the receiving laboratory (e.g., temperature excursion, broken specimens, incorrect labeling, missing manifest). Populated only when shipment_status = rejected.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Date and time at which the shipment was handed over to the courier at the originating clinical site. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the specimen shipment. Drives chain-of-custody workflow and exception management. Values: pending (prepared, not yet dispatched), in_transit (with courier), delivered (courier confirmed delivery), received (lab confirmed
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: shipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shipment by its clinical purpose. Values: routine (standard scheduled collection), urgent (expedited for safety or protocol reasons), pk_sample (Pharmacokinetics samples requiring strict timing), biomarker (exploratory biomarker
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: specimen_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual specimen tubes, aliquots, or containers included in this shipment as declared on the manifest. Used for reconciliation at receipt.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: subject_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct study subjects whose specimens are included in this shipment. Supports subject-level reconciliation and enrollment tracking at the laboratory.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB

attributes.name: temperature_condition
attributes.description: Required temperature storage and transport condition for the shipment as specified in the laboratory manual. Critical for specimen integrity. Values: ambient (15–25°C), refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (-20°C), dry_ice (-78°C), liquid_nitrogen (-196°C).
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2); IATA P650 (biological substances); CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion (deviation outside the acceptable range) was detected during transit. True = excursion occurred; False = no excursion. Triggers specimen usability assessment workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Upper bound of the acceptable temperature range (in degrees Celsius) for this shipment as defined in the study laboratory manual. Used to evaluate temperature excursion severity.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2); CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Lower bound of the acceptable temperature range (in degrees Celsius) for this shipment as defined in the study laboratory manual. Used to evaluate temperature excursion severity.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB; ICH E6(R2); CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: temperature_monitor_code
attributes.description: Serial number or identifier of the temperature data logger or indicator device placed in the shipment. Enables retrieval of the full temperature log for excursion investigation and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAP accreditation; IATA P650

attributes.name: temperature_monitor_type
attributes.description: Type of temperature monitoring device included in the shipment. Data_logger provides continuous electronic recording; indicator_card provides a visual pass/fail indicator; none indicates no monitoring device was used.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAP accreditation standards; IATA P650

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment package, enabling real-time logistics monitoring and proof-of-delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (for dry ice/biological specimens)

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: United Nations dangerous goods classification number for the shipment contents (e.g., UN3373 for Category B biological substances, UN1845 for dry ice). Required on shipping labels and documentation when hazardous_material_flag is True.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; UN Model Regulations; IATA P650

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this specimen shipment record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

products.name: reference_range
products.description: Master definition of laboratory reference ranges (normal ranges) for analytes, with full version history. Captures analyte/LOINC code, lower and upper normal limits, unit of measure, sex, age range, ethnicity applicability, specimen type, lab facility
products.reference: CDISC SDTM LB LBORNRLO/LBORNRHI; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: reference_range_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reference range record in the laboratory master. Primary key for the reference_range data product.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id

attributes.name: lab_analyte_id

attributes.name: lab_facility_id

attributes.name: lab_panel_id

attributes.name: organization_id

attributes.name: protocol_id

attributes.name: sap_id

attributes.name: study_id

attributes.name: submission_id

attributes.name: age_max

attributes.name: age_min

attributes.name: age_unit

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval lifecycle status of this reference range version. Only approved ranges are used for out-of-range flagging and CTCAE grading in clinical trial lab results.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reference range version was formally approved by the authorized laboratory or sponsor personnel. Part of the GCP-required audit trail.

attributes.name: change_reason

attributes.name: change_reason_detail

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this reference range version became or becomes effective for use in clinical trial lab result evaluation and out-of-range flagging.

attributes.name: ethnicity_applicability

attributes.name: instrument_code

attributes.name: is_current_version

attributes.name: is_sponsor_defined

attributes.name: lab_accreditation_standard

attributes.name: loinc_code

attributes.name: actual_time_post_dose_hours
attributes.description: Calculated elapsed time in hours between the actual dose administration time and the actual sample collection time. Distinct from nominal_time_hours; used as the primary time variable in PK concentration-time profiles and non-compartmental analysis (NCA).

attributes.name: analyte_name
attributes.description: The name of the drug compound, metabolite, or biomarker being measured in this PK sample (e.g., parent compound, active metabolite, total drug). Corresponds to CDISC SDTM PC.PCTEST.

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: The method used to collect the biological sample from the subject. Relevant for bioanalytical method validation and potential pre-analytical variability assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCLOC; ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Guidance

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: PK sample collection date/time; implements SDTM PC.PCDTC
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCDTC; ICH E6(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: The type of collection container or tube used for the PK sample. Determines anticoagulant/additive present, which affects matrix type (plasma vs serum) and bioanalytical method compatibility. Critical for pre-analytical quality control.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTUBE; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this PK sample record was first created in the source system (EDC or LIMS). Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Represents the ALCOA+ 'contemporaneous' requirement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dose_administration_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time of the reference dose administration used to calculate actual time post-dose for this sample. Sourced from the dosing record in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Required for accurate ATPT calculation per CDISC SDTM PC domain conventions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCRFTDTC; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: dose_number
attributes.description: The sequential dose number relative to which this PK sample was collected (e.g., 1 for first dose, steady-state dose number). Critical for distinguishing single-dose PK from multiple-dose/steady-state PK profiles in DMPK analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCRFTDTC reference dose; CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: edc_form_reference
attributes.description: The reference identifier of the eCRF form in the EDC system (Medidata Rave) where this PK sample collection event was recorded. Enables direct traceability from the silver-layer data product back to the source EDC record for SDV and audit purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; Medidata Rave eCRF

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for excluding this PK sample from the primary analysis dataset. Populated only when sample_exclusion_flag is True. Examples include 'Outside sampling window', 'Haemolysed sample', 'Vomiting within 2h of dose', 'Bioanalytical
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E9; Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP)

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: The number of freeze-thaw cycles the PK sample has undergone. Excessive freeze-thaw cycles can degrade analyte stability and invalidate bioanalytical results.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018)

attributes.name: lab_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the PK sample was received and logged at the bioanalytical or central laboratory. Used to calculate total sample transit time and to verify cold-chain compliance. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: nominal_time_hours

attributes.name: nominal_time_point
attributes.description: The protocol-specified nominal time point for sample collection relative to dose administration (e.g., 'Pre-dose', '0.5h', '1h', '2h', '4h', '8h', '24h'). Used as the planned time point label in PK analysis and SDTM PC domain mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPTNOM; ICH E3 Section 11.4; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: pre_dose_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample is a pre-dose (trough/baseline) collection. True = pre-dose sample; False = post-dose sample. Pre-dose samples are used to assess trough concentrations, baseline drug levels, and accumulation ratios in multiple-dose PK
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPT; CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current processing stage of the PK sample from collection through shipment to the bioanalytical laboratory. Distinct from sample_status (overall lifecycle); this tracks the physical processing workflow.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the sample was processed (e.g., centrifuged and aliquoted) after collection. Time from collection to processing is a critical pre-analytical variable that can affect analyte stability and bioanalytical results.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation was associated with this PK sample collection event (e.g., collection outside the acceptable sampling window, incorrect tube used, missed collection). True = deviation present; False = no deviation.

attributes.name: sample_code

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCREFID; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: sample_condition_on_receipt

attributes.name: sample_exclusion_flag

attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC ANL01FL; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: sample_status

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Medidata Rave specimen workflow; ICH E6(R2) GCP
