attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The protocol-assigned subject number (e.g., site-subject identifier such as 001-001) used to identify the participant in regulatory submissions and PK analysis datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SUBJID; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA 45 CFR §164; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this PK sample record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail and data integrity monitoring under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Used to detect unauthorized or unexplained data changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: volume_collected_ml
attributes.description: The actual volume of biological sample collected from the subject, expressed in millilitres. Used for sample sufficiency assessment, bioanalytical aliquoting planning, and protocol compliance verification against the required volume specified in the PK
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCVOL; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH M10

attributes.name: volume_required_ml
attributes.description: The protocol-specified minimum volume of sample required for the PK assay at this time point, expressed in millilitres. Used to assess whether the collected volume meets protocol requirements and to flag insufficient sample events.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Study Protocol PK Sampling Schedule; ICH M10

attributes.name: within_sampling_window
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual sample collection time falls within the protocol-defined acceptable PK sampling window for this nominal time point. True = within window (compliant); False = outside window (potential protocol deviation).
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E3 Section 11.4; 21 CFR Part 312

products.name: bioanalytical_assay
products.description: Master definition of a validated bioanalytical assay used to quantify drug concentrations, biomarkers, or immunogenicity in clinical trial samples. Captures assay name, analyte measured, assay type (LC-MS/MS, ELISA, ECL, PCR, flow cytometry), validation
products.reference: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the bioanalytical assay record in the lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a validated analytical method owned and managed by the bioanalytical laboratory.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018)

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Bioanalytical method validation requires a qualified scientist's approval per 21 CFR Part 58 and EMA bioanalytical guidelines.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.clinical_program. Business justification: Bioanalytical assays are developed, validated, and owned at the program level for a specific investigational compound.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: GLP/GCP bioanalytical assays must reference their validated method SOP. Regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA bioanalytical section) and FDA/EMA inspections require direct traceability from
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: FDA/EMA bioanalytical method validation guidance requires each validated assay to be linked to the specific IMP it measures.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Bioanalytical assays are validated to measure specific investigational products.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A bioanalytical assay is validated and performed at a specific laboratory facility.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.master_service_agreement. Business justification: Bioanalytical assays are performed by contract labs under MSAs specifying validated method requirements, LLOQ/ULOQ standards, GLP compliance, and regulatory submission
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.organization. Business justification: Bioanalytical assays are sponsor-commissioned and sponsor-owned; method validation reports are regulatory submissions tied to a specific sponsor's IND/NDA.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pipeline_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.pipeline_asset. Business justification: A bioanalytical assay is developed and validated to measure a specific investigational compound or metabolite (pipeline asset).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to, for study context and traceability.

attributes.name: validation_tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Bioanalytical validation reports are TMF documents (DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 3, Section 3.2).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Mean accuracy of the assay expressed as percent of nominal concentration (%Nominal) at QC levels during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically 85–115% (80–120% at LLOQ). Stored as the worst-case value across QC levels.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: analyte_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the analyte type measured by the assay. Distinguishes small molecule drugs (PK), large molecule biologics, biomarkers (PD), immunogenicity (anti-drug antibodies), metabolites, and endogenous compounds.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: analyte_name
attributes.description: Name of the substance being measured by the assay (e.g., drug compound, metabolite, biomarker, anti-drug antibody). Directly links the assay to the pharmacokinetic (PK), pharmacodynamic (PD), or immunogenicity endpoint it supports.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: assay_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the assay by the bioanalytical laboratory or sponsor (e.g., 'BA-LC-001', 'ELISA-TNF-003'). Used as the business identifier across CTMS, EDC, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011)

attributes.name: assay_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the bioanalytical assay as used in study protocols, validation reports, and regulatory submissions (e.g., 'LC-MS/MS Assay for Compound XYZ in Human Plasma'). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation

attributes.name: assay_purpose
attributes.description: Primary scientific purpose the assay serves within the clinical or nonclinical program. PK (Pharmacokinetics) assays measure drug concentration over time; PD (Pharmacodynamics) assays measure biological effect; Immunogenicity assays detect anti-drug
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Analytical technology platform used to perform the assay. Common types include LC-MS/MS (Liquid Chromatography-Tandem Mass Spectrometry), ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay), ECL (Electrochemiluminescence), PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction), Flow
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: calibration_curve_model
attributes.description: Mathematical regression model used to fit the calibration curve for back-calculation of analyte concentrations from instrument response. Common models include Linear (1/x or 1/x² weighting), Quadratic, 4-Parameter Logistic (4PL), and 5-Parameter Logistic
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: cdisc_test_code
attributes.description: CDISC test code; implements SDTM PC.PCTESTCD
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA SDTM Submission Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bioanalytical assay record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cut_point_method
attributes.description: Statistical method used to establish the screening and confirmatory cut points for immunogenicity (anti-drug antibody) assays (e.g., 'Parametric 5th percentile', 'Non-parametric 5th percentile').
attributes.references: FDA Immunogenicity Testing Guidance (2019); EMA Guideline on Immunogenicity Assessment; ICH M10

attributes.name: dilution_integrity_factor
attributes.description: Maximum validated dilution factor that can be applied to samples exceeding the ULOQ while maintaining assay accuracy and precision within acceptance criteria. Samples requiring dilution beyond this factor must be flagged.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the assay validation is no longer considered current and re-validation or re-qualification is required. Relevant for long-running studies where assay reagents, reference standards, or critical reagents may expire.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: gcp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assay is performed under Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards as required for clinical trial sample analysis. True = GCP-compliant; False = non-GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: glp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assay was validated and is performed under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations. GLP compliance is required for nonclinical safety studies submitted to regulatory agencies. True = GLP-compliant; False = non-GLP.
attributes.references: GLP (21 CFR Part 58); OECD Principles of GLP; EMA GLP Directive 2004/10/EC

attributes.name: inter_run_precision_cv
attributes.description: Between-run precision expressed as percent coefficient of variation (%CV) across multiple analytical runs during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically ≤15% (%CV). Stored as the worst-case value across QC levels.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: internal_standard
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal standard (IS) used in the assay for quantification normalization (e.g., stable isotope-labeled analog, structural analog).
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: intra_run_precision_cv
attributes.description: Within-run precision expressed as percent coefficient of variation (%CV) at the QC concentration levels, as determined during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically ≤15% (%CV), or ≤20% at LLOQ.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: lloq
attributes.description: Lower Limit of Quantification — the lowest analyte concentration that can be reliably quantified with acceptable accuracy and precision per the validated method. Expressed in the unit defined by lloq_uloq_unit.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10; CDISC SDTM PC Domain

attributes.name: lloq_uloq_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the LLOQ and ULOQ values (e.g., 'ng/mL', 'pg/mL', 'µg/mL', 'nM'). Must be consistent with the unit reported in PK/PD concentration data submitted to regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: long_term_stability_days
attributes.description: Number of days for which analyte stability in the biological matrix at long-term storage conditions (typically -20°C or -70°C) has been validated. Samples stored beyond this period require re-validation of stability before results can be reported.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: matrix_effect_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether matrix effect (ion suppression/enhancement for LC-MS/MS; non-specific binding for LBA) was formally evaluated during validation. True = matrix effect experiments conducted; False = not assessed.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: matrix_type
attributes.description: Specimen matrix type; implements SDTM PC.PCSPEC (CDISC CT SPECTYPE codelist)
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: parallelism_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether parallelism (serial dilution of incurred samples producing results parallel to the calibration curve) was assessed. Relevant primarily for LBA and immunogenicity assays. True = parallelism assessed; False = not assessed.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: reference_standard_lot
attributes.description: Lot number of the certified reference standard used to prepare calibration standards and quality control (QC) samples. Traceability of the reference standard lot is required for regulatory submissions and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); USP Reference Standards; ICH M10

attributes.name: sample_volume_required_ul
attributes.description: Minimum volume of biological matrix (in microliters) required per sample aliquot for a single assay run. Used for specimen collection planning, biobank management, and feasibility assessment of retrospective analyses.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; CDISC SDTM BS Domain

attributes.name: selectivity_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether selectivity (absence of interference from endogenous matrix components) was formally assessed during validation. True = selectivity experiments conducted and documented; False = not assessed.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: Biological species for which the assay has been validated. Assays validated in human matrices may differ from those validated in preclinical animal species used in DMPK studies. Drives applicability to clinical vs. nonclinical programs.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: sponsor_assay_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned identifier for the assay as referenced in the study protocol, the source system, or regulatory submission. May differ from the CRO's internal assay code. Required for cross-referencing sponsor documents with CRO laboratory records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA IND (21 CFR Part 312); CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: stability_freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles for which analyte stability in the biological matrix has been validated. Samples subjected to more freeze-thaw cycles than validated must be flagged or excluded from analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage temperature and conditions for samples analyzed by this assay (e.g., '-70°C ± 10°C', '-20°C', '2–8°C'). Defines the chain-of-custody storage requirement for clinical samples to maintain analyte integrity.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; ICH Q1A Stability Testing

attributes.name: superseded_by_assay_code
attributes.description: Assay code of the newer version that replaces this assay when it is retired or superseded. Supports version lineage tracking and ensures historical sample results can be linked to the correct assay version.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; ALCOA+

attributes.name: uloq
attributes.description: Upper Limit of Quantification — the highest analyte concentration that can be reliably quantified within the validated dynamic range. Samples above ULOQ must be diluted and re-assayed. Expressed in the unit defined by lloq_uloq_unit.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the bioanalytical assay record. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Tracks when assay parameters, validation status, or metadata were last changed.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bioanalytical method validation was formally completed and the validation report was approved. Marks the point from which the assay is considered fit for regulated use in clinical sample analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory validation tier of the assay. 'Validated' indicates full GLP/GCP-compliant validation per FDA/EMA/ICH M10 guidelines; 'Qualified' indicates fit-for-purpose qualification; 'Exploratory' indicates early-phase research use only; 'In
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the assay method (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1'). Incremented when the assay undergoes method changes requiring partial or full re-validation. Enables traceability of which assay version was used for each study's sample analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: weighting_factor
attributes.description: Statistical weighting factor applied to the calibration curve regression to minimize heteroscedasticity (e.g., '1/x', '1/x²', 'none'). Documented in the validation report and applied consistently during sample analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

products.name: bioanalytical_result
products.description: Transactional record of a bioanalytical or biomarker assay result from a clinical trial PK/PD, DMPK, or exploratory biomarker sample. Captures assay run ID, sample ID, analyte/biomarker measured, concentration or categorical result value, unit/scale
products.reference: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: bioanalytical_result_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each bioanalytical or biomarker assay result record in the clinical trial laboratory data product. Serves as the primary key for the silver-layer lakehouse table.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domain; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_arm. Business justification: PK/PD exposure analysis by treatment arm is a core pharmacokinetic reporting requirement. Arm-level PK parameter comparisons (e.g., AUC, Cmax by dose group) are required for regulatory
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_assay. Business justification: A bioanalytical result is produced by executing a specific validated bioanalytical assay.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: blinding_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.blinding_config. Business justification: Bioanalytical/PK concentration results directly reveal treatment assignment in blinded studies. Blinding_config governs access restrictions for unblinded statisticians vs.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: Bioanalytical data sharing with third parties (CROs, partners, regulators) requires subject consent verification.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_epoch. Business justification: PK/PD results must be epoch-stratified for NCA (single-dose vs steady-state epochs) and SDTM PC domain mapping.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A bioanalytical result is generated at a specific laboratory facility. The existing laboratory_code STRING column is a denormalized reference to lab_facility.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: FDA/EMA bioanalytical method validation guidance requires traceability from drug concentration results to the specific IMP manufacture batch.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pk_analysis_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.pk_analysis_spec. Business justification: Bioanalytical results are processed into PK parameters according to a specific PK analysis spec (LLOQ handling, NCA rules, exclusion criteria).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pk_sample_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological specimen record from which this assay result was derived. Supports chain-of-custody traceability from collection through analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCREFID; 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP)

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this bioanalytical result was generated. Links the result to the governing protocol, sponsor, and regulatory context.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_visit_schedule. Business justification: PK/PD bioanalytical results must be mapped to protocol-defined sampling visits for SDTM PC/PP domain generation and NCA analysis.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: PK/bioanalytical analysis (NCA, population PK, exposure-response) requires treatment arm and dose level from randomization.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) from whom the bioanalytical sample was collected. Enables subject-level PK/PD profiling and safety linkage.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA

attributes.name: actual_time_point
attributes.description: The actual elapsed time (in hours post-dose) at which the sample was collected, calculated from the dose administration timestamp and sample collection timestamp. Used in non-compartmental and compartmental PK analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA PK Guidance; ICH E14

attributes.name: analysis_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bioanalytical assay was performed and the result was generated by the laboratory instrument or system. Distinct from collection timestamp; used for audit trail and turnaround time tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: assay_platform
attributes.description: Analytical technology platform used to generate this result. Determines method-specific acceptance criteria and regulatory validation requirements. Values include LC-MS/MS (liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry), ELISA, ECL
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; ICH Q2(R1)

attributes.name: assay_run_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the bioanalytical laboratory to the analytical run (batch) in which this sample was processed. Used to link results to calibration curve and QC sample performance for the run. Maps to PCRUNID in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCRUNID; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: calibration_curve_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the calibration curve for the analytical run met pre-defined acceptance criteria (e.g., ≥75% of calibrators within ±15% of nominal, ±20% at LLOQ). A failed calibration curve invalidates all results from the run.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: categorical_result
attributes.description: Qualitative or categorical result for assays that produce non-numeric outcomes (e.g., POSITIVE/NEGATIVE for immunogenicity, BELOW_LLOQ for concentrations below the lower limit of quantification). Null when numeric_result is populated.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSTRESC; FDA Immunogenicity Guidance 2019

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the biological sample was collected from the subject. The principal real-world event time for this bioanalytical result record. Maps to PCDTC in CDISC SDTM PC domain. Conforms to ISO 8601 format.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCDTC; ISO 8601; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bioanalytical result record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: The dilution factor applied to the sample prior to analysis when the original concentration exceeded the ULOQ. The reported result incorporates this factor. Maps to PCDILIND/PCDILUTN in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCDILUTN; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result has been excluded from the primary PK/PD analysis dataset (e.g., due to protocol deviation, sample integrity issue, or statistical outlier determination per the Statistical Analysis Plan).
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; FDA PK Guidance

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for excluding this result from the PK/PD analysis dataset. Required when exclusion_flag is true. Examples: 'Sample collected outside protocol window', 'Hemolyzed sample', 'Calibration curve failure', 'Subject vomited within 2
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; ICH E9(R1); FDA PK Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles the sample underwent prior to analysis. Stability data from method validation defines the maximum allowable cycles; exceedance may invalidate the result.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: isr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample was selected for Incurred Sample Reanalysis (ISR), a regulatory requirement to demonstrate reproducibility of results in authentic study samples. ISR is mandatory for pivotal PK studies submitted to FDA and EMA.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; Crystal City IV Workshop

attributes.name: isr_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the Incurred Sample Reanalysis (ISR) assessment. PASS indicates the original and repeat results agree within ±20% of their mean for ≥67% of ISR samples. FAIL triggers investigation. NOT_APPLICABLE when isr_flag is false.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: lloq
attributes.description: The lowest concentration of analyte in a sample that can be quantitatively determined with acceptable precision and accuracy for this validated method and run. Used to flag results as BLQ (below limit of quantification).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCLLOQ; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: matrix_type
attributes.description: Type of biological matrix from which the sample was derived and analyzed. Determines applicable method validation parameters and reference ranges. Maps to PCSPEC in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSPEC; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: nominal_time_point
attributes.description: The protocol-specified time point (in hours post-dose) at which the sample was scheduled to be collected (e.g., 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0, 24.0). Used as the reference for PK modeling and deviation calculation. Maps to PCTPTNUM in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCTPTNUM; ICH E14; FDA PK Guidance

attributes.name: numeric_result
attributes.description: Numeric result; implements SDTM PC.PCSTRESN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSTRESN; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: qc_sample_performance
attributes.description: Overall acceptance outcome for the QC samples (low, medium, high QC) within the analytical run. PASS indicates ≥67% of QC samples within ±15% of nominal with at least 50% at each level passing. FAIL invalidates the run. MARGINAL triggers scientific review.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; ICH Q2(R1)

attributes.name: result_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the bioanalytical result type: PK_CONCENTRATION (pharmacokinetic drug/metabolite concentration), BIOMARKER (pharmacodynamic or disease biomarker), IMMUNOGENICITY (anti-drug antibody or neutralizing antibody), EXPLORATORY
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; ICH E16 Biomarker Qualification; FDA Biomarker Guidance

attributes.name: result_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment entered by the bioanalytical scientist or laboratory reviewer providing additional context for the result (e.g., instrument flags, unusual chromatography, sample appearance notes). Maps to PCORRES or PCCOMMENT in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: result_reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validated bioanalytical result was formally reported and released by the laboratory to the sponsor or data management team. Marks the transition from laboratory-internal to reportable status.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the bioanalytical result indicating whether it is reportable for inclusion in the clinical database, requires repeat analysis, or has been invalidated. Drives data flow into EDC and CDISC SDTM datasets.

attributes.name: sample_stability_flag

attributes.references: CAP; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 15189:2022; UKAS; DAkkS; A2LA; FDA 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: certification_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: gcp_compliant

attributes.name: inspection_outcome

attributes.name: issue_date

attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022; CAP; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lab_director_name

attributes.name: lab_director_qualification
attributes.description: Professional qualifications, credentials, or certifications held by the laboratory director (e.g., MD, PhD, FACB, FRCPA). Required to verify director eligibility under CLIA and accrediting body requirements.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493 Subpart M; CAP; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: lab_type

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

attributes.name: last_inspection_outcome

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: previous_certificate_number

attributes.name: proficiency_testing_program

attributes.name: qualification_assessment_date

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: recognition_type
attributes.description: The specific type of certification or regulatory recognition granted by this health authority to the facility (e.g., CLIA for FDA, GLP for EMA, GCP for PMDA). Sourced directly from detection-phase relationship_data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2), 21 CFR Part 58, OECD GLP Principles

attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory's accreditation record is currently eligible to be cited in regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, CTD/eCTD). Derived from accreditation status, expiry, and CAPA closure but stored as an explicit business flag for
attributes.references: FDA IND 21 CFR Part 312; FDA NDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA MAA; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH M4 CTD; eCTD

attributes.name: kit_number

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: kit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the kit by specimen matrix type (e.g., blood, urine, tissue). Determines the collection containers and preservatives included. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blood|urine|saliva|tissue|csf|stool|buccal_swab|plasma|serum|other — promote to reference

attributes.name: manufacture_date

attributes.name: preservative_type

attributes.name: bioanalytical_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_result. Business justification: Data queries in clinical trials can be raised against bioanalytical results (PK/PD, DMPK data) in the EDC, not only against standard lab results.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_analyte_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_analyte. Business justification: A lab query is raised against a specific analyte result. The lbtestcd STRING column on lab_query is a denormalized reference to the analyte tested.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: laboratory_lab_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific laboratory result record in the lab_result product that this query was raised against. Core linkage between the query and the underlying data point.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC CDASH LB domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: primary_lab_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce/user record of the individual (data manager, medical monitor, CRA, or system process) who raised this query. Supports ALCOA+ attributability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signatures; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: quality_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: Lab queries that reveal systematic data issues (e.g., multiple sites with same anomaly, instrument calibration failure) escalate to formal quality events.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study under which this laboratory query was raised. Links the query to the parent protocol and sponsor context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site associated with the subject whose laboratory result triggered this query. Used for site-level query metrics and monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit during which the specimen was collected and the lab result was generated, providing temporal context for the query.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV/SE domains; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: tertiary_lab_responded_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who submitted the query response on behalf of the site or laboratory. Supports ALCOA+ attributability and electronic signature audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signatures; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) whose laboratory result is the subject of this query. Supports subject-level data quality tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the query was cancelled, if applicable (e.g., query raised in error, duplicate query, data issue resolved through another mechanism). Required for cancelled queries to maintain ALCOA+ audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: corrected_value
attributes.description: The laboratory result value after correction, if a data change was made as a result of this query. Null if no correction was applied. Provides after-state for audit trail per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this lab_query record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Audit trail field for data lineage and ALCOA+ compliance. Distinct from raised_datetime which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_correction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resolution of this query resulted in a data value change in the source EDC or LIMS record. True = a data correction was made; False = original data confirmed or query cancelled without change. Key metric for data quality reporting.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: dbl_blocking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this open query is blocking the Database Lock (DBL) for the study or subject. True = must be resolved before DBL can proceed; False = non-blocking. Critical for study close-out planning and timeline management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; DBL SOP

attributes.name: ecrf_field_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Field Name
attributes.description: Specific field name within the eCRF form that contains the queried laboratory data value (e.g., 'LBORRES', 'LBORRESU'). Enables precise identification of the data point in question for site response and EDC correction.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18

tag_set.value: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Field Name

attributes.name: ecrf_form_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Form Name
attributes.description: Name of the eCRF form in the EDC (Medidata Rave) on which the queried laboratory data field resides (e.g., 'Laboratory Results', 'Hematology'). Supports EDC navigation and query routing to the correct data entry form.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18

tag_set.value: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Form Name

attributes.name: edc_query_code
attributes.description: Native query identifier assigned by the source EDC system (Medidata Rave) or LIMS. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer record and the operational system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC Query Management; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.4

attributes.name: escalation_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the query was formally escalated. Null if no escalation has occurred. Used for escalation cycle time analytics and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this query has been formally escalated to a higher authority (e.g., from CRA to Clinical Lead, or from site to sponsor medical monitor) due to non-response, SLA breach, or data criticality. Triggers escalation workflow in CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Sponsor-CRO escalation SOPs

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: The laboratory result value as it existed at the time the query was raised, captured as a string to accommodate numeric, text, and coded values. Provides before-state for audit trail and data lineage per ALCOA+ requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: query_category
attributes.description: Functional category indicating which business process or team initiated the query — data management programmatic check, medical monitor review, safety review, statistical review, or site-initiated clarification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: query_iteration_count
attributes.description: Number of times this query has been re-opened or re-issued against the same laboratory result field, indicating the number of response-review cycles. A high iteration count signals persistent data quality issues at the site or lab.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; Medidata Rave EDC Query Management

attributes.name: query_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally visible query identifier assigned by the EDC (Medidata Rave) or LIMS system at the time of query creation. Used for cross-system tracking and communication with sites and labs (e.g., QRY-2024-00123).
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC Query Management; CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18

attributes.name: query_priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the query indicating urgency of resolution. Critical queries (e.g., those linked to SAE data or DBL-blocking issues) require immediate attention. Drives escalation and SLA enforcement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: query_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record in which this query originated — EDC (Medidata Rave), a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), the source system or a manually entered query. Supports multi-system data quality governance.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: query_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the laboratory data query. Drives workflow routing, SLA monitoring, and DBL readiness assessment. Open = awaiting response; Answered = response received, pending DM review; Closed = resolved and accepted; Cancelled = withdrawn.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC Query Lifecycle; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: query_text
attributes.description: Full narrative text of the query as raised by the data manager or medical monitor, describing the data issue, the specific concern, and the action requested from the site or laboratory. Core ALCOA+ documentation field.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: query_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason the query was raised against the laboratory result. Drives triage, routing, and resolution workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: raised_by_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the person or process that raised the query (e.g., Data Manager, Medical Monitor, Clinical Research Associate (CRA), Statistician, or automated system check). Denormalized for reporting without requiring a user-role join.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: raised_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the query was formally raised and entered into the EDC or LIMS. Principal business event timestamp for the query lifecycle. Required for SLA calculation and ALCOA+ contemporaneity compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Outcome action taken to resolve the query: data value was corrected in the EDC/LIMS, original data was confirmed as correct, query was withdrawn by the raiser, or no action was required. Critical for data audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: resolution_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the query was formally closed or cancelled by the data manager after reviewing the site/lab response. Marks the end of the query lifecycle. Used for cycle time analytics and DBL readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: response_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the site or laboratory submitted their response to the query. Used for SLA compliance measurement and ALCOA+ contemporaneity tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: response_text
attributes.description: Full narrative response provided by the site or laboratory in reply to the query, explaining the data discrepancy, confirming the value, or documenting a correction. Core ALCOA+ documentation field for audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018

attributes.name: safety_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the queried laboratory result is associated with a safety event (SAE, AE, or SUSAR) or a critical value, requiring expedited resolution. True = safety-relevant; False = routine data quality query.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; CTCAE

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the query response or resolution exceeded the defined SLA target days. True = SLA was breached; False = responded within SLA. Drives escalation workflows and site performance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Sponsor-CRO Agreement SLA terms

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this lab_query record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: usubjid
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM-compliant unique subject identifier (sponsor-study-subject concatenation) denormalized onto the query record for direct regulatory submission traceability and ALCOA+ audit compliance without requiring a join.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.4 DM domain; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: visit_name
attributes.description: Protocol-defined visit name (e.g., Screening, Week 4, End of Treatment) during which the queried laboratory specimen was collected. Denormalized for query analytics and reporting without requiring a visit join.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH

products.name: specimen_aliquot
products.description: Master record for aliquots derived from a primary specimen for distribution to multiple testing labs or long-term storage, including storage placement tracking.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM SD Domain; ISBER Best Practices for Repositories

attributes.name: specimen_aliquot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the specimen aliquot record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Reference to the validated bioanalytical assay method assigned to test this aliquot. Applicable for PK, PD, and biomarker aliquots.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline; CDISC SDTM PC/PP domains

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: Biorepository operations require that each stored aliquot is traceable to the consent version authorizing its use (biobanking, genetic testing, secondary research).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the central or local laboratory responsible for receiving, storing, or testing this aliquot.
attributes.references: CLIA; CAP accreditation; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189

attributes.name: parent_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary specimen from which this aliquot was derived. Establishes the parent-child chain of custody lineage.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment manifest under which this aliquot was transported to a testing or storage laboratory. Supports chain of custody and logistics tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IATA P650 dangerous goods regulations; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this aliquot was collected and is being managed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical site where the parent specimen was collected and the aliquot originated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subject study visit at which the parent specimen was collected. Links aliquot to the clinical event context.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV/SV domains; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) from whom the parent specimen was collected. Supports subject-level sample accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: aliquot_code
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known unique barcode or label identifier assigned to this aliquot at the time of processing. Used for physical tracking and chain of custody.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ISBT 128 specimen labeling standard

attributes.name: aliquot_purpose
attributes.description: Designated analytical or storage purpose for this aliquot. Drives routing to the appropriate laboratory or storage tier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clinical_testing|pk_analysis|biomarker|backup|archive|exploratory — promote to reference product if additional
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: aliquot_seq_num
attributes.description: Sequential integer identifying the order in which this aliquot was derived from the parent specimen (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Supports multi-aliquot tracking per specimen.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: aliquot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the aliquot. Drives chain of custody accountability and biorepository management workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_storage|in_transit|in_testing|consumed|destroyed|lost — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM SA domain; FDA Bioanalytical Guidance

attributes.name: blinded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this aliquot is subject to study blinding (i.e., treatment assignment is masked). Governs access controls and prevents unblinding during active study phases.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: box_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the box or tray within the rack where this aliquot is placed. Part of the three-dimensional storage coordinate system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAP biorepository standards; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complete, unbroken chain of custody record exists for this aliquot from collection through current status. A value of False triggers a compliance review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: collection_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time the parent specimen was collected from the subject. Inherited from the parent specimen for chain of custody and stability calculations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain (SAELTM); ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for laboratory technician or data manager notes regarding this aliquot (e.g., visible hemolysis, lipemia, unusual appearance, processing deviations).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of physical container used to store the aliquot (e.g., cryovial, EDTA tube, serum separator tube, microcentrifuge tube). Affects stability and compatibility with analytical methods.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain; ISO 15189; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this aliquot record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: data_origin
attributes.description: Source system from which this aliquot record was ingested (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, the source system laboratory information management system). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DDF

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the aliquot was destroyed or discarded, if applicable. Required for chain of custody closure and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure for biological samples)

attributes.name: destruction_reason
attributes.description: Reason for aliquot destruction or discard. Required for regulatory accountability and chain of custody documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stability_expired|volume_insufficient|testing_complete|sponsor_request|protocol_deviation|lost|contaminated —
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of freeze-thaw cycles this aliquot has undergone. Exceeding the validated limit may compromise analyte integrity and render the aliquot unsuitable for testing.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM SA domain

attributes.name: max_freeze_thaw_allowed
attributes.description: Validated maximum number of freeze-thaw cycles permitted for this aliquot type before analyte stability is compromised. Defined in the bioanalytical method validation plan.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric position coordinate within the box (e.g., A1, B12, H08) identifying the exact slot where the aliquot is stored. Enables precise physical retrieval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAP biorepository standards; ISBT 128

attributes.name: processing_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time the aliquot was separated from the parent specimen and prepared for storage or shipment. Critical for stability and pre-analytical variable tracking.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: protocol_num
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned protocol number for the clinical study. Denormalized for direct regulatory reporting and specimen labeling without requiring a study join.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: rack_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the rack within the storage unit where this aliquot is placed. Part of the three-dimensional storage coordinate system (rack/box/position).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAP biorepository standards; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: stability_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date beyond which the aliquot is considered analytically unstable based on validated long-term stability data. Triggers discard or re-evaluation workflows.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline; ICH Q1A(R2); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Nominal storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this aliquot (e.g., -80, -20, 4, 25). Used for stability monitoring and deviation assessment.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ISO 15189; CAP

attributes.name: storage_unit_code
attributes.description: Reference to the physical storage unit (freezer, refrigerator, liquid nitrogen tank) where this aliquot is currently placed. Supports biorepository location management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; CAP accreditation standards

attributes.name: storage_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage unit housing this aliquot (e.g., -80°C freezer, -20°C freezer, refrigerator, liquid nitrogen vapor phase). Determines stability expectations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; CAP; ISO 15189

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this aliquot has experienced a documented temperature excursion outside the validated storage range. Triggers stability impact assessment.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; CAP; ISO 15189; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this aliquot record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: usubjid
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM-compliant unique subject identifier (sponsor-subject-site concatenation). Required for regulatory submission datasets and cross-domain subject traceability.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4 (DM.USUBJID); FDA eCTD submission requirements; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of the aliquot in millilitres at the time of processing. Used for sufficiency assessment and inventory management.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain (SAVOL); FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ISO 15189

attributes.name: volume_sufficient_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the remaining aliquot volume is sufficient to complete the assigned assay or testing requirement. Drives re-collection or backup aliquot retrieval workflows.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the aliquot volume. Typically mL for liquid specimens; mg or g for tissue aliquots.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain; UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure); ISO 15189

products.name: protocol_lab_schedule
products.description: Master definition of the protocol-mandated laboratory assessment schedule for a study, mapping each study visit to required lab panels. Captures study ID, visit name/number, visit window (day range), required lab panels, optional panels, fasting
products.reference: CDISC SDTM TS/TV Domains; ICH E6(R2) Protocol Requirements

attributes.name: protocol_lab_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol-mandated laboratory assessment schedule record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_epoch. Business justification: Lab schedules are organized by study epoch (screening, treatment, follow-up); linking to epoch enables epoch-level lab requirement reporting, SDTM TE domain mapping, and protocol schedule
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory panel (e.g., hematology, chemistry, urinalysis, PK/PD, DMPK) required or optionally collected at this visit per the protocol schedule.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB domain; LOINC

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules are defined per protocol version; regulatory submissions and protocol compliance audits require tracing which lab panels were mandated by which protocol version.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Protocol amendments frequently change lab assessment schedules (adding/removing panels, changing timepoints).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this laboratory assessment schedule is defined. Links to the master study record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TA domain

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: When protocol amendments change visit or specimen requirements, new lab schedule versions are issued.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: backup_sample_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a backup or reserve aliquot must be collected and stored alongside the primary specimen for potential future analysis (e.g., for biomarker or pharmacogenomics research).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study laboratory manual

attributes.name: central_lab_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment must be performed at the central laboratory (as opposed to a local laboratory). Drives specimen shipment logistics and result routing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: collection_time_constraint
attributes.description: Time-of-day or dose-relative constraint for specimen collection at this visit (e.g., pre-dose, post-dose, morning only, timed serial PK sampling). Critical for PK/PD and DMPK assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP domains; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: collection_time_offset_hours
attributes.description: Nominal time offset in hours relative to dose administration for post-dose or timed serial specimen collection (e.g., 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 24 hours post-dose). Applicable primarily to PK/PD and DMPK assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC domain; FDA Guidance on PK Studies

attributes.name: collection_time_window_minutes
attributes.description: Acceptable deviation window in minutes around the nominal collection time offset for timed specimen collection. Used to assess protocol deviations for PK/PD sampling.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: collection_tube_type

attributes.name: critical_result_review_required

attributes.name: edc_form_name

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this laboratory schedule entry is effective, typically aligned with the protocol version approval date or protocol amendment effective date.

attributes.name: fasting_duration_hours_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours the subject must fast prior to specimen collection when fasting is required. Null when fasting_required is false.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study protocol schedule of assessments

attributes.name: fasting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject must be in a fasted state prior to specimen collection for this laboratory assessment at this visit. Drives subject instructions and site collection procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM LB.LBFAST

attributes.name: is_exploratory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is an exploratory or research-use-only endpoint not included in the primary or secondary efficacy analyses. Supports data management and the source system

attributes.name: is_pd_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is a pharmacodynamic (PD) biomarker collection. Supports differentiation of PD endpoints from standard safety laboratory panels.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB/MB domains; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_pk_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is a pharmacokinetic (PK) or DMPK sample collection. When true, timed serial collection rules and PK-specific processing instructions apply.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC domain; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_safety_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is designated as a safety laboratory panel per the protocol. Safety assessments trigger critical value review workflows and DSMB/DMC reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.32; CTCAE

attributes.name: local_lab_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from a local (site) laboratory are acceptable for this assessment, either as a primary result or as a backup when central lab results are unavailable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study laboratory manual

attributes.name: panel_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory panel is mandatory (required), optional, conditional on a clinical trigger, restricted to the PK cohort, or applicable only to a defined subject subset per the protocol schedule of assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM LB domain

attributes.name: processing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specimen requires on-site processing (e.g., centrifugation, aliquoting) prior to shipment to the central laboratory. Drives site laboratory capability requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study laboratory manual

attributes.name: repeat_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a repeat specimen collection is permitted at this visit if the initial sample is insufficient, haemolysed, or otherwise unacceptable. Drives site instructions and EDC query management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: result_turnaround_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from specimen receipt at the laboratory to result reporting. Used for monitoring visit planning, data management timelines, and SLA tracking with the central laboratory.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); central laboratory service agreement

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or footnotes from the protocol schedule of assessments providing additional instructions, conditional collection rules, or clarifications for this laboratory assessment at this visit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study protocol schedule of assessments

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this protocol laboratory schedule entry. Reflects whether the schedule is in draft, active per the current protocol version, amended, superseded by a protocol amendment, or retired.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312; Veeva Vault document lifecycle

attributes.name: sdtm_domain

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD submission requirements

attributes.name: shipment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which specimens collected at this visit should be shipped to the central laboratory (e.g., immediate same-day shipment for PK samples, weekly batch shipment for routine safety labs).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study laboratory manual; IATA P650

attributes.name: source_system_record_code

attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen required for this laboratory panel at this visit (e.g., blood, urine, plasma, serum, CSF). Drives specimen collection kit configuration and chain of custody planning.

attributes.name: specimen_volume_ml

attributes.name: storage_temperature

attributes.references: ISBER Best Practices; IATA P650; study laboratory manual

attributes.name: study_day_target

attributes.name: subject_population

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: superseded_date

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this protocol laboratory schedule record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: visit_name

attributes.name: visit_num
attributes.description: Visit number; implements SDTM --VISITNUM
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV.VISITNUM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: Visit type; implements SDTM TV/SV visit metadata (CDISC CT visit-type codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: visit_window_day_max
attributes.description: Latest allowable study day (relative to target study day) for the visit window, defining the acceptable upper bound for specimen collection. Used for protocol deviation assessment and site monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: visit_window_day_min
attributes.description: Earliest allowable study day (relative to target study day) for the visit window, defining the acceptable lower bound for specimen collection. Used for protocol deviation assessment and site monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the certification program as designated by the issuing authority (e.g., 'CLIA Certificate of Compliance – Hematology', 'CAP Proficiency Testing – Chemistry'). Serves as the identity label for this certification record.

attributes.name: certification_notes

attributes.name: certification_scope

attributes.name: certification_status

attributes.name: certification_type

attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation; FDA 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP); ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: eqa_participation_cycle
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific EQA participation cycle or survey period (e.g., '2024-Q1', '2024-CYCLE-2'). Applicable when certification_type = EQA_SCHEME. Supports tracking of periodic proficiency testing compliance.

attributes.name: eqa_scheme_name

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Null for certifications with indefinite validity. Critical for renewal workflow triggering and regulatory compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: issue_date

attributes.name: issuing_authority

attributes.name: issuing_authority_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction under which the certification was issued (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, JPN, AUS). Supports multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: lab_director_name

attributes.name: mutual_recognition_flag

attributes.name: proficiency_test_result

attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493 Subpart H; CAP Proficiency Testing; ISO 15189

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: renewal_due_date

attributes.name: detection_limit_lower
attributes.description: The lowest concentration or value that can be reliably detected by the analytical method for this analyte (Lower Limit of Detection, LLOD). Values below this threshold are reported as '<LLOD'.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline (2011); ICH M10; CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide

attributes.name: detection_limit_upper
attributes.description: The highest concentration or value that can be reliably quantified by the analytical method for this analyte (Upper Limit of Quantitation, ULOQ). Values above this threshold require dilution or are reported as '>ULOQ'.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this analyte definition was retired or superseded. Null indicates the analyte is currently active. Used to enforce temporal validity checks when mapping historical study data and to prevent use of deprecated analytes in new study builds.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Controlled Terminology Governance; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this analyte definition became effective and approved for use in clinical trial data collection. Supports temporal versioning of the controlled vocabulary and ensures studies use the correct analyte definition at the time of data
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Controlled Terminology Governance; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: lbtest
attributes.description: Lab test name; implements SDTM LB.LBTEST (CDISC CT LBTEST codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4 — LB Domain; CDISC Controlled Terminology NCI Thesaurus

attributes.name: lbtestcd
attributes.description: Lab test code; implements SDTM LB.LBTESTCD (CDISC CT LBTESTCD codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4 — LB Domain; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: loinc_code
