attributes.name: max_freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: Maximum number of freeze-thaw cycles permitted for specimens used to measure this analyte before result validity is compromised. Enforced during specimen chain-of-custody tracking to flag specimens that have exceeded the allowable cycle count
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline (2011); ICH M10; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: minimum_volume_ml
attributes.description: Minimum volume of specimen in milliliters required to perform the assay for this analyte. Used to validate specimen adequacy upon receipt at the central laboratory and to configure collection volume requirements in the lab manual and RTSM kit
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022 Medical Laboratories; CAP Accreditation Standards; CLSI GP41-A6 Venipuncture

attributes.name: pk_pd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this analyte is used in pharmacokinetic (PK) or pharmacodynamic (PD) analyses. When true, the analyte is subject to DMPK bioanalytical method validation requirements and results are processed through the PC/PP SDTM domains and
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4 — PC/PP Domains; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: preferred_volume_ml
attributes.description: Optimal/preferred volume of specimen in milliliters for reliable analyte measurement, accounting for repeat testing and QC requirements. Drives collection kit tube size selection and subject blood volume burden calculations in protocol feasibility
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022 Medical Laboratories; CLSI GP41-A6; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Study Protocol Design Standards

attributes.name: reporting_precision
attributes.description: Number of decimal places to which results for this analyte should be reported and stored. Ensures consistent numeric precision across EDC data entry in Medidata Rave, SDTM dataset generation, and statistical analysis outputs in SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: requires_fasting
attributes.description: Indicates whether specimen collection for this analyte requires the subject to be in a fasting state. When true, the eCRF in Medidata Rave will prompt collection of fasting status (LBFAST in SDTM) and the collection instructions in the lab manual will
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4 — LBFAST; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Study Protocol Design Standards

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain Assignment
attributes.description: Target SDTM domain; implements SDTM Dataset.DOMAIN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards Catalog

tag_set.value: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain Assignment

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Primary specimen type required or accepted for this analyte (e.g., 'BLOOD', 'SERUM', 'PLASMA', 'URINE', 'CSF', 'TISSUE'). Corresponds to CDISC LBSPEC variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4 — LBSPEC; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ISO 15189

attributes.name: stability_hours_ambient
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours the collected specimen remains stable for this analyte at ambient (room) temperature before processing or refrigeration is required.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022 Medical Laboratories; CAP Accreditation Standards; CLSI EP25-A Specimen Stability

attributes.name: stability_hours_frozen
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours (or equivalent duration) the collected specimen remains stable for this analyte when stored frozen (typically -20°C or -80°C). Governs long-term biobanking, re-analysis eligibility, and sample expiry management in the specimen
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022 Medical Laboratories; CAP Accreditation Standards; CLSI EP25-A Specimen Stability; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: stability_hours_refrigerated
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours the collected specimen remains stable for this analyte when stored refrigerated (2–8°C). Used to define specimen handling windows in the lab manual, RTSM kit instructions, and central lab processing SOPs.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022 Medical Laboratories; CAP Accreditation Standards; CLSI EP25-A Specimen Stability

attributes.name: standard_unit
attributes.description: Standardized unit; implements SDTM LB.LBSTRESU (CDISC CT UNIT codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4 — LBSTRESU; UCUM; ISO 80000-1; ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles

attributes.name: unit_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric multiplier applied to convert a result from the default_unit to the standard_unit (e.g., 0.0555 to convert glucose from mg/dL to mmol/L). Used by the data transformation layer in SAS Drug Development and Medidata Rave to auto-standardize incoming
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; UCUM; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this analyte record was most recently modified. Used for change detection in downstream ETL pipelines, audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

attributes.name: who_dd_code
attributes.description: WHODrug dictionary code; implements WHODrug Drug Record Number
attributes.references: WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD); ICH E2B(R3); CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Pharmacokinetics Guidance

attributes.description: Actual physical count of IMP units or kits recorded during the most recent physical inventory count at this location. Compared against the system quantity to identify discrepancies requiring investigation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: last_shipment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent inbound IMP or kit shipment was received and confirmed at this location. Used to track supply chain activity and assess time since last replenishment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM shipment module

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply chain node holding this inventory. Distinguishes between investigational sites (where IMP is dispensed to subjects), depots (regional or central storage), central pharmacies, and satellite depots.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: maximum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Maximum number of IMP units or kits permitted at this location to prevent overstocking, minimize expiry risk, and comply with storage capacity constraints. Used in supply planning and RTSM configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: minimum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Absolute minimum number of IMP units or kits that must be maintained at this location to ensure uninterrupted subject dosing. Falling below this level triggers an urgent resupply escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM supply parameters

attributes.name: qty_adjusted
attributes.description: Net inventory adjustment quantity applied to this position due to physical count discrepancies, data corrections, or reconciliation differences. Positive values indicate upward adjustments; negative values indicate downward adjustments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: qty_allocated
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits currently reserved or allocated to specific subjects or randomization slots via the RTSM but not yet physically dispensed. Reduces available-for-dispensing stock.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: qty_destroyed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits that have been destroyed at or from this location, including expired, damaged, or returned-and-destroyed stock. Required for regulatory accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: qty_dispensed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits dispensed to study subjects at this location since the study began or since the last accountability reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in the RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: qty_expired
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits that have passed their expiry date at this location and are no longer eligible for dispensing. Tracked separately for regulatory accountability and waste reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical count of IMP units or kits available at this location, excluding quarantined, allocated, and reserved stock. Represents the net usable inventory at the time of the last update. Used as the primary metric for resupply trigger evaluation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_quarantined
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits currently placed in quarantine at this location due to quality concerns, temperature excursions, damaged packaging, or pending investigation. These units are not available for dispensing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: qty_received
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits received at this location since the study began or since the last accountability reconciliation period. Sourced from inbound shipment confirmations in the RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_returned
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits returned from subjects or from this site to the depot or sponsor for destruction or reconciliation. Used in accountability reconciliation calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent IMP accountability reconciliation was completed and approved for this inventory position. Required for regulatory inspection readiness and study close-out documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ principles of contemporaneous data capture. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements under ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11, and enables change detection in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold at which a resupply request should be triggered for this IMP or kit type at this location. When qty_on_hand falls at or below this value, the RTSM or supply planner initiates a replenishment shipment.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP supply planning best practices

attributes.name: reorder_qty
attributes.description: Standard replenishment quantity to be shipped when a resupply is triggered for this location and IMP/kit type. Defined in the supply plan and used by the RTSM to generate resupply orders automatically.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: resupply_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent resupply request was initiated for this inventory position. Used to track supply chain responsiveness and expected delivery timelines.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: resupply_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active resupply request has been triggered for this inventory position. Set to True when qty_on_hand falls at or below the reorder_point and a resupply order has been initiated in the RTSM or supply management system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP supply planning

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the IMP batch must be retested to confirm continued stability and suitability for use. Applicable for products with defined retest periods rather than fixed expiry dates. Triggers stability testing workflows.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: rtsm_location_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Location Code
attributes.description: The location identifier assigned to this site or depot within the RTSM system (Medidata Rave). Used to reconcile inventory records between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational RTSM source system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

tag_set.value: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Location Code

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the IMP or kit at this location, as specified in the Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier (IMPD) or protocol. Drives cold-chain logistics planning and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23; USP <1079>

attributes.name: storage_condition_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current storage conditions at this location are compliant with the required storage condition specification for this IMP or kit type.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312; GCP

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of recorded temperature excursion events for this inventory position at this location. Used to assess cold-chain compliance history and inform quarantine or destruction decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.68; USP <1079>

attributes.name: treatment_arm_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the treatment arm or randomization group associated with this kit type inventory (e.g., active drug, placebo, dose level A). For blinded studies, this field may be restricted to unblinded personnel only.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM ARM domain

products.name: supply_plan
products.description: Clinical supply plan - distinct concept, separate owner from monitoring_plan and program_plan.

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the investigational medicinal product (IMP) supply plan record within the clinical trial supply chain management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Supply plan approval is a formal clinical operations step requiring a named responsible employee (supply director or CTM).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.clinical_program. Business justification: Supply plans are authored at the program level to govern IMP manufacturing strategy across all studies.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: delivery_preference_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.delivery_preference. Business justification: Sponsor delivery preferences (RTSM system, blinding type, cold chain standards, SDV requirements, storage conditions) directly configure supply plan parameters.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dosing_regimen_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.dosing_regimen. Business justification: Supply quantity forecasting is directly calculated from the dosing regimen (dose frequency, treatment duration, number of subjects per arm).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) being planned, linking to the product master record that defines formulation, dosage form, and strength.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU Directive 2001/20/EC; 21 CFR Part 312; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Supply plans are scoped to an IND — the IND defines the protocol coverage, phase, and product authorization that drives manufacturing quantity planning.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Supply plans are built for a specific investigational product as defined in the study protocol (IND/IMPD reference, storage conditions, shelf life).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that owns the investigational product and is responsible for supply funding and oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.50; EU CTR 536/2014 Art. 71

attributes.name: pipeline_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.pipeline_asset. Business justification: Supply plans are built around a specific investigational compound's development phase, enrollment projections, and manufacturing requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Supply plans are built against a specific protocol version — planned enrollment, dosing regimen, number of arms, and visit frequency all derive from the protocol.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Supply planning is directly driven by the randomization scheme — allocation ratios, treatment arm counts, block sizes, and stratification factors determine IMP quantities and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sample_size_calc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sample_size_calc. Business justification: Supply plan quantities (forecasted_enrollment, dropout_rate_pct, total_units_planned) are derived directly from the approved sample size calculation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this supply plan is created. Links the supply plan to the study protocol, enrollment projections, and dosing regimen.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: supply_program_strategic_plan_id
attributes.description: BIGINT

attributes.name: accountability_reconciliation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether drug accountability reconciliation is required under this supply plan, as mandated by GCP and regulatory requirements. Drives reconciliation workflow in RTSM and site monitoring activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA GCP guidelines

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supply plan was formally approved by the sponsor supply team and/or CRO supply chain lead. Null if plan has not yet been approved.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding configuration of the study as it affects supply planning. Double-blind studies require matched placebo kits; open-label studies have simpler kit structures. Impacts kit design and labeling requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: buffer_stock_weeks
attributes.description: Target buffer stock expressed in weeks of supply to be maintained at depot and/or site level. Ensures continuity of supply during manufacturing lead times and logistics delays.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP requires cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled storage and transport) throughout the supply chain. Drives depot selection, packaging specifications, and logistics provider requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; WHO Technical Report Series 961; GDP guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply plan record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destruction_plan_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply plan version includes a returns and destruction plan for expired, unused, or damaged IMP. Required for GMP compliance and accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: dropout_rate_pct
attributes.description: Assumed subject dropout/discontinuation rate (as a percentage) applied in demand forecasting calculations. Accounts for subjects who withdraw consent, are lost to follow-up, or are discontinued per protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP guidelines

attributes.name: expiry_management_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy applied for managing IMP expiry at depot and site level. FIFO (First In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), manual review, or RTSM-managed automated expiry tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: forecasted_enrollment
attributes.description: Total number of subjects projected to be enrolled over the planning horizon, derived from enrollment projections and site feasibility assessments. Primary driver of IMP demand forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of the geographic coverage of this supply plan, specifying countries or regions included (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives country-level demand forecasting and depot assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: horizon_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Typically extends to study completion or database lock (DBL) plus a buffer for returns and destruction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: horizon_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the beginning of the forecasted demand and manufacturing schedule window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for supply chain planners to document assumptions, constraints, protocol amendment impacts, or sponsor-specific instructions relevant to this supply plan version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: overage_pct
attributes.description: Planned overage percentage applied on top of net demand to account for wastage, damaged kits, protocol amendments, and supply chain uncertainties. Agreed with sponsor and documented in the supply agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: plan_date
attributes.description: The principal business date on which this supply plan was formally prepared or issued. Represents the real-world event date distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the supply plan, typically formatted as SP-{StudyCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}. Used in sponsor communications, RTSM configuration, and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: planned_manufacturing_batches
attributes.description: Total number of manufacturing batches planned to fulfill the forecasted IMP demand over the planning horizon, including buffer and overage quantities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: planning_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency or trigger basis for this supply plan update cycle. Typically monthly or per enrollment milestone as defined in the supply agreement with the sponsor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: Randomization methodology used in the RTSM for kit assignment to subjects. Drives kit numbering, stratification factors, and supply allocation logic within Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: resupply_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity of kits or units to be shipped per resupply order when the resupply trigger threshold is reached. Defined per site tier and country in the supply plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: resupply_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum kit or unit quantity at depot or site level that triggers an automatic resupply order via RTSM (Interactive Response Technology). When inventory falls to or below this threshold, a resupply shipment is initiated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: rtsm_plan_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Plan ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding supply plan configuration record within the Medidata Rave RTSM system. Enables traceability between the lakehouse supply plan record and the operational RTSM configuration.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

tag_set.value: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Plan ID

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the IMP in months from date of manufacture, as defined in the product specification and stability data. Critical for expiry management and resupply timing calculations.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.137; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: site_tier_scope
attributes.description: Site tier classification covered by this supply plan. Allows differentiated supply planning for high-enrolling versus low-enrolling sites, supporting optimized kit allocation and resupply strategies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: supply_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply plan. Draft indicates initial creation; under_review indicates sponsor/CRO review; approved indicates sign-off; active indicates currently governing supply operations; superseded indicates replaced by a newer
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP as specified in the product dossier. Defines upper bound for cold-chain and ambient storage qualification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; WHO GDP guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP as specified in the product dossier. Used to define cold-chain logistics requirements and depot qualification criteria.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; WHO GDP guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: total_units_planned
attributes.description: Total number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) planned for manufacture and distribution over the planning horizon, inclusive of overage and buffer stock.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: treatment_arms_count
attributes.description: Number of treatment arms (including placebo/comparator) in the study protocol that require separate IMP supply planning. Drives kit type differentiation in RTSM randomization configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which IMP supply quantities are expressed and tracked throughout the supply plan (e.g., kit, vial, tablet). Aligns with RTSM kit configuration and dispensing records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC CDASH; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this supply plan record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every planning cycle revision or status change.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the supply plan (e.g., v1.0, v2.3), incremented at each planning cycle or upon significant enrollment milestone updates. Supports version history and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

products.name: manufacture_batch
products.description: Records IMP manufacturing batch details including batch number, manufacturing date, batch size, manufacturing site, GMP certificate of analysis reference, release status (quarantine, released, rejected), expiry date, and storage conditions.

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the IMP manufacturing batch record in the clinical supply chain. Primary key for all downstream kit, inventory, and accountability traceability.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 Good Manufacturing Practice Guide; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: Each manufacturing batch produces a specific IMP. manufacture_batch.imp_name and imp_code are denormalized from imp_master.product_name and product_code.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: qualified_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: EU GMP Annex 13 requires a named Qualified Person to certify each IMP batch release. Linking to employee enables QP qualification verification, GMP compliance reporting, and batch release
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Batch records and CoAs are submitted as part of IND/CTA regulatory submissions. manufacture_batch has ind_number and cta_reference as plain text.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity of units from this batch that are available for allocation to depots or clinical sites, net of already allocated, dispensed, returned, and destroyed quantities. Used for supply planning and shortage risk monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric batch/lot number assigned by the manufacturing site, as printed on the IMP label and referenced in the Certificate of Analysis (CoA).
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 13; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Total number of units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) manufactured in this batch. Used for supply planning, yield calculations, and accountability reconciliation against dispensed and returned quantities.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.186; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: batch_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the batch size quantity (e.g., units, vials, tablets, kits). Required for unambiguous interpretation of batch_size in supply planning and accountability reports.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: batch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the batch purpose: clinical (intended for subject dosing), validation (process validation), stability (stability study samples), reference (retained reference samples), reserve (emergency reserve).
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding classification of the IMP batch indicating whether the batch is open-label, single-blind, double-blind, or triple-blind. Determines labelling requirements, handling procedures, and unblinding protocols at clinical sites.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: coa_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the GMP Certificate of Analysis (CoA) issued by the manufacturing site for this batch. The CoA confirms the batch meets all release specifications. Links to the document management system (Veeva Vault eTMF).
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.194; EU GMP Annex 13; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacture batch record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cta_reference
attributes.description: Clinical Trial Authorisation (CTA) reference number issued by the relevant national competent authority (e.g., EMA, MHRA) under which this IMP batch is authorised for use in the clinical trial.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA; MHRA; Health Canada

attributes.name: destroyed_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of units from this batch that have been confirmed destroyed, including rejected units, expired returns, and reconciliation destructions. Required for GMP accountability reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.208; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: destruction_certificate_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the destruction certificate issued upon confirmed destruction of batch units. Required for GMP accountability reconciliation and regulatory audit trail. Links to document management system (Veeva Vault).
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.208; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Pharmaceutical dosage form of the IMP in this batch (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection). Determines storage, handling, and dispensing requirements at clinical sites.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; FDA Dosage Form Terminology; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the IMP batch must not be used, as determined by stability studies and printed on the IMP label. Critical for expiry management, site recall, and RTSM kit assignment logic to prevent dispensing of expired product.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the GMP manufacturing authorisation or certificate issued by the relevant regulatory authority for the manufacturing site. Confirms the site is authorised to manufacture IMPs for clinical trials.
attributes.references: EU GMP Directive 2003/94/EC; 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q7; EMA

attributes.name: is_comparator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is a comparator (active control or placebo) product rather than the investigational drug. True = comparator/placebo; False = investigational drug. Used for supply planning, kit assembly, and RTSM randomization configuration.

attributes.name: upper_threshold_c

attributes.name: study_site_id

attributes.name: subject_visit_data_id

attributes.name: tmf_document_id

attributes.name: comments

attributes.name: cra_signoff_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA / monitor signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if cra_signoff_flag is False.

attributes.name: cra_signoff_flag

tag_set.value: Clinical Research Associate (CRA) Monitor Sign-Off Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drug accountability reconciliation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destroyed_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units destroyed at the site or returned to depot for destruction during the reconciliation period. Destruction must be documented per sponsor SOP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Number of individual discrepancy line items identified during this reconciliation (e.g., missing kit, unaccounted return, dispensing record mismatch). Distinct from discrepancy_units which measures total quantity variance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: discrepancy_detail
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature, root cause, and resolution status of identified discrepancies. Captured by the CRA or site staff. Required when discrepancy_count > 0. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: discrepancy_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current resolution status of identified discrepancies. 'not_applicable' = no discrepancy found; 'open' = discrepancy identified, investigation not started; 'under_investigation' = root cause analysis in progress; 'resolved' = discrepancy explained and
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: discrepancy_units
attributes.description: Quantity difference between expected_closing_balance_units and actual_closing_balance_units (actual minus expected). A non-zero value triggers discrepancy investigation. Positive = surplus; negative = shortage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: dispensed_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units dispensed to subjects at the site during the reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in Medidata Rave RTSM and eCRF dispensing logs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: expected_closing_balance_units
attributes.description: Calculated expected closing balance: opening_balance_units + received_units - dispensed_units + returned_units - destroyed_units + adjusted_units. Used as the reference value against which the physical count is compared to identify discrepancies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: expired_units_count
attributes.description: Number of IMP units that had expired as of the reconciliation period end date. Expired units must be quarantined and destroyed per sponsor SOP; their presence in usable inventory constitutes a protocol deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiry_date_earliest
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earliest IMP Expiry Date on Site
attributes.description: The earliest expiry date among all IMP units currently on hand at the site as of the reconciliation period end date. Used to flag impending expiry risk and trigger resupply or destruction actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.3; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

tag_set.value: Earliest IMP Expiry Date on Site

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_flag

attributes.name: opening_balance_units

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Defines the closing boundary for all IMP transactions included in this reconciliation.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Together with period_end_date, defines the window of IMP activity (receipts, dispensing, returns, destruction) being reconciled.

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag

attributes.name: received_units

attributes.name: reconciliation_date

attributes.name: quantity_approved
attributes.description: Number of IMP kits or units approved for dispatch after supply manager or depot review. May differ from quantity_requested due to stock availability or protocol constraints.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Number of IMP kits or units requested in this resupply order, as specified at the time of order creation by the RTSM algorithm or supply manager.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: quantity_shipped
attributes.description: Actual number of IMP kits or units included in the outbound shipment fulfilling this resupply order. Populated at dispatch and used for accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantities specified in this resupply order (e.g., kit, vial, blister pack). Ensures consistent interpretation across depots and sites.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the drug accountability reconciliation was completed for the IMP kits delivered under this resupply order. Populated when accountability_reconciled is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR 312; EU GMP Annex 13; ALCOA+

attributes.name: requesting_location_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the resupply order was initiated by an investigational site, a regional depot, or a central pharmacy. Determines routing and fulfillment logic.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: rtsm_order_reference
attributes.description: The native order reference or transaction ID assigned by the RTSM system (Medidata Rave) when the resupply order was generated. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: rtsm_trigger_rule
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the RTSM resupply algorithm rule that triggered this order (e.g., minimum stock level rule, days-of-supply threshold rule). Null for manually initiated orders.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_system_order_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or unique identifier of this resupply order in the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM internal order ID). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: stock_at_trigger
attributes.description: Actual inventory count at the requesting site or depot at the moment the resupply order was triggered. Used to validate trigger logic and support supply accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the IMP kits in this resupply order during transit and at the destination. Determines packaging, courier, and handling instructions.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Courier-assigned tracking number for the shipment fulfilling this resupply order. Enables real-time shipment tracking and delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: trigger_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resupply order was automatically triggered by the RTSM resupply algorithm (e.g., minimum stock threshold breach) or initiated manually by a supply manager or other authorized personnel.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this resupply order record. Used for change detection, ETL incremental loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: urgency_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the resupply order indicating the speed of fulfillment required. Emergency orders may trigger expedited cold-chain logistics and override standard lead times.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: import_permit
products.description: Manages country-level import permits and licenses required for cross-border IMP shipments. Captures permit number, issuing authority, country, IMP reference, permitted quantity, permit validity dates, application date, approval date, and permit status.

attributes.name: import_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the import permit record in the clinical supply lakehouse. Primary key for the import_permit data product.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Import permits for IMP in EU/EEA are issued in the context of a CTA. Regulatory and supply teams must link import permits to the authorizing CTA for compliance audits.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Import permits fulfill jurisdiction-specific regulatory obligations for IMP importation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_country. Business justification: Import permits are country-specific regulatory documents tied to a study's country activation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.depot. Business justification: Import permits are associated with the receiving depot — the depot that will receive the cross-border IMP shipment. The permit authorizes importation to a specific country/facility.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) covered by this import permit. Identifies the specific drug substance or device being imported.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q7

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: US import permits for IMP reference the IND number as the regulatory authorization basis.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.organization. Business justification: Import permits are applied for by or on behalf of the sponsor organization. Regulatory and supply teams must trace permits to the sponsoring org for compliance audits, country-level
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Import permits are issued by health authorities against a specific protocol/IND version. Regulatory submissions for import authorization reference the protocol version.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Import permits for IMP require a named local regulatory contact employee responsible for submissions and authority liaison.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical supply shipment that this import permit authorizes. Enables traceability between the permit and the physical IMP shipment.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: sponsor_regulatory_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.regulatory_strategy. Business justification: Import permits are obtained as part of executing the sponsor's country-level regulatory strategy.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this import permit is required. Links the permit to the specific trial protocol and IMP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Import permits are ICH GCP essential TMF documents (Zone 5 — Regulatory). Each import permit record must link to its filed TMF document for country-level regulatory compliance tracking
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: applicant_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal entity (CRO, sponsor, or local affiliate) that submitted the import permit application to the regulatory authority. May differ from the sponsor when a CRO acts as the applicant.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date on which the import permit application was formally submitted to the issuing regulatory authority. Used to track regulatory lead times and application-to-approval cycle times.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally approved and issued the import permit. Null if the permit has not yet been approved. Used to calculate approval lead time and schedule shipments.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the import permit record was first created in the clinical supply management system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: customs_declaration_number
attributes.description: Official customs entry or declaration number assigned by the customs authority upon import clearance. Links the import permit to the customs clearance record for audit and accountability purposes.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.description: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) registration number for the study. Required on EU import permits to link the IMP importation to the registered clinical trial.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA EudraCT; MHRA

attributes.name: export_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country from which the IMP is being exported. Required for bilateral import/export permit matching and customs documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH Q10; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: hs_tariff_code
attributes.description: World Customs Organization Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code for the IMP. Required for customs clearance and import duty determination. Typically 6-10 digits depending on the destination country.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: imp_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the IMP as stated on the import permit, including drug name, dosage form, strength, and any blinding information. Must match the IMP details on the permit document exactly for customs compliance.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

attributes.name: import_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the destination country into which the IMP is being imported. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and customs procedures.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

attributes.name: inn_name
attributes.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) of the active pharmaceutical ingredient as recognized by the WHO. Used in regulatory submissions and customs declarations to identify the drug substance.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: issuing_authority_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the regulatory authority that issued the permit (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN, AUS, CAN, DEU). Identifies the jurisdiction of the issuing body.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the national regulatory authority or government body that issued the import permit (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada). Used for regulatory correspondence and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory or operational notes related to the import permit, such as special conditions imposed by the authority, customs broker instructions, or escalation details.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: permit_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the scanned or electronic copy of the import permit document stored in the eTMF (Veeva Vault). Enables direct retrieval of the official permit document for customs and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) TMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Official permit number assigned by the issuing regulatory authority. This is the externally-known identifier used in regulatory correspondence, customs declarations, and shipment documentation.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10; WHO ICTRP

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the import permit. Drives shipment release decisions and regulatory compliance tracking. Draft = in preparation; Submitted = application filed with authority; Approved = permit granted; Rejected = application denied; Expired =
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the import permit by scope of authorization. Single_shipment covers one consignment; multi_shipment covers a defined number of shipments; blanket covers all shipments within a validity period; emergency is expedited authorization
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10; WHO ICTRP

attributes.name: permitted_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of IMP authorized for import under this permit. Expressed in the unit defined by permitted_quantity_unit. Enables supply planning and prevents over-shipment against permit limits.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

attributes.name: permitted_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the permitted_quantity field (e.g., units, vials, tablets, capsules, kg, g, mg, L, mL). Must align with the IMP dosage form and packaging configuration.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; CDISC SDTM; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: permitted_shipment_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of individual shipments authorized under this permit. Applicable for multi_shipment permit types. Null for single_shipment or blanket permits where shipment count is not restricted.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally rejected the import permit application. Populated only when permit_status is 'rejected'. Used to track regulatory response timelines and initiate resubmission.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the regulatory authority for rejecting the import permit application. Populated when permit_status is 'rejected'. Used to guide resubmission and CAPA activities.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: renewal_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before permit expiry that the renewal application must be submitted to the issuing authority. Used to trigger automated renewal reminders and prevent supply disruption.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this import permit requires periodic renewal before the study completes. Triggers proactive renewal workflow to prevent supply chain disruption due to permit expiry.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: requires_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP requires cold-chain logistics management during import (refrigerated, frozen, or ultra-frozen transport). Drives logistics planning and customs clearance prioritization.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GDP guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority revoked a previously approved import permit. Populated only when permit_status is 'revoked'. Triggers immediate shipment hold and regulatory notification.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the regulatory authority for revoking a previously approved import permit. Populated when permit_status is 'revoked'. Triggers regulatory notification and supply chain hold.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the IMP as specified on the import permit and in the IMP dossier. Drives cold-chain logistics requirements during import and customs clearance. Must align with kit_definition storage conditions.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; GDP guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the import permit record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: utilized_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of IMP actually imported against this permit to date. Used to track permit utilization, remaining authorized quantity, and accountability reconciliation. Expressed in the same unit as permitted_quantity_unit.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10; ALCOA+

attributes.name: utilized_shipment_count
attributes.description: Number of shipments that have been made against this permit to date. Used to track permit utilization and determine remaining shipment capacity for multi_shipment permits.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10; ALCOA+

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the import permit is legally effective and shipments may be made under its authority. Typically coincides with or follows the approval date.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

products.name: comparator_drug
products.description: Master record for comparator drugs and placebo products used in controlled clinical trials. Captures comparator drug name, manufacturer, regulatory approval status in applicable countries, sourcing strategy (commercial purchase vs.

attributes.name: comparator_drug_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the comparator drug or placebo master record in the clinical supply system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.clinical_program. Business justification: Comparator drugs are procured and governed at the program level. IMPD comparator sections and program-level supply agreements require linking comparator drug records to the clinical
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: comparator_drug is a specialization of imp_master — imp_master explicitly covers comparator products.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: qualified_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Comparator drugs used in clinical trials require QP certification under EU GMP Annex 13.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.approval. Business justification: Comparator drugs are approved marketed products — supply teams must verify the regulatory approval status and conditions before procurement and use in trials.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.study_contract. Business justification: Comparator drug sourcing, over-labelling obligations, and supply terms are governed by the study contract.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.therapeutic_area. Business justification: comparator_drug carries a plain-text 'therapeutic_area' column that is a denormalized reference to the therapeutic_area reference entity.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approved_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where the comparator drug holds a valid marketing authorisation or regulatory approval. Used to validate site-level dispensing eligibility and import compliance.
attributes.references: EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; FDA 21 CFR 314; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the comparator drug active substance. Used for therapeutic area alignment, WHO-DD coding, and pharmacovigilance signal detection.
attributes.references: WHO ATC/DDD Index; WHO-DD; CDISC SDTM CM Domain

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding configuration applied to the comparator drug in the trial context: open_label (no blinding), single_blind (subject blinded), double_blind (subject and investigator blinded), triple_blind (subject, investigator, and sponsor blinded).
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Blinding; CDISC SDTM TA Domain

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this comparator drug master record was first created in the system. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for MASTER_RESOURCE role. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: destruction_method
attributes.description: Approved method for destruction of unused or returned comparator drug stock. Used in drug accountability reconciliation and environmental compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 312.59; ICH Q3C; GDPR (for destruction records)

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this comparator drug master record was discontinued or retired from active clinical supply use. Null if the record is still active. Used for lifecycle management and historical reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Pharmaceutical dosage form of the comparator drug (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, oral solution, patch). MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE proxy for MASTER_RESOURCE role — the principal physical characteristic of the drug product.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; WHO Pharmaceutical Dosage Forms; FDA 21 CFR 211

attributes.name: drug_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this comparator drug or placebo within the clinical supply catalogue. Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL / BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for cross-system reference.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Full proprietary or International Non-proprietary Name (INN) of the comparator drug or placebo product as it appears on the commercial label or sponsor documentation.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM CM Domain

attributes.name: drug_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the comparator drug master record. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for MASTER_RESOURCE role. 'quarantined' indicates the product is on hold pending quality investigation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 211

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this comparator drug master record is valid and approved for use in clinical supply operations. Supports version-controlled master data management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: formulation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the comparator drug formulation including excipients, vehicle, and any special formulation characteristics relevant to blinding, matching, or stability. Sourced from the product SmPC or Certificate of Analysis.
attributes.references: ICH Q8(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 314

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the current Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certificate issued by the relevant regulatory authority for the manufacturing site producing the comparator drug. Required for import authorisation and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EU GMP Directive 2003/94/EC; FDA 21 CFR 211; ICH Q7; EMA GMP Database

attributes.name: import_licence_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an import licence or import authorisation is required to ship the comparator drug into the trial countries. True triggers the regulatory affairs team to obtain the necessary import documentation prior to shipment.
attributes.references: EU Directive 2001/20/EC; FDA 21 CFR 312.110; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: inn_name
attributes.description: WHO-assigned International Non-proprietary Name (INN) for the active substance of the comparator drug, used for regulatory submissions and MedDRA/WHO-DD coding alignment.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; WHO-DD; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: is_biological
attributes.description: Indicates whether the comparator drug is a biological product (e.g., monoclonal antibody, vaccine, blood-derived product). Biological products are subject to additional regulatory requirements including BLA/MAA pathways and cold-chain mandates.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 600; EMA Directive 2001/83/EC Annex I Part II; ICH Q5A-Q5E

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether the comparator drug requires cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled storage and transport). True triggers cold-chain monitoring, qualified packaging, and GDP-compliant distribution documentation.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 68/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the comparator drug is classified as a controlled substance under applicable national legislation (e.g., DEA Schedule in the US, UK Misuse of Drugs Act). Triggers additional accountability and chain-of-custody requirements.
attributes.references: US DEA Controlled Substances Act; UK Misuse of Drugs Act 1971; EU Directive 2001/83/EC

attributes.name: is_placebo_matched
attributes.description: Indicates whether a matching placebo has been manufactured or sourced to maintain blinding integrity for this comparator drug. True = matching placebo exists; False = no matching placebo required.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: manufacturer_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the comparator drug is manufactured. Used for import/export compliance and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FDA 21 CFR 312; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the pharmaceutical manufacturer or marketing authorisation holder responsible for producing the comparator drug. Used for procurement, GMP verification, and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 211; ICH Q7

attributes.name: max_storage_temp_c
attributes.description: Maximum permissible storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the comparator drug, as specified in the product SmPC or Certificate of Analysis. Used for cold-chain excursion monitoring and depot qualification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 68/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961

attributes.name: min_storage_temp_c
attributes.description: Minimum permissible storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the comparator drug, as specified in the product SmPC or Certificate of Analysis. Used for cold-chain excursion monitoring and depot qualification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 68/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code (NDC) for the comparator drug product, used for US-based procurement, dispensing records, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 207; FDA NDC Directory

attributes.name: over_labelling_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commercial comparator drug packaging must be over-labelled with clinical trial-specific information (e.g., protocol number, sponsor name, 'For Clinical Trial Use Only') to meet GMP Annex 13 and local regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 312.6; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Description of the primary and secondary packaging configuration for the comparator drug (e.g., blister pack of 28 tablets, vial in carton). Used for kit definition alignment and label design.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 211.94; ICH Q6A

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the product role in the trial: comparator (active reference drug), placebo (inert matching product), active_control (approved drug used as benchmark), or rescue_medication (permitted concomitant therapy).
attributes.references: ICH E10; FDA 21 CFR 312; EMA Guideline on the Choice of the Non-Inferiority Margin

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Regulatory approval status of the comparator drug in the primary trial country. Indicates whether the product holds a valid marketing authorisation (MA) or equivalent approval. Distinct from IMP regulatory classification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 314; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: retest_period_months
attributes.description: Period in months after which the comparator drug must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specification before further use. Applicable where a formal expiry date is not assigned.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); ICH Q1E; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: Standardised route by which the comparator drug is administered to the subject (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, intramuscular, topical). Aligned with CDISC SDTM controlled terminology.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology (ROUTE); FDA 21 CFR 201; ICH M4

attributes.name: rtsm_product_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Product ID
attributes.description: Product identifier assigned to the comparator drug within the RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM). Used to link supply planning, kit assignment, and dispensing records in the RTSM to this master record.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM

tag_set.value: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Product ID

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Total approved shelf life of the comparator drug in months from the date of manufacture, as stated on the Certificate of Analysis or product SmPC. Used for expiry management, resupply planning, and RTSM expiry configuration.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 211.137

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy
