tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Number

attributes.name: is_void
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry has been voided due to a system error or data correction. Voided entries are retained for regulatory completeness but excluded from active consent status calculations. Supports ALCOA+ Enduring data integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Enduring, Available); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lar_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) to the subject when consent was obtained via a surrogate (e.g., parent, legal guardian, spouse). Populated when actor_role = 'LAR'. Required for vulnerable population consent documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.55; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The value of the changed field after this audit event was applied. Stores the resulting state for the modified field. Required for before/after comparison in regulatory inspections and ALCOA+ data integrity verification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Accurate); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9

attributes.name: previous_value
attributes.description: The value of the changed field immediately before this audit event was applied. Null for record creation events. Stored as STRING to accommodate any field type.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Original); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9

attributes.name: re_consent_trigger_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason that triggered a re-consent requirement for the subject (e.g., protocol amendment, new safety information, ICF version update). Populated only for event_type = 're_consented' or 'status_changed' to re_consent_required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance on Re-Consent

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit entry record was first ingested into the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp (the real-world event time). Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous, Available); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this audit entry record in the Silver Layer. Since consent audit entries are immutable by design, this field is expected to remain null after initial load; populated only for void corrections or metadata updates.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Enduring, Available); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: signature_meaning
attributes.description: The declared meaning associated with the electronic signature captured at this audit event (e.g., 'I agree', 'Witnessed', 'Approved'). Required by 21 CFR Part 11.50 to associate a meaning with each electronic signature in the audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.50; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.9

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier assigned by the originating source system (Clinpal, Veeva Vault, CTMS) for this audit event. Enables traceability back to the system of record for data lineage and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Original, Attributable); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this audit entry was voided. Populated only when is_void = True. Maintains a complete and transparent audit trail even for corrected records, as required by ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Attributable, Enduring); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason provided by the subject or their Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) for withdrawing consent. Populated only for event_type = 'withdrawn'. Required for subject safety follow-up and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25(a)(8); GDPR Article 7(3)

products.name: lar_representative
products.description: Master record for a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) associated with a trial subject who lacks capacity to consent independently. Stores LAR full name, relationship to subject, contact details, legal authority documentation type and reference

attributes.name: lar_representative_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) master record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.25; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: legal_authority_tmf_document_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Authority Tmf Document Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The legal authority document (power of attorney, guardianship order) authorizing the LAR must be on file in the TMF as an essential document for vulnerable subject protection.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

tag_set.value: Legal Authority Tmf Document Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this LAR authorization is applicable. Scopes the LAR record to a specific trial protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the subject is enrolled and where the LAR authorization is operative.

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject for whom this LAR is authorized to provide consent. Links the LAR record to the subject master.

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: LAR legal authority verification must be performed by a qualified employee per GCP and IRB requirements for vulnerable population protection.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: authorization_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's legal authority to consent on behalf of the subject expires or is terminated. Null indicates open-ended authority. Used to enforce consent eligibility checks.

attributes.name: authorization_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's legal authority to consent on behalf of the subject became effective. Defines the beginning of the valid consent authorization window.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the LAR's legal authorization to consent on behalf of the subject. Drives consent workflow eligibility in Clinpal eConsent and the source system
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.25; ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal assessment of the subject's decision-making capacity was conducted, confirming the need for LAR consent. Required for regulatory documentation in pediatric and cognitively impaired populations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the formal capacity assessment determining the subject's ability to provide independent informed consent. Drives the requirement for LAR consent and re-assessment scheduling.

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal capacity assessment was required to establish the subject's inability to consent independently, thereby necessitating LAR involvement. True for cognitively impaired or pediatric populations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the LAR master record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) data integrity principles. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctms_lar_record_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) LAR Record ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the LAR record in the source system Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the CTMS operational system for site monitoring and visit tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 5.5; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

tag_set.value: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) LAR Record ID

attributes.name: econsent_platform_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the LAR record in the Clinpal eConsent platform. Used for cross-system traceability between the Silver layer lakehouse and the operational eConsent system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the Legally Authorized Representative. Used for eConsent workflow notifications via Clinpal, re-consent triggers, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the Legally Authorized Representative as it appears on their government-issued identification or legal authority document.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.3(l)

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRB/IEC Approval Required for LAR Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval was required for the use of LAR consent procedures for this subject population at this site.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 56; ICH E6(R2) 3.1; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

tag_set.value: IRB/IEC Approval Required for LAR Consent Flag

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (country, state, or province) under whose laws the LAR's authority document was issued and is recognized. Governs applicable legal standards for LAR validity (e.g., US-CA, US-NY, GBR, DEU).
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name or surname of the Legally Authorized Representative as it appears on their government-issued identification or legal authority document.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.3(l)

attributes.name: legal_authority_document_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal authority document (e.g., court order, power of attorney) was issued or became effective. Used to validate currency of authorization.

attributes.name: legal_authority_document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal instrument that establishes the LAR's authority to consent on behalf of the subject (e.g., court order, power of attorney, guardianship certificate). Required for regulatory compliance per 21 CFR 50.3(l).
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the LAR's mailing address (street number and name). Used for postal correspondence, regulatory notifications, and ICF delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.25

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the LAR's mailing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Supplements address line 1 for complete postal delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the LAR's mailing address. Required for complete postal address and jurisdictional determination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the LAR's mailing address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA) and legal authority standards.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the LAR's mailing address. Required for complete postal address and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the LAR's mailing address. Used for jurisdictional compliance and postal delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the Legally Authorized Representative as recorded on official identification documents. May be null if not applicable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for site staff to record additional observations, special circumstances, or contextual information about the LAR's authorization that are not captured in structured fields. Subject to ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: population_category
attributes.description: Classification of the vulnerable population category that necessitates LAR consent for this subject. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and IRB/IEC conditions.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: The LAR's preferred channel for receiving communications from the site, including re-consent notifications and study updates. Drives outreach workflow in Clinpal and the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code representing the LAR's preferred language for consent documentation and communications (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr-CA'). Ensures ICF is provided in a language the LAR understands per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.9; 21 CFR 50.25(b); GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the Legally Authorized Representative. Used for re-consent notifications, safety communications, and site follow-up.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; ICH E6(R2) 4.8

attributes.name: re_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a re-consent process is required for this LAR due to a protocol amendment, new safety information, or ICF version update. Triggers re-consent workflow in Clinpal.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; 21 CFR 50.25; GCP; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: re_consent_trigger_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why re-consent is required from the LAR. Drives re-consent workflow prioritization and regulatory documentation in the eConsent system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; 21 CFR 50.25; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the LAR's legal or familial relationship to the trial subject (e.g., parent, legal guardian, healthcare proxy). Determines the basis of legal authority.

attributes.name: secondary_phone
attributes.description: Alternate telephone number for the Legally Authorized Representative, used when the primary phone is unreachable. Supports continuity of contact for consent and safety communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: subject_assent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject's assent was obtained alongside the LAR's consent. Applicable for pediatric or partially capacitated subjects. Null if assent was not required or not obtained.

attributes.name: subject_assent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's assent (agreement to participate, distinct from formal consent) was obtained in addition to the LAR's consent. Applicable for pediatric subjects with developing capacity per 21 CFR 50.55.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the LAR master record. Used for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's identity and legal authority documentation were verified by authorized site personnel (PI or CRC). Required for GCP audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the site staff's verification of the LAR's identity and legal authority documentation. Tracks whether the CRC or PI has confirmed the LAR's credentials per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; GCP; 21 CFR 50.25; ALCOA+

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR withdrew their consent authorization on behalf of the subject, or the date on which the LAR's authority was formally revoked. Triggers subject withdrawal workflow.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for the withdrawal of the LAR's consent authorization or revocation of legal authority. Required for regulatory reporting and subject safety follow-up.

products.name: icf_amendment
products.description: Tracks amendments to an approved ICF version, capturing the amendment number, amendment date, nature of change (safety update, protocol change, administrative correction), regulatory authority requiring the amendment, IRB/IEC submission date and approval
products.reference: ICF Amendment / Informed Consent Form Amendment

attributes.name: icf_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the ICF amendment record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: authored_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: ICF amendment authorship must be traceable to a qualified employee per ICH E6(R2) for TMF and regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinpal_workflow_id
attributes.description: The workflow identifier assigned by the Clinpal eConsent system for the re-consent or new consent workflow triggered by this amendment. Enables traceability between the amendment record and the eConsent execution.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent Platform; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: consent_icf_version_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resulting Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version ID
attributes.description: Reference to the new ICF version produced as a result of this amendment. Null until the amended ICF version is formally approved and issued.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Veeva Vault eTMF document versioning

tag_set.value: Resulting Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version ID

attributes.name: investigator_brochure_safety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.investigator_brochure_safety. Business justification: IB safety updates with new risk information directly trigger ICF amendments per ICH E6 GCP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: Regulatory requirement: every ICF amendment must receive IRB/IEC approval before implementation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Every ICF amendment is driven by a protocol amendment requiring IRB/IEC resubmission.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: safety_communication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_communication. Business justification: Safety-related ICF amendments are directly triggered by safety communications (e.g., SUSAR letters, urgent safety measures).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: superseded_by_amendment_icf_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subsequent amendment that supersedes this one, if applicable. Null for the current active amendment. Enables full amendment lineage chain reconstruction for regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Veeva Vault eTMF; TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: affected_subject_population
attributes.description: Defines which subject population is required to undergo re-consent as a result of this amendment. Drives the re-consent workflow in Clinpal and determines the scope of CRA site monitoring activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; OHRP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world date on which the amendment was formally initiated or authored. Serves as the primary business event date for the amendment lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential identifier for the amendment (e.g., AM-001, AM-002). Used in regulatory submissions, IRB/IEC correspondence, and TMF filing to uniquely reference the amendment within the study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ICF amendment. Tracks progression from initial drafting through IRB/IEC submission, approval or rejection, and eventual supersession by a subsequent amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of change driving the amendment. Safety updates require expedited IRB/IEC review; protocol changes may require full board review; administrative corrections may qualify for expedited review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance on Amendments

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a subject capacity or competency assessment is required before re-consent can be obtained under this amendment. Relevant for vulnerable populations, pediatric studies, or subjects with cognitive impairment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.55; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; OHRP

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nature and rationale of the changes introduced by this amendment. Captures what was changed, why it was changed, and the impact on subject safety or study conduct.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; OHRP

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction in which this amendment applies. Supports country-specific regulatory tracking where different health authorities have different amendment requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E6(R2); FDA; EMA; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ICF amendment record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: deviation_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to the amendment indicating the potential for protocol deviations if re-consent is not completed within the required timeframe. Informs monitoring prioritization in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA Guidance on Oversight of Clinical Investigations; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: econsent_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amended ICF will be deployed via the Clinpal eConsent platform. When True, triggers the eConsent build and validation workflow in Clinpal for the resulting ICF version.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; Clinpal eConsent

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data privacy provisions apply to this amendment, typically for studies enrolling subjects in EU/EEA countries. When True, the amended ICF must include GDPR-compliant data processing disclosures.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 6, 7, 9, 13, 14; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether HIPAA authorization provisions apply to this amendment, typically for studies enrolling subjects at U.S. sites. When True, the amended ICF must include a HIPAA-compliant authorization section.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP

tag_set.value: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: The date from which the amended ICF version becomes effective for use at clinical sites. Sites must not use the amended ICF prior to this date. Typically set to or after the IRB/IEC approval date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_decision
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Decision
attributes.description: The formal decision rendered by the IRB or IEC on the amendment submission. Approved with modifications requires a revised ICF resubmission before implementation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56.109; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Decision

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the amended ICF document (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, de-DE). Multi-language studies require separate amendment tracking per language version.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.6; GDPR Article 7; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: lar_consent_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) Consent Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent from a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) is applicable for this amendment, typically for subjects who lack decision-making capacity. Triggers LAR-specific consent workflow in Clinpal.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.55; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; OHRP

tag_set.value: Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) Consent Applicable Flag

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, internal comments, or contextual information related to the amendment that does not fit into structured fields. Not intended for regulatory submission content.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: reconsent_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which all affected subjects must complete re-consent. Null when reconsent_required is False. Used to monitor site compliance and escalate overdue re-consent activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; OHRP

attributes.name: reconsent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether currently enrolled subjects are obligated to provide re-consent under this amendment. True triggers re-consent workflow initiation in Clinpal and site notification via the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment must be submitted to a health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA) as part of an IND, CTA, or equivalent regulatory filing. True triggers a regulatory submission workflow in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the IRB or IEC for rejecting or deferring the amendment. Populated only when irb_iec_decision is rejected or deferred. Required for CAPA tracking in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56.109; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: requiring_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority, ethics committee, or organizational body that mandated or triggered this amendment. Supports regulatory inspection readiness by documenting the source of the amendment requirement.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Principal Investigator (PI) or medical monitor who reviewed and approved the amendment content prior to IRB/IEC submission. Supports GCP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was triggered by a safety finding, SUSAR, SAE signal, or DSMB/DMC recommendation. Safety-related amendments require expedited IRB/IEC review and may trigger immediate site notification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: site_applicability
attributes.description: Defines whether this amendment applies to all clinical sites globally, a specific subset of sites, or only sites within a particular country. Drives site notification and monitoring workflows in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor formally approved the amendment content prior to IRB/IEC submission. Required for sponsor oversight documentation in the TMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: tmf_section_reference
attributes.description: The TMF Reference Model section code under which this amendment document is filed (e.g., 06.02.01 for ICF amendments). Ensures correct eTMF filing and supports inspection readiness metrics.
attributes.references: TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ICF amendment record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: veeva_document_code
attributes.description: The document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF for the amendment package (cover letter, revised ICF, IRB/IEC correspondence). Supports TMF completeness checks and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; TMF Reference Model

products.name: consent_delegation_log
products.description: Records the delegation of consent-related responsibilities at a site, capturing which qualified staff members (PI, sub-investigator, CRC) are authorized to conduct the informed consent process for a given study.
products.reference: Delegation of Authority Log / Consent Delegation Log

attributes.name: consent_delegation_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent delegation log record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.2; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: gcp_training_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Training Record ID
attributes.description: Reference to the GCP training record in MasterControl that documents the staff member's current GCP certification, supporting delegation eligibility verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.2.5; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR 312.53

tag_set.value: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Training Record ID

attributes.name: primary_consent_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the site staff member (PI, sub-investigator, CRC, or other qualified personnel) to whom consent responsibilities are delegated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.2; Workday HCM

attributes.name: protocol_training_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the protocol-specific training record confirming the staff member has been trained on the study protocol prior to conducting consent activities.

attributes.name: consent_collection_method
attributes.description: The method by which data processing consent was collected from the data subject. 'econsent' refers to Clinpal or equivalent eConsent platform; 'paper' refers to physical ICF/consent form; 'electronic_signature' refers to 21 CFR Part 11 compliant
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the data subject provided explicit consent to data processing. This is the principal real-world event date for the consent transaction, distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 13/14; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this data processing consent expires, if a defined consent period was specified. Null for open-ended consents. Triggers re-consent workflow when approaching.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: consent_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique reference number assigned to this data processing consent record (e.g., DPC-2024-00123). Used for audit trails, regulatory submissions, and subject rights request tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing Activities); HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the data processing consent record. 'active' indicates valid consent in force; 'withdrawn' indicates the data subject has revoked consent; 'expired' indicates the consent period has lapsed; 'pending' indicates awaiting subject
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this data processing consent record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: data_access_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has exercised their right of access under GDPR Article 15 to obtain a copy of their personal data. True = access request submitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 15; GDPR Article 12(3)

attributes.name: data_erasure_request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the data subject submitted a request for erasure of their personal data. Null if no erasure request has been made. Initiates the 30-day regulatory response clock.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; GDPR Article 12(3)

attributes.name: data_erasure_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has exercised their right to erasure (right to be forgotten) under GDPR Article 17. True = erasure request submitted. Triggers data deletion or anonymization workflow.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; GDPR Article 19

attributes.name: data_portability_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has exercised their right to data portability under GDPR Article 20, requesting their data in a structured, machine-readable format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 20; GDPR Article 12(3)

attributes.name: data_processor_name
attributes.description: The name of the legal entity acting as the GDPR Data Processor processing personal data on behalf of the Data Controller (e.g., the CRO, EDC vendor, or laboratory). Required for GDPR Article 30 records.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(8); GDPR Article 28; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: data_restriction_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has exercised their right to restriction of processing under GDPR Article 18. True = restriction request submitted. Limits further processing until resolved.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 18; GDPR Article 19

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Date
attributes.description: The date on which the HIPAA Authorization was signed by the data subject or their legally authorized representative. Null if HIPAA authorization is not applicable.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Expiry Date
attributes.description: The date on which the HIPAA Authorization expires, if a specific expiration date was stated. Null if the authorization is open-ended or not applicable.

attributes.description: Indicates whether a HIPAA Authorization (45 CFR 164.508) is required for this data subject in addition to GDPR consent, applicable for US-based subjects or US-covered entities. True = HIPAA authorization required.

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Reference
attributes.description: The IRB or IEC approval reference number for the privacy notice and data processing consent form version used. Confirms that the consent documentation was reviewed and approved by the ethics committee.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 3.1; OHRP 45 CFR 46; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4; FDA 21 CFR 56

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Reference

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this consent record (e.g., 'EU', 'US', 'UK', 'JP', 'AU'). Determines which privacy regulation (GDPR, HIPAA, UK GDPR, APPI, Privacy Act) governs the data processing consent.
attributes.references: GDPR; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The GDPR Article 6 lawful basis under which personal data is processed. 'consent' applies when the data subject has given explicit consent; other bases apply per applicable regulatory context. Required for GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing Activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 9(2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: notice_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country subtag) of the privacy notice delivered to the data subject (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'ja', 'en-US'). Ensures the notice was provided in the subject's native language.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(1); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2

attributes.name: primary_research_consent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Research Data Processing Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has consented to processing of their personal data for the primary clinical research purpose of the study (e.g., efficacy and safety analysis). True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 9(2)(j); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28

tag_set.value: Primary Research Data Processing Consent Flag

attributes.name: privacy_notice_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the privacy notice was delivered to the data subject prior to or at the time of consent. Required to demonstrate compliance with GDPR transparency obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; GDPR Article 14

attributes.name: privacy_notice_delivery_method
attributes.description: The method by which the privacy notice was delivered to the data subject. Supports audit evidence for GDPR transparency compliance. Values: paper, electronic (e.g., Clinpal eConsent), verbal (with written record), email, portal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; GDPR Article 14; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: privacy_notice_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privacy notice (per GDPR Articles 13/14) delivered to the data subject at the time of consent. Enables tracking of which notice version was in effect when consent was obtained.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; GDPR Article 14; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: re_consent_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the data subject completed the re-consent process following a re-consent trigger. Null if re-consent has not yet been completed.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2

attributes.name: re_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject is required to provide fresh data processing consent due to a material change in processing purposes, privacy notice amendment, or protocol amendment. True = re-consent workflow must be initiated.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32; ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: re_consent_trigger_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason that triggered the re-consent requirement, such as a protocol amendment, updated privacy notice, new data processing purpose, or change in data controller. Null if re_consent_required is False.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28

attributes.name: recontact_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has consented to being re-contacted for future studies, follow-up research, or additional data collection after the current study concludes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 13(2)(a); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: rights_request_response_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Subject Rights Request Response Date
attributes.description: The date on which the organization responded to the data subject's rights request. Must be within 30 days of the request per GDPR Article 12(3). Null if no rights request has been submitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(3); GDPR Article 12(4)

tag_set.value: Data Subject Rights Request Response Date

attributes.name: rights_request_status
attributes.description: Current status of any outstanding data subject rights request (access, erasure, restriction, portability) associated with this consent record. 'none' if no rights request has been submitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12; GDPR Articles 15-20

attributes.name: secondary_research_consent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secondary Research Data Processing Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has consented to use of their data for secondary research purposes beyond the primary study objective (e.g., exploratory analyses, future research). True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 89; ICH E6(R2)

tag_set.value: Secondary Research Data Processing Consent Flag

attributes.name: subject_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the data subject formally acknowledged receipt and understanding of the privacy notice. May differ from consent_date if acknowledgment precedes formal consent signature.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 13; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has consented to sharing of their personal data with third parties (e.g., sponsors, regulatory authorities, CRO partners, academic institutions). True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 46; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this data processing consent record was last modified. Tracks amendments, status changes, and withdrawal events for audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the data subject withdrew their data processing consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Triggers downstream data erasure or restriction workflows per GDPR Article 17.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508(b)(5)

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the data subject for withdrawing data processing consent. Supports regulatory reporting and subject rights management.

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.description: File name of the translated ICF document as stored in the eTMF or document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault). Supports document retrieval and audit trail.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: econsent_platform_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for this translated ICF version within the eConsent platform (Clinpal). Enables traceability between the lakehouse record and the operational eConsent workflow system.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this translated ICF version is authorized for use in subject consent activities at the applicable site. Typically aligned with IRB/IEC approval date or sponsor authorization date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; GCP; FDA 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this translated ICF version requires separate IRB/IEC approval in the applicable country or region. True = local ethics committee approval is required before use at site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Required Flag

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Status
attributes.description: Current approval status of this translated ICF version with the relevant IRB or IEC. 'not_submitted' = pending submission; 'submitted' = under review; 'approved' = ethics committee approved; 'rejected' = not approved; 'waived' = formal approval waived by
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Status

attributes.name: irb_iec_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Name
attributes.description: Name of the IRB or IEC responsible for reviewing and approving this translated ICF version. Supports multi-site trials where different ethics committees govern different countries.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR 56; EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Name

attributes.name: quality_review_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal quality review (QC check) of the translated ICF has been completed by the sponsor, CRO, or designated reviewer. True = QC review passed. Supports GCP quality assurance requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; GCP; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: quality_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the quality review of the translated ICF was completed. Null if quality review has not yet been performed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; ALCOA+; MasterControl

attributes.name: readability_grade_level
attributes.description: Descriptive grade level or reading age equivalent of the translated ICF (e.g., '6th grade', 'B1 CEFR'). Supports compliance with FDA and EMA guidance that consent documents be understandable to the lay population.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); EMA; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: readability_score
attributes.description: Numeric readability score of the translated ICF document (e.g., Flesch-Kincaid or equivalent localized readability metric). Regulatory guidance recommends ICF documents be written at an appropriate reading level for the target population.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any discrepancies identified during back-translation reconciliation and how they were resolved. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: region_name
attributes.description: Named geographic region or territory for which this translation applies when a single language spans multiple countries (e.g., 'Latin America Spanish', 'Canadian French'). Supplements country_code for multi-country language variants.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: source_icf_version_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Number
attributes.description: The version number of the source (original language) ICF document that was translated, as assigned by the sponsor or CRO (e.g., v1.0, v2.1). Ensures traceability between source and translated documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR 50

tag_set.value: Source Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Number

attributes.name: source_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter code representing the original language of the ICF document prior to translation (e.g., 'en' for English). Establishes the translation direction.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor formally approved this translated ICF version. Null if sponsor approval has not been granted or is not required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8; GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal sponsor approval is required for this translated ICF version before it can be submitted to the IRB/IEC or used at site. True = sponsor sign-off is mandatory.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8; GCP; FDA 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: translation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ICF translation document. 'draft' = initial translation in progress; 'under_review' = submitted for back-translation or IRB/IEC review; 'approved' = IRB/IEC approved for use at site; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: superseded_date
attributes.description: The date on which this translated ICF version was superseded by a newer approved version. Null if the translation is still current. Supports lifecycle management and ensures subjects are consented with the most current version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; GCP; FDA 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: target_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter code representing the language into which the ICF was translated (e.g., 'fr' for French, 'de' for German, 'ja' for Japanese). Required per GCP ICH E6 to provide consent in the subject's native language.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: target_language_name
attributes.description: Human-readable full name of the target language (e.g., 'French', 'German', 'Japanese'). Complements the ISO code for display in reports and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: translator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual translator who performed the forward translation of the ICF, when translation is performed by a named individual rather than a vendor organization. Supports ALCOA+ attributability requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: translator_qualification
attributes.description: Description of the translator's professional qualifications, certifications, or credentials (e.g., ATA Certified Translator, medical translation specialist). Supports GCP documentation of qualified personnel.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.2; ISO 17100; GCP

attributes.name: translation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of consent document translated. 'full' = complete ICF; 'summary' = short-form consent summary; 'assent' = pediatric assent form; 'lay_summary' = plain language summary; 'amendment_only' = translation of an ICF amendment only.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR 50.27; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this consent translation record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vault_document_code
attributes.description: The unique document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault eTMF for the translated ICF document. Enables direct cross-reference to the source system of record for document retrieval.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

products.name: consent_deviation
products.description: Records protocol deviations specifically related to the informed consent process, such as consent obtained after study procedures began, expired ICF version used, missing witness signature, or re-consent not completed within required timeframe.

attributes.name: consent_deviation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent deviation record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: consent_icf_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Informed Consent Form (ICF) version that was involved in or relevant to the deviation (e.g., the expired version that was used, or the version that should have been used for re-consent).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; Clinpal eConsent version management

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: A consent deviation records a protocol deviation in the consent process for a specific subject.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: discovered_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Consent deviation discovery must be attributed to a specific qualified employee for CAPA root cause analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dispensing_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.dispensing_record. Business justification: The most critical consent deviation type is IMP dispensed without valid consent. Linking consent_deviation directly to the causative dispensing_record enables root cause analysis
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent protocol deviation record in the compliance domain, if this consent deviation was also logged as a broader protocol deviation. Enables cross-domain traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; compliance.protocol_deviation product

attributes.name: reconsent_trigger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.reconsent_trigger. Business justification: consent_deviation has reconsent_required (BOOLEAN) and reconsent_completed_date (DATE) fields. When a consent deviation requires re-consent, a reconsent_trigger is raised.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study in which the consent deviation occurred. Links to the study master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS study entity

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the consent deviation was identified. Links to the site master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; Oracle Siebel CTMS site entity

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: Consent deviations (e.g., randomization before consent, wrong ICF version at randomization) must be linked to the specific randomization event for population impact
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Consent deviation reports must be filed in the TMF for inspection readiness and regulatory oversight.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) associated with this consent deviation. Links to the subject master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9; HIPAA 45 CFR 164

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes entered by the deviation owner, quality manager, or reviewer that do not fit into other structured fields. Captures supplementary context for audit trail and inspection readiness purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the immediate corrective actions taken to address this specific consent deviation instance (e.g., re-consent obtained, missing witness signature collected, subject notified).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl CAPA; FDA CAPA guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this consent deviation record was first created in the system, capturing the audit trail entry point. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: data_integrity_impacted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the consent deviation has a potential impact on the integrity or validity of data collected from the affected subject, which may affect the subject's inclusion in analysis populations (ITT, PP).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; CDISC SDTM; FDA Data Integrity Guidance (2018); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: consent_deviation_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific nature of the consent deviation, including what happened, when, and the circumstances surrounding the event. Provides context beyond the structured deviation type classification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; GCP audit trail requirements

attributes.name: deviation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the consent deviation record, typically assigned by the CTMS or quality management system (e.g., CD-STUDY001-00042). Used for cross-system referencing, regulatory inspection, and CAPA linkage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; MasterControl deviation numbering convention

attributes.name: deviation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent deviation record, tracking its workflow from initial identification through resolution and closure. Drives inspection readiness dashboards and CAPA workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl quality event lifecycle; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the specific type of informed consent process failure. Examples: consent obtained after study procedures began (consent_after_procedure), an expired ICF version was used (expired_icf_version), required witness signature was
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the consent deviation was first identified or discovered, whether by site staff, a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) during monitoring, or through a data review. Distinct from the date the deviation occurred.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 312.62; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: impact_assessment
attributes.description: Narrative assessment of the actual or potential impact of the consent deviation on subject rights, subject safety, data integrity, and study validity. Informs the regulatory reportability determination and severity classification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Oversight of Clinical Investigations; EMA GCP Inspection Findings

attributes.name: inspection_ready
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this consent deviation record and all associated documentation (CAPA, notifications, re-consent records) are complete and ready for regulatory inspection review. Supports inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA Inspection Readiness; EMA GCP Inspection Findings; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of this consent deviation. Nullable if notification has not yet occurred or is not required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3.7; 21 CFR Part 56.108; OHRP 45 CFR 46

attributes.name: irb_iec_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notified Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study has been formally notified of this consent deviation, as required by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3.7; 21 CFR Part 56.108; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 52; OHRP 45 CFR 46

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notified Flag

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the consent deviation actually occurred (e.g., the date the study procedure was performed before consent was obtained, or the date the expired ICF was signed).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: pi_aware
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the Principal Investigator (PI) at the site has been made aware of this consent deviation. PI awareness is a GCP requirement for site-level deviation management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.60; FDA Guidance on Investigator Responsibilities

attributes.name: pi_awareness_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was formally made aware of this consent deviation. Used to track timeliness of PI notification and GCP compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.60

attributes.name: preventive_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of preventive actions planned or implemented to prevent recurrence of this type of consent deviation (e.g., site retraining on ICF version control, system alert configuration in Clinpal for ICF expiry).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl CAPA; ISO 9001 preventive action

attributes.name: reconsent_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the required re-consent process was completed and the subject signed the appropriate ICF version. Nullable if re-consent is not required or has not yet been completed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; Clinpal eConsent; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: reconsent_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the subject must undergo a re-consent process as a corrective action for this deviation (e.g., signing the current approved ICF version to replace an expired version that was used).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; Clinpal eConsent re-consent workflow

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this consent deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, etc.), IRB/IEC, or sponsor per applicable regulations and the study protocol. Drives regulatory submission workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 52; EMA GCP Inspection Findings

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent deviation was formally reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority as applicable. Used to calculate reporting timeliness and compliance with notification windows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 52

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent deviation was fully resolved, including completion of any required corrective actions (e.g., re-consent obtained, missing signatures collected, CAPA closed). Nullable until resolution is achieved.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl CAPA closure; FDA Inspection readiness

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Documented root cause analysis narrative explaining the underlying reason the consent deviation occurred (e.g., site staff training gap, ICF version control failure, system notification failure for re-consent trigger).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA CAPA guidance; MasterControl root cause analysis module

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Structured categorical classification of the root cause to enable trend analysis across deviations. Categories include training deficiencies, process failures, system issues, communication breakdowns, and oversight gaps.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA Quality Systems Guidance; ISO 9001 root cause classification

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Risk-based severity classification of the consent deviation. Critical deviations may directly impact subject rights, safety, or data integrity and typically require immediate escalation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Oversight of Clinical Investigations (2013); EMA GCP Inspection Findings

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., MasterControl deviation record number, Clinpal event ID). Enables reverse traceability from the lakehouse back to the system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ data provenance; Databricks Silver Layer lineage

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this consent deviation. Used to calculate notification timeliness against contractual and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_notified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this consent deviation per the Clinical Trial Agreement and GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring workflow

attributes.name: subject_continued_in_study
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the affected subject continued participation in the clinical study following the consent deviation and any required corrective actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: subject_rights_impacted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the consent deviation directly impacted the rights or welfare of the trial subject (e.g., subject underwent a procedure without valid informed consent).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9; OHRP guidance on unanticipated problems

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent deviation record. Used for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

domains.name: randomization
domains.description: Manages subject allocation algorithms, stratification factors, randomization codes, blinding integrity, and unblinding procedures. Integrated with eCRF and supply domains for kit assignment and treatment arm allocation via IRT/IVRS/RTSM systems.

products.name: rand_scheme
products.description: Master definition of a randomization scheme for a clinical study. Captures the allocation algorithm type (simple, block, stratified, minimization, adaptive), block sizes, allocation ratio, seed values, and scheme version.

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the randomization scheme record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: biostatistician_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: ICH E9 and GCP require the randomization scheme to be traceable to the qualified biostatistician who designed it. This is a regulatory audit trail requirement.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Randomization schemes are designed and executed under a governing randomization SOP (e.g., SOP for randomization list generation, IRT management).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.organization. Business justification: Randomization scheme design is sponsor-specific: blinding type, allocation algorithm, and IRT system selection are mandated by the sponsoring organization.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Randomization schemes are designed against a specific protocol version per ICH E9(R1) and GCP requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this randomization scheme is defined. Links the scheme to its parent protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TA Domain

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization scheme was activated in the IRT/RTSM system and made available for subject allocation. Marks transition to 'active' status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: allocation_algorithm
attributes.description: The statistical randomization algorithm used to assign subjects to treatment arms. 'simple' = unrestricted random; 'block' = fixed block sizes; 'stratified_block' = blocks within strata; 'minimization' = dynamic balancing; 'adaptive' = response-adaptive
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: allocation_ratio
attributes.description: Randomization allocation ratio; implements CDISC SDTM TS parameter RANDQT / trial design allocation ratio.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; Oracle Clinical One RTSM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization scheme received formal biostatistics and QA approval, authorizing its use in the study. Marks transition from 'draft' to 'approved' status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual (QA or biostatistics lead) who formally approved the randomization scheme. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding type; implements CDISC SDTM TS parameter BLIND (TSVAL where TSPARMCD=BLIND).
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.5; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: block_size_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of permissible block sizes used in block or stratified-block randomization (e.g., '4,6,8'). Variable block sizes reduce predictability. Null for non-block algorithms.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: cdisc_sdtm_domain
attributes.description: Target CDISC SDTM domain for randomization data (e.g., DM.ARM/ACTARM, TA); implements SDTM domain reference.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD Submission Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this randomization scheme record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: generation_method_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the randomization list generation methodology, including algorithm parameters, SAS/R procedure used, and any special considerations. Included in the Randomization Plan and CSR.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; SAP

attributes.name: generation_software
attributes.description: Name and version of the software used to generate the randomization list (e.g., 'SAS 9.4', 'R 4.2.1', 'the source system 21.3'). Required for regulatory submission and reproducibility validation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of 3-letter ISO country codes where this randomization scheme is applicable (e.g., 'USA,GBR,DEU'). Relevant for multi-regional trials with country-specific regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E9; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA IND; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a scheme amendment requires re-submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Relevant when stratification factors or allocation ratios change.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: irt_scheme_reference
attributes.description: The scheme identifier or configuration reference as recorded in the IRT/RTSM system (e.g., the source system scheme ID or Medidata Rave RTSM list ID). Enables cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: irt_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system used to execute this randomization scheme (e.g., 'the source system 'Medidata Rave RTSM', 'Almac IXRS'). Identifies the operational system of record for subject allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on IRT/IVRS; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: is_centralized
attributes.description: Indicates whether randomization is performed centrally via IRT/IVRS/RTSM (True) or locally at the site (False). Centralized randomization is the standard for GCP-compliant multi-center trials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on IRT; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: is_stratified_by_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether randomization is stratified by investigative site. Site stratification is common in multi-center trials to ensure balance across sites.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: is_variable_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether variable (random) block sizes are used rather than a fixed block size. Variable blocks reduce the ability to predict upcoming assignments and are preferred for double-blind studies.

attributes.name: maximum_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of subjects permitted in this stratification cell per treatment arm. Enrollment is capped at this value to prevent over-representation of a stratum.

attributes.name: minimum_enrollment_count

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: protocol_version

attributes.name: randomization_method

attributes.name: randomized_count
