attributes.references: IFRS 10; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: gdpr_data_controller_role
attributes.description: Defines the GDPR data controller/processor role of the child organization relative to the parent for clinical trial subject data. Controller = determines purposes and means; Joint Controller = shared determination; Processor = processes on behalf of
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, 26, 28; ICH E6(R2); EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth level of the child organization within the corporate hierarchy tree. Level 1 represents a direct subsidiary of the ultimate parent; higher values indicate deeper nesting.
attributes.references: ISO 15926 Industrial Data; IFRS 10

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain from the ultimate parent to the child organization, using a delimiter-separated list of organization IDs (e.g., '1001/1045/1078').

attributes.name: hierarchy_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this hierarchy relationship record, supporting optimistic concurrency control and change history tracking. Incremented each time the relationship attributes are updated.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Audit Trail); ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+

attributes.name: ind_holder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child organization holds or co-holds an Investigational New Drug (IND) application or equivalent regulatory authorization (e.g., CTA in EU) in its own name. Relevant for regulatory accountability and submission ownership tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_controlling_entity
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parent organization exercises control over the child organization as defined by IFRS 10 (power over investee, exposure to variable returns, ability to use power to affect returns). True = controlling; False = non-controlling interest.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: is_primary_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship represents the primary (canonical) reporting path for the child organization when multiple parent relationships exist (e.g., matrix structures or dual-reporting affiliates).
attributes.references: IFRS 10; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contextual information about the organizational hierarchy relationship not captured in structured fields (e.g., special contractual arrangements, regulatory carve-outs, transition notes during M&A activity).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of equity ownership held by the parent organization in the child organization, expressed as a decimal value between 0.00 and 100.00. Critical for determining consolidation thresholds under IFRS 10 and for sponsor financial roll-up reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SEC Regulation S-K Item 601; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: pipeline_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the sponsor's drug development pipeline that the child organization is responsible for managing or contracting. Supports portfolio analytics and CRO engagement planning across the sponsor corporate family.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority governing the child organization's clinical trial activities (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, TGA, MHRA, Health Canada). Determines applicable regulatory submission requirements and GCP compliance frameworks for studies contracted
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); PMDA; TGA; MHRA; Health Canada

attributes.name: relationship_basis
attributes.description: The legal or operational basis underpinning the parent-child relationship. Equity = share ownership; Contractual = agreement-based control without equity; Regulatory = regulatory-mandated grouping; Operational = functional reporting without legal
attributes.references: IFRS 10; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: relationship_code

attributes.references: ISO 11179; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the parent-child organizational relationship. Drives whether the relationship is included in active roll-up reporting and sponsor portfolio consolidation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IFRS 10

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the corporate relationship between the parent and child organization. Drives roll-up logic and reporting scope. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|subsidiary|affiliate|division|joint_venture|licensee|branch|representative_office —
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SEC Regulation S-K; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sap_company_code

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_alignment

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: voting_rights_percentage

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: fast_track_designation

attributes.name: geography_scope

attributes.name: phase_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated by the sponsor for all clinical development activities within this phase, expressed in US Dollars. Classified as confidential due to commercially sensitive financial content.

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the clinical development phase of the pipeline asset. Covers the full continuum from preclinical research through post-marketing.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1) General Considerations for Clinical Studies; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Clinical Development

attributes.name: phase_duration_days
attributes.description: Actual number of calendar days elapsed during this development phase, calculated from phase_start_date to phase_end_date. Null if the phase is still active. Used for benchmarking development timelines against industry standards.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA PDUFA Performance Goals; EMA Annual Report

attributes.name: phase_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the pipeline asset completed or exited this development phase. Null if the phase is still active. Used to calculate phase duration and development timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: phase_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for the clinical development phase (e.g., 'Phase I', 'Phase IIb', 'NDA/BLA Submission'). Used in reports, dashboards, and regulatory documents.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); CDISC SDTM IG Domain TA

attributes.name: phase_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number representing the chronological order of this phase record within the pipeline asset's development history. Enables correct ordering of phase transitions for longitudinal analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: phase_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the pipeline asset formally entered this development phase. For Phase I, this typically aligns with first-in-human (FIH) dosing; for NDA/BLA, with submission filing date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: phase_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the pipeline asset within this development phase. Indicates whether the phase is actively progressing, has been completed, is temporarily suspended, or has been terminated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: planned_phase_end_date
attributes.description: Originally planned calendar date for the pipeline asset to complete this development phase. Used to measure schedule variance and forecast downstream phase timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA IND Regulations; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: planned_phase_start_date
attributes.description: Originally planned calendar date for the pipeline asset to enter this development phase, as defined in the integrated development plan. Used to measure schedule variance against actual start.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA IND Regulations; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: previous_phase_code
attributes.description: Phase code of the immediately preceding development phase for this pipeline asset. Enables direct traversal of the phase history chain without requiring a self-join. Null for the first phase record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: primary_endpoint_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary efficacy or safety endpoint defined for this development phase was met upon phase completion. True = primary endpoint achieved; False = not achieved; Null = phase not yet completed or endpoint not yet evaluated.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; EMA Guideline on Clinical Development

attributes.name: regulatory_milestone_achieved
attributes.description: Description of the key regulatory milestone achieved upon completion or during this phase (e.g., 'IND Clearance', 'End-of-Phase-II Meeting', 'NDA Acceptance', 'Breakthrough Therapy Designation'). Null if no milestone was achieved.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_milestone_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the regulatory milestone associated with this phase was formally achieved or received. Used for regulatory timeline tracking and submission planning.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_strategy_notes

attributes.name: study_count

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: termination_reason_category

attributes.name: transition_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for why the pipeline asset transitioned into or out of this development phase. Captures scientific, regulatory, commercial, or safety rationale for phase progression, hold, or termination.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.42 (Clinical Hold); EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: transition_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the type of phase transition event. Distinguishes between forward progression, temporary hold, full termination, restart after hold, or protocol amendment-driven transition.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.42; EMA Guideline on Clinical Development

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pipeline asset phase record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the interaction took place, such as sponsor headquarters city, CRO office address, or virtual platform name (e.g., 'Pfizer HQ - New York', 'MS Teams').
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: meeting_cadence
attributes.description: Scheduled recurrence frequency for this type of interaction as defined in the governance framework or contract. Used to assess cadence compliance against contractual obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: minutes_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting minutes for this interaction have been formally reviewed and approved by both sponsor and CRO representatives. True = approved; False = pending or not applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: minutes_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meeting minutes were formally approved by both parties. Used to measure minutes turnaround time against governance SLA targets.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: next_interaction_date
attributes.description: Agreed or planned date for the next scheduled interaction of the same type with this sponsor. Supports meeting cadence planning and account management follow-up.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: open_action_item_count
attributes.description: Number of action items generated from this interaction that remain open and unresolved at the time of record update. Supports governance compliance dashboards and follow-up tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Overall qualitative outcome of the interaction from a relationship management perspective: positive (objectives met, relationship strengthened), neutral, negative (concerns raised), escalated (issues requiring senior intervention), or deferred (key
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique reference number for this interaction, used in meeting minutes, action item trackers, and governance logs. Format: INT-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Primary regulatory agency relevant to the regulatory strategy discussion in this interaction, if applicable (e.g., FDA for IND/NDA strategy calls, EMA for MAA discussions).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory submission discussed during a regulatory strategy call interaction, such as Investigational New Drug (IND), New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA), or Marketing Authorization Application (MAA).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH CTD

attributes.name: sponsor_participant_count
attributes.description: Number of sponsor-side individuals who attended this interaction. Used for engagement intensity analysis and governance tier compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_participant_names
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sponsor-side personnel who participated in this interaction. Stored as a denormalized text field for meeting minutes and engagement history reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the interaction commenced, including timezone offset. Used for duration calculation and meeting cadence compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the interaction record: scheduled (confirmed on calendar), completed (held and minutes finalized), cancelled, rescheduled, or pending_minutes (held but minutes not yet approved).
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief title or subject line summarizing the purpose of the interaction, analogous to a meeting subject line in calendar systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area or disease indication relevant to this interaction (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology). Enables portfolio-level engagement analysis by therapeutic area.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MedDRA

attributes.name: total_action_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of action items raised during this interaction, including both open and closed items. Used to assess meeting productivity and governance rigor.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interaction by its business purpose. Governance meetings include Joint Steering Committee (JSC), Joint Operations Committee (JOC), Executive Business Review (EBR), and Quarterly Business Review (QBR).
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this interaction record, including timezone offset. Required for change tracking and audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

products.name: review_meeting
products.description: Tracks formal governance meetings between sponsor and CRO organizations including Joint Steering Committee (JSC), Joint Operations Committee (JOC), Executive Business Reviews (EBR), and Quality Business Reviews (QBR).
products.reference: Joint Steering Committee / JSC / JOC / EBR / QBR

attributes.name: review_meeting_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sponsor-CRO governance review meeting record in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.clinical_program. Business justification: Sponsor review meetings occur at the program level (e.g., program steering committees, joint development committees).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cro_chair_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Governance meeting records require a proper FK to the CRO employee chairing the meeting for minutes approval, action item ownership, audit trail completeness, and GCP inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.sponsor_contact. Business justification: The sponsor_review_meeting table stores sponsor_chair as a free-text string. Adding sponsor_contact_id FK (nullable) normalizes the sponsor chair reference to the sponsor_contact
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that funds and owns the clinical trial portfolio covered by this governance meeting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: preferred_provider_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.preferred_provider_agreement. Business justification: Alliance governance review meetings (QBRs, annual reviews) are conducted at the PPA level to review volume attainment, service performance, and strategic alignment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sponsor_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.engagement. Business justification: Formal governance meetings between sponsor and CRO occur within the context of a commercial engagement.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing contract (preferred provider agreement, FSP agreement, or master service agreement) under which this governance meeting cadence is required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_study. Business justification: Sponsor governance review meetings (JSC, PMC, DSMB prep) are held for specific studies. Linking sponsor_review_meeting to study enables study-level governance tracking, meeting minutes
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Formal sponsor review meetings are frequently convened to review regulatory submission readiness, submission status, and agency responses.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal meeting minutes document stored in the eTMF or document management system (Veeva Vault). Links the governance meeting record to its official written record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: action_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of action items raised during the governance meeting, each with an assigned owner and due date. Drives follow-up tracking and accountability reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: The date on which the governance meeting actually took place. May differ from scheduled_date if the meeting was rescheduled. Null if the meeting has not yet occurred or was cancelled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the governance meeting actually concluded. Used to calculate actual meeting duration and assess time management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the governance meeting actually commenced. Compared against scheduled_start_time to measure punctuality and governance discipline.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: agenda_distributed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meeting agenda was formally distributed to all participants. Used to verify compliance with advance-notice requirements stipulated in the governance charter (e.g., 5 business days prior).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; governance charter

attributes.name: agenda_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal agenda items included in the meeting. Provides a high-level measure of meeting scope and complexity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of commercial agreement under which this governance meeting is mandated. FSP = Functional Service Provider agreement; Preferred Provider = strategic preferred provider agreement; Full Service = end-to-end CRO engagement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA contract management

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the meeting was cancelled or rescheduled. Populated only when meeting_status is Cancelled or Rescheduled. Required for governance audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this governance meeting record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: cro_attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of CRO-side participants who attended the governance meeting. Used for quorum validation and engagement analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: decision_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal decisions recorded during the governance meeting. Supports governance effectiveness tracking and decision velocity analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: escalation_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal escalations raised during the governance meeting. Null or zero when escalation_raised is False. Used for risk and relationship health analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; preferred provider agreement escalation procedures

attributes.name: escalation_description
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the escalation(s) raised during the meeting, including the nature of the issue, impacted studies or workstreams, and the escalation path. Null when no escalations were raised.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: escalation_raised
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more formal escalations were raised during this governance meeting. True = at least one escalation was formally logged; False = no escalations raised. Triggers escalation management workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; preferred provider agreement escalation procedures

attributes.name: financial_review_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal financial review (budget burn, pass-through reconciliation, change orders) was included as an agenda item in this governance meeting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA; SOX

attributes.name: governance_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier of the governance meeting within the sponsor-CRO governance framework. Executive = C-suite/VP level (EBR); Operational = day-to-day operations (JOC); Quality = quality and compliance focus (QBR); Portfolio = cross-study strategic
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; preferred provider agreement governance frameworks

attributes.name: kpi_review_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal KPI dashboard review was included as an agenda item in this governance meeting. True = KPI review conducted; False = KPI review not included.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; preferred provider agreement KPI frameworks

attributes.name: meeting_format
attributes.description: Modality of the governance meeting: In-Person (all participants physically co-located), Virtual (fully remote via video/teleconference), or Hybrid (mix of in-person and remote participants).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: meeting_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually defined recurrence frequency for this meeting type under the governing sponsor-CRO agreement. Drives automated scheduling and cadence compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; preferred provider agreement governance schedules

attributes.name: meeting_location
attributes.description: Physical venue or virtual platform where the meeting was held (e.g., 'Sponsor HQ, New York — Conference Room A' or 'Microsoft Teams'). Null for fully virtual meetings where platform is captured separately.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: meeting_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the governance meeting (e.g., JSC-2024-007). Used in correspondence, agendas, and minutes to uniquely identify the meeting across systems.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: meeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the governance meeting. Tracks whether the meeting is upcoming (Scheduled), has occurred (Completed), was cancelled, rescheduled, or is currently in session (In Progress).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: meeting_summary
attributes.description: High-level narrative summary of the key topics discussed, decisions reached, and outcomes of the governance meeting. Intended for executive stakeholders who require a concise overview without reading full minutes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: meeting_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the governance meeting as it appears on the agenda and formal minutes (e.g., 'Q3 2024 Joint Steering Committee — Oncology Portfolio Review').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formal governance meeting. JSC = Joint Steering Committee; JOC = Joint Operations Committee; EBR = Executive Business Review; QBR = Quality Business Review; Ad Hoc = unscheduled governance session; Other = any other formal governance
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CTMS governance frameworks

attributes.name: minutes_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meeting minutes were formally approved by both sponsor and CRO representatives. Null until minutes reach Approved/Finalized status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: minutes_status
attributes.description: Current approval lifecycle state of the formal meeting minutes. Tracks progression from initial draft through sponsor and CRO review to final approval and archival.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: next_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date agreed upon during this meeting for the next occurrence of the same governance meeting type. Supports forward scheduling and cadence continuity tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: open_action_item_count
attributes.description: Number of action items from this meeting that remain open (not yet completed or closed) at the time of last record update. Key KPI for governance health and accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: quality_review_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal quality metrics review (e.g., protocol deviations, CAPA status, audit findings) was included as an agenda item. Relevant for QBR meeting types.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl; ISO 9001

attributes.name: quorum_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the minimum required number of attendees (quorum) as defined in the governance charter was present, making the meeting's decisions formally binding. True = quorum achieved; False = quorum not met.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; governance charter requirements

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The originally planned calendar date on which the governance meeting was scheduled to occur. Used for cadence tracking and SLA compliance under preferred provider agreements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the governance meeting was scheduled to conclude. Used to calculate planned meeting duration and manage participant availability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the governance meeting was scheduled to begin. Supports calendar management and multi-timezone coordination between sponsor and CRO.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of sponsor-side participants who attended the governance meeting. Used for quorum validation and engagement analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_chair
attributes.description: Full name of the sponsor-side individual who chairs or co-chairs the governance meeting. Typically a senior sponsor representative such as a VP Clinical Development or Alliance Manager.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic area or disease domain covered by the portfolio of studies reviewed in this governance meeting (e.g., Oncology, Cardiovascular, Neuroscience, Immunology). Enables portfolio-level analytics by therapeutic area.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this governance meeting record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

products.name: bid_request

products.reference: RFP / Request for Proposal / Bid Request

attributes.name: bid_request_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the bid request record in the CRO's business development pipeline. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.clinical_program. Business justification: Bid requests are submitted for studies within a clinical program. Program-level bid aggregation drives win/loss analysis and CRO pipeline forecasting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: confidentiality_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.confidentiality_agreement. Business justification: Before an RFP/bid package is shared with a CRO, a CDA must be executed.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.health_authority. Business justification: Bid requests for regulatory affairs services must reference the target health authority to scope submission effort, clock days, fee estimates, and eCTD format requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: indication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.indication. Business justification: Bid requests are for studies targeting a specific indication. Standardized indication coding is required for win/loss analysis and CRO capability matching.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.master_service_agreement. Business justification: Bid requests submitted under an existing MSA framework reference the MSA for applicable terms, rate structures, and service scope.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that submitted this bid request / Request for Proposal (RFP) to the CRO.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: parent_bid_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original bid request record if this is a resubmission or amendment. Enables lineage tracking across bid iterations for the same study opportunity.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: pipeline_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.pipeline_asset. Business justification: A bid request is typically submitted for a specific investigational product in the sponsor's pipeline.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_bid_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CRO's internal business development or proposal lead employee responsible for managing this bid request. Drives accountability and commission tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday HCM

attributes.name: regulatory_procedure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.procedure. Business justification: Bid requests for regulatory affairs work are scoped against a specific regulatory procedure (e.g., FDA NDA standard review, EMA centralized procedure).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sponsor_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.engagement. Business justification: A bid request from a sponsor may be associated with an existing commercial engagement (expansion of scope) or may initiate a new engagement.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_template. Business justification: RFP/bid requests are generated from versioned proposal document templates. Linking ensures audit trail for which template version was used per bid.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.therapeutic_area. Business justification: Bid requests are categorized by therapeutic area for CRO capability matching and win/loss analysis. bid_request has therapeutic_area as a denormalized plain text field.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor formally awarded the study contract to the CRO. Populated only when bid_status = 'awarded'. Triggers transition to study start-up activities.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: bid_defense_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the bid defense meeting or presentation where the CRO presents its proposal to the sponsor's evaluation team. A key milestone in the competitive selection process.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: bid_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bid request within the CRO's business development workflow. Drives pipeline reporting and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: budget_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this bid request (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency sponsor engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX

attributes.name: competing_cro_count
attributes.description: Number of competing Contract Research Organizations (CROs) known to be invited to bid on this RFP. Used for competitive analysis and bid strategy calibration.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: competitive_context
attributes.description: Classification of the competitive environment for this bid: sole-source (only CRO invited), competitive (multiple CROs bidding), preferred provider (CRO has preferred status), or incumbent (CRO currently running the study). Influences bid strategy.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: country_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing the geographic scope of the study as specified in the RFP (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, JPN). Drives regulatory strategy and site feasibility.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bid request record was first created in the system. Audit trail field aligned with ALCOA+ data integrity principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: estimated_budget_amount
attributes.description: CRO's internal gross estimated budget for the full scope of services requested in the RFP, expressed in the budget_currency. Used for revenue forecasting and bid pricing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: estimated_duration_months
attributes.description: Sponsor-estimated total duration of the study in months from first site initiation to database lock (DBL). Used for resource planning and revenue recognition scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: estimated_site_count
attributes.description: Sponsor-provided estimate of the total number of investigative sites to be activated globally. Drives site management, monitoring, and travel budget estimates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: estimated_subject_count
attributes.description: Sponsor-provided estimate of the total number of study subjects (patients) to be enrolled across all sites and countries. Key driver of budget, resource, and timeline estimates.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: investigational_product_name
attributes.description: Name or code of the investigational drug, biologic, or device being studied as provided by the sponsor. May be a compound code prior to INN assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; WHO-DD; FDA IND regulations 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_resubmission
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bid request is a resubmission or revision of a previously submitted proposal for the same study. True if resubmission; False if original submission.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: loss_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the CRO lost this bid to a competitor. Populated only when bid_status = 'lost'. Used for win/loss analysis and continuous improvement of bid strategy.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: no_bid_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CRO formally decided not to submit a proposal for this bid request. Populated only when bid_status = 'no_bid'. Used for pipeline and capacity analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: no_bid_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the CRO elected not to submit a proposal for this bid request. Populated only when bid_status = 'no_bid'. Used for strategic portfolio and capacity analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, sponsor-specific requirements, strategic considerations, or internal commentary relevant to this bid request that is not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: proposal_due_date
attributes.description: Sponsor-mandated deadline by which the CRO must submit its formal proposal and budget in response to the RFP.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CRO formally received the sponsor's Request for Proposal (RFP) or bid request document. Marks the start of the bid lifecycle and triggers internal timelines.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: region_scope
attributes.description: High-level geographic region classification for the study scope. Used for regional capacity planning and business development reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: requested_services
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the specific CRO service modules requested by the sponsor (e.g., clinical monitoring, data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance). Informs scope-of-work development.

attributes.name: rfp_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the sponsor's RFP document stored in the eTMF or document management system (Veeva Vault). Enables traceability between the bid record and the source RFP document.

attributes.name: rfp_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned reference number provided by the sponsor on the Request for Proposal (RFP) document. Used to cross-reference the CRO's bid with the sponsor's procurement records.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: service_model
attributes.description: Type of CRO engagement requested by the sponsor: full-service (CRO manages all functions), Functional Service Provider (FSP) model (CRO provides specific functions), hybrid, or module-specific. Drives scope and pricing.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; CRO Business Development SOP

attributes.name: sponsor_budget_ceiling
attributes.description: Maximum budget amount disclosed by the sponsor in the RFP, if provided. Used to calibrate the CRO's proposal and assess bid competitiveness.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SOX

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary sponsor contact for this bid request. Used for proposal submission and bid defense coordination.

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: governing_law_country

attributes.name: indemnification_scope

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount

attributes.name: payment_schedule_type

attributes.description: Externally-known sequential identifier for the amendment within the context of the parent contract (e.g., AMD-2024-001). Used in legal correspondence and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the amendment. Tracks progression from initial drafting through negotiation, signature collection, execution, and potential supersession or voiding.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: amendment_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the primary purpose of the amendment (e.g., 'Payment Schedule Revision Q3 2024'). Used for identification in contract management systems and legal registers.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal or commercial area being modified by this amendment. Distinguishes amendments that change legal terms, payment terms, liability clauses, confidentiality provisions, termination conditions, or intellectual property rights.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 28; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: amendment_version
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing version number for this amendment, supporting versioned history of the legal contract. Increments when an amendment is revised prior to execution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: change_rationale
attributes.description: Business or legal justification for why this amendment was initiated. Documents the triggering event or business need (e.g., regulatory requirement change, scope renegotiation, dispute resolution).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: clauses_modified
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or narrative identifying the specific contract clause numbers or section references that are modified, added, or deleted by this amendment (e.g., 'Section 4.2, Section 7.1, Exhibit B').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: confidentiality_period_years
attributes.description: Duration in years for which confidentiality obligations apply under the amended contract terms. Relevant when the amendment modifies the confidentiality clause of the master agreement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: contract_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contract and amendment financial values (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency sponsor agreements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this amendment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: cro_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative from the CRO (Contract Research Organization) who signed the amendment. Required for legal validity and regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: cro_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the CRO's authorized signatory (e.g., 'President', 'VP Business Development'). Validates signatory authority level for the CRO party.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: The agreed mechanism for resolving disputes arising from the amended contract terms. Captures whether parties have agreed to arbitration, litigation, mediation, or expert determination.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the amended terms become legally binding and operationally effective. May differ from the execution date if retroactive or future-dated application is agreed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all required parties formally signed and executed the amendment, making it legally binding. Distinct from effective_date which governs when terms apply.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the amended terms cease to apply, if the amendment is time-limited. Null for amendments that remain in force until superseded or the parent contract terminates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: finance_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finance team has reviewed and approved the financial implications of the amendment, including impact on accruals, revenue recognition, and billing milestones.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value change to the parent contract resulting from this amendment (positive for increases, negative for decreases). Expressed in the contract currency. Populated only when financial_impact_flag is True.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: financial_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment has a direct financial impact on the contract value, payment schedule, or billing milestones. True triggers downstream finance accrual and revenue recognition review.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of the amended contract terms (e.g., 'Delaware, USA', 'England and Wales'). Critical for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: indemnification_modified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment modifies the indemnification provisions of the parent contract. Triggers legal and risk management review when True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment process was formally initiated, typically when the first draft was created or the request was submitted. Supports negotiation cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: initiating_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party initiated the amendment request: the pharmaceutical/biotech sponsor, the CRO (Contract Research Organization), or mutually agreed. Supports contract governance analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.50

attributes.name: legal_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the internal legal team has completed their review and approved the amendment language prior to execution. Part of the amendment governance workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302; MasterControl

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the internal legal review was completed and sign-off was granted. Populated when legal_review_completed is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary liability exposure agreed between parties as modified by this amendment. Expressed in contract_currency. Populated when amendment_type includes liability modifications.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: negotiation_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which negotiation was concluded and terms were agreed upon by all parties, prior to formal execution. Enables measurement of negotiation duration as a KPI.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: negotiation_round_count
attributes.description: Number of negotiation rounds completed before the amendment was agreed. Supports KPI reporting on contract negotiation efficiency and legal resource consumption.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which active negotiation between the CRO and sponsor commenced for this amendment. Used to measure negotiation cycle time and track legal resource utilization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: new_payment_terms_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the revised payment terms introduced by this amendment, including net payment days, milestone triggers, or revised billing schedule. Populated only when payment_terms_modified is True.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, or negotiation history notes that do not fit structured fields. Intended for legal and contract management team use.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: payment_terms_modified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment modifies the payment terms of the parent contract, including payment schedule, milestone definitions, or net payment days. Triggers finance team review.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ASC 606; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the required regulatory notification was submitted to the relevant authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.). Populated only when regulatory_notification_required is True.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amendment triggers a regulatory notification obligation to FDA, EMA, or other governing bodies (e.g., changes to sponsor responsibilities under ICH E6). Drives compliance workflow.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MHRA

attributes.name: sponsor_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative from the sponsor organization who signed the amendment. Required for legal validity and regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sponsor_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the sponsor's authorized signatory (e.g., 'VP Clinical Operations', 'Chief Medical Officer'). Validates signatory authority level.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this amendment record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_number
attributes.description: System document identifier in Veeva Vault for the executed amendment document. Supports direct deep-linking from the data lakehouse to the source document management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: service_level_agreement
products.description: Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining measurable performance commitments the CRO must meet for specific service categories (e.g., query resolution turnaround, SAE reporting timelines, monitoring visit frequency, data entry lag).

attributes.name: service_level_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Service Level Agreement record in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SLA approvals by named employees are required for governance and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: SLA performance audits verify CRO adherence to contracted thresholds (e.g., query resolution rate, monitoring visit frequency).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sop. Business justification: SLA measurement methodology is governed by SOPs (e.g., SOP for monitoring visit conduct defines the SLA metric).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.health_authority. Business justification: SLAs with regulatory_commitment_flag are driven by specific health authority requirements (e.g., FDA 15-day expedited safety reporting timelines).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: SLAs for turnaround time, critical value notification, and result reporting are negotiated with specific lab facilities. Lab operations teams monitor SLA performance per facility.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.master_service_agreement. Business justification: Service Level Agreements can be established at the MSA level as framework performance commitments that apply across all studies under the MSA.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that is the counterparty to this SLA. Enables sponsor-level SLA performance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: preferred_provider_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.preferred_provider_agreement. Business justification: Service Level Agreements can be established at the PPA framework level, defining performance commitments that apply across all studies under the preferred provider
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: scope_of_work_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Statement of Work or scope-of-work document that this SLA is specifically attached to, where the SLA is scoped below the master contract level.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: study_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master service agreement or contract to which this SLA is attached. Links the SLA to its governing legal instrument.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study or trial to which this SLA applies, when the SLA is scoped at the study level rather than the enterprise contract level.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: superseded_by_service_level_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer SLA record that replaces this one when sla_status is 'superseded'. Enables forward navigation of the SLA version chain for audit and historical analysis.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Amendment or change order number that introduced or last modified this SLA, if applicable. Provides traceability to the contract amendment history and version control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; Veeva Vault; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLA was formally approved and signed off by both the CRO and the sponsor. Marks the transition from draft to active status and is required for regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA record was first created in the system. Required for audit trail and data lineage tracking per ALCOA+ principles and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: credit_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a service credit (bonus or rebate) is awarded to the sponsor when the CRO exceeds the SLA threshold. Supports incentive-based contract structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: credit_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the service credit awarded when the CRO exceeds the SLA target. Expressed in contract currency or as a percentage of invoice, consistent with penalty_type conventions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1; SOX

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this SLA ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended SLAs that remain in force until the contract terminates.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this SLA becomes binding and performance measurement begins. Aligns with the contract or SOW commencement date.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: escalation_contact
attributes.description: Name or role of the designated escalation contact (e.g., Project Manager, Sponsor Alliance Manager) who must be notified when the escalation threshold is breached. Supports SLA governance and sponsor relationship management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric value at which a near-breach warning or escalation is triggered before the formal SLA threshold is reached (e.g., escalate at 20 hours for a 24-hour SAE reporting SLA). Enables proactive remediation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO/IEC 20000-1; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Free-text description of conditions or events that are excluded from SLA measurement (e.g., sponsor-caused delays, system downtime, force majeure, regulatory authority hold). Critical for fair breach adjudication.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO/IEC 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: governing_regulation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory citation that mandates or informs this SLA threshold when regulatory_commitment_flag is True (e.g., 'FDA 21 CFR 312.32 – 15-day SAE reporting', 'ICH E2A – expedited safety reporting', 'EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42').
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E2A; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA; PMDA

attributes.name: grace_period_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the grace period value (hours, business_days, or calendar_days). Paired with grace_period_value to define the full grace period window.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: grace_period_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the allowable grace period beyond the threshold before a breach is formally recorded (e.g., 2 for a 2-hour grace period). Accommodates system downtime or force majeure scenarios.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently SLA performance is measured and reported: per_event (each occurrence), daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually. Drives the cadence of SLA performance review meetings with the sponsor.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Description of how the SLA metric is measured and from which source system (e.g., 'Calculated from SAE receipt timestamp to submission timestamp in the source system 'Query open-to-close duration in Medidata Rave EDC').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, negotiation history, sponsor-specific interpretations, or operational guidance related to this SLA that does not fit structured fields.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: penalty_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial penalty or service credit applies when this SLA is breached. True = penalty/credit terms are defined; False = informational SLA with no financial consequence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: penalty_cap_value
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative penalty or credit that can be applied under this SLA within a measurement period, expressed in the penalty currency or as a percentage cap. Protects the CRO from unlimited liability exposure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1; SOX

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the penalty_value when penalty_type is fixed_fee (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for non-monetary penalty types.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA; SOX

attributes.name: penalty_type
attributes.description: Type of financial consequence applied upon SLA breach: fixed_fee (flat monetary penalty), percentage_of_invoice (percentage deducted from the relevant invoice), service_credit (credit applied to future invoices), milestone_hold (billing milestone
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: penalty_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the penalty or credit applied upon breach. Interpretation depends on penalty_type: a fixed monetary amount (in contract currency) for fixed_fee, or a percentage for percentage_of_invoice. Commercially sensitive.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1; SOX

attributes.name: regulatory_commitment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA is directly tied to a regulatory reporting obligation (e.g., FDA 15-day SAE reporting, EMA SUSAR submission timelines). True = regulatory deadline drives the SLA threshold; False = contractual performance target only.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E2A

attributes.name: reporting_format
attributes.description: Agreed format for communicating SLA performance results to the sponsor: dashboard (real-time portal), monthly_report (formal written report), quarterly_review (governance meeting), ad_hoc (on-request), automated_alert (system-generated notification).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the service domain governed by this SLA (e.g., Safety Reporting, Data Management, Site Monitoring, Patient Recruitment, Regulatory Submissions, Biostatistics, Supply Chain).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO/IEC 20000-1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: service_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular classification within the service category (e.g., within Safety Reporting: 'SAE Initial Report', 'SUSAR Submission'; within Data Management: 'Query Resolution', 'Data Entry Lag'). Enables fine-grained SLA performance analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sla_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this SLA within the contract management system (e.g., SLA-QRY-001). Used as the business key for cross-system reference and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA: draft (under negotiation), active (in force), suspended (temporarily paused by mutual agreement), expired (past effective end date), terminated (ended early), superseded (replaced by an amendment).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: sla_title
attributes.description: Human-readable short title describing the SLA commitment (e.g., 'SAE Reporting Turnaround – 24h', 'Query Resolution – 5 Business Days'). Used in dashboards, reports, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA metric type: response_time (time to first action), turnaround_time (time to completion), frequency (how often an activity must occur), rate (throughput rate), percentage (proportion-based target), count (absolute volume target).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: target_metric_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the specific performance metric being measured (e.g., 'Time to SAE Initial Report', 'Query Resolution Turnaround', 'Monitoring Visit Frequency', 'Data Entry Lag Days', 'Site Activation Cycle Time').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: threshold_direction
attributes.description: Specifies whether compliance requires the measured value to be less than or equal to (e.g., turnaround time ≤ 24h), greater than or equal to (e.g., visit frequency ≥ 1/month), or exactly equal to the threshold. Critical for automated compliance evaluation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the threshold value (e.g., hours, business_days, calendar_days, percentage, visits_per_month). Defines how the threshold_value is interpreted for compliance assessment.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: The numeric performance threshold that the CRO must meet or exceed for this SLA (e.g., 24 for a 24-hour SAE reporting window, 95 for 95% query resolution rate, 5 for 5 business days). The principal quantitative commitment of the SLA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this SLA record. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this SLA record, incremented each time the SLA terms are renegotiated or amended. Supports version history tracking and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: scope_of_work_id

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: dispute_reason

attributes.name: escalation_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which annual rate escalation is calculated: 'fixed' (predetermined fixed percentage), 'cpi_linked' (tied to Consumer Price Index), 'negotiated' (subject to annual renegotiation), 'none' (no escalation applies for the rate card term).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; SOX; CRO Industry Practice

attributes.name: escalation_rate_pct
attributes.description: Annual rate escalation percentage applied to the unit rate at each contract year anniversary (e.g., CPI-linked or fixed escalation). Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 3.00 = 3%). Governs automatic rate adjustments over multi-year MSA terms.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country scope for which this rate applies (e.g., North America, Western Europe, Asia-Pacific, or specific ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes). Reflects regional labor cost differentials and regulatory environment complexity.

attributes.name: rate_card_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate card. 'draft' indicates under negotiation; 'active' indicates currently in use for SOW pricing; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'expired' indicates past effective date range; 'withdrawn' indicates

attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: meeting_format
attributes.description: The format in which the agency meeting is conducted. Face-to-Face = in-person at agency or sponsor site; Teleconference = audio-only call; Videoconference = video-enabled remote meeting; Written Response Only = agency responds in writing without a live
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings Between the FDA and Sponsors or Applicants of PDUFA Products (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: meeting_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned or internally generated unique reference number for the meeting request, as tracked in Veeva Vault regulatory submissions module and referenced in agency correspondence (e.g., FDA meeting request number).
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VII Commitments; 21 CFR Part 312.47

attributes.name: meeting_objectives
attributes.description: Free-text description of the primary scientific, regulatory, or strategic objectives for the agency meeting, as stated in the meeting request. Captures the key questions and discussion topics the sponsor seeks to resolve.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: meeting_stage
attributes.description: The clinical development stage at which the agency meeting is requested, indicating the regulatory milestone context (e.g., Pre-IND, End-of-Phase 2, Pre-NDA/BLA submission). Aligns with FDA Type B meeting sub-categories.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.47; FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: meeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the agency meeting. Planned = internally identified need; Requested = formal meeting request submitted to agency; Granted = agency has agreed to hold the meeting; Scheduled = date and format confirmed; Completed = meeting has
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings Between the FDA and Sponsors or Applicants of PDUFA Products (2017)

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meeting per agency-defined categories. FDA meetings are classified as Type A (urgent/critical), Type B (pre-IND, end-of-Phase 2, pre-NDA/BLA), or Type C (other). EMA meetings are classified as Scientific Advice.
attributes.value_regex: Type A|Type B|Type C|Scientific Advice|Consultation|Written Response Only
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings Between the FDA and Sponsors or Applicants of PDUFA Products (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: minutes_draft_date
attributes.description: The date on which the draft meeting minutes were prepared by the sponsor following the agency meeting. FDA requires sponsors to submit draft minutes within 30 days of the meeting.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); 21 CFR Part 312.47

attributes.name: minutes_finalized_date
attributes.description: The date on which the meeting minutes were finalized and agreed upon by both the sponsor and the health authority. Finalized minutes represent the official record of agency agreements and commitments.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); 21 CFR Part 312.47; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: minutes_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor submitted the draft meeting minutes to the health authority for review and comment.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); 21 CFR Part 312.47

attributes.name: nda_bla_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Drug Application (NDA) / Biologics License Application (BLA) Number
attributes.description: The FDA-assigned NDA or BLA application number if the meeting is related to a marketing application. Applicable for pre-NDA/BLA, post-approval, or labeling meetings.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); 21 CFR Part 601 (BLA); FDA Regulations

tag_set.value: New Drug Application (NDA) / Biologics License Application (BLA) Number

attributes.name: open_action_items_count
attributes.description: Number of action items from the agency meeting that remain open or unresolved. Used for regulatory follow-up tracking and inspection readiness monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: outcome_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the overall outcome of the agency meeting with respect to the sponsor's objectives. Agreement Reached = agency aligned with sponsor's proposed approach; Partial Agreement = some questions resolved; No Agreement = agency did not concur
attributes.value_regex: Agreement Reached|Partial Agreement|No Agreement|Pending Agency Response|Information Only
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: pdufa_response_deadline
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which the FDA must respond to the meeting request under Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) commitments. Type A: 30 days; Type B: 70 days; Type C: 90 days from receipt of meeting request.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VII Commitments; FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Name of the investigational product discussed in this meeting.
