attributes.name: proposed_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date proposed by the sponsor in the meeting request for when the meeting should occur. May differ from the agency-confirmed date.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017); EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: questions_submitted_count
attributes.description: The number of formal questions submitted to the health authority in the meeting request or briefing document. Used to track scope and complexity of the meeting agenda.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Formal Meetings (2017)

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal meeting request was submitted to the health authority. This is the principal business event timestamp that initiates the regulatory clock for agency response timelines under PDUFA commitments.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VII Commitments; 21 CFR Part 312.47; EMA Scientific Advice Procedure

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area or disease indication relevant to the meeting (e.g., Oncology, Cardiovascular, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for regulatory strategy analytics and agency workload tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this agency meeting record was last modified, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: The document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF/regulatory submissions module for the meeting request package, briefing document, or meeting minutes. Enables direct traceability to the source document management system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the CTD dossier was formally approved internally for submission. Captures the approval event in the dossier lifecycle per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature requirements.

attributes.name: archival_location
attributes.description: Physical or electronic archival location of the compiled CTD dossier package (e.g., Veeva Vault path, network share, or physical archive reference). Required for inspection readiness and long-term retention.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for regulatory affairs team notes, submission strategy remarks, or outstanding action items related to the CTD dossier.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the CTD dossier record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.

attributes.name: ctd_format
attributes.description: Submission format of the CTD dossier. eCTD (Electronic Common Technical Document) is the standard for FDA, EMA, and PMDA. NeeS (Non-eCTD Electronic Submission) and paper formats are legacy options.
attributes.references: ICH M2 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Specification; PMDA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: dossier_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the CTD dossier, used in regulatory correspondence and Veeva Vault tracking. Format: CTD-{AppCode}-{Year}-{Seq}.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Specification

attributes.name: dossier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the CTD dossier. Tracks progression from authoring through regulatory submission and archival.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: dossier_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the CTD dossier, typically including the drug name, application type, and submission sequence (e.g., 'DrugX NDA Initial Submission CTD Dossier').
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline

attributes.name: dossier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dossier submission type. Initial submissions establish the application; amendments and supplements update specific modules; annual reports fulfill periodic reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; 21 CFR Part 314.70 (NDA Supplements); EMA Variation Regulation (EC) No 1234/2008

attributes.name: dossier_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CTD dossier (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented with each major revision or amendment cycle.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Name of the investigational drug or biologic product that is the subject of the CTD dossier (proprietary name, INN, or code name).
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; WHO INN Programme; FDA Drug Naming Guidance

attributes.name: dtd_version
attributes.description: Version of the eCTD Document Type Definition (DTD) or XML schema used for the dossier backbone (e.g., 3.2.2 for FDA, 4.0 for EMA). Determines structural compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ICH M2 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Specification

attributes.name: gap_analysis_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dossier gap analysis was completed. Used to assess the currency of the gap analysis relative to dossier updates.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA Pre-Submission Meeting Guidance

attributes.name: gap_analysis_status
attributes.description: Status of the formal gap analysis conducted to identify missing or incomplete content units within the CTD dossier prior to submission.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA Pre-Submission Meeting Guidance; EMA Pre-Submission Guidance

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The therapeutic indication or disease area for which the drug is being developed and for which the CTD dossier is submitted.
attributes.references: ICH M4E (R2) CTD Efficacy Guideline; FDA Labeling Guidance; EMA SmPC Guideline

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CTD dossier has been assessed and confirmed as ready for regulatory agency inspection. True when all required documents are present, validated, and accessible.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedures

attributes.name: last_compiled_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CTD dossier was most recently compiled and packaged for submission or review. Tracks the currency of the assembled dossier.
attributes.references: ICH M2 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the CTD dossier record. Required for audit trail and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: module1_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 1 (Regional Administrative Information), which contains region-specific forms, cover letters, and labeling. Content varies by target agency.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Module 1 Specification

attributes.name: module2_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 2 (CTD Summaries), including the Quality Overall Summary (QOS), Nonclinical Overview, Clinical Overview, Nonclinical Written and Tabulated Summaries, and Clinical Summary.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; ICH M4Q; ICH M4S; ICH M4E

attributes.name: module3_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 3 (Quality), covering drug substance, drug product, and related quality documentation per ICH M4Q.
attributes.references: ICH M4Q (R1) CTD Quality Guideline

attributes.name: module4_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 4 (Nonclinical Study Reports), including pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, and toxicology study reports per ICH M4S.
attributes.references: ICH M4S (R2) CTD Safety Guideline

attributes.name: module5_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 5 (Clinical Study Reports), including all clinical pharmacology, efficacy, and safety study reports per ICH M4E.
attributes.references: ICH M4E (R2) CTD Efficacy Guideline; ICH E3 Clinical Study Report

attributes.name: open_gap_count
attributes.description: Number of identified content gaps (missing or incomplete documents/sections) that remain unresolved in the current dossier version. Key metric for submission readiness.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA Pre-Submission Meeting Guidance

attributes.name: overall_completeness_status
attributes.description: Aggregate readiness assessment of the entire CTD dossier across all five modules. Used for dossier gap analysis and submission readiness reviews.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA Pre-Submission Meeting Guidance; EMA Pre-Submission Guidance

attributes.name: planned_submission_date
attributes.description: Target date on which the CTD dossier is planned to be submitted to the regulatory agency. Used for milestone tracking and resource planning.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA PDUFA Goal Dates; EMA Submission Timelines

attributes.name: prior_submission_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the prior submission or dossier version that this submission amends or supplements. Enables lineage tracking across submission cycles.
attributes.references: ICH M2 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: publishing_tool

attributes.name: publishing_tool_version

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsor organization responsible for the dossier.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: total_document_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual content units (documents, datasets, study reports) included in this CTD dossier version. Used for completeness tracking and submission package verification.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: validation_report_date

attributes.name: validation_report_status

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory context, internal commentary, or strategic notes related to this special designation (e.g., agency meeting outcomes, key discussion points, competitive intelligence). Not for official regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: orphan_disease_prevalence
attributes.description: Stated prevalence or incidence of the rare disease or condition as submitted to the health authority in support of an Orphan Drug Designation request (e.g., 'fewer than 200,000 patients in the US' per 21 CFR Part 316, or '≤5 in 10,000 in the EU' per EC
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316.3(b)(13); EC Regulation No 141/2000 (EU Orphan Medicinal Products); EMA COMP

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Proprietary or working name of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) for which the special designation is sought or granted. May differ from the INN (International Nonproprietary Name) at early development stages.
attributes.references: ICH M4Q (CTD Quality Module); FDA IND Regulations 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on IMP

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the sponsor formally submitted the designation request to the health authority. Marks the start of the agency review clock for expedited designation programs.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA Performance Goals; 21 CFR Part 312.82; EMA PRIME Guidance

attributes.name: resubmission_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor plans to resubmit the designation request following a denial or withdrawal. Drives regulatory planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: FDA Breakthrough Therapy Guidance 2018; 21 CFR Part 316.25; EMA PRIME Resubmission Procedure

attributes.name: resubmission_target_date
attributes.description: Planned date for resubmitting the designation request to the health authority after a denial or withdrawal. Null if resubmission is not planned or not yet scheduled.

attributes.name: rolling_review_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation enables rolling review of the marketing application (submission of completed CTD modules before the full dossier is ready). Applicable to FDA Fast Track and EMA PRIME designations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.82 (Fast Track Rolling Review); EMA PRIME Rolling Review; FDA Guidance on Fast Track 2018

attributes.name: surrogate_endpoint_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation was granted or the approval pathway relies on a surrogate or intermediate clinical endpoint rather than a traditional clinical outcome endpoint. Relevant for Accelerated Approval and Breakthrough Therapy designations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 Subpart H (Accelerated Approval); FDA Guidance on Surrogate Endpoints 2018; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: tax_credit_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation qualifies the sponsor for the Orphan Drug Tax Credit (50% of qualified clinical testing expenses in the US under IRC Section 45C). Applicable only to FDA Orphan Drug designations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 45C (Orphan Drug Tax Credit); 21 CFR Part 316; FDA Orphan Drug Act

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Broad medical or scientific domain in which the investigational product is being developed (e.g., Oncology, Rare Disease, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for portfolio analytics and regulatory strategy alignment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference

attributes.name: withdrawal_date

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: action_item_number

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault Action Item Module

attributes.name: action_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the regulatory action item. Drives operational dashboards, escalation logic, and compliance reporting. 'overdue' is system-set when due_date has passed without closure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: action_item_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the nature of the action item. Drives workflow templates and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commitment|information_request|capa|protocol_amendment|label_update|response_to_agency|internal_task|other — promote to

attributes.name: agency_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the health authority formally acknowledged receipt of the response or deliverable. Used to confirm the regulatory clock was stopped and to document agency receipt for the eTMF.

attributes.name: agency_mandated_due_date
attributes.description: The specific response deadline formally communicated by the health authority (e.g., FDA 30-day information request clock, EMA Day 120 response). Distinct from the internal due_date which may be set earlier to allow review time.

attributes.name: agency_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the completed response or deliverable was formally submitted to the health authority. Distinct from completion_date (internal closure) — captures the actual agency-facing delivery date for regulatory clock tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312/314; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: assigned_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the individual responsible for completing this action item. Used for automated notifications, escalation alerts, and audit trail. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR and HIPAA.

attributes.name: assigned_owner_name

attributes.name: assigned_team

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the action item was fully completed and closed. Nullable until the item reaches 'closed' status. Used to calculate cycle time and measure regulatory responsiveness KPIs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_code
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory inspection (GCP, GMP, GLP) that generated this action item. Nullable when the source event is a meeting or correspondence rather than an inspection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the action item must be completed. May be agency-mandated (e.g., 30-day response clock from FDA information request) or internally set. Drives overdue status calculation and escalation triggers.

attributes.name: escalation_date

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action item has been escalated to senior regulatory leadership or executive management due to risk, overdue status, or strategic importance. True = escalated; False = not escalated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why this action item was escalated (e.g., 'Approaching agency deadline with incomplete data package', 'Potential clinical hold risk identified'). Provides context for management review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: finding_classification
attributes.description: GCP/GMP inspection finding classification when the action item originates from an inspection finding. Aligns with FDA and EMA inspection classification standards. Nullable for non-inspection-sourced action items.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, interim progress updates, or commentary on the action item that does not fit structured fields. Supports operational communication within the regulatory affairs team.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: The date on which this action item was formally opened and entered into the regulatory task register. Represents the business event timestamp for the creation of the obligation.

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action item represents a recurrence of a previously identified issue or finding. True = recurrence of a prior finding; False = new issue. Used in quality trend analysis and CAPA effectiveness assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ISO 9001 CAPA

attributes.name: regulatory_area
attributes.description: Functional regulatory domain to which this action item belongs (e.g., clinical, safety, CMC). Enables domain-specific filtering and assignment routing within the regulatory affairs team.

attributes.name: regulatory_procedure_reference

attributes.name: title

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp

attributes.name: gcp_critical_document_flag

tag_set.value: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Critical Document Flag

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document workflow instance was first created and launched in Veeva Vault. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the workflow lifecycle and the start point for overall cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; ALCOA+

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this workflow and its associated document have been reviewed and confirmed as inspection-ready per GCP and regulatory authority standards. Supports pre-inspection TMF completeness assessments by FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: instance_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by Veeva Vault to this specific workflow instance. Used for cross-system traceability and audit trail correlation with the source eTMF system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow API; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this workflow instance, reflecting urgency of document review and approval. Critical priority is assigned to GCP essential documents, regulatory submissions with imminent deadlines, and safety-related documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document being processed through this workflow is intended for regulatory submission (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD). True triggers additional compliance checks and approval requirements per FDA/EMA submission standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH CTD; eCTD; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: rejection_count
attributes.description: Number of times the document has been rejected and returned for revision within this workflow instance. High rejection counts indicate document quality issues and are tracked for quality metrics and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or categorized reason provided when a workflow step is rejected. Documents the specific deficiency identified by the reviewer, supporting document quality improvement and GCP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: sla_breach_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the workflow or any of its steps has exceeded the defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) timeframe. True when step_completion_date or actual_completion_date exceeds the corresponding due date. Drives escalation and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault SLA Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document workflow instance within Veeva Vault. Tracks progression from initiation through review, approval decision, and terminal states. Supports GCP-compliant document control audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_action_taken
attributes.description: The specific action performed by the assignee at the current or last completed workflow step. Captures the decision outcome (approved, rejected) or process action (delegated, escalated) for audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Veeva Vault; ALCOA+

attributes.name: step_assignee_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual assigned to the current workflow step. Captured at time of assignment for audit trail integrity per ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: step_assignee_role
attributes.description: Business role responsible for completing the current workflow step (e.g., 'Principal Investigator (PI)', 'Clinical Research Associate (CRA)', 'Regulatory Affairs Manager', 'Quality Assurance (QA) Reviewer').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment or rationale provided by the step assignee when completing, rejecting, or escalating the workflow step. Supports GCP documentation requirements and provides context for rejection decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: step_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the current or most recently completed workflow step was actioned and closed. Compared against step_due_date to determine SLA compliance and cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the workflow step action was recorded in Veeva Vault. Provides sub-day granularity required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic audit trail and time-stamped electronic signature records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the current workflow step as defined by the workflow SLA configuration. Used to calculate SLA breach status and trigger escalation notifications for overdue document reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault SLA Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Overall target date by which the entire document workflow (all steps) must be completed. Derived from workflow SLA rules and used for inspection readiness tracking and TMF completeness KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault SLA

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the Veeva Vault workflow template used to instantiate this workflow (e.g., 'SOP Review and Approval', 'Regulatory Document Approval', 'ICF Review Workflow'). Identifies the standard process blueprint applied.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl SOP

attributes.name: template_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the workflow template at the time this workflow instance was initiated. Ensures reproducibility and audit traceability when templates are updated over time.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model zone classification for the document being processed. Categorizes the document into the appropriate TMF structural zone to support inspection readiness and TMF completeness assessments.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: total_steps
attributes.description: Total number of steps defined in the workflow template for this workflow instance. Used in conjunction with current_step_sequence to calculate workflow completion percentage for inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workflow by its primary business purpose within the document lifecycle. Distinguishes review-only workflows from approval workflows, distribution workflows, archival workflows, and amendment workflows.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this document_workflow record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Tracks the most recent state change for incremental processing and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

products.name: signature
products.description: Records electronic signatures applied to controlled documents per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Captures signer identity, signer role (author, reviewer, approver, sponsor representative), signature date and timestamp, signature meaning (reviewed, approved

attributes.name: signature_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each electronic signature record applied to a controlled document. Primary key for the document_signature data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: delegation_of_authority_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delegation of authority record when the signer is acting on behalf of another party (e.g., a sub-investigator signing on behalf of the Principal Investigator). Supports sponsor oversight and GCP compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: organization_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.sponsor_contact. Business justification: Sponsor contacts are signatories on key TMF documents (protocol approvals, ICF approvals, regulatory submissions).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_signature_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated user record of the individual who applied the electronic signature. Satisfies the ALCOA+ principle of Attributability — every signature must be traceable to a unique individual.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(i); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) with which the signed document is associated. Enables study-level signature completeness reporting and TMF inspection readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model Zone/Section/Artifact taxonomy

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site associated with the signed document, where applicable (e.g., site-level ICF, site initiation documents). Supports site-level TMF completeness and inspection readiness metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8.3; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the controlled document record in the document master that this signature was applied to. Links the signature to its parent TMF/eTMF document.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault Document Object

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific version of the document at the time the signature was applied. Ensures the signature is bound to an immutable document version, satisfying 21 CFR Part 11 integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: workflow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_workflow. Business justification: Electronic signatures are applied within the context of a document workflow step (review, approval, distribution).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: audit_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the signed document content and signature metadata at the time of signing. Provides tamper-evidence and integrity verification for the electronic signature record, satisfying 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a) data integrity
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); NIST SP 800-57; FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the signer at the time of signing. May capture the signer's attestation statement, conditional approval notes, or reviewer observations. Stored as part of the immutable signature audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; Veeva Vault eSignature Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp when the signature request record was first created in the source system (Veeva Vault). Supports audit trail completeness and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: device_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device (workstation, tablet, or mobile device) used to apply the electronic signature. Supports forensic audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 system access controls validation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(d); FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: digital_certificate_serial
attributes.description: Serial number of the digital certificate used when the signature method is digital_certificate or smart_card. Enables certificate chain validation and revocation checking for PKI-based electronic signatures.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.200(b); X.509 Certificate Standard; NIST SP 800-57

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the signer must apply their electronic signature, as defined in the document workflow configuration. Used for SLA tracking, escalation triggering, and inspection readiness reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: hash_algorithm
attributes.description: Cryptographic algorithm used to generate the audit hash for this signature record (e.g., SHA-256, SHA-512). Required to enable future hash verification and to document the cryptographic standard applied at the time of signing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); NIST FIPS 180-4

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signature record has been reviewed and confirmed as complete and compliant for regulatory inspection purposes. Used in TMF inspection readiness dashboards and GCP audit preparation.

attributes.name: ip_address

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); GDPR Article 4(1); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_regulatory_submission_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signature is part of a document package intended for regulatory submission (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD). When True, the signature record is subject to heightened integrity and retention requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH M4 CTD; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: last_reminder_timestamp

attributes.references: Veeva Vault eSignature Workflow; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code representing the language and regional settings active at the time of signing (e.g., en-US, de-DE, ja-JP). Relevant for multi-national trials to confirm the signer viewed the document in their preferred language.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29; ICH E6(R2) §4.8

attributes.name: meaning
attributes.description: The legally defined meaning associated with the electronic signature, as required by 21 CFR Part 11. Specifies the intent of the signer (e.g., reviewed = content reviewed for accuracy; approved = authorized for release; acknowledged = receipt confirmed).

attributes.name: reference_number

attributes.name: signer_title

attributes.name: source_system_signature_reference

products.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.1; 21 CFR 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58

attributes.name: archival_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each archival record entry tracking the disposition of a TMF document or study file at study close-out.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: archival_authorized_by_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Archival Authorized By Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Archival authorization must be traceable to a qualified employee under ICH E6 and 21 CFR Part 11 — inspectors verify authorization authority.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

tag_set.value: Archival Authorized By Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this archival record applies. Enables study-level archival compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site whose documents are being archived, if applicable. Null for sponsor-level TMF documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.3; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: tmf_artifact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_artifact. Business justification: Archival records reference the DIA TMF Reference Model artifact classification for retention period determination and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TMF document or study file record being archived. Links to the source document entity in the document management domain.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_version. Business justification: Archival records capture the disposition of a specific document version at study close-out. The document_version STRING column is a denormalized reference.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: archival_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document or study file was formally transferred to the archive. This is the principal business event date for the archival transaction, distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58

attributes.name: archival_location
attributes.description: Physical or electronic location where the archived document is stored. For physical archives, this includes the facility name, building, room, shelf, and box reference.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: archival_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional context, exceptions, or special instructions related to the archival record (e.g., partial document archival, known deviations from standard archival procedures, special handling instructions).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ALCOA+

attributes.name: archival_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the archival record. 'pending' = awaiting archival; 'archived' = successfully archived; 'retrieved' = temporarily retrieved from archive; 'destroyed' = permanently destroyed per retention schedule; 'on_hold' = destruction or
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58

attributes.name: archival_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is archived electronically (eTMF/long-term electronic archive), physically (paper-based archive facility), or as a hybrid (both electronic and physical copies retained).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: archive_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the physical or electronic archive facility or vendor responsible for storing the archived documents (e.g., Iron Mountain, sponsor internal archive, Veeva Vault long-term archive). Supports vendor management and retrieval logistics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: archive_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the archived document or file by the archive facility or eTMF system (e.g., Veeva Vault document ID or physical archive box/folder reference). Used for retrieval and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose regulatory requirements govern the retention and archival of this document (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, JPN). Determines applicable retention regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this archival record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: custodian_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or individual currently responsible for the custody and safekeeping of the archived documents (e.g., sponsor name, CRO name, third-party archive vendor). Supports accountability and retrieval logistics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: custody_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which formal custody of the archived documents was transferred to the sponsor or designated archive custodian. Null if transfer has not occurred. Supports chain of custody documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5.12; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: database_lock_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinical database was locked for the study, which may serve as the reference date for calculating retention periods for certain document categories per sponsor SOPs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; ICH E9

attributes.name: destruction_authorization_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number of the formal destruction authorization document or approval record that sanctioned the permanent destruction of the archived file. Provides the audit trail required by GCP and regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: destruction_authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized individual (e.g., sponsor representative, QA director) who formally approved the destruction of the archived document. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the archived document was permanently destroyed following expiry of the retention period and completion of the destruction authorization process. Null if document has not been destroyed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: destruction_method
attributes.description: The method used to permanently destroy the archived document upon expiry of the retention period (e.g., shredding for physical documents, secure digital deletion or degaussing for electronic records). Required for GCP compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: document_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the archived document per ICH GCP essential document categories (e.g., essential document, non-essential, regulatory submission document, site file, sponsor file). Determines applicable retention requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the document or study file being archived, as recorded in the eTMF (Veeva Vault) or physical archive index.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: etmf_vault_document_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) Vault Document ID
attributes.description: The unique document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault eTMF to the archived document. Enables direct traceability between the archival record in the lakehouse and the source document in the operational eTMF system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11

tag_set.value: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) Vault Document ID

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this archival record and its associated document have been verified as inspection-ready (True) or require remediation before a regulatory inspection (False). Supports FDA, EMA, MHRA, and PMDA inspection preparation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA/INS/GCP/454280/2010; MHRA GCP Inspection

attributes.name: litigation_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a litigation hold (legal hold) has been placed on this archived document, preventing destruction regardless of retention expiry. True = document is under legal hold; False = no hold in effect.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; GDPR Article 17(3); SOX; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The primary regulatory authority whose requirements govern the archival and retention of this document (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Drives jurisdiction-specific retention period and destruction rules.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA GCP Guidelines; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: retention_basis
attributes.description: The regulatory or contractual basis that determines the retention period for this document. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ICH_GCP_15yr|FDA_21CFR_312.62|EMA_EU_CTR|sponsor_requirement|PMDA_requirement|MHRA_requirement|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; PMDA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The calculated date on which the mandatory retention period expires and the document becomes eligible for destruction, based on the archival date plus the retention period. Drives destruction scheduling workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: The required retention period in years for the archived document, as determined by the applicable regulatory requirement or sponsor policy (e.g., 15 years per ICH GCP, 2 years post-NDA approval per 21 CFR 312.62, or longer per sponsor requirement).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; EMA/INS/GCP/454280/2010

attributes.name: retrieval_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the archived document was physically or electronically retrieved from the archive. Null if not yet retrieved. Distinct from retrieval_request_date to track turnaround time.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: retrieval_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for retrieving the archived document from the archive (e.g., regulatory inspection, audit, litigation, study amendment, sponsor request). Supports access control and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: retrieval_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which a formal request was made to retrieve the archived document from the archive facility. Null if no retrieval has been requested. Supports archive access tracking and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor was formally notified of the archival or destruction of the document, as required by ICH GCP and applicable regulations. Null if notification is not required or not yet sent.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: study_closeout_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinical study was formally closed out, triggering the archival obligations for TMF documents. Used to calculate retention period start dates and compliance deadlines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58

attributes.name: tmf_reference_model_zone
attributes.business_glossary_term: Trial Master File (TMF) Reference Model Zone
attributes.description: The DIA TMF Reference Model zone classification of the archived document (e.g., Zone 01 - Trial Management, Zone 02 - Central Trial Documents, Zone 03 - Regulatory, Zone 04 - IRB/IEC, Zone 05 - Site Management).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

tag_set.value: Trial Master File (TMF) Reference Model Zone

attributes.name: transfer_of_custody_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether custody of the archived documents has been formally transferred to the sponsor or a designated third-party archive (True) or remains with the CRO (False). Relevant for CRO-managed studies at close-out.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5.12; 21 CFR Part 312.62; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this archival record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles, enabling detection of unauthorized or unexpected record changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: access_log
products.description: Business compliance audit trail recording access events to controlled documents in Veeva Vault per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Each record captures: user identity, user role, access action (view, download, print, edit, delete), document version accessed
products.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.10(e); EU Annex 11; Veeva Vault Audit Trail

attributes.name: access_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each document access event record in the audit trail. Primary key for the document_access_log table.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: electronic_signature_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the electronic signature applied during this access event, if the action required a signature (e.g., document approval, attestation). Links to the 21 CFR Part 11 compliant e-signature record in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The unique system identifier of the user who performed the access event, as recorded in Veeva Vault. Supports attribution requirement under ALCOA+ (Attributable) and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: regulatory_inspection_id
attributes.description: regulatory
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.19; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical study (protocol) to which the accessed document belongs. Enables study-level access audit reporting and supports regulatory inspection queries by study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investigative site associated with the accessed document, if the document is site-specific (e.g., site regulatory binder, site file document). Null for central/sponsor-level documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The document access log records access events to controlled documents. vault_document_id (STRING) is a Veeva Vault system reference, but there is no integer FK to tmf_document.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vault_document_version_id
attributes.description: The specific version identifier of the document in Veeva Vault that was accessed (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, DRAFT). Ensures the audit trail captures exactly which version was viewed, downloaded, or modified, supporting ALCOA+ traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: access_action
attributes.description: The type of action performed on the document during this access event. Enumerated values: view (read-only display), download (file retrieved to local device), print (document sent to printer), edit (document content modified), delete (document removed or
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: access_channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the document was accessed in Veeva Vault: web_browser (standard UI), vault_api (programmatic API access), mobile_app (Veeva Vault mobile), integration (system-to-system integration).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault API; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: access_device_type
attributes.description: The category of device used to access the document (desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, server). Supports security monitoring and access pattern analysis for GCP inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems in Clinical Investigations

attributes.name: access_justification
attributes.description: The business reason provided by the user for accessing a restricted or confidential document, as required by document confidentiality policy. Mandatory for restricted-level documents; optional for confidential.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: access_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the access attempt: success (access granted and action completed), denied (access refused due to permissions), error (system error prevented completion), timeout (session expired before completion).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(d); FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems in Clinical Investigations

attributes.name: access_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) when the document access event occurred, as recorded by Veeva Vault. Satisfies the ALCOA+ 'Contemporaneous' requirement and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail timestamp mandate. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: anomaly_reason
attributes.description: A description of why this access event was flagged as anomalous, populated when is_anomalous_access is True. Examples: 'Access outside business hours', 'Bulk download detected', 'Access from unrecognized IP', 'Access to superseded document version'.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: data_extract_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audit record was extracted from Veeva Vault and loaded into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation for the lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Enduring, Available); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: document_confidentiality_level
attributes.description: The data classification level of the document at the time of access. Determines whether an access justification is required (restricted and confidential documents require justification per policy). Aligns with the business data classification levels.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 32; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA §164.312

attributes.name: document_name
attributes.description: The title or name of the controlled document at the time of access, captured as a denormalized snapshot. Ensures the audit record remains interpretable even if the document is renamed or archived.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) §8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: document_status_at_access
attributes.business_glossary_term: Document Status at Time of Access
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the document at the exact moment of access. Captures whether the user accessed a draft, approved, superseded, or archived version, which is critical for GCP compliance and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model

tag_set.value: Document Status at Time of Access

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document accessed per the DIA TMF Reference Model or Veeva Vault document type taxonomy (e.g., Protocol, Informed Consent Form, Investigator Brochure, Site Initiation Visit Report, Regulatory Submission).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) §8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: document_version_number
attributes.description: The human-readable version label of the document accessed (e.g., '1.0', '2.3', 'DRAFT', 'FINAL'). Captured as a denormalized snapshot for audit readability without requiring a join to the document version table.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: download_file_format
attributes.description: The file format in which the document was downloaded, applicable only when access_action is 'download'. Null for non-download actions. Supports data leakage monitoring and controlled document distribution tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §8; eCTD guidance

attributes.name: inspection_context
attributes.description: Indicates whether this access event occurred in the context of a regulatory inspection (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA audit). True when the access was performed to support an active regulatory inspection. Enables inspection-specific access pattern reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.19; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_anomalous_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this access event has been flagged as anomalous by automated monitoring rules (e.g., access outside business hours, access from unusual IP, bulk download, access to superseded documents).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems; ICH E6(R2) §5.5

attributes.name: justification_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether the user actually provided an access justification when one was required. Used in conjunction with justification_required to identify compliance gaps where justification was mandated but not supplied.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: justification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an access justification was required for this access event based on the document's confidentiality level and access action. True when justification was mandated by policy; False otherwise. Supports compliance gap detection.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: print_copy_count
attributes.description: The number of copies printed during a print access event. Applicable only when access_action is 'print'. Null for non-print actions. Supports controlled document print tracking per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8; 21 CFR Part 11; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: prior_access_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the immediately preceding access event by the same user on the same document version. Enables detection of unusual access frequency patterns and supports forensic audit analysis.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports data lineage and audit trail for the lakehouse record itself, distinct from the access_timestamp which records the business event time.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this record was last updated in the Silver Layer data product. Supports data lineage tracking and identifies records that have been corrected or enriched post-initial load.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority under whose jurisdiction this access event is most relevant, particularly for inspection-context accesses. Supports multi-jurisdictional regulatory reporting (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); MHRA GCP; PMDA

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this audit log record is eligible for archival or deletion, aligned with the retention period of the parent document. Per ICH E6(R2), TMF records must be retained for at least 2 years after the last marketing approval or study
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: signature_meaning
attributes.description: The meaning associated with the electronic signature applied during this access event, per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements (e.g., approved, reviewed, authored, witnessed). Null if no signature was applied.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50(a); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: source_ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the device from which the document access event originated. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail completeness and cybersecurity monitoring. May be considered PII under GDPR in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); GDPR Article 4; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: study_protocol_number
attributes.description: The sponsor-assigned protocol number of the clinical study associated with the accessed document, captured as a denormalized snapshot. Enables direct audit trail readability without requiring a join to the study table.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: tmf_section
attributes.description: The specific section identifier within the TMF zone for the accessed document per the DIA TMF Reference Model (e.g., '01.01 Trial Oversight', '03.01 Regulatory Approvals'). Enables granular TMF access pattern analysis.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: The TMF zone classification of the accessed document per the DIA TMF Reference Model (e.g., Zone 01 - Trial Management, Zone 02 - Central Trial Documents, Zone 03 - Regulatory, Zone 04 - IRB/IEC, Zone 05 - Site Management).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: user_full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the user who performed the access event at the time of the event. Captured as a denormalized field to preserve the audit record even if the user record changes, per ALCOA+ contemporaneous and enduring requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: user_organization
attributes.description: The organization or company affiliation of the user at the time of access (e.g., sponsor name, CRO name, investigative site name). Supports multi-sponsor and multi-site access auditing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: The business role of the user at the time of the access event (e.g., Principal Investigator, Clinical Research Associate, Data Manager, Regulatory Affairs Specialist, Sponsor Representative).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: vault_audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: The native audit trail record identifier generated by Veeva Vault for this access event. Serves as the source system reference key enabling traceability back to the original immutable audit record in Veeva Vault for regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); Veeva Vault Audit Trail; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: vault_document_reference
attributes.description: The native document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault to the controlled document that was accessed. Serves as the primary reference to the source document record in the eTMF/regulatory system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: vault_session_reference
attributes.description: The Veeva Vault session identifier associated with this access event. Enables correlation of multiple access events within a single user session for forensic audit analysis and inspection support.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); Veeva Vault Audit Trail

products.name: etmf_exchange
products.description: Tracks eTMF document exchange transactions between CRO and sponsor organizations per the DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard. Each record represents a discrete transfer event: exchange direction (CRO-to-sponsor, sponsor-to-CRO), document package
products.reference: eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v1.0; DIA eTMF Working Group

attributes.name: etmf_exchange_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) Exchange ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each eTMF document exchange transaction record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

tag_set.value: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) Exchange ID

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.clinical_program. Business justification: Program-level eTMF transfers occur at program closeout or partnership handover (e.g., full program TMF transfer from CRO to sponsor).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: reference_number

attributes.name: requirement_code
