products.name: quality_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing quality events identified through QC reviews, self-inspections, routine quality monitoring, or proactive quality surveillance activities.

attributes.name: quality_event_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the quality event record within the MasterControl quality management module. Serves as the primary key for all downstream references to this quality event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: compliance_capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal CAPA record initiated in MasterControl as a result of this quality event. Populated only when capa_required is True and the CAPA has been formally opened. Null until CAPA is initiated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sop. Business justification: quality_event.affected_sop_number is a free-text string identifying the SOP implicated in the quality event.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: Quality events in clinical trials frequently arise from consent process failures (wrong ICF version used, consent obtained after procedures, missing signatures).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: database_lock_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.database_lock_event. Business justification: Quality events arising from database lock failures (outstanding queries, failed QC checks, unauthorized lock) must reference the specific DBL event.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: identified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Quality event management requires tracking the specific employee who identified the event for GCP accountability, trend analysis by identifier role, and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: laboratory_lab_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Quality events are frequently triggered by laboratory data issues — systematic result errors, instrument failures, reagent lot problems. quality_event has affected_data_domain.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Manufacturing batch failures, OOS results, and QP release holds are quality events under GMP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.organization. Business justification: Quality events with sponsor_notified=true and sponsor_notification_date require a direct FK to the sponsor org for notification routing and sponsor-level quality reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parent_event_quality_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to a prior quality event record that this event is a recurrence of, or a related parent event in a cluster of related quality issues. Populated when recurrence_flag is True or when events are grouped for systemic analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.protocol_deviation. Business justification: quality_event.deviation_reference_number is a free-text string referencing a related protocol deviation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: specimen_collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_collection. Business justification: Specimen collection quality failures (hemolysis, lipemia, inadequate volume) are formal quality events requiring CAPA.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: specimen_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_shipment. Business justification: Temperature excursions during specimen shipment are a named quality event type in clinical trials. specimen_shipment has temperature_excursion_flag.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sponsor_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.engagement. Business justification: Quality events are tracked per engagement for account health scoring and governance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study affected by this quality event. Links the event to the specific protocol under which the quality issue was identified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the quality event was identified or originated. Null if the event is study-wide or sponsor/CRO-level rather than site-specific.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: affected_data_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM or clinical data domain affected by the quality event (e.g., AE, CM, LB, VS, DM, DS, EX). Used for data management impact assessment, targeted re-monitoring, and SDTM submission quality review. Null if the event is not data-domain-specific.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: affected_process
attributes.description: The specific clinical trial business process or functional area impacted by the quality event (e.g., informed consent management, adverse event reporting, randomization, data entry, site monitoring, regulatory submission).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: audit_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality event record has been reviewed and confirmed as complete and audit-ready for regulatory inspection or sponsor audit purposes. True: record is audit-ready.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance; Veeva Vault eTMF; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) has been determined to be required for this quality event. True: CAPA must be initiated in MasterControl. False: event can be resolved without formal CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the quality event record was first created in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements and ALCOA+ attributability. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality event has compromised or potentially compromised the integrity of clinical trial data in the EDC or source documents. True: data integrity affected. False: no data integrity impact.
attributes.references: FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: Number of errors, discrepancies, or non-conformances identified within the QC sample reviewed. Used in conjunction with sample_size to compute error rate for quality trending and threshold monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: error_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of errors identified relative to the total sample size (error_count / sample_size). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Used for quality threshold monitoring, KPI reporting, and CAPA escalation triggers.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the quality event, including what was observed, where it occurred, and the potential impact on subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: event_reference_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-visible reference number assigned to the quality event upon creation in MasterControl. Used in audit trails, regulatory correspondence, and CAPA linkage. Format: QE-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quality event within the MasterControl workflow. Open: newly identified, awaiting triage. Under Review: QA/QC team actively investigating. Pending CAPA: CAPA determination made, awaiting CAPA initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quality event by its nature. Drives routing, escalation rules, and CAPA determination logic. Values: data_quality_issue (EDC/eCRF data errors), process_non_compliance (GCP/SOP deviation), system_failure (EDC, CTMS, or IRT system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: identification_source
attributes.description: The activity or mechanism through which the quality event was detected. Drives root cause analysis and process improvement analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the quality event was first identified or detected. This is the principal real-world event date per ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any immediate containment or corrective actions taken at the time of quality event identification, prior to formal CAPA initiation. Examples: data query raised in EDC, site notified, process halted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: irb_iec_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality event must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study. True: IRB/IEC notification required. False: not required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations; EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportable Flag

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the quality event as a protocol deviation per ICH E6(R2) and sponsor requirements. Major: deviation that may affect subject safety or data integrity. Minor: deviation with minimal impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: qc_outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the QC review activity that generated this quality event. Pass: quality threshold met, no significant issues. Fail: quality threshold exceeded, formal action required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality event represents a recurrence of a previously identified and closed quality event of the same type at the same site or study. True: recurrence identified. False: first occurrence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notified
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada) notified of this quality event, if applicable. Null if regulatory_reportability is not_reportable. Supports regulatory submission tracking and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_reportability
attributes.description: Assessment of whether this quality event requires reporting to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) or to the sponsor. Reportable: must be submitted to regulatory body. Not Reportable: no regulatory notification required.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quality event was formally resolved and closed in MasterControl. Populated when event_status transitions to closed. Used to calculate time-to-resolution KPIs and assess compliance with quality SLA targets.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of how the quality event was resolved, including actions taken, verification of effectiveness, and confirmation that the issue has been addressed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the QA reviewer formally assessed and triaged the quality event in MasterControl. Used to measure triage cycle time and compliance with internal quality SLA targets for event review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; MasterControl QMS; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) professional who reviewed and assessed the quality event in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail and GCP oversight accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause identified during quality event investigation. Used for systemic quality trending, SOP improvement prioritization, and CAPA effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; ISO 9001 Root Cause Analysis

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the root cause identified through investigation of the quality event. Captured by the QA investigator following root cause analysis. Supports CAPA development and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Total number of records, data points, or items reviewed during the QC activity that identified this quality event. Used to calculate error rate and assess the statistical significance of the finding. Applicable when the event originates from a QC review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Risk-based severity classification of the quality event per GCP quality standards. Critical: may impact subject safety or data integrity requiring immediate action. Major: significant GCP deviation with potential regulatory impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA GCP Inspection Findings Classification; FDA Guidance on GCP Inspections

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this quality event. Populated when sponsor_notified is True. Used to verify compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA GCP Guidance; Sponsor Quality Agreement

attributes.name: sponsor_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this quality event. True: sponsor notification sent. False: sponsor not yet notified. Required for CRO-sponsor quality agreement compliance and sponsor oversight obligations under ICH
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA GCP Guidance; Sponsor Quality Agreement

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality event has a direct or potential impact on the safety of enrolled study subjects. True: subject safety may be or has been affected. False: no subject safety impact identified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the quality event record in MasterControl. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: audit_id

attributes.name: source_document_reference

attributes.name: sample_size_calc_id

attributes.name: budget_expiry_date

attributes.name: budget_number

attributes.name: payment_reference_note

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the site payment disbursement within the the source system Drives reconciliation and financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|processed|paid|cancelled|on_hold|reversed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment by the type of clinical trial activity it compensates: milestone-based, per-procedure fee, per-visit fee, site startup, study closeout, pass-through cost reimbursement, patient stipend, or overhead.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA AP Module

attributes.name: payment_value_date
attributes.description: The bank value date on which funds are credited to the site's bank account, which may differ from the payment_date (posting date) due to banking clearing cycles. Used for cash flow forecasting and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SWIFT Standards; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site payment was confirmed as reconciled against the site bank statement or clinical trial agreement milestone. Populated when reconciliation_status transitions to 'reconciled'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current reconciliation state of the site payment against the site's bank statement confirmation and the clinical trial agreement milestone schedule. Drives the finance team's month-end close and audit readiness.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment record represents a reversal (True) of a previously posted payment, used to correct erroneous disbursements. Reversed payments must be linked to the original via original_payment_id.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: sap_ap_document_number
attributes.description: the source system Payable document number generated when the payment was posted. Serves as the primary cross-reference between the clinical trial finance data product and the ERP system of record for audit and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sap_payment_run_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the the source system payment program run (F110) that generated this disbursement. Enables batch-level reconciliation and audit tracing of grouped payment runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sap_vendor_code
attributes.description: the source system master record identifier for the investigational site or principal investigator entity receiving the payment. Used to match the payment to the correct payee in the ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this site payment record in the data platform. Tracks status changes, reconciliation updates, and corrections for audit and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: the source system System Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code identifying the specific project task or deliverable this payment is charged against. Enables granular project accounting and sponsor cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; GAAP ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the gross payment prior to disbursement, as required by applicable tax jurisdiction rules. Zero if no withholding tax applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Module; IRS Publication 515; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: the source system tax code identifying the applicable tax type and rate configuration for this payment. Used for tax reporting (e.g., IRS Form 1042-S, local equivalents).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Module; IRS Form 1042-S; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate of withholding tax applied to the gross payment amount, as determined by the applicable tax treaty or local tax regulation for the site's jurisdiction. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515; OECD Model Tax Convention; SAP S/4HANA Tax Module

products.name: patient_stipend
products.description: Transactional record for stipend and reimbursement payments made to trial subjects (patients) for study participation, travel, and incidental expenses. Captures subject reference, study visit association, stipend type (participation fee, travel

attributes.name: patient_stipend_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each patient stipend or reimbursement payment record. Primary key for the patient_stipend data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Patient stipend approval is a named IRB/FMV compliance process. Linking to the approving employee supports fair market value compliance audits and IRB reporting requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: Stipend payment eligibility requires verified active consent — finance must confirm the subject held valid consent at time of payment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Patient stipend payments are charged to a cost center for clinical trial subject cost tracking.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Stipend budget management requires tying each payment to the specific enrollment record — critical for re-screened subjects who enroll multiple times and for per-enrollment stipend cap
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Patient stipends post to a GL account for subject reimbursement expense recognition. patient_stipend.gl_account_code is a denormalized string; adding gl_account_id FK normalizes this to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: reissue_of_stipend_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original patient_stipend_id that this record replaces or reissues (e.g., due to lost check, failed bank transfer, or payment correction). Enables payment lineage tracking and prevents duplicate disbursement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Financial Controls; ALCOA+

attributes.name: study_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.study_budget. Business justification: Patient stipend payments draw from the study budget allocation (study_budget.patient_stipend_amount tracks the total allocated for stipends).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this stipend payment is issued. Links the payment to the governing study protocol and sponsor agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigative site at which the subject is enrolled and where the stipend obligation originates. Used for site-level financial reporting and budget reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_visit_schedule. Business justification: Patient stipends are paid per protocol-defined visit. study_visit_schedule defines the visit type and FMV-compliant stipend rate.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific scheduled or unscheduled study visit that triggered this stipend payment. Enables visit-level payment tracking and protocol compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) receiving the stipend or reimbursement. Core party reference linking the payment to the enrolled participant.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: accrual_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (YYYY-MM) in which the stipend expense is accrued for financial reporting purposes, which may differ from the payment date. Supports month-end close and sponsor invoicing accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; GAAP/IFRS Accrual Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the stipend payment was formally approved by the authorized approver (e.g., site coordinator, finance manager) prior to disbursement. Supports SOX dual-control and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a stipend payment was cancelled or placed on hold. Populated only when payment_status is 'cancelled' or 'on_hold'. Required for audit trail and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; SOX

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the site where the subject is enrolled. Determines applicable tax regulations, currency, and local payment compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; HIPAA; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stipend payment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ principles, and SOX financial record-keeping controls.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency study operations and financial consolidation in the source system
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: fmv_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stipend payment amount is within the approved fair market value range as reviewed by the IRB/IEC. A value of True confirms compliance; False triggers a compliance review workflow.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Financial Disclosure; OIG Compliance Guidance; IRB/IEC FMV Guidelines; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: fmv_rate
attributes.description: Approved fair market value rate for this stipend type as established by the IRB/IEC and sponsor. Used to validate that payment amounts comply with regulatory guidelines preventing undue inducement of study participation.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Financial Disclosure; OIG Compliance Guidance; IRB/IEC FMV Guidelines; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: irb_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the IRB/IEC approval that authorized the subject payment plan for this study. Confirms that the stipend structure has been reviewed and approved by the ethics committee as required by GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount disbursed to the subject after tax withholding deductions. Equals payment_amount minus tax_withheld_amount. Used for subject-facing payment confirmation and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP; IRS Publication 525; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information related to this stipend payment record. Not used for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross stipend or reimbursement amount to be paid to the subject before any applicable tax withholding. Expressed in the payment currency. Used for budget tracking and FMV compliance assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; OIG FMV Guidelines; FDA Financial Disclosure; SOX

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the stipend payment was or is scheduled to be disbursed to the subject. Used for financial period accruals, cash flow reporting, and subject retention tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; GAAP/IFRS Accrual Accounting; SOX

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Mechanism used to disburse the stipend to the subject. Determines the downstream payment processing workflow and compliance requirements for subject payment programs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IRB/IEC Subject Payment Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processing vendor or financial institution used to disburse the stipend (e.g., Greenphire ClinCard, BioClinica, bank name). Supports vendor management and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Vendor Controls

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment processor or bank reference number assigned upon successful disbursement (e.g., ACH trace number, check number, prepaid card transaction ID). Used for payment reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP; NACHA ACH Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stipend payment record within the payment workflow. Drives operational processing, financial accruals, and reconciliation activities in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: protocol_number
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned protocol identifier for the clinical study under which this stipend is issued. Enables direct cross-referencing with regulatory submissions and sponsor financial reporting without requiring a join.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: receipt_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required supporting receipt or documentation has been received from the subject prior to payment processing. Blocks payment disbursement when receipt_required is True and this flag is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IRB/IEC Subject Payment Guidelines; SOX Internal Controls; ALCOA+

attributes.name: receipt_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation (e.g., travel receipt, parking receipt) is required to process this reimbursement payment. Applicable primarily to expense reimbursement stipend types.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; IRB/IEC Subject Payment Guidelines; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: stipend_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this stipend payment record, used for cross-system reconciliation and subject communication. Sourced from the source system payable module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: stipend_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stipend or reimbursement category. Determines the nature of the payment for fair market value (FMV) compliance, tax reporting, and budget allocation.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Financial Disclosure; OIG Compliance Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP; IRB/IEC Fair Market Value Guidelines

attributes.name: subject_consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's valid informed consent (ICF) has been verified as current and on file prior to processing this stipend payment. Ensures payment is only made to consented participants.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP; Clinpal eConsent

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Protocol-assigned subject identification number (e.g., site-subject number in format SSSXXX) used to identify the subject in study records without exposing personal identity. Enables cross-system traceability while maintaining subject pseudonymization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM USUBJID; HIPAA Safe Harbor; GDPR Article 25

attributes.name: tax_form_type
attributes.description: Type of tax reporting form applicable to this stipend payment based on jurisdiction and payment classification. Populated only when tax_reportable is True. Supports year-end tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525; IRS Form 1099-MISC; SAP S/4HANA Tax Module; SOX

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stipend payment is subject to tax reporting obligations (e.g., IRS Form 1099-MISC in the U.S.). Drives year-end tax reporting processes and subject tax notification workflows.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525; IRS Form 1099-MISC; GDPR; SAP S/4HANA Tax Module

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax withheld from the gross stipend payment prior to disbursement to the subject. Applicable where local tax regulations require withholding on research participation payments.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525; GDPR; SAP S/4HANA Tax Module; SOX

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this stipend payment record. Required for change tracking, data lineage, and SOX audit trail compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: visit_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the associated study visit was completed by the subject, triggering the stipend payment obligation. Establishes the business event date distinct from the payment disbursement date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: the source system Work Breakdown Structure element code used to allocate the stipend cost to a specific study activity or deliverable. Enables granular project accounting and sponsor pass-through billing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System; GAAP/IFRS Project Accounting; SOX

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Master record for purchase orders issued to vendors and service providers supporting clinical trial operations (e.g., central labs, imaging CROs, specialty vendors, courier services).

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the purchase order record in the clinical trials finance data lakehouse (Silver Layer). Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: PO approval is a named procurement control process. Clinical trial finance requires an auditable link from each PO to the authorizing employee for spend governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_assay. Business justification: POs for DMPK/PK studies are issued for specific validated bioanalytical assays.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal cost center responsible for this purchase order, used for project accounting and financial reporting in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO Module); SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Purchase orders reference a GL account for the source system assignment and commitment tracking.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Purchase orders for IP manufacturing, packaging, labeling, and distribution reference the specific investigational product.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Sponsors and CROs issue purchase orders to central labs for analytical services. Linking purchase_order to lab_facility enables procurement tracking, budget commitment by facility
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.study_budget. Business justification: Purchase orders are issued against study budgets and consume committed budget amounts. The PO has wbs_element which maps to study_budget.wbs_element_code.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study or trial protocol this purchase order supports. Enables study-level cost tracking and sponsor invoicing reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting (PS Module); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: subcontract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.subcontract. Business justification: POs are raised to fund subcontracted vendor services in clinical trials. Each PO must reference the subcontract authorizing the spend — required for three-way match (PO/GR/invoice)
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or service provider (e.g., central lab, imaging CRO, specialty vendor, courier) to whom this purchase order is issued.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master (LFA1); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: accrual_amount
attributes.description: The financial accrual amount recognized for this purchase order in the current accounting period, representing goods/services received but not yet invoiced. Supports GAAP/IFRS period-end close and SOX financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Accruals; GAAP/IFRS ASC 420; SOX

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the purchase order received final approval through the the source system strategy workflow. Used for SOX controls and procurement cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SOX; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the purchase order within the the source system workflow (release strategy). Tracks whether the PO has been approved by all required authorization levels per SOX segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Release Strategy (EKKO.FRGKE); SOX Procurement Controls; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text reason provided when a purchase order is cancelled. Required for audit trail, procurement analytics, and SOX controls documentation. Populated only when po_status is 'cancelled'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SOX Procurement Controls; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: the source system code representing the legal entity issuing this purchase order. Required for entity-level financial reporting, SOX controls, and multi-entity consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module (EKKO.BUKRS); SOX; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this purchase order record was first created in the system (the source system the lakehouse Silver Layer). Required for audit trail, SOX controls, and ALCOA+ data integrity compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.AEDAT); SOX; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the purchase order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency clinical trial financial management and sponsor invoicing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.WAERS); GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which goods or services are requested to be delivered or completed by the vendor. Used for supply chain scheduling and clinical trial operational planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKET.EINDT); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: International commercial terms (Incoterms) governing delivery obligations, risk transfer, and cost allocation between the CRO and vendor (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP). Relevant for clinical supply chain and central lab shipments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.INCO1); ICC Incoterms 2020; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied at the time of PO creation to convert the PO currency to the company code functional currency (e.g., USD). Required for multi-currency financial consolidation and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.WKURS); GAAP/IFRS ASC 830; SOX

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net PO amount converted to the company's functional currency (typically USD) using the exchange rate at PO creation. Used for consolidated financial reporting and SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP/IFRS ASC 830; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods or services were confirmed as received from the vendor. Used for accrual period determination, invoice matching, and accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (MKPF.BUDAT); GAAP/IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: goods_receipt_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether goods or services ordered under this PO have been received: not received, partially received, or fully received. Drives accounts payable invoice matching (3-way match) and accrual calculations in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.ELIKZ); GAAP/IFRS Accruals; SOX

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current accounts payable invoice processing status for this purchase order. Tracks whether vendor invoices have been received, matched, and processed against the PO in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; GAAP/IFRS; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount invoiced by the vendor against this purchase order to date, in PO currency. Used to calculate open commitment (PO value minus invoiced amount) for accrual and financial forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; GAAP/IFRS Accruals; SOX

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net total value of the purchase order after discounts and adjustments but before tax. Represents the accounts payable obligation and is used for accrual calculations and sponsor invoicing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.NETWR); GAAP/IFRS; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: pass_through_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the costs under this purchase order are pass-through expenses to be recharged directly to the sponsor (True) or absorbed as CRO operational costs (False). Critical for sponsor invoicing and budget reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX; Clinical Trial Sponsor Agreement

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow forecasting in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module (LFB1.ZTERM); GAAP/IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: po_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the purchase order was formally issued to the vendor. This is the principal real-world event date for the procurement transaction, distinct from the system creation timestamp.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.BEDAT); SOX; GAAP/IFRS Procurement Accruals

attributes.name: po_gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross value of the purchase order before any discounts, taxes, or adjustments, expressed in the PO currency. Represents the full procurement commitment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.GNETWR); GAAP/IFRS; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable purchase order number assigned by the source system module (e.g., PO-2024-000123). Used in vendor communications, accounts payable matching, and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.EBELN); SOX Procurement Controls

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order, tracking progression from draft through approval, issuance, goods/service receipt, and closure or cancellation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SOX Procurement Controls; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order by procurement instrument type: standard (single delivery), blanket (multiple releases against a ceiling), framework (master agreement call-off), service (service entry sheet-based), or emergency (expedited
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.BSART); SOX Procurement Controls

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: the source system group (buyer group) code identifying the team or individual buyer responsible for managing this purchase order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.EKGRP); SOX Segregation of Duties

attributes.name: purchasing_org
attributes.description: the source system organization code responsible for negotiating and issuing this purchase order. Represents the organizational unit with procurement authority.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.EKORG); SOX Segregation of Duties

attributes.name: sap_mm_document_number
attributes.description: The the source system Management (MM) module document reference number for this purchase order (EKKO table key). Enables traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO); 21 CFR Part 11; SOX

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods or services being procured under this purchase order (e.g., 'Central laboratory specimen processing services for Phase III oncology study'). Provides business context for audit and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKPO.TXZ01); ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX

attributes.name: sponsor_billable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order's costs are billable to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor under the clinical trial agreement. Drives sponsor invoicing and accounts receivable processes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX; Clinical Trial Sponsor Agreement; GAAP/IFRS Revenue Recognition

attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cumulative_accrual_amount
attributes.description: The total accrual amount accumulated from study start through the current accrual period for the same cost category and study/site combination. Supports budget-to-actual tracking and study-level financial forecasting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the accrual amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Required for multi-currency clinical trial financial operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: accrual_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature and business justification of the accrual entry. Provides context for auditors, finance reviewers, and SOX controls testing. Should reference the specific service, period, and study activity being accrued.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 420; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency accrual amount to USD for consolidated reporting. Sourced from the source system rate tables at period-end.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (YYYY) in which the accrual is recognized. Used for annual financial reporting, budget-to-actual analysis, and year-end close procedures in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: is_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accrual represents a pass-through cost that will be recharged to the sponsor at actual cost without markup. True = pass-through cost; False = direct CRO service cost. Affects sponsor invoicing and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 808

attributes.name: is_sox_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accrual entry is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls testing and documentation requirements. True = SOX-controlled accrual requiring documented review and approval; False = non-SOX accrual.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the accrual entry, used in financial reporting, audit trails, and cross-system reconciliation. Follows the format ACR-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM) for which the accrual is recognized. Determines the financial reporting period in which the clinical trial cost is recorded, critical for period-end close accuracy and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual journal entry was posted to the the source system Ledger. This is the principal business event date for the accrual transaction and determines the accounting period assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the finance analyst or accountant who prepared and submitted the accrual entry. Required for SOX segregation of duties and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: prior_period_accrual_amount
attributes.description: The accrual amount recognized in the immediately preceding accounting period for the same cost category and study/site combination. Used to calculate period-over-period variance and support accrual roll-forward analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual entry is scheduled to be automatically reversed in the source system set to the first day of the following accounting period to offset the accrual when the actual invoice is received.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The the source system document number of the reversal journal entry that offsets this accrual. Populated after the reversal is executed; null if the accrual has not yet been reversed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: The the source system Accounting (FI) document number assigned when the accrual journal entry is posted in the general ledger. Used for cross-referencing between the data lakehouse and the ERP system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the accrual entry within the period-end close process. Draft entries are under preparation; posted entries have been recorded in the GL; reversed entries have been offset; adjusted entries have been corrected; approved entries
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: supporting_units
attributes.description: The quantity of activity units (e.g., enrolled subjects, completed visits, monitoring days, lab samples) used as the basis for calculating the accrual amount. Provides the quantitative driver behind enrollment-based, visit-based, or unit-based accruals.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: accrual_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the clinical trial cost being accrued. Drives GL account mapping and financial reporting categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 420; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: The per-unit cost rate applied to supporting units to calculate the accrual amount (accrual_amount = supporting_units × unit_rate). Sourced from the executed site budget or investigator grant agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the accrual record. Tracks changes to accrual amounts, status, or supporting data as part of the period-end close process and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the accrual amount and the actual invoice amount when the invoice is received and matched. A positive variance indicates over-accrual; negative indicates under-accrual. Used for accrual accuracy monitoring and process improvement.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: variance_explanation
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the variance between the accrual amount and the actual invoice amount. Required for material variances exceeding the defined threshold as part of SOX controls and period-end close procedures.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: the source system Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code that maps the accrual to a specific project task or deliverable within the clinical trial project accounting hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cash Management; IFRS; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: cash_outflow_forecast_amount
attributes.description: Projected cash disbursements to investigators, sites, vendors, and other payees during the forecast period. Supports cash flow management and treasury planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cash Management; IFRS; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the reliability and accuracy of the forecast, reflecting the preparer's confidence based on data quality, enrollment stability, and milestone predictability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference between the forecasted total cost and the budgeted total cost for the period (budget minus forecast). Positive value indicates favorable (under-budget) variance. Expressed in the forecast currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Variance Analysis; SOX Section 302; IFRS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the financial forecast record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts in this forecast are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency sponsor financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency; IFRS

attributes.name: direct_cost_forecast_amount
attributes.description: Projected total direct costs for the forecast period, including investigator grants, site payments, patient stipends, and clinical operations labor. Expressed in the forecast currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; IFRS; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: enrolled_subjects_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed cumulative number of subjects enrolled as of the forecast period end date. Used to project visit-based costs, patient stipends, and milestone completion timelines.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: enrollment_rate_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed patient enrollment rate (subjects per site per month) used as a key driver in the financial forecast model. Changes in enrollment rate directly impact revenue recognition timing and cost projections.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year to which the forecast belongs. Aligns with the source system close and accrual posting cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Calendar; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which the forecast period belongs, as defined in the the source system calendar. Used for annual financial planning, SOX reporting, and year-over-year variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Calendar; SOX Section 302; IFRS

attributes.name: forecast_basis
attributes.description: Methodology used to construct the financial forecast. Indicates whether the forecast was built from granular site/subject data (bottom-up), extrapolated from portfolio trends (top-down), or derived from a statistical model.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: forecast_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the forecast document, following the format FC-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in sponsor financial reporting, internal management reviews, and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the forecast period being projected. Defines the closing boundary of the financial projection window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the forecast period being projected. Defines the beginning boundary of the financial projection window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the financial forecast record. Controls whether the forecast is active for reporting and decision-making or has been replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast by periodicity or purpose. Determines the time horizon and granularity of the projection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monthly|quarterly|annual|ad_hoc|rolling_12_month|study_to_date — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: forecast_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the forecast for a given study and forecast period. Incremented each time a forecast is revised, enabling comparison of forecast iterations over time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gross_margin_forecast_amount
attributes.description: Projected gross margin for the forecast period, calculated as revenue forecast minus direct cost forecast. Expressed in the forecast currency. Used for sponsor financial reporting and internal profitability management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Reporting; IFRS; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gross_margin_forecast_pct
attributes.description: Projected gross margin as a percentage of forecasted revenue for the period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3250 = 32.50%). Used for portfolio-level profitability benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Reporting; IFRS; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: indirect_cost_forecast_amount
attributes.description: Projected total indirect and overhead costs allocated to the study for the forecast period, including G&A allocations and shared service charges. Expressed in the forecast currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; IFRS; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: is_baseline_forecast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast version has been designated as the baseline against which future forecast variances will be measured. Only one forecast per study and period may be flagged as baseline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: milestone_completion_pct
attributes.description: Projected percentage of study milestones expected to be completed by the end of the forecast period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65%). Drives revenue recognition and sponsor invoicing projections.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; IFRS 15; ASC 606

attributes.name: pass_through_cost_forecast_amount
attributes.description: Projected total pass-through costs to be reimbursed by the sponsor for the forecast period, such as central lab fees, imaging costs, and regulatory filing fees. Expressed in the forecast currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP/AR; IFRS 15; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: preparation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the forecast was formally prepared and submitted for review. Distinct from the system audit timestamp; represents the real-world event date for the forecast cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: reporting_period_label
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the forecast period used in sponsor financial reports and internal management dashboards (e.g., 'Q3 2024', 'FY2024', 'October 2024'). Supports consistent period identification across reporting cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: revenue_forecast_amount
attributes.description: Projected total revenue to be recognized from the sponsor for the forecast period, including service fees, pass-through reimbursements, and milestone payments. Expressed in the forecast currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: revenue_variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference between the forecasted revenue and the budgeted revenue for the period (forecast minus budget). Positive value indicates favorable variance; negative indicates unfavorable. Expressed in the forecast currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Variance Analysis; SOX Section 302; IFRS

attributes.name: scope_level
attributes.description: Indicates the organizational or operational scope at which the forecast is prepared. Study-level forecasts project a single protocol; portfolio-level forecasts aggregate across multiple studies for sponsor or management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast has been formally submitted to the sponsor as part of contractual financial reporting obligations. Supports sponsor relationship management and contract compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AR; ICH E6(R2); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the financial forecast record. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: variance_explanation
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the preparer explaining material variances between the current forecast and the approved budget or prior forecast version. Required for management review and SOX documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Reporting

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: the source system Breakdown Structure element code identifying the project node to which this forecast is linked. Enables project-level cost and revenue tracking aligned to the study's project accounting structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS); SOX Section 302

products.name: finance_billing_milestone

attributes.name: accrual_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the billing milestone amount that has been accrued as revenue in the current period (0.00 to 100.00). Reflects the estimated completion of the milestone trigger criteria for accrual purposes.

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval workflow status for triggering the milestone invoice: pending_approval (awaiting finance/management sign-off), approved (cleared for invoicing), rejected (trigger evidence insufficient), not_required (auto-approved per contract terms).

attributes.name: billing_amount
attributes.description: Gross contractual amount to be invoiced to the sponsor upon achievement of this milestone, expressed in the billing currency. Represents the base revenue amount before any adjustments or withholdings.

attributes.name: billing_plan_line_number

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing milestone record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor required for SOX and ALCOA+ data integrity compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the billing milestone amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Determines the currency in which the sponsor invoice will be raised.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the billing currency amount to the functional currency at the time of milestone recognition or invoicing. Sourced from the source system rate tables.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor invoice was raised in the source system Receivable for this billing milestone. Null until the milestone reaches invoiced status. Determines the revenue recognition date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable; ASC 606; SOX Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_at_risk
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing milestone is classified as at-risk (True), meaning the sponsor has disputed, placed on hold, or the CRO has assessed a significant probability of non-collection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable; ASC 606; SOX Bad Debt Controls

attributes.name: is_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing milestone represents a pass-through cost reimbursement (True) rather than a CRO service fee (False). Pass-through milestones are billed at cost without margin and require separate financial treatment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; CRO Contract Standards; SOX

attributes.name: milestone_description

attributes.name: milestone_name

attributes.name: milestone_number

attributes.name: milestone_sequence

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing milestone: pending (not yet met), triggered (trigger criteria satisfied, ready for invoicing), invoiced (invoice raised to sponsor), paid (payment received), cancelled (milestone voided), on_hold (temporarily
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Billing Plan; SOX Revenue Recognition Controls; ASC 606

attributes.name: milestone_type

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Billing Plan Configuration; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
