attributes.name: accrual_amount
attributes.description: Accrued cost amount for this budget line representing services rendered but not yet invoiced, posted as a period-end accrual in the source system Critical for accurate period financial reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI); SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Specific clinical trial activity associated with this budget line (e.g., 'Site Initiation Visit', 'Monitoring Visit', 'Database Lock', 'Regulatory Submission', 'Patient Screening', 'SAE Reporting').
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA Activity-Based Costing

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs incurred against this budget line item to date in the transaction currency, as posted in the source system for budget vs. actual variance analysis and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this budget line was formally approved by the authorized financial approver. Required for SOX financial controls documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the budget to which this line belongs (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.0-Amendment-1'). Supports budget versioning for contract amendments, scope changes, and sponsor re-negotiations. Aligns with the source system version management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Amount committed via purchase orders or contracts against this budget line but not yet invoiced or paid. Represents financial obligations that reduce available budget. Sourced from the source system management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Commitment Management; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the cost type for this budget line. Drives financial reporting segmentation and sponsor invoicing. Values: direct_labor (CRO staff effort), pass_through (third-party vendor costs billed at cost), investigator_grant (site/PI
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Element Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the cost category (e.g., 'Clinical Monitoring', 'Data Management', 'Biostatistics', 'Central Lab', 'Imaging', 'RTSM', 'eCRF License'). Enables detailed cost tracking and variance analysis at the activity level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Accounting; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget line record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record origination. Conforms to 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements and SOX audit trail standards.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget line (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY'). Supports multi-currency clinical trial budgets for global studies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Accounting

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the functional currency. Sourced from the source system rate tables. Required for multi-currency budget reporting and variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Exchange Rate Management; US GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal accounting period (1–12 or 1–13 depending on fiscal year variant) within the fiscal year to which this budget line is allocated. Enables monthly budget tracking and period-end accrual management in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this budget line is allocated (e.g., 2024, 2025). Used for annual budget planning, financial period reporting, and SOX financial controls alignment in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Planned amount converted to the company's functional currency (typically USD) using the applicable exchange rate. Required for consolidated financial reporting and SOX compliance across multi-currency global studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Accounting; SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: is_milestone_based
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment for this budget line is triggered by achievement of a defined clinical milestone (True) rather than time-and-materials or unit-based billing (False). Drives milestone payment scheduling and sponsor invoicing logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP; US GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: is_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line represents a pass-through cost that is billed to the sponsor at cost without CRO markup (True) or a CRO-managed cost subject to margin (False). Critical for sponsor invoicing and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP; US GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the budget line item activity or cost element (e.g., 'Site Initiation Visit - Site 001', 'Investigator Grant - Per Patient Enrolled', 'Central Lab Processing Fee'). Used in sponsor budget reports and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number ordering this item within the parent budget. Enables ordered display and navigation of budget line items in sponsor budget reports and the source system accounting views.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget line item. Controls whether the line is available for cost posting and sponsor invoicing. Draft: under preparation; Approved: authorized for spend; Active: costs being incurred; On Hold: temporarily suspended
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Description of the clinical or contractual milestone that triggers payment for this budget line when is_milestone_based is True (e.g., 'First Patient First Visit', 'Database Lock', 'Last Patient Last Visit', 'Regulatory Submission').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context for this budget line item (e.g., assumptions, scope clarifications, amendment rationale, vendor quotes). Supports financial review and audit documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the time period covered by this budget line item. Defines the temporal boundary for cost incurrence and accrual cutoff. Used in time-phased budget reporting and study close-out.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time period covered by this budget line item. Defines the temporal scope for cost incurrence and accrual recognition. Used in time-phased budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount for this line item in the transaction currency (planned_quantity × unit_cost). Represents the authorized spend ceiling for this activity. Used for variance analysis and sponsor budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Budgeted quantity of units for this line item (e.g., number of monitoring visits, number of patients enrolled, number of lab kits, number of FTE hours). Combined with unit_cost to derive the total planned amount.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: the source system code associated with this budget line for internal profitability reporting. Enables study-level and sponsor-level margin analysis within the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-PCA); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: the source system representing the legal entity responsible for this budget line. Required for multi-entity financial consolidation, intercompany accounting, and SOX entity-level financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI); SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: the source system document number associated with the budget posting for this line item. Provides direct traceability from the lakehouse Silver layer back to the source system transaction for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI); SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sap_internal_order
attributes.description: the source system number used for detailed cost collection and monitoring for this budget line, particularly for pass-through costs and investigator grants. Supplements WBS element for granular cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-OPA); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sponsor_line_ref
attributes.description: Sponsor's own reference code or line identifier for this budget item as defined in the contract or sponsor budget template. Enables cross-referencing between CRO internal budget and sponsor-facing budget documentation for reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Negotiated or standard cost per unit for this budget line item in the transaction currency. Multiplied by planned_quantity to derive planned_amount. Commercially sensitive as it reflects CRO pricing and investigator grant rates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the planned quantity (e.g., 'visit', 'patient', 'hour', 'FTE', 'kit', 'sample', 'page', 'month'). Required for accurate cost calculation and sponsor budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Management; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this budget line record. Supports change detection, incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: the source system Structure element code that classifies this budget line within the project hierarchy (e.g., study phase, activity, task). Drives cost allocation, project accounting, and financial reporting in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS); PMI PMBOK WBS Standard

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for this training assignment, formatted as TRN-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in audit trails, compliance reports, and CAPA references. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; SOP on Training Management

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the training assignment. Drives compliance dashboards, overdue notifications, and regulatory readiness reporting. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this transaction.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Inspection Readiness

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential attempt number for the training assessment (1 = first attempt, 2 = second attempt, etc.). Tracks retake history. Maximum attempts may be governed by the training SOP. Supports analysis of training effectiveness.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; SOP on Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or context related to this training assignment, such as reasons for late completion, special circumstances, or instructor observations. Supports audit trail narrative.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee completed the SOP training (read-and-understand acknowledgement, e-learning module completion, or instructor sign-off). Null if training is not yet completed. Core compliance evidence field.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Inspection Readiness

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the employee completed the training, including timezone offset. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and audit trail integrity. Complements completion_date with time-level precision.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Training Management Module; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this training assignment record was first created in the source system (MasterControl). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Training Management Module; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the training completion has exceeded the due date at the time of last record update. Zero or negative if on time. Used for compliance KPI reporting and escalation prioritization.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; SOP on Training Management; FDA Inspection Readiness

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department of the employee at the time of training assignment (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs). Snapshot value for compliance reporting and departmental training coverage analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; SOP on Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the employee must complete the assigned SOP training. Used to trigger overdue notifications, compliance reporting, and escalation workflows. Typically set based on SOP effective date plus a grace period defined in the training SOP.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOP on Training Management

attributes.name: job_role
attributes.description: Job role or title of the employee at the time of training assignment (e.g., Clinical Research Associate, Data Manager, Biostatistician). Captured as a snapshot to support role-based training compliance analysis even if the employee's role changes later.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; SOP on Training Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this training assignment record was most recently updated in the source system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Training Management Module; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: mastercontrol_training_code
attributes.description: External system-of-record identifier assigned by MasterControl to this training assignment. Used for cross-system traceability and audit reconciliation between the lakehouse and the source document control system.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: max_attempts_allowed
attributes.description: Maximum number of assessment attempts permitted for this training assignment as configured in MasterControl. Null if unlimited. Used to enforce training policy and trigger escalation when maximum attempts are exhausted without passing.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; SOP on Training Management

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the training assessment: pass (score met or exceeded threshold), fail (score below threshold), not_assessed (no assessment required for this method), or pending (assessment not yet taken). Core compliance evidence for regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Inspection Readiness; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum assessment score percentage required to pass the training (e.g., 80.00). Defined at the SOP training requirement level and captured here for audit trail completeness. Enables pass/fail determination and historical threshold tracking.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; SOP on Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: recurrence_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days after completion before the next training assignment is automatically generated for this SOP. Null if recurrence_required is false. Supports periodic retraining scheduling (e.g., 365 for annual retraining).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; SOP on Training Management

attributes.name: recurrence_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOP training must be repeated on a periodic basis (e.g., annually). Drives the generation of future training assignments upon completion. Configured at the SOP training requirement level.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; SOP on Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: signed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the employee applied their electronic signature to acknowledge training completion. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail. May differ slightly from completion_timestamp if signature is applied after assessment.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Training Management Module; ALCOA+; EU Annex 11

attributes.name: sop_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assigned SOP version became effective. Used to determine whether training was completed before or after the SOP became operative, supporting compliance gap analysis.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sop_version
attributes.description: Version number of the SOP document at the time of training assignment (e.g., 1.0, 2.3). Critical for compliance to confirm training was completed on the current effective version. Supports version-specific training gap analysis.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.13; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: training_category
attributes.description: Classification of why this training was assigned: initial (new hire or new SOP), retraining (following deviation or CAPA), periodic (scheduled refresh), change-driven (SOP version update), or role-based (role change).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAPA SOP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: training_method
attributes.description: Modality by which the SOP training is delivered: read-and-understand (employee reads and acknowledges), instructor-led (classroom or virtual), e-learning (online module), on-the-job (supervised practice), or blended.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.8; SOP on Training Management

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the QA manager or authorized approver who approved the training waiver. Captured as a string snapshot for audit trail completeness. Null if no waiver was granted.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: Date on which the training waiver was approved. Null if no waiver was granted. Required for audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented justification for waiving this training assignment (e.g., employee is leaving the organization, SOP is being retired, equivalent training completed externally). Null if assignment_status is not 'waived'. Required for audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: training_curriculum
products.description: Master record defining structured training curricula assigned to job profiles or roles within the clinical research organization. Captures curriculum name, target job profile or role, list of required training courses (GCP, SOP, protocol-specific
products.reference: MasterControl Curriculum; ICH E6(R2) Training Requirements

attributes.name: training_curriculum_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the training curriculum record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: the source system identifier of the individual who approved this curriculum version in MasterControl. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sop. Business justification: Training curricula with sop_training_included=true must reference the governing SOP to trigger automatic curriculum updates when SOPs are revised.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: training_curriculum.target_job_profile is a denormalized STRING reference to the job profile this curriculum is designed for.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.organization. Business justification: Sponsor-specific training curricula (GCP, protocol, system) must be traceable to the sponsoring organization for inspection readiness, sponsor audit compliance, and ensuring CRO staff
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: the source system identifier of the individual responsible for authoring, maintaining, and reviewing this curriculum (typically a Training Manager or QA Lead). Supports accountability tracking and periodic review scheduling.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: superseded_by_curriculum_training_curriculum_id
attributes.description: Reference to the training_curriculum_id of the newer curriculum version that replaced this one. Null if this is the current active version. Enables version lineage tracing for regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: applicable_study_phase
attributes.description: The clinical study phase(s) for which this curriculum is applicable. Certain curricula (e.g., first-in-human safety monitoring) are phase-specific. 'all_phases' indicates the curriculum applies across all study phases.
attributes.references: ICH E8; 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trial Guidelines; FDA

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this curriculum version was formally approved in MasterControl by the designated approver. Required for regulatory audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: change_summary
attributes.description: A brief description of the changes made in this version of the curriculum compared to the previous version (e.g., 'Updated GCP module to reflect ICH E6(R3) guidance; added EU CTR 536/2014 module').
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: completion_window_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from assignment date within which all courses in the curriculum must be completed by the assigned employee. Drives compliance deadline enforcement and escalation workflows (e.g., 30 days for onboarding GCP, 14 days for
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 312.53; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: curriculum_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the curriculum in MasterControl (e.g., CURR-GCP-001). Used for cross-system reference, regulatory submissions, and audit trail identification.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: curriculum_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the curriculum's purpose, scope, learning objectives, and target audience. Provides context for training administrators, QA reviewers, and regulatory inspectors.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: curriculum_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the training curriculum (e.g., 'GCP Onboarding Curriculum for Clinical Research Associates'). Used in training assignment reports and compliance dashboards.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: curriculum_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the curriculum in MasterControl. Draft indicates the curriculum is being authored; active means it is currently assigned and enforced; retired means it is no longer in use; superseded means a newer version has replaced it
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: curriculum_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the curriculum by its primary purpose. Onboarding curricula apply to new hires; role_based to specific job profiles; protocol_specific to study-assigned staff; system_specific to EDC/CTMS/eTMF users; regulatory to GCP/ICH/FDA
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The primary method by which this curriculum is delivered to employees. elearning: self-paced online modules; instructor_led: classroom or virtual instructor-led training; blended: combination of elearning and instructor-led; read_acknowledge: document
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this curriculum version becomes binding and must be completed by assigned personnel. Used to trigger training assignment notifications and compliance deadline calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl Training Management; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: The estimated total time in hours required to complete all courses in the curriculum. Used for workforce capacity planning, onboarding scheduling, and resource allocation in the source system
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; Workday HCM Workforce Planning

attributes.name: gcp_training_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curriculum includes at least one Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training course as required by ICH E6(R2). Critical flag for regulatory inspection readiness and delegation log verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1.3; 21 CFR Part 312.53; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA; EMA

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic region or country scope for which this curriculum is applicable (e.g., USA, EU, JPN, GLOBAL). Relevant for region-specific regulatory requirements such as FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (USA), EU CTR 536/2014 (EU), or PMDA guidelines (Japan).
attributes.references: FDA; EMA; PMDA; MHRA; Health Canada; TGA; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: inspection_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curriculum and its associated documentation are in a state ready for regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, Health Canada, TGA). True means all required approvals, version controls, and audit trails are complete.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA; EMA; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) for the primary language in which this curriculum is authored (e.g., en, en-US, fr, ja, de). Supports multi-regional deployment and regulatory submissions to PMDA, EMA, Health Canada, TGA.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1; EMA; PMDA; Health Canada; TGA; MHRA

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this curriculum was last reviewed for content accuracy and regulatory currency. Supports periodic review scheduling and GCP compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; MasterControl Document Control; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of this curriculum is mandatory for the assigned job profile or role. Mandatory curricula trigger compliance alerts and may block system access (e.g., EDC, CTMS) if not completed within the required window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1.3; 21 CFR Part 312.53; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: mastercontrol_curriculum_code
attributes.description: The native document or curriculum identifier assigned by MasterControl (source system of record). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and MasterControl.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: max_attempts_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum number of times an employee may attempt the curriculum assessment before escalation or remediation is required. Null if unlimited attempts are permitted.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next periodic review of this curriculum must be completed. Calculated from last_review_date plus the review cycle interval. Drives review task creation in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; MasterControl Document Control; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: passing_score_percent
attributes.description: The minimum percentage score required to pass assessments within this curriculum. Typically 80% for GCP-related curricula per industry standard. Null if the curriculum has no scored assessments (e.g., read-and-acknowledge only).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Training Management; FDA Training Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_training_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curriculum includes protocol-specific training courses. When true, the curriculum is typically linked to a specific study protocol and must be completed before site staff can perform protocol-defined activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.2.5; 21 CFR Part 312.53; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: recertification_period_months
attributes.description: The interval in months after which employees must re-complete the curriculum to maintain certification (e.g., 24 months for GCP refresher). Null if the curriculum is a one-time completion requirement with no recertification cycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1.3; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this training curriculum record was first created in the source system (MasterControl). Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this training curriculum record was last modified in the source system (MasterControl). Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements for electronic records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: The primary regulatory framework or guideline mandating this curriculum (e.g., ICH E6(R2) GCP, 21 CFR Part 312, EU CTR 536/2014, ISO 14155, GDPR). Multiple references may be pipe-delimited. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and audit documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 14155; FDA; EMA; MHRA; PMDA; Health Canada; TGA; OHRP

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this curriculum version was retired or superseded. Null if the curriculum is currently active. Supports lifecycle management and historical compliance reporting.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sop_training_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curriculum includes Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) training courses. SOP training is a GCP requirement for all clinical research personnel performing regulated activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl Document Control; OHRP

attributes.name: sponsor_specific
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curriculum was developed to meet a specific sponsor's training requirements. Sponsor-specific curricula may include sponsor SOPs, sponsor EDC system training, or sponsor-mandated GCP guidelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 312.53; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: system_training_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curriculum includes training on operational systems such as EDC (Medidata Rave), CTMS (the source system (Veeva Vault), or IRT/RTSM. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 system access authorization.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: target_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional group for which this curriculum is designed (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs). Enables department-level compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Structure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area or disease indication for which this curriculum is designed (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Null for general curricula applicable across all therapeutic areas.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); MedDRA SOC Classification

attributes.name: total_course_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual training courses included in this curriculum. Provides a quick reference for workload estimation during onboarding planning and capacity management.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the curriculum following semantic versioning convention (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented upon each approved revision. Critical for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: workday_learning_program_code
attributes.description: The corresponding learning program identifier in the source system module, if the curriculum is also managed or tracked in the source system. Enables bidirectional reconciliation between MasterControl and the source system completion records.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; ICH E6(R2)

products.name: payroll_record

products.reference: Workday HCM Payroll; SOX Payroll Controls

attributes.name: payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payroll processing record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the payroll_record data product.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial cost center to which this payroll expense is allocated. Supports workforce cost allocation to clinical studies and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record for whom this payroll disbursement was processed. Links to the workforce employee master in the source system
attributes.references: Workday HCM; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Payroll records post to specific GL accounts as part of the payroll journal entry process.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: reversed_record_payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payroll_record_id that this record reverses or corrects. Null if this is not a reversal record. Maintains the audit chain for payroll corrections per SOX requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: study_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.study_budget. Business justification: Payroll records carry 'study_allocation_code' indicating which study budget absorbs the labor cost.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Total allowances paid to the employee in this pay period, including travel allowances, per diem, housing allowances, and other non-salary compensation components common in clinical research field roles.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; local tax authority

attributes.name: bank_account_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the employee's bank account number to which direct deposit was made. Stored as a masked reference for audit and reconciliation purposes only; full account number is not retained.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; PCI DSS; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The fixed base salary component of gross pay for this pay period, prorated to the pay frequency. Excludes variable pay components such as overtime, bonuses, and allowances.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: benefits_deduction
attributes.description: Total employee-paid benefits deductions withheld from gross pay, including health insurance premiums, dental, vision, and other voluntary benefit elections.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; HIPAA; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus pay included in this payroll record. May include study milestone bonuses, retention bonuses, or annual performance awards.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts in this payroll record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The organizational department to which the employee was assigned during this pay period (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs). Supports workforce cost allocation reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: employee_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the employee as recorded in the source system the time of payroll processing. Retained as a point-in-time snapshot for audit and regulatory purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: employer_benefits_contribution
attributes.description: Employer-paid portion of employee benefits costs (health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance) for this pay period. Included in total workforce cost allocation to clinical studies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; HIPAA; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: employer_retirement_contribution
attributes.description: Employer matching or defined contribution to the employee's retirement plan for this pay period (e.g., 401(k) match, pension contribution). Part of total compensation cost for study budget allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 560; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: employer_tax_contribution
attributes.description: Employer-side payroll tax contributions (e.g., employer FICA/Social Security, Medicare, unemployment insurance) associated with this payroll record. Required for total labor cost allocation to clinical studies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's employment arrangement during this pay period. Determines applicable payroll rules, benefit eligibility, and tax treatment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: gross_pay
attributes.description: Total gross compensation earned by the employee for the pay period before any deductions. Equals the sum of all pay components (base salary, overtime, bonus, allowances). Key figure for SOX financial reporting and workforce cost allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404; FLSA

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total regular hours worked by the employee during the pay period as recorded in the source system tracking. Used for hourly pay calculations and study resource utilization reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll record represents a reversal of a previously processed payroll entry. True if this record corrects or voids a prior disbursement. Critical for SOX audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The employee's job title at the time of payroll processing (e.g., Clinical Research Associate, Biostatistician, Data Manager). Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for workforce cost analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: The actual amount disbursed to the employee after all deductions (taxes, benefits, retirement contributions) have been subtracted from gross pay. Represents the take-home pay amount.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: overtime_amount
attributes.description: Total overtime pay earned by the employee during this pay period, calculated per applicable labor law (e.g., FLSA 1.5x rate). Relevant for CRAs and site staff with variable field hours.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period beyond the standard threshold (e.g., >40 hours/week under FLSA). Drives overtime_amount calculation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid within this pay group (e.g., biweekly, monthly). Determines the number of pay periods per year for annualization calculations.

attributes.description: The workforce role of the employee at the time the non-compliance occurred. Captured as a denormalized snapshot to preserve historical accuracy independent of role changes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Workday HCM; GCP Role Definitions

tag_set.value: Employee Role at Time of Non-Compliance

attributes.name: initiation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Initiation Date
attributes.description: The date on which the CAPA was formally initiated and opened in MasterControl. Serves as the principal business event date for SLA and timeline calculations.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Module; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Initiation Date

attributes.name: inspection_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CAPA record and its supporting documentation are complete and ready for regulatory inspection review. Used in inspection readiness dashboards and TMF completeness assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedures; MasterControl

attributes.name: mastercontrol_capa_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: MasterControl Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the MasterControl CAPA module, used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail linkage back to the system of record.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Module; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

tag_set.value: MasterControl Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference

attributes.name: non_compliance_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the non-compliance or performance issue that triggered the CAPA. Used for trend analysis, root cause aggregation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM; MasterControl

attributes.name: non_compliance_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the GCP compliance failure, training non-compliance, or performance issue that prompted the CAPA. Captures the factual account of the event as observed during audit or inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, interim status updates, or supplementary information not captured in structured fields. Supports ALCOA+ documentation principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: preventive_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific preventive actions planned or taken to proactively mitigate the risk of future non-compliance. Populated for preventive and combined CAPA types.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 9001:2015 Section 10.2

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the CAPA to guide resource allocation and escalation. Derived from severity and potential patient safety or regulatory impact, but may be independently set by the CAPA owner.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Module; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100

attributes.name: qa_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the QA reviewer completed their review of the CAPA record and approved or rejected the closure request.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl QA Workflow

attributes.name: qa_review_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the QA review of the CAPA closure package. Rejected or returned records require additional action before closure can be granted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CAPA record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this CAPA record in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA was initiated for a recurring non-compliance issue previously addressed by a prior CAPA for the same employee. Recurrence triggers escalated management review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority notified or implicated in the non-compliance event, if applicable. Relevant for multi-regional studies where different authorities have jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedures; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relevant regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) was notified of the non-compliance event associated with this CAPA. Required for critical GCP violations under applicable regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA GCP Inspection Procedures; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorized root cause of the non-compliance as determined during CAPA investigation. Supports systemic trend analysis and preventive action planning across the workforce.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 9001:2015 Section 10.2; MasterControl

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the identified root cause of the non-compliance or performance issue, as documented by the CAPA owner following investigation. Required for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the non-compliance event driving the CAPA. Critical and major findings typically require expedited closure timelines and may trigger regulatory notification obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedures; MasterControl

attributes.name: workday_worker_code
attributes.description: The the source system identifier for the employee who is the subject of the CAPA. Enables HR system cross-referencing for performance management and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: delegation_authority_level
attributes.description: The regulatory delegation scope granted to this employee for this specific clinical program. Delegation authority is program-specific and role-specific — the same employee may have different delegation levels across different programs.

attributes.name: fte_allocation_percentage

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_expertise

attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

products.name: training_course
products.description: Master reference table for training_course. Referenced by training_course_id.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Primary key for training_course

attributes.name: prerequisite_training_course_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on training_course (prerequisite_training_course_id)

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: training_curriculum_id
attributes.description: add column training_curriculum_id (BIGINT) with FK to workforce.training_curriculum.training_curriculum_id — courses belong to curricula

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: External organization that accredits or certifies this training course (e.g., TransCelerate, ACRP, SoCRA, BARQA).

attributes.name: accreditation_number
attributes.description: Official accreditation or approval reference number assigned by the accrediting body for this course.

attributes.name: applicable_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or jurisdiction for which this training is applicable or required (e.g., USA, EU, JPN, global). Supports multi-region compliance tracking.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current version of the training course received formal approval for deployment.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quality assurance or compliance officer who approved the current version of this training course for use.

attributes.name: assessment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal assessment or examination is required for course completion, as opposed to attendance-only completion.

attributes.name: available_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 language codes for all available translations of this training course.

attributes.name: competency_level
attributes.description: The proficiency level that the course is designed to develop, used for career development pathways and role qualification matrices.

attributes.name: content_owner_department
attributes.description: The internal department or functional group responsible for maintaining and updating the course content (e.g., Quality Assurance, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs).

attributes.name: cost_per_participant
attributes.description: Standard cost per participant for the training course, used for budgeting and resource allocation planning.

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code used to identify the training course across systems, catalogs, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: course_type
attributes.description: Classification of the training course by subject matter category. Distinguishes Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training from Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), regulatory, therapeutic area, technical skills, and safety training.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training course record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_units
attributes.description: Number of continuing education (CE) or continuing professional development (CPD) credit units awarded upon successful completion.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_per_participant amount.

attributes.name: delegation_log_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of this course is a prerequisite for being listed on a study delegation log per GCP requirements.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The modality through which the training course is delivered to participants.

attributes.name: training_course_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the course content, learning objectives, and scope.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total estimated duration of the training course measured in hours, used for capacity planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the training course becomes effective and available for enrollment.

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course satisfies Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training requirements per ICH E6(R2) guidelines.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (with optional ISO 3166-1 region) indicating the primary language in which the course is delivered.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the course content was last reviewed for accuracy, regulatory alignment, and relevance by the content owner.

attributes.name: lms_course_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this course within the organization's Learning Management System (LMS), enabling system integration and completion tracking.

attributes.name: max_enrollment_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of participants allowed per session for instructor-led or blended courses. Null for self-paced e-learning.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic content review to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance and content accuracy.

attributes.name: passing_score_percent
attributes.description: Minimum assessment score percentage required to successfully complete the course and receive certification credit.

attributes.name: prerequisite_course_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of training_course_id values that must be completed before enrolling in this course. Null if no prerequisites exist.

attributes.name: recertification_interval_months
attributes.description: Number of months after which the training certification expires and recertification is required. Null if no recertification is needed.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training course is mandated by a regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH) as a prerequisite for clinical trial participation.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which this training course version is retired and no longer available for new enrollments. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: training_course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the training course indicating whether it is available for enrollment, under development, or no longer offered.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Primary workforce role for which this training course is designed. Clinical Research Associates (CRA), Clinical Research Coordinators (CRC), biostatisticians, data managers, medical monitors, or regulatory specialists.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area or disease domain to which the training course content is specific (e.g., oncology, cardiology, neurology). Null if the course is general/cross-therapeutic.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the training course as displayed in the learning management system and training records.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training course record was last modified.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external training vendor or provider if the course is sourced externally rather than developed in-house.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the course content, incremented when material is updated to reflect regulatory changes or content improvements.

domains.name: program
domains.description: Manages clinical development programs spanning multiple studies for a therapeutic indication or pipeline asset. Owns program-level planning, portfolio governance, milestone tracking, and cross-study coordination.

products.name: clinical_program
products.description: Top-level master entity representing a clinical development program — a strategic grouping of one or more clinical studies targeting a specific therapeutic indication or pipeline asset.

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the clinical development program. Primary key for the clinical_program entity across the enterprise data platform.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: indication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.indication. Business justification: clinical_program carries disease_indication (STRING) and indication_meddra_code (STRING) as denormalized text fields.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that owns and funds this clinical development program. Links to the sponsor master entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.50

attributes.name: parent_clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on clinical_program (parent_clinical_program_id)

attributes.name: pipeline_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.pipeline_asset. Business justification: Every clinical program is built around a specific pipeline asset. This is a fundamental drug development relationship.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.therapeutic_area. Business justification: clinical_program.therapeutic_area is a free-text STRING denormalization of the therapeutic_area reference master that exists in this domain.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the clinical development program was completed or terminated. Populated upon program closure; null for active programs. Used for variance analysis against projected end date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA IND Closure; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation (BTD) to the investigational product under this program. BTD expedites development and review of drugs for serious conditions. True = designation granted.
attributes.references: FDA FDASIA Section 902; 21 CFR Part 312.82; PDUFA

attributes.name: budget_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the program budget (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and the source system
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: the source system center code to which program expenditures are allocated for financial reporting and GL accounting. Enables program-level cost tracking and budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL/CO; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the clinical program record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: clinical_program_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the clinical development program's scientific rationale, strategic objectives, and key development hypotheses. Used in portfolio governance documents, regulatory strategy briefs, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault Program Record; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: development_phase
attributes.description: Current or primary clinical development phase of the program per ICH E8 classification (Phase I through Phase IV). Drives regulatory strategy, resource planning, and portfolio governance decisions.
attributes.value_regex: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase II/III|Phase III|Phase IV
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials

attributes.name: dsmb_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) is required for this clinical development program based on risk profile, study design, or regulatory requirements. True = DSMB/DMC required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on DMC; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Required Flag

attributes.name: fast_track_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Fast Track Designation to the investigational product under this program, facilitating development and expediting review for serious conditions with unmet medical need. True = designation granted.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.82; FDAMA Section 112; PDUFA

attributes.name: global_study_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual clinical studies (trials) planned or active under this clinical development program. Provides a program-level scope indicator for portfolio governance and resource planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); WHO ICTRP

attributes.name: modality
attributes.description: Scientific modality or drug class of the investigational product (e.g., Small Molecule, Biologic, Cell Therapy, Gene Therapy). Determines applicable regulatory guidelines, manufacturing requirements, and safety monitoring frameworks.
attributes.references: FDA CDER/CBER; EMA; ICH Q8/Q9/Q10; ICH S6(R1)

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigational product has received Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) from FDA or EMA for a rare disease indication under this program. Confers market exclusivity and development incentives. True = designation granted.
attributes.references: FDA Orphan Drug Act 21 CFR Part 316; EMA Regulation (EC) No 141/2000; OOPD

attributes.name: pediatric_investigation_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pediatric Investigation Plan (PIP) has been agreed with EMA or a Pediatric Study Plan (PSP) with FDA for this program. Required for most new medicinal products under EU Pediatric Regulation and FDA PREA.
attributes.references: EU Pediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006; FDA PREA; ICH E11(R1)

attributes.name: portfolio_priority
attributes.description: Strategic priority ranking of the clinical development program within the sponsor's pipeline portfolio. Used for resource allocation, investment decisions, and executive portfolio governance reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Project Portfolio Management

attributes.name: prime_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EMA has granted PRIority MEdicines (PRIME) designation to the investigational product under this program, providing enhanced support for development of medicines that target unmet medical needs. True = designation granted.
attributes.references: EMA PRIME Scheme; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA Guideline

attributes.name: program_budget
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated to the clinical development program across all studies and activities, expressed in the program's base currency. Used for financial governance, variance tracking, and portfolio investment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Financial Controls; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the clinical development program across all internal systems (CTMS, eTMF, EDC). Serves as the externally-known business identifier referenced in regulatory submissions and cross-system integrations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the clinical development program (e.g., 'XYZ-001 Oncology Phase II/III Program'). Used in portfolio governance dashboards, regulatory strategy documents, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS Program Object

attributes.name: program_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or working title for the clinical development program used in internal communications, reports, and dashboards where space is limited.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Veeva Vault Program Record

attributes.name: program_start_date
attributes.description: Official start date of the clinical development program, typically aligned with first IND/CTA filing or first-in-human study initiation. Used for program duration tracking and portfolio milestone reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: program_status

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS Program Status; FDA IND Annual Report

attributes.name: program_type

attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; EMA PRIME; ICH E11; Orphan Drug Regulation (EC) No 141/2000

attributes.name: projected_end_date
attributes.description: Anticipated completion date for the entire clinical development program, encompassing all studies through regulatory submission. Used for portfolio planning, resource forecasting, and milestone tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: record_version

attributes.name: regulatory_strategy_summary
