attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: operating_procedures_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) or working procedures that govern the governance body's operations, meeting conduct, and decision-making processes. Links to MasterControl SOP repository.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 2.13; MasterControl; FDA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: program_phase
attributes.description: Clinical development phase(s) covered by the program under this governance body's oversight. Indicates the stage of drug development being governed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase II/III|Phase III|Phase IV|Pre-Clinical — 7
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trial Phases Guidance

attributes.name: quorum_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of total voting membership required for quorum, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 66.67 for two-thirds majority). Used when quorum is defined proportionally rather than by fixed count.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006)

attributes.name: quorum_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum number of voting members required to be present for a governance body meeting to be considered valid and decisions to be binding, as specified in the charter.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006)

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the governance body's decisions or recommendations are subject to regulatory reporting obligations (e.g., DMC recommendations that trigger IND safety reports or protocol amendments).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: Frequency in months at which the governance body charter and membership composition are formally reviewed and reaffirmed or updated. Typically 12 or 24 months per GCP best practices.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Document Control; FDA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: sponsor_co_chair
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the sponsor organization's designated co-chair for the governance body. Typically a senior sponsor representative in Joint Development Committee structures.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Sponsor-CRO Relationships

attributes.name: sponsor_organization
attributes.description: The sponsor organization responsible for this governance body.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5; 21 CFR Part 312.50; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 2

attributes.name: governance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the governance body, indicating whether it is actively operating, temporarily suspended, or formally dissolved.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area or disease indication that the clinical development program and its governance body oversee (e.g., Oncology, Cardiovascular, Neurology, Immunology). Aligns with MedDRA System Organ Class taxonomy.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH E6(R2); FDA CDER Therapeutic Area Guidance

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier of the governance body within the program's governance framework. Strategic bodies set direction and approve major decisions; Operational bodies manage execution; Tactical bodies handle day-to-day coordination.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Sponsor-CRO Relationships; Industry GCP Best Practices

attributes.name: total_member_count
attributes.description: Total number of members constituting the governance body, including voting and non-voting members, as defined in the charter. Used for quorum calculation and composition reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this governance body record. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: voting_member_count
attributes.description: Number of members with formal voting rights within the governance body. Distinct from total membership which may include non-voting observers or advisors.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006)

products.name: governance_meeting
products.description: Transactional record for each formal program governance meeting held by a program oversight committee. Captures meeting date, meeting type (scheduled, ad hoc, emergency), agenda topics, attendees, quorum achieved flag, key decisions made, action items

attributes.name: governance_meeting_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each program governance meeting record in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: chair_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Governance meeting chairs are named employees accountable for quorum, decision authority, and minutes approval. Regulatory inspections require traceable meeting governance.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical development program under whose governance structure this meeting was convened.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8

attributes.name: governance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program oversight committee (e.g., Program Review Board, Joint Steering Committee, Data Monitoring Committee) that convened this meeting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees

attributes.name: organization_contact_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sponsor Chair Sponsor Contact Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.sponsor_contact. Business justification: Governance meetings have a sponsor co-chair who is a specific sponsor contact. governance_meeting has chair_name as a denormalized plain text field.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

tag_set.value: Sponsor Chair Sponsor Contact Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: primary_prior_meeting_governance_meeting_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding governance meeting in the same committee series. Enables meeting chain linkage for action item carry-forward tracking and minutes continuity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Governance meeting minutes are TMF-essential documents (DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 1).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: action_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of action items raised during the governance meeting. Supports tracking of follow-up obligations and governance accountability metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: agenda_distributed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meeting agenda was formally distributed to attendees. Regulatory and governance best practice requires agenda distribution within a defined period before the meeting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: agenda_topics
attributes.description: Structured summary or pipe-delimited list of the principal agenda items discussed at the meeting (e.g., 'Study Progress Review | Safety Data Review | Enrollment Update | Budget Review'). Supports meeting content search and analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: agenda_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the final agenda document circulated prior to the meeting (e.g., v1.0, v2.1). Supports document control and traceability to the eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of individuals who attended the governance meeting, including voting members, non-voting observers, and invited guests. Used for quorum verification and minutes accuracy.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: chair_role
attributes.description: Organizational role or title of the meeting chair (e.g., 'Chief Medical Officer', 'Program Director', 'Independent Committee Chair'). Provides governance accountability context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Confidentiality classification of the meeting and its outputs: open (no restrictions), restricted (internal program team only), closed (voting members only, e.g., DSMB closed session), strictly_confidential (blinded safety data, regulatory-sensitive).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; GDPR; HIPAA; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this governance meeting record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: decision_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal decisions recorded during the governance meeting. Used for governance KPI reporting and meeting productivity analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the governance meeting concluded. Used to calculate meeting duration and for minutes accuracy.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: escalation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the issue or decision requiring escalation to a higher governance body. Populated only when escalation_required is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether any decision or issue arising from this meeting requires escalation to a higher governance body (e.g., Executive Steering Committee, Sponsor). True = escalation triggered; False = no escalation required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8; FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees

attributes.name: key_decisions
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the principal decisions made during the governance meeting (e.g., protocol amendment approval, site expansion authorization, budget reallocation). Extracted from approved minutes for analytics and reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical venue or virtual platform where the meeting was held (e.g., 'Conference Room A, Boston HQ' or 'Microsoft Teams'). Recorded in minutes for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: meeting_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the governance meeting was held or is scheduled to be held. Principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: meeting_format
attributes.description: Modality of the meeting: in_person (all attendees physically co-located), virtual (all attendees remote via teleconference/videoconference), or hybrid (mix of in-person and remote attendees).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: meeting_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which this type of governance meeting is regularly convened as defined in the committee charter. Used for scheduling compliance monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|as_needed — 7 candidates
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees

attributes.name: meeting_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential or structured identifier for the meeting (e.g., PRG-GOV-2024-007). Used as the business-facing reference in agendas, minutes, and action item logs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: meeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the governance meeting record. Drives workflow routing for agenda preparation, minutes approval, and action item follow-up.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS meeting lifecycle

attributes.name: meeting_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the governance meeting as it appears on the agenda and minutes document (e.g., 'Q3 2024 Program Review Board Meeting – PROG-001').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF document naming conventions

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meeting by its scheduling basis: scheduled (routine calendar meeting), ad_hoc (convened outside the regular schedule), emergency (convened urgently for a safety or critical operational issue), or extraordinary (special purpose
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: minutes_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meeting minutes were formally approved by the committee chair or designated approver. Required for regulatory audit trail and eTMF completeness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: minutes_approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who formally approved the meeting minutes. Supports ALCOA+ compliance (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) for regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: minutes_status
attributes.description: Current approval lifecycle state of the meeting minutes document: draft (initial preparation), under_review (circulated for comment), approved (formally signed off by chair), final (distributed to all attendees), archived (filed in eTMF).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: next_meeting_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of the next governance meeting as agreed at the close of this meeting. Supports forward planning and governance calendar management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: open_action_items_from_prior
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Action Items Carried Forward Count
attributes.description: Number of action items from previous governance meetings that remained open and were reviewed at this meeting. Key governance health indicator.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8

tag_set.value: Open Action Items Carried Forward Count

attributes.name: quorum_achieved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required quorum of voting members was present at the meeting, making decisions and resolutions formally binding. True = quorum met; False = quorum not met.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: quorum_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of voting members required to be present for the meeting to be quorate and for decisions to be binding, as defined in the committee charter.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_implication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any decision or discussion item from this meeting has a direct regulatory implication (e.g., protocol amendment requiring IND/CTA update, safety signal requiring expedited reporting). True = regulatory action may be required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA; FDA

attributes.name: safety_topic_discussed
attributes.description: Indicates whether any safety-related topic (e.g., SAE review, SUSAR assessment, DSMB recommendation, risk-benefit evaluation) was discussed during the meeting. Supports safety governance audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting (or a portion thereof) was conducted as an open session (all attendees), closed session (voting members only, e.g., for unblinded safety review), or executive session (senior leadership only).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the governance meeting commenced. Used for quorum determination and minutes accuracy.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: Reference to the TMF zone and section under which the meeting minutes and agenda are filed in the eTMF (e.g., 'Zone 1 / Section 1.3 – Governance'). Supports eTMF completeness and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault eTMF; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this governance meeting record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: voting_member_count
attributes.description: Number of voting committee members who were present at the meeting. Used to confirm quorum achievement and validate the binding nature of decisions made.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees

products.name: decision
products.description: Transactional record capturing formal go/no-go and key strategic decisions made at the program level, including portfolio investment decisions, phase transition approvals, and program termination decisions.

attributes.name: decision_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each formal program-level decision record in the clinical development portfolio.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: Go/no-go program decisions (e.g., proceed to NDA filing, terminate program) are made in the context of specific regulatory applications.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical development program against which this decision was made.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA IND/NDA regulations

attributes.name: dsmb_meeting_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.dsmb_meeting. Business justification: Program go/no-go decisions are directly triggered by DSMB meeting recommendations (program_decision.dsmb_recommendation is a text field).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: governance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governance body or committee (e.g., Portfolio Review Board, Executive Committee, DSMB/DMC) that issued this decision.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: governance_meeting_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.governance_meeting. Business justification: program_decision.meeting_reference is a STRING field that informally references the governance meeting at which the decision was made.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: interim_analysis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.interim_analysis. Business justification: Program decisions to stop, continue, or adapt a program are driven by interim analysis outcomes.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: maker_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Go/no-go decisions on clinical programs must be traceable to named employees for regulatory submissions and governance audit trails.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.sponsor_contact. Business justification: Program decisions require sponsor concurrence (sponsor_concurrence_flag and sponsor_concurrence_date already exist).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_decision_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the subsequent program_decision record that replaced or superseded this decision. Null if this decision is current and active. Enables decision lineage and version chain traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault document versioning

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_assessment. Business justification: Program go/no-go decisions (phase transitions, terminations) are formally supported by GCP risk assessments.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: signal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_signal. Business justification: Program go/no-go decisions and phase transitions are frequently triggered by safety signals. program_decision has safety_signal_flag (boolean) but no FK to the specific signal.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.study_budget. Business justification: Go/no-go program decisions directly impact study budgets — a go decision releases budget, a no-go freezes or terminates it.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Program go/no-go decisions and phase transition decisions are TMF-filed documents per ICH E6 GCP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: action_items_summary
attributes.description: Summary of follow-up action items, next steps, or deliverables assigned as a result of this decision (e.g., protocol amendment required, regulatory submission to be filed, additional safety data to be collected). Supports program execution tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl CAPA tracking

attributes.name: authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the governance body, committee, or executive role that holds formal authority for this decision (e.g., 'Portfolio Review Committee', 'Chief Medical Officer', 'Executive Leadership Team').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: benefit_risk_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the benefit-risk profile that informed this decision, weighing therapeutic benefits against potential risks.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA PDUFA benefit-risk framework; EMA benefit-risk methodology

attributes.name: conditions_of_approval
attributes.description: Conditions or requirements attached to the approval decision, including any post-approval commitments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA conditional marketing authorization guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this program decision record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the formal decision was officially made and ratified by the decision authority. This is the principal real-world event date for the decision record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: dissenting_opinion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any member of the decision-making body formally recorded a dissenting opinion against the decision outcome. True if a dissent was registered. Supports governance transparency and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; corporate governance best practices

attributes.name: dissenting_opinion_summary
attributes.description: Summary of any dissenting opinions expressed during the decision-making process.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; corporate governance best practices

attributes.name: dsmb_recommendation
attributes.description: The formal recommendation issued by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) that informed this decision, where applicable. Values: continue, modify, pause, terminate, not_applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA guidance on DMCs; DSMB charter (biostatistics.dsmb_charter)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the decision becomes operationally binding and program activities must align with the decision outcome. May differ from decision_date if a transition period is granted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: Specific disease or medical condition targeted by the program at the time of this decision (e.g., Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Type 2 Diabetes). Supports indication-level portfolio governance and regulatory strategy tracking.
attributes.references: MedDRA; WHO ICD-11; FDA IND/NDA indication labeling

attributes.name: investment_amount
attributes.description: The approved or committed financial investment amount associated with this decision (e.g., budget approved for next phase, termination cost). Expressed in the program's base currency. Business-confidential financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA project accounting; SOX financial reporting controls

attributes.name: investment_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the investment_amount field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency portfolio financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA; SOX financial reporting controls

attributes.name: maker_role
attributes.description: Organizational role or title of the individual who made or ratified the decision (e.g., 'Chief Medical Officer', 'VP Clinical Development', 'Program Steering Committee Chair'). Supports governance accountability reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; Workday HCM job profile

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number assigned to this program decision record, used in governance minutes, regulatory dossiers, and TMF cross-references.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF document numbering conventions

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The formal result of the governance decision: approved (proceed), rejected (do not proceed), deferred (postponed pending additional data), conditional_approval (proceed with conditions), or withdrawn (decision request retracted prior to vote).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: phase_from
attributes.description: The clinical development phase the program was in at the time of the decision (the originating phase). Relevant for phase transition decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA clinical development guidance

attributes.name: phase_to
attributes.description: The target clinical development phase the program is transitioning into as a result of this decision. Null if the decision is not a phase transition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA clinical development guidance

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: Rationale and justification for the decision, including supporting evidence and reasoning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: regulatory_agency_consulted
attributes.description: Name(s) of regulatory agencies (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA) that were formally consulted (e.g., via Type B meeting, scientific advice) prior to or as part of this decision. Supports regulatory strategy documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA scientific advice procedures; ICH E6(R2); PMDA consultation guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the regulatory submission consequence of this decision (e.g., requires IND amendment, impacts NDA/BLA filing strategy, triggers MAA update, requires eCTD update, or no regulatory submission impact).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); FDA 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); EMA MAA guidance; ICH CTD/eCTD

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which a deferred or conditional decision must be reviewed or re-evaluated based on new data or milestone achievement. Supports governance calendar management and escalation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS milestone tracking

attributes.name: risk_assessment_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the risk assessment that informed this decision, including identified risks and mitigation strategies.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl risk assessment

attributes.name: safety_signal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety signal, serious adverse event (SAE), or suspected unexpected serious adverse reaction (SUSAR) was a contributing factor in this decision. True if safety data influenced the decision outcome.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA pharmacovigilance guidelines; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Veeva Vault document ID, the source system record ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; Databricks Delta Lake lineage

attributes.name: sponsor_concurrence_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor formally concurred with or ratified this program decision. Null if sponsor_concurrence_flag is False or not applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CRO-sponsor agreement terms; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: sponsor_concurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor formally concurred with this program decision. True if sponsor sign-off was obtained. Relevant for CRO-managed programs where sponsor approval is a governance requirement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CRO-sponsor agreement terms; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: decision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the decision record within the governance workflow: draft (being prepared), pending_review (submitted for ratification), ratified (formally approved and binding), superseded (replaced by a subsequent decision), or voided
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl document lifecycle

attributes.name: supporting_data_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the supporting data and evidence that informed this decision.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E9(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; SAP/interim analysis outputs from SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area or disease indication relevant to this decision (e.g., Oncology, Cardiovascular, Neurology, Immunology). Enables portfolio-level analytics by therapeutic domain.
attributes.references: MedDRA; WHO ICD-11; FDA therapeutic area classifications

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarizing the decision (e.g., 'Phase II Go Decision for PROG-001 in Oncology'). Used in governance dashboards, TMF indexing, and regulatory dossier tables of contents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: decision_type
attributes.description: Classification of the strategic decision category. Captures the nature of the governance action: go/no-go milestone, phase transition approval (e.g., Phase I to Phase II), indication expansion, program termination, regulatory strategy pivot, or portfolio
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA IND/NDA/BLA regulations; EMA guidance on clinical development

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: baseline_end_date

attributes.name: baseline_start_date

attributes.name: timeline_code

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, notes, or clarifications regarding the program timeline status, assumptions, or constraints not captured in structured fields. Supports governance review documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this program timeline record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance requirements.

attributes.name: critical_path_driver
attributes.description: The primary activity, milestone, or dependency currently driving the critical path (e.g., 'Last Patient Last Visit', 'Regulatory Submission', 'Database Lock'). Used for targeted risk mitigation and escalation.

attributes.name: critical_path_summary
attributes.description: Narrative or structured summary identifying the critical path activities and milestones that determine the program's minimum duration. Highlights the sequence of dependent tasks with zero float that drive the forecast end date.

attributes.name: csr_target_date
attributes.description: The target date for completion of the Clinical Study Report (CSR) for the program's pivotal study or integrated summary. Required for regulatory submission planning per ICH E3 guidelines.

attributes.name: forecast_end_date
attributes.description: The current forecast completion date for the program, updated based on rolling re-projections from study-level timelines, enrollment rates, and regulatory milestones. Key input to portfolio governance and submission planning.

attributes.name: forecast_start_date
attributes.description: The current forecast start date for the program, reflecting the latest re-planning based on actual progress, site performance, and enrollment data. May differ from baseline if program initiation was delayed.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: governance_review_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which this program timeline is reviewed by the program governance committee or sponsor. Determines the expected update frequency for forecast dates and status fields.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SOX

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The specific disease or condition being studied within the program (e.g., 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer', 'Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus'). Aligns with MedDRA coding and regulatory submission labeling.
attributes.references: MedDRA; FDA IND Regulations 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this record represents the currently active and operative program timeline version. Exactly one record per program should have this set to True at any point in time.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the program timeline record was most recently updated, reflecting the latest forecast refresh or status change. Used for data currency monitoring in portfolio dashboards.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: milestone_count_at_risk
attributes.description: Number of program-level milestones currently flagged as at-risk of missing their forecast date. Key input to program risk dashboards and DSMB/DMC reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); DSMB Charter

attributes.name: milestone_count_completed
attributes.description: Number of program-level milestones that have been achieved as of the last timeline update. Used to calculate program completion percentage and track progress against the baseline.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: milestone_count_total
attributes.description: Total number of program-level milestones tracked within this timeline version. Provides a structural summary of timeline complexity for governance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: timeline_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the program timeline (e.g., 'Phase II/III Integrated Development Timeline v2'), used in governance reports and portfolio dashboards.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: next_governance_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date of the next program governance committee review at which this timeline will be assessed and potentially updated. Drives workflow notifications and reporting preparation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: program_phase
attributes.description: The clinical development phase(s) covered by this program timeline (e.g., Phase II/III). Determines regulatory requirements, timeline complexity, and governance oversight level.

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E8(R1); EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_target_date
attributes.description: The target date for the primary regulatory submission (NDA/BLA/MAA) derived from this program timeline. Critical milestone for sponsor portfolio planning and regulatory agency interactions.
attributes.references: FDA NDA/BLA 21 CFR Part 314/601; EMA MAA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH CTD/eCTD

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for why this timeline version was created or revised (e.g., 'Protocol amendment impact', 'Enrollment rate below target', 'Regulatory feedback on IND'). Required for governance accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk classification for the program timeline, reflecting the likelihood and impact of schedule delays based on current program status, enrollment performance, and regulatory interactions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; ISO 14971 Risk Management

attributes.name: risk_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the primary schedule risks and mitigation strategies for the program timeline, as assessed at the last governance review. Supports DSMB/DMC reporting and sponsor escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; ISO 14971

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: The numeric difference in calendar days between the current forecast end date and the approved baseline end date. Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate ahead-of-schedule performance. Core KPI for program governance.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); PMI PMBOK Schedule Management

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this timeline record in the originating operational system (e.g., the source system internal ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: timeline_status
attributes.description: Current schedule health status of the program timeline, indicating whether the program is on-track, at-risk of delay, actively delayed, completed, or cancelled. Used in portfolio governance reporting and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_count
attributes.description: Number of individual clinical studies (trials) included within this program timeline. Reflects the scope of the integrated development program.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area or disease indication that the clinical development program targets (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology). Used for portfolio segmentation and resource allocation.
attributes.references: MedDRA; WHO ICD-11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: timeline_type
attributes.description: Classification of the timeline record indicating whether it represents the approved baseline, current forecast, a scenario plan, or an archived historical version.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this program timeline record was most recently modified. Enables change detection, incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this timeline record (e.g., v1.0, v2.3), enabling tracking of successive baseline revisions and forecast updates over the program lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: version_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this timeline version became the operative schedule for the program. Enables point-in-time reconstruction of the program schedule for regulatory submissions and audits.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: version_superseded_date
attributes.description: The date on which this timeline version was superseded by a newer version. Null for the currently active version. Supports historical timeline reconstruction and version chain integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: timeline_event
products.description: Transactional record for individual scheduled events and deliverables within a program timeline. Captures event name, event type (study start, database lock, regulatory submission, advisory committee meeting, approval decision, program review), planned

attributes.name: timeline_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each timeline event record within a clinical development program. Primary key for the timeline_event data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical development program to which this timeline event belongs. Links the event to its parent program for portfolio-level schedule tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: interim_analysis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.interim_analysis. Business justification: Interim analyses are explicitly scheduled as critical-path timeline events in program planning (data cut date, IA results readout).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_predecessor_event_timeline_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the immediately preceding timeline event that must be completed before this event can begin. Supports critical path management and dependency chain analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: program_development_milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.program_milestone. Business justification: timeline_event has a milestone_flag (BOOLEAN) indicating when an event corresponds to a formal program milestone.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific clinical study associated with this timeline event, where the event is study-scoped rather than program-wide. Nullable for program-level events not tied to a single study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: timeline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.program_timeline. Business justification: timeline_event is a transactional child record representing individual scheduled events within a program timeline.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Defined criteria that must be met for this timeline event to be formally marked as completed. Ensures objective, auditable completion standards aligned with GCP and sponsor requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: The confirmed date on which this timeline event was completed or occurred. Populated only upon event completion. Used to calculate schedule variance against the planned baseline.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the program governance authority who approved this timeline event. Supports electronic signature audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this timeline event was formally approved by the program governance board. Populated when approved_flag is True. Supports audit trail and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timeline event and its associated dates have been formally approved by the program governance board (True) or are still pending approval (False). Supports governance workflow controls.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current schedule baseline version was approved and locked. Used to track re-baselining history and assess cumulative schedule drift across program lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: baseline_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the program schedule baseline against which this event's planned date is measured (e.g., BL-01, BL-02). Supports baseline comparison and re-baselining audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for program team notes, status updates, or contextual remarks related to this timeline event. Supports program review discussions and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: The estimated percentage of work completed for this timeline event, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Updated during program review cycles to reflect in-progress event progress.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timeline event record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event lies on the critical path of the program schedule (True). Critical path events directly impact the overall program completion date and receive heightened monitoring priority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the root cause of a schedule delay when schedule_variance_days is positive. Supports CAPA tracking and program risk reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: delay_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the delay reason code, capturing specific circumstances contributing to the schedule variance. Supports root cause analysis and lessons learned.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: dependency_type
attributes.description: The logical dependency relationship between this event and its predecessor event, following standard project scheduling conventions (Finish-to-Start, Start-to-Start, Finish-to-Finish, Start-to-Finish). Used in critical path network construction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: The planned number of calendar days allocated for the completion of this timeline event, from start to finish. Used in resource planning and Gantt chart construction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: early_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest possible date this event can begin based on predecessor completion and resource availability, as calculated in the critical path network. Used for schedule optimization and float analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: event_category
attributes.description: High-level functional category grouping the event for portfolio analytics and cross-domain reporting. Enables filtering by clinical, regulatory, safety, biostatistics, data management, or operational workstreams.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the timeline event, used in program plans, Gantt charts, and regulatory submissions. Follows the EVT- prefix convention in the source system
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the timeline event, including scope, acceptance criteria, and any special conditions. Provides context for program team members and governance reviewers.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the timeline event (e.g., 'First Patient First Visit', 'Database Lock', 'NDA Submission', 'Advisory Committee Meeting'). Used in program dashboards and milestone reports.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the timeline event reflecting its execution progress. Drives program schedule performance dashboards and escalation workflows. Values: planned, in_progress, completed, delayed, cancelled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ISO 14155

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the timeline event indicating its business nature. Drives reporting groupings and critical path logic. Values: study_start, database_lock, regulatory_submission, advisory_committee_meeting, approval_decision, program_review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: float_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days by which this event can be delayed without impacting the program critical path. Zero float indicates a critical path event. Supports proactive schedule risk management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: The current best-estimate date on which this timeline event is expected to occur, updated as program conditions evolve. Reflects the most recent schedule projection used in program review meetings.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: lag_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days of lag or lead time applied to the dependency relationship with the predecessor event. Positive values indicate a waiting period after predecessor completion; negative values indicate overlap.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: late_finish_date
attributes.description: The latest date by which this event must be completed without delaying the overall program end date. Used in critical path analysis to determine schedule float and prioritize risk mitigation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: milestone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timeline event is designated as a key program milestone (True) versus a routine scheduled deliverable (False). Milestone events are tracked at the executive and sponsor governance level.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team lead responsible for ensuring this timeline event is completed on schedule. Used in program status reports and escalation communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: The originally baselined date on which this timeline event was scheduled to occur, as defined in the approved program plan. Serves as the baseline reference for schedule variance calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ISO 14155

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this timeline event reflecting its strategic importance to the program. Used to triage resource allocation and escalation decisions during program reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: The regulatory authority to which a submission or approval decision event is directed (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada). Nullable for non-regulatory events.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA; MHRA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_type
attributes.description: For events of type regulatory_submission, specifies the submission dossier type (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD). Nullable for non-regulatory event types. Aligns with FDA, EMA, PMDA submission classifications.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH CTD; PMDA

attributes.name: responsible_role
attributes.description: The functional role or organizational unit accountable for delivering this timeline event (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management). Used for workload planning and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed risk level for this timeline event based on schedule sensitivity, predecessor dependencies, and program impact. Drives escalation thresholds and program governance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 14971; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: The difference in calendar days between the actual (or forecast) date and the planned baseline date. Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate early completion. Key KPI for program schedule performance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: source_event_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this timeline event in the originating operational system (e.g., Siebel CTMS milestone ID, the source system event ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timeline event record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data currency validation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: risk

attributes.name: risk_id

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 14971 Risk Management

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical development program to which this risk belongs, enabling portfolio-level risk aggregation and governance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8(R1)

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: parent_risk_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on risk (parent_risk_id)

attributes.name: primary_risk_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce member (typically a Program Director, Clinical Lead, or Regulatory Affairs Lead) accountable for monitoring and managing this risk to resolution. Aligns with RACI accountability frameworks in GCP-compliant program governance.

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk was actually resolved (mitigated, closed, or accepted). Null if the risk remains open. Used for cycle time analysis and governance performance reporting.

attributes.name: affected_studies

attributes.name: capa_reference

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the risk domain: scientific (e.g., efficacy uncertainty), regulatory (e.g., IND/NDA/BLA/MAA submission risk), operational (e.g., site activation delays), competitive (e.g., competitor trial results), financial (e.g., budget
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: contingency_plan

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nature of the risk, its potential cause, and the business context in which it was identified. Supports risk review meetings, DSMB/DMC briefings, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: escalation_date

attributes.name: escalation_required

attributes.name: escalation_target

attributes.name: financial_exposure_usd

attributes.name: identified_date
