attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known unique code assigned to this risk record within the program risk register (e.g., PRSK-ONC-000123). Used in governance reports, DSMB/DMC submissions, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 14971; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the severity of consequences if the risk materializes, considering impact on program timeline, patient safety, regulatory approval, and financial outcomes.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric value corresponding to the impact rating (e.g., 1=very low, 2=low, 3=medium, 4=high, 5=very high). Combined with probability_score to compute the composite risk score.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk was most recently reviewed and assessed by the risk owner or program governance committee. Supports overdue review identification and governance compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH Q9; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: Current implementation status of the mitigation strategy: not_started, in_progress, completed, or on_hold. Enables tracking of mitigation execution progress separate from the overall risk status.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Detailed description of the planned or implemented actions to reduce the probability or impact of the risk (e.g., 'Engage additional regulatory consultant for IND submission review', 'Activate backup sites to offset enrollment shortfall').
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ISO 14971

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next formal review of this risk. Drives automated review reminders and governance calendar scheduling. Frequency is typically determined by risk priority (e.g., critical risks reviewed monthly).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH Q9

attributes.name: patient_safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk has a direct or potential impact on patient safety, including SAE/SUSAR reporting obligations, DSMB/DMC review triggers, or clinical hold risk. Ensures safety risks receive mandatory expedited review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Derived priority classification based on the risk score (e.g., critical: score 20–25, high: 12–19, medium: 6–11, low: 1–5). Used to drive escalation workflows, governance review frequency, and resource allocation decisions.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971

attributes.name: probability_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative likelihood rating that the risk event will materialize during the program lifecycle. Typically assessed on a 5-point scale (very low to very high) per the program's risk management framework. Used in risk scoring and prioritization.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; ISO 14971; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: probability_score
attributes.description: Numeric value corresponding to the probability rating (e.g., 1=very low, 2=low, 3=medium, 4=high, 5=very high). Used in quantitative risk score calculation and portfolio-level risk heat map generation.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk has a direct potential impact on regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD) or regulatory agency interactions (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada). Drives regulatory affairs team notification workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: residual_impact_rating
attributes.description: Reassessed impact rating after mitigation controls have been applied. Used alongside residual_probability_rating to compute the residual risk score and confirm risk acceptability.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971

attributes.name: residual_probability_rating
attributes.description: Reassessed probability rating after mitigation controls have been applied. Compared against the initial probability_rating to demonstrate risk reduction effectiveness.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk score after mitigation (residual probability score × residual impact score). Compared to the pre-mitigation risk_score to quantify risk reduction and determine if the residual risk is within acceptable tolerance.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Composite numeric risk score, typically calculated as probability_score × impact_score (range 1–25 on a 5×5 matrix). Drives risk prioritization, escalation thresholds, and portfolio risk heat map reporting.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding record in the originating source system (e.g., CTMS risk ID, Veeva Vault document ID, MasterControl CAPA ID). Supports data lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the risk record: open (active and unresolved), mitigated (controls applied and risk reduced), closed (risk no longer applicable or resolved), accepted (risk acknowledged and formally accepted by program leadership without
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 14971; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the risk category (e.g., within 'regulatory': IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, PMDA, EMA; within 'safety': SAE signal, SUSAR reporting, DSMB review). Supports detailed risk analytics and reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MedDRA SOC/PT hierarchy; ICH Q9

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the risk is expected to be mitigated, closed, or formally accepted. Used for milestone tracking and program governance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 14971

attributes.name: timeline_impact_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of calendar days by which the program or study timeline could be delayed if this risk materializes. Used for critical path analysis, milestone risk assessment, and sponsor portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8(R1)

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable label summarizing the risk (e.g., 'Delayed IND approval due to CMC data gaps'). Used as the primary display name in risk dashboards and portfolio governance reports.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable risk score defined by the program governance framework. Risks with residual_risk_score exceeding this threshold require escalation to senior leadership or the sponsor. Supports risk acceptance decision-making.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: trigger_criteria
attributes.description: Defined conditions or early warning indicators that signal the risk is materializing or escalating (e.g., 'Enrollment rate falls below 60% of target for two consecutive months'). Supports proactive risk monitoring and automated alerting.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this risk record, in ISO 8601 format. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

products.name: risk_mitigation
products.description: Transactional record capturing individual risk mitigation actions and their execution status for program-level risks. Captures mitigation action description, action owner, planned completion date, actual completion date, action status (planned

attributes.name: risk_mitigation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each risk mitigation action record within the program risk management framework. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; ISO 14971 Risk Management

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical development program to which this mitigation action belongs. Links the mitigation action to the overarching program risk management framework.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: compliance_capa_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference ID
attributes.description: Reference to an associated CAPA record in the quality management system (MasterControl) when this mitigation action is formally linked to a CAPA. Enables traceability between risk mitigation and quality event management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA tracking

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference ID

attributes.name: escalated_risk_mitigation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on risk_mitigation (escalated_risk_mitigation_id)

attributes.name: primary_risk_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (employee or contractor) accountable for executing and completing this mitigation action. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Typically a Program Manager, Risk Manager, or functional lead.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; Workday HCM workforce records

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_id
attributes.description: Reference to a protocol deviation record that triggered or is associated with this mitigation action. Supports traceability between compliance events and risk response actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; compliance.protocol_deviation

attributes.name: risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent program-level risk record that this mitigation action is designed to address. Establishes the parent-child relationship between a risk and its mitigation actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 14971; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: tertiary_risk_effectiveness_reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual who conducted the formal effectiveness review of this mitigation action. Typically a QA lead, Program Manager, or independent reviewer per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; MasterControl CAPA; GCP audit trail requirements

attributes.name: action_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the specific mitigation action to be taken, including the approach, scope, and expected mechanism by which the action reduces the identified risk.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.0; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; ISO 14971 Section 6

attributes.name: action_owner_role
attributes.description: Functional role or job title of the mitigation action owner at the time of assignment (e.g., Program Manager, Clinical Operations Lead, Biostatistics Lead). Supports accountability reporting and escalation routing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; Workday HCM

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current execution lifecycle state of the mitigation action. Drives risk dashboard reporting and escalation workflows. 'overdue' is set when planned_completion_date has passed without completion.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl CAPA workflow standards

attributes.name: action_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarizing the mitigation action (e.g., 'Implement enhanced site monitoring protocol'). Used as the IDENTITY_LABEL in risk registers and dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mitigation action by its strategic intent: preventive (reduces likelihood), corrective (addresses root cause after occurrence), contingency (response plan if risk materializes), transfer (shifts risk to another party), or acceptance
attributes.references: ISO 14971; ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the mitigation action was fully executed and confirmed complete. Null if the action has not yet been completed. Used to calculate cycle time and assess timeliness of risk response.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; MasterControl CAPA tracking

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which execution of the mitigation action actually commenced. Compared against planned_start_date to assess schedule adherence and identify systemic delays in risk response.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: closure_justification
attributes.description: Narrative justification for formally closing this mitigation action, documenting the evidence that the action was completed, verified, and the residual risk accepted. Required for regulatory inspection readiness and TMF documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault eTMF; MasterControl CAPA closure

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this mitigation action record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the risk being mitigated has a direct or potential impact on clinical data integrity (ALCOA+ principles). True = data integrity is implicated; False = no direct data integrity impact. Relevant for EDC and CDISC compliance.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM/ADaM standards

attributes.name: due_date_revised
attributes.description: Updated target completion date if the original planned_completion_date was formally extended. Captures approved timeline changes and distinguishes legitimate extensions from overdue actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl CAPA; Oracle Siebel CTMS change management

attributes.name: effectiveness_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative from the effectiveness reviewer documenting the rationale for the effectiveness rating, evidence reviewed, and any observations about residual risk or further actions needed.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; MasterControl CAPA; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Post-execution assessment of how effectively the mitigation action reduced or eliminated the identified risk. Populated after action completion and formal effectiveness review. Drives decisions on whether additional mitigation is required.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; ISO 14971 Section 9; MasterControl CAPA effectiveness check

attributes.name: effectiveness_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal effectiveness assessment of the completed mitigation action was conducted. Required for CAPA closure and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; MasterControl CAPA tracking; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100

attributes.name: implementation_approach
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific method, process, or procedure to be used in executing the mitigation action. May reference SOPs, work instructions, or system configurations (e.g., EDC edit checks, RTSM alerts).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP SOP standards; MasterControl document control

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this mitigation action record was most recently modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: linked_milestone
attributes.description: Name or code of the program milestone (e.g., 'First Patient In', 'Database Lock', 'NDA Submission') to which this mitigation action is tied. Enables milestone-level risk tracking and critical path analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS milestone tracking; FDA IND/NDA submission timelines

attributes.name: mitigation_action_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the mitigation action, used in risk registers, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Follows the pattern MIT-<PROGRAM_CODE>-<SEQUENCE>.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ISO 14971

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: High-level strategic approach applied to manage the risk, aligned with ICH Q9 risk management principles. Distinguishes the overarching strategy from the specific action_type.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; ISO 14971 Section 6; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the mitigation action is expected to be fully executed and closed. Used to calculate overdue status and drive risk dashboard KPI reporting. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date-precision) for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ISO 14971

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which execution of the mitigation action is planned to begin. Used for timeline planning, Gantt chart generation, and milestone tracking within the program risk management plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS milestone tracking

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this mitigation action, reflecting the urgency of execution relative to the risk severity and program timeline. Drives resource allocation and escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ISO 14971

attributes.name: recurrence_prevention_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing measures put in place to prevent recurrence of the risk after mitigation. Supports lessons-learned capture and cross-program knowledge transfer within the clinical development portfolio.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; MasterControl CAPA; FDA CAPA guidance; ISO 14971

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this mitigation action has direct implications for regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA) or regulatory agency notifications. True = regulatory impact identified; False = no direct regulatory impact.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: residual_risk_acceptance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the residual risk was formally accepted by the authorized governance body. Null if residual risk has not yet been accepted or if further mitigation is required.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: residual_risk_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residual risk level after mitigation has been formally accepted by the program risk governance body (e.g., DSMB, DMC, or Sponsor). True = accepted; False = further mitigation required.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ISO 14971 Section 7; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: residual_risk_level
attributes.description: The assessed level of risk remaining after the mitigation action has been fully implemented and its effectiveness confirmed. Used to determine whether the residual risk is acceptable or requires further mitigation per the program risk acceptance criteria.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; ISO 14971 Section 7; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: responsible_function
attributes.description: The organizational function or department accountable for executing this mitigation action (e.g., Clinical Operations, Data Management, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics). Supports cross-functional risk governance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS organizational structure

attributes.name: risk_domain
attributes.description: The functional domain of the parent risk that this mitigation action addresses. Enables domain-specific risk reporting and cross-program benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH Q9; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the risk being mitigated has a direct or potential impact on subject safety. True = subject safety is implicated; False = no direct subject safety impact. Drives prioritization and DSMB/DMC notification requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP regulations

attributes.name: supporting_systems
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operational systems involved in executing or monitoring this mitigation action (e.g., Medidata Rave, the source system Veeva Vault). Supports system-level impact analysis and integration planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC standards

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which implementation of the mitigation action was formally verified as complete and effective. Distinct from actual_completion_date (when the action was done) and effectiveness_review_date (when effectiveness was assessed).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; ALCOA+; MasterControl audit management

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Description of the method used to verify that the mitigation action has been implemented as planned (e.g., site visit, SDV, EDC audit trail review, document review in Veeva Vault, monitoring report review). Supports GCP audit readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incrementing version counter for this mitigation action record, supporting optimistic concurrency control and audit trail versioning in the Databricks Silver Layer. Incremented on each substantive update.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; Databricks Delta Lake versioning

attributes.name: assumption_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to this planning assumption for cross-referencing in clinical development plans, program governance documents, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: effective_from_date

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: lower_bound_value

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this assumption by the program governance committee or assumption owner. Drives automated review reminders in the CTMS and program planning tools.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); GCP ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Primary regulatory agency relevant to this assumption, particularly for regulatory timeline and submission assumptions. Drives agency-specific planning parameters in the clinical development plan.
attributes.references: FDA; EMA; PMDA; MHRA; TGA; Health Canada; ICH E8(R1)

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this assumption must be reviewed and revalidated by the assumption owner or program governance committee to ensure continued relevance to the clinical development plan.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA Guidance for Industry: Clinical Development Programs; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: risk_mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Description of the contingency or mitigation actions to be executed if this assumption is invalidated, including fallback strategies, alternative approaches, and escalation paths within the program governance framework.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; ICH E8(R1); FDA Guidance for Industry: Clinical Development Programs

attributes.name: assumption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the planning assumption within the program governance workflow. Drives whether the assumption is actively used in program planning or has been retired/replaced.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA Guidance for Industry: Clinical Development Programs; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: subcategory

attributes.name: supporting_document_ref

attributes.name: therapeutic_area

attributes.name: title

attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA Guidance for Industry: Clinical Development Programs

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: validation_date

attributes.description: Reference to the prior version of this KRI/KPI definition record, enabling a full version history chain for audit and regulatory inspection purposes.

attributes.name: applicable_development_phase
attributes.description: The clinical development phase(s) for which this indicator definition is applicable (e.g., Phase_I, Phase_II, Phase_III, Phase_IV, all_phases). Allows phase-specific KRI/KPI frameworks within the same program.
attributes.references: ICH E8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: applicable_therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area for which this indicator is specifically calibrated (e.g., Oncology, Neurology, Cardiovascular). Some KRI thresholds are disease-area specific. Null if the indicator applies universally across all therapeutic areas.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MedDRA

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this KRI/KPI definition was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from draft to active status and is required for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual who formally approved this KRI/KPI definition or its most recent version change. Required for electronic signature compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: The source of the industry benchmark or historical baseline used to set the target and warning thresholds (e.g., 'TransCelerate Industry Benchmark 2023', 'Internal Historical Average 2020-2023', 'FDA Guidance', 'Sponsor SOPs').
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: benchmark_value
attributes.description: The industry or historical benchmark value for this indicator against which the target threshold was calibrated. Enables comparison of program performance against external standards.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: capa_required_on_breach
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required on Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) must be initiated in MasterControl when this indicator breaches its critical threshold. Supports GCP compliance and quality management workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; MasterControl CAPA; 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: change_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification for the most recent change to this indicator definition, including threshold adjustments, metric redefinition, or ownership transfers. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this KRI/KPI definition record was first created in the system. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: critical_threshold
attributes.description: The threshold value at which the indicator triggers a red alert, indicating a critical risk or performance failure requiring immediate escalation to program governance or sponsor. Drives CAPA initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum; TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: data_source_object
attributes.description: The specific module, dataset, form, or table within the source system from which indicator data is extracted (e.g., 'AE Form' in Medidata Rave, 'Case Safety Report' in the source system 'Visit Tracking' in the source system
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the raw data for this indicator is sourced (e.g., Medidata Rave, the source system the source system the source system data lineage tracing and source system reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: dsmb_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a critical threshold breach for this indicator must be reported to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC). Drives automated DSMB notification workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on DMC; DSMB Charter

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reportable Flag

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this KRI/KPI definition is retired or superseded. Null for currently active indicators. Enables temporal versioning of the program monitoring framework.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this KRI/KPI definition becomes active and measurements begin. Supports versioning and historical comparison of indicator definitions over the program lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: escalation_owner
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual or committee to whom a critical threshold breach is escalated (e.g., 'Program Steering Committee', 'DSMB', 'Sponsor Medical Monitor'). Distinct from the indicator owner who manages routine monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: governance_committee
attributes.description: The governance body (e.g., Program Review Board, Portfolio Governance Committee, DSMB/DMC, Joint Steering Committee) in whose meetings this indicator is reviewed. Links the KRI/KPI to the appropriate oversight forum.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on DMC; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: indicator_category
attributes.description: Business domain category grouping this indicator for portfolio governance reporting (e.g., safety, data_quality, enrollment, site_performance, regulatory, supply_chain, finance, operational). Enables domain-level roll-up in governance dashboards.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: indicator_code
attributes.description: Unique business-facing alphanumeric code identifying this KRI/KPI definition within the program portfolio (e.g., PRG-KRI-001, PRG-KPI-042). Used as the externally-known identifier in governance reports and portfolio dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: indicator_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the KRI or KPI (e.g., 'Protocol Deviation Rate', 'Site Activation Cycle Time', 'SAE Reporting Compliance Rate'). Used as the display label in governance meetings and portfolio reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: indicator_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this KRI/KPI definition. 'draft' = under development; 'active' = in use for governance monitoring; 'suspended' = temporarily paused; 'retired' = no longer monitored; 'under_review' = being reassessed for threshold or definition
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: indicator_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification within the indicator category (e.g., 'SAE Reporting' under safety, 'Protocol Deviation' under data_quality, 'Screen Failure Rate' under enrollment). Provides granular segmentation for drill-down analytics.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: indicator_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether this indicator is a Key Risk Indicator (KRI) — measuring risk exposure — or a Key Performance Indicator (KPI) — measuring operational performance. Drives how thresholds are interpreted and escalated in governance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this indicator is on the critical path for program delivery milestones. Critical path KRIs/KPIs receive priority escalation and are featured in executive portfolio dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Critical Path Initiative

attributes.name: is_regulatory_commitment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI/KPI is a formal regulatory commitment to a health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA) as part of a Risk Management Plan, IND, or study protocol.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_safety_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this indicator is classified as a safety-related KRI (e.g., SAE reporting timeliness, SUSAR submission compliance, AE data completeness). Safety indicators receive heightened governance scrutiny and may trigger DSMB notification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this indicator definition was most recently reviewed by the governance committee or indicator owner, even if no changes were made. Supports periodic review compliance and governance cadence tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; MasterControl

attributes.name: measurement_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether a higher value is favorable (e.g., consent rate), a lower value is favorable (e.g., protocol deviation rate), or the value should remain within a target range. Governs how threshold breaches are evaluated in governance logic.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: How often this indicator is measured and reported (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly). Determines the cadence of data collection and governance review cycles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the indicator value (e.g., 'percentage', 'days', 'count', 'rate per 100 patient-years', 'USD'). Required for correct threshold interpretation and cross-program comparability.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: metric_definition
attributes.description: Precise business definition of what this indicator measures, including the numerator and denominator logic where applicable (e.g., 'Number of SAEs reported within 24 hours divided by total SAEs reported in the period, expressed as a percentage').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: Defines whether the indicator is measured over a rolling window (e.g., last 30 days), cumulatively from study start, at a specific point in time, or study-to-date. Critical for consistent interpretation of computed values.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: responsible_function
attributes.description: The organizational function or department accountable for monitoring and responding to this indicator (e.g., 'Clinical Operations', 'Biostatistics', 'Pharmacovigilance', 'Data Management', 'Regulatory Affairs').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which the indicator definition itself (thresholds, metric definition, ownership) is formally reviewed and potentially updated by the governance committee. Distinct from measurement_frequency which governs data collection cadence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; MasterControl

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this KRI/KPI record in the originating source system (e.g., CTMS indicator ID, MasterControl document number). Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: target_threshold
attributes.description: The desired or optimal value for this indicator representing expected performance under normal operating conditions. Serves as the baseline against which warning and critical thresholds are calibrated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: threshold_operator
attributes.description: Logical operator defining how the measured value is compared to the warning and critical thresholds (e.g., 'gt' = greater than triggers alert, 'lt' = less than triggers alert, 'between' = value must remain within a range).
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this KRI/KPI definition record was most recently modified. Required for change tracking and audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this KRI/KPI definition (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Incremented when metric definition, thresholds, or ownership changes are approved. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: warning_threshold
attributes.description: The threshold value at which the indicator triggers a yellow/amber alert, indicating early risk signal requiring heightened monitoring or investigation. Distinct from the critical threshold which triggers escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum; TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

products.name: kri_reading
products.description: Transactional record capturing periodic observed readings of program-level KRIs and KPIs against their defined thresholds. Captures the KRI reference, reading date, observed value, threshold status (green/amber/red), trend direction, data source snapshot

attributes.name: kri_reading_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Program Key Risk Indicator (KRI) Reading ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each periodic KRI/KPI reading record captured at the program level. Serves as the primary key for this transactional observation event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

tag_set.value: Program Key Risk Indicator (KRI) Reading ID

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical development program for which this KRI reading was captured. Links the observation to the governing program entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA IND regulations 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (program lead, medical monitor, or governance committee chair) who formally confirmed and accepted this KRI reading. Required for electronic signature compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 when reading_status transitions to 'confirmed'.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: governance_meeting_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governance committee meeting (e.g., DSMB, PMC, Portfolio Review) during which this KRI reading was formally reviewed. Nullable when readings are generated outside a formal meeting cycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: kri_id
attributes.description: Reference to the KRI/KPI definition record that specifies the metric name, threshold configuration, and measurement methodology for this reading. Ensures each reading is traceable to its governing definition.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_reading_kri_reading_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrected KRI reading record that supersedes this one when reading_status is 'superseded'. Enables full audit chain reconstruction for regulatory inspection, ensuring the history of corrections is traceable per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI reading requires a documented corrective or mitigation action. True = a CAPA or risk mitigation action must be initiated; False = no action required beyond continued monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: amber_threshold_lower
attributes.description: The lower boundary of the caution (amber) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Values within the amber band trigger heightened monitoring and management attention without requiring immediate escalation.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: amber_threshold_upper
attributes.description: The upper boundary of the caution (amber) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration in effect at reading time.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the CAPA record initiated in response to this KRI threshold breach. Links the reading to the formal quality management response tracked in MasterControl. Null when no CAPA has been initiated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl CAPA; ISO 9001

attributes.name: computation_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the observed value was computed automatically by an analytics pipeline, entered manually by a data manager or CRA, or produced through a semi-automated process requiring human validation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this KRI reading was formally confirmed by the governance reviewer. Represents a distinct lifecycle event timestamp required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: consecutive_breach_count
attributes.description: Number of consecutive review cycles (including the current one) during which this KRI has been in amber or red status. Used by governance committees to assess persistence of risk signals and trigger escalation protocols when a defined breach duration
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this KRI reading record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a data quality concern was identified with the underlying source data used to compute this reading (e.g., incomplete EDC data, site data not yet reconciled, known system outage).
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: data_quality_note
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific data quality issue identified when data_quality_flag is True. Documents the nature of the concern (e.g., 'Site 007 data not yet entered in EDC', 'CTMS extract delayed by 3 days') to support audit review and reading
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: data_snapshot_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or version label of the source data snapshot used to compute this KRI reading (e.g., EDC data extract version, CTMS report run ID, database lock reference).
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: denominator_value
attributes.description: The denominator used in computing a rate or percentage KRI (e.g., total enrolled subjects for a protocol deviation rate, total expected visits for a visit completion rate).
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI reading has triggered a formal escalation to senior management, the sponsor, or a regulatory body based on threshold breach severity or consecutive breach count. True = escalation initiated; False = no escalation required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The organizational level to which this KRI reading has been escalated when escalation_flag is True. Determines the appropriate response protocol and notification recipients. Null when no escalation is required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: green_threshold_lower
attributes.description: The lower boundary of the acceptable (green) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration that was in effect at the time of this specific reading, supporting historical
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: green_threshold_upper
attributes.description: The upper boundary of the acceptable (green) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration in effect at reading time.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: kri_category
attributes.description: High-level domain category classifying the KRI for portfolio-level aggregation and governance reporting. Enables committee members to filter and group indicators by risk domain.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: numerator_value
attributes.description: The numerator used in computing a rate or percentage KRI (e.g., number of protocol deviations, number of completed visits). Stored alongside the denominator to enable independent verification of the observed_value and full audit traceability per ALCOA+
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: observed_value
attributes.description: The raw numeric value of the KRI/KPI as measured at the reading date. This is the principal quantitative fact of the observation event (e.g., 0.85 for 85% enrollment rate, 3.2 for 3.2 days average SAE reporting lag).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC ADaM; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: prior_reading_value
attributes.description: The observed value from the immediately preceding review cycle for this KRI. Stored on the current reading record to enable direct trend comparison without requiring a self-join, supporting governance committee dashboards and period-over-period analysis.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: reading_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this KRI observation was captured or the data snapshot was taken. Represents the principal business event date for this measurement, distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: reading_reference_code
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for this KRI reading event, typically formatted as KRI-RDG-{PROGRAM_CODE}-{YYYYMMDD}. Used in governance reports, dashboards, and audit trails to uniquely reference a specific reading without exposing the surrogate key.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: reading_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this KRI reading record. 'draft' = computed but not yet reviewed; 'under_review' = submitted for governance committee review; 'confirmed' = formally accepted by the governance body; 'superseded' = replaced by a corrected reading
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: review_cycle_period
attributes.description: The governance review period this reading belongs to, expressed as a standardized period label (e.g., '2024-Q1', '2024-W23', '2024-03'). Enables time-series alignment across multiple KRIs within the same review cycle for governance committee reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: review_cycle_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the review cycle during which this reading was generated. Determines the expected cadence for trend analysis and threshold breach escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: reviewer_commentary
attributes.description: Free-text narrative commentary provided by the governance committee reviewer or program lead explaining the context of the observed value, root cause of any threshold breach, mitigating factors, or planned actions. Captured at the time of formal review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023; ALCOA+

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The planned or aspirational target value for this KRI in the current review cycle, as defined in the program plan or Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system). Distinct from threshold boundaries — represents the desired performance level, enabling
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC ADaM; SAP conventions

attributes.name: threshold_status
attributes.description: Red-Amber-Green (RAG) status classification of the observed value against the defined thresholds at the time of reading. 'green' = within acceptable range; 'amber' = caution zone requiring heightened monitoring; 'red' = threshold breached requiring
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: trend_direction
attributes.description: Directional trend classification comparing the current observed value to the prior period reading. 'improving' = moving toward green; 'worsening' = moving toward or deeper into red; 'stable' = no material change; 'insufficient_data' = fewer than two data
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: trend_magnitude
attributes.description: The absolute numeric change between the current observed_value and the prior_reading_value, expressed in the same unit_of_measure. Positive values indicate increase; negative values indicate decrease.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the observed_value is expressed (e.g., 'percentage', 'days', 'count', 'rate_per_site', 'ratio'). Essential for correct interpretation of the numeric reading across heterogeneous KRI types.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this KRI reading record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles. Updated on any field change including status transitions and commentary additions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: variance_from_target
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between the observed_value and the target_value (observed minus target). Negative values indicate underperformance; positive values indicate overperformance relative to target.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: anatomical_main_group
attributes.description: Descriptive label of the anatomical main group (organ or system on which the drug acts) that this ATC level 1 classification represents.

attributes.name: atc_classification_system
attributes.description: Name of the classification system that governs this term, identifying it as the WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification.

attributes.name: atc_level1_code
attributes.description: Single-letter code representing the anatomical main group in the WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification (e.g., A, B, C).

attributes.name: atc_level1_name
attributes.description: Official textual name of the anatomical main group corresponding to the ATC level 1 code (e.g., Alimentary tract and metabolism).

attributes.name: code_description
attributes.description: Extended descriptive text explaining the scope and therapeutic grouping covered by this ATC level 1 anatomical main group.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date on which this ATC level 1 classification term became effective in the referenced dictionary version.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this ATC level 1 classification term ceased to be effective; null for currently active terms.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language of the ATC level 1 name and description text.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ATC level 1 terminology record was first captured into the clinical data repository.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this ATC level 1 terminology record within the maintained dictionary.

attributes.name: source_authority
attributes.description: Organization responsible for assigning and maintaining this ATC classification term, typically the WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology.

attributes.name: whodrug_dictionary_version
attributes.description: Version of the WHODrug Global dictionary release from which this ATC level 1 term was sourced (e.g., WHODrug B3 format March 2024).

attributes.name: whodrug_atc_level1_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to terminology.whodrug_atc_level1. Business justification: ATC level 2 (therapeutic subgroup) rolls up to one ATC level 1 (anatomical main group). Child-to-parent FK connects the siloed whodrug_atc_level1 and whodrug_atc_level2 tables.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: atc_classification_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this record within the five-level ATC hierarchy; fixed at 2 for therapeutic subgroup entries.

attributes.name: atc_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language of the therapeutic subgroup name and description (e.g., 'en').

attributes.name: atc_level2_code
attributes.description: The official three-character ATC Level 2 code denoting the therapeutic subgroup (one anatomical main group letter followed by two therapeutic digits, e.g., C03).

attributes.name: atc_level2_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name/description of the ATC Level 2 therapeutic subgroup (e.g., 'Diuretics').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ATC Level 2 classification record was first captured in the terminology repository.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ATC Level 2 classification entry becomes valid and usable for drug coding.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this ATC Level 2 classification entry ceases to be valid; null for currently active entries.

attributes.name: is_official_who_assigned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ATC Level 2 code was officially assigned by the WHO Collaborating Centre (true) versus a provisional or sponsor-assigned classification (false).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ATC Level 2 classification record was last updated in the terminology repository.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this ATC Level 2 classification entry within the dictionary version.

attributes.name: revision_note
attributes.description: Free-text note describing changes applied to this ATC Level 2 entry in the current dictionary release (e.g., name change, code reclassification).

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric ordering value used to present ATC Level 2 subgroups in canonical sequence within their parent anatomical main group.

attributes.name: superseded_by_atc_level2_code
attributes.description: The ATC Level 2 code that replaces this entry when it has been reclassified or merged; null if not superseded.

attributes.name: therapeutic_subgroup_description
attributes.description: Extended descriptive text explaining the scope and intended therapeutic use of medicinal products classified under this ATC Level 2 subgroup.

attributes.name: whodrug_dictionary_version
attributes.description: The WHODrug Global dictionary release version in which this ATC Level 2 classification entry is valid (e.g., GLB202401 / version/date identifier).

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`agreement_billing_milestone`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Financial milestone tracking for study contracts: milestone value, payment status, enrollment and visit targets, and revenue recognition performance."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`agreement`.`agreement_billing_milestone`"
  parameters:
    - name: p_target_currency
      data_type: STRING
      default: "'USD'"
  dimensions:
    - name: "milestone_type"
      display_name: "Milestone Type"
      expr: milestone_type
      comment: "Type of billing milestone (enrollment, visit, deliverable, regulatory, etc.)"
    - name: "billing_status"
      display_name: "Billing Status"
      expr: billing_status
      comment: "Current billing status (pending, invoiced, paid, disputed, etc.)"
    - name: "approval_status"
      display_name: "Approval Status"
      expr: approval_status
      comment: "Approval status of the milestone (pending, approved, rejected)"
    - name: "functional_area"
      display_name: "Functional Area"
      expr: functional_area
      comment: "Functional area responsible for the milestone (clinical ops, data management, regulatory, etc.)"
    - name: "revenue_recognition_method"
      display_name: "Revenue Recognition Method"
      expr: revenue_recognition_method
      comment: "Method used for revenue recognition (milestone, percentage-of-completion, etc.)"
    - name: "planned_trigger_year"
      display_name: "Planned Trigger Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', planned_trigger_date)
      comment: "Year when milestone is planned to trigger"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "planned_trigger_quarter"
      display_name: "Planned Trigger Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', planned_trigger_date)
      comment: "Quarter when milestone is planned to trigger"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "planned_trigger_month"
      display_name: "Planned Trigger Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', planned_trigger_date)
      comment: "Month when milestone is planned to trigger"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "invoice_year"
      display_name: "Invoice Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', invoice_date)
      comment: "Year when milestone was invoiced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "invoice_month"
      display_name: "Invoice Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)
      comment: "Month when milestone was invoiced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "milestone_count"
      display_name: "Milestone Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of billing milestones"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_milestone_amount"
      display_name: "Total Milestone Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(milestone_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of all milestone amounts in contract currency"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_adjusted_amount"
      display_name: "Total Adjusted Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(adjusted_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of adjusted milestone amounts after change orders or disputes"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_milestone_amount"
      display_name: "Average Milestone Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(milestone_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average milestone value across all milestones"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_enrollment_target"
      display_name: "Total Enrollment Target"
      expr: SUM(CAST(enrollment_target_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of enrollment targets across enrollment-based milestones"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_visit_target"
      display_name: "Total Visit Target"
      expr: SUM(CAST(visit_count_target AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of visit count targets across visit-based milestones"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_percent_complete"
      display_name: "Average Percent Complete"
      expr: AVG(CAST(percent_complete AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average completion percentage across all milestones"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "milestone_value_at_risk"
      display_name: "Milestone Value at Risk"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN billing_status = 'disputed' THEN CAST(milestone_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total value of milestones currently in dispute"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "overdue_milestone_count"
      display_name: "Overdue Milestone Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND billing_status NOT IN ('paid', 'cancelled') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of milestones past their payment due date and not yet paid"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "paid_milestone_count"
      display_name: "Paid Milestone Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN billing_status = 'paid' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of milestones that have been paid"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "payment_cycle_days_avg"
      display_name: "Average Payment Cycle Days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(payment_received_date, invoice_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from invoice to payment receipt"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Financial milestone tracking for study contracts: milestone value, payment status, enrollment and visit targets, and revenue recognition performance.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`agreement_change_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Contract change order tracking: scope changes, budget impact, timeline extensions, and approval workflow performance for study contracts."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`agreement`.`change_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "change_type"
      display_name: "Change Type"
      expr: change_type
      comment: "Type of change order (scope, budget, timeline, regulatory, etc.)"
    - name: "co_status"
      display_name: "Change Order Status"
      expr: co_status
      comment: "Current status of the change order (draft, pending, approved, rejected, executed)"
    - name: "change_reason"
      display_name: "Change Reason"
      expr: change_reason
      comment: "Primary reason for the change order"
    - name: "priority"
      display_name: "Priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Priority level of the change order (high, medium, low)"
    - name: "regulatory_driven_flag"
      display_name: "Regulatory Driven"
      expr: regulatory_driven_flag
      comment: "Whether the change order was driven by regulatory requirements"
    - name: "initiation_year"
      display_name: "Initiation Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', initiation_date)
      comment: "Year when change order was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "initiation_quarter"
      display_name: "Initiation Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', initiation_date)
      comment: "Quarter when change order was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "initiation_month"
      display_name: "Initiation Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', initiation_date)
      comment: "Month when change order was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "change_order_count"
      display_name: "Change Order Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of change orders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_delta_value"
      display_name: "Total Delta Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(delta_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of all contract value changes from change orders"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_delta_value"
      display_name: "Average Delta Value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(delta_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average contract value change per change order"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_service_fee_delta"
      display_name: "Total Service Fee Delta"
      expr: SUM(CAST(service_fee_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of service fee changes from change orders"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_pass_through_delta"
      display_name: "Total Pass-Through Delta"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pass_through_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of pass-through cost changes from change orders"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_timeline_extension_days"
      display_name: "Total Timeline Extension Days"
      expr: SUM(CAST(timeline_extension_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of timeline extensions in days across all change orders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_timeline_extension_days"
      display_name: "Average Timeline Extension Days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(timeline_extension_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average timeline extension per change order"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "total_site_count_delta"
      display_name: "Total Site Count Delta"
      expr: SUM(CAST(site_count_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net change in site count from all change orders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_subject_count_delta"
      display_name: "Total Subject Count Delta"
      expr: SUM(CAST(subject_count_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net change in subject count from all change orders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "approved_co_count"
      display_name: "Approved Change Order Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN co_status = 'approved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of change orders that have been approved"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "rejected_co_count"
      display_name: "Rejected Change Order Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN co_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of change orders that have been rejected"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "regulatory_driven_co_count"
      display_name: "Regulatory-Driven Change Order Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_driven_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of change orders driven by regulatory requirements"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_approval_cycle_days"
      display_name: "Average Approval Cycle Days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(sponsor_approval_date, initiation_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from initiation to sponsor approval"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Contract change order tracking: scope changes, budget impact, timeline extensions, and approval workflow performance for study contracts.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`agreement_contract_negotiation`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Contract negotiation efficiency: cycle time, round count, escalation rate, and value negotiated across study contracts and MSAs."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`agreement`.`contract_negotiation`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "negotiation_status"
      display_name: "Negotiation Status"
      expr: negotiation_status
      comment: "Current status of the negotiation (active, completed, stalled, terminated)"
    - name: "negotiation_type"
      display_name: "Negotiation Type"
      expr: negotiation_type
      comment: "Type of negotiation (new contract, amendment, renewal, etc.)"
    - name: "priority_level"
      display_name: "Priority Level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Priority level of the negotiation (high, medium, low)"
    - name: "payment_model"
      display_name: "Payment Model"
      expr: payment_model
      comment: "Payment model being negotiated (fixed-price, time-and-materials, milestone-based, etc.)"
    - name: "escalation_flag"
      display_name: "Escalation Flag"
      expr: escalation_flag
      comment: "Whether the negotiation has been escalated"
    - name: "negotiation_start_year"
      display_name: "Negotiation Start Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', negotiation_start_date)
      comment: "Year when negotiation started"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "negotiation_start_quarter"
      display_name: "Negotiation Start Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', negotiation_start_date)
      comment: "Quarter when negotiation started"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "negotiation_start_month"
      display_name: "Negotiation Start Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', negotiation_start_date)
      comment: "Month when negotiation started"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "negotiation_count"
      display_name: "Negotiation Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of contract negotiations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_negotiated_value"
      display_name: "Total Negotiated Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(negotiated_contract_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of negotiated contract values"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_negotiated_value"
      display_name: "Average Negotiated Value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(negotiated_contract_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average negotiated contract value per negotiation"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_service_fee_value"
      display_name: "Total Service Fee Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(service_fee_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of service fee values negotiated"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_pass_through_value"
      display_name: "Total Pass-Through Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pass_through_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of pass-through values negotiated"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_negotiation_rounds"
      display_name: "Average Negotiation Rounds"
      expr: AVG(CAST(negotiation_round AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of negotiation rounds per contract"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "avg_open_issue_count"
      display_name: "Average Open Issue Count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(open_issue_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of open issues per negotiation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "escalated_negotiation_count"
      display_name: "Escalated Negotiation Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN escalation_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of negotiations that have been escalated"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "completed_negotiation_count"
      display_name: "Completed Negotiation Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN negotiation_status = 'completed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of negotiations that have been completed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "stalled_negotiation_count"
      display_name: "Stalled Negotiation Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN negotiation_status = 'stalled' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of negotiations that are currently stalled"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_negotiation_cycle_days"
      display_name: "Average Negotiation Cycle Days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_execution_date, negotiation_start_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from negotiation start to execution"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "avg_round_duration_days"
      display_name: "Average Round Duration Days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(round_end_date, round_start_date))
      comment: "Average duration of a negotiation round in days"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "avg_legal_review_days"
      display_name: "Average Legal Review Days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(legal_review_end_date, legal_review_start_date))
      comment: "Average number of days for legal review"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Contract negotiation efficiency: cycle time, round count, escalation rate, and value negotiated across study contracts and MSAs.
