CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`agreement_deliverable`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Deliverable performance tracking: on-time delivery rate, quality metrics, effort variance, and SLA compliance for contractual deliverables."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`agreement`.`deliverable`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "deliverable_type"
      display_name: "Deliverable Type"
      expr: deliverable_type
      comment: "Type of deliverable (report, dataset, document, submission package, etc.)"
    - name: "deliverable_category"
      display_name: "Deliverable Category"
      expr: deliverable_category
      comment: "Category of deliverable (regulatory, clinical, statistical, data management, etc.)"
    - name: "delivery_status"
      display_name: "Delivery Status"
      expr: delivery_status
      comment: "Current delivery status (planned, in progress, submitted, accepted, rejected)"
    - name: "qc_review_status"
      display_name: "QC Review Status"
      expr: qc_review_status
      comment: "Quality control review status"
    - name: "priority_level"
      display_name: "Priority Level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Priority level of the deliverable (high, medium, low)"
    - name: "responsible_functional_team"
      display_name: "Responsible Functional Team"
      expr: responsible_functional_team
      comment: "Functional team responsible for the deliverable"
    - name: "cdisc_compliant_flag"
      display_name: "CDISC Compliant"
      expr: cdisc_compliant_flag
      comment: "Whether the deliverable must be CDISC compliant"
    - name: "regulatory_submission_flag"
      display_name: "Regulatory Submission"
      expr: regulatory_submission_flag
      comment: "Whether the deliverable is part of a regulatory submission"

      display_name: "Planned Delivery Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', planned_delivery_date)
      comment: "Year when deliverable is planned for delivery"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "planned_delivery_quarter"
      display_name: "Planned Delivery Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', planned_delivery_date)

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "deliverable_count"
      display_name: "Deliverable Count"

        decimal_places:
          type: all

      display_name: "Total Contracted Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(contracted_value_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of contracted value across all deliverables"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_contracted_value"
      display_name: "Average Contracted Value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(contracted_value_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average contracted value per deliverable"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_estimated_effort_hours"
      display_name: "Total Estimated Effort Hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_effort_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of estimated effort hours across all deliverables"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "total_actual_effort_hours"
      display_name: "Total Actual Effort Hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_effort_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of actual effort hours across all deliverables"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "avg_estimated_effort_hours"
      display_name: "Average Estimated Effort Hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_effort_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated effort hours per deliverable"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "avg_actual_effort_hours"
      display_name: "Average Actual Effort Hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_effort_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual effort hours per deliverable"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "on_time_delivery_count"
      display_name: "On-Time Delivery Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= planned_delivery_date THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deliverables delivered on or before planned date"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "late_delivery_count"
      display_name: "Late Delivery Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date > planned_delivery_date THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deliverables delivered after planned date"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "accepted_deliverable_count"
      display_name: "Accepted Deliverable Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN delivery_status = 'accepted' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deliverables that have been accepted"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "rejected_deliverable_count"
      display_name: "Rejected Deliverable Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN delivery_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deliverables that have been rejected"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "sla_met_count"
      display_name: "SLA Met Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN sla_met_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deliverables that met their SLA"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_days_overdue"
      display_name: "Average Days Overdue"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_overdue AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days overdue for late deliverables"

      comment: "Year the analysis was created"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Analysis Quarter"
      display_name: "Analysis Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Quarter the analysis was created"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Analysis Month"
      display_name: "Analysis Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the analysis was created"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Analyses"
      display_name: "Total Analyses"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT analysis_id)
      comment: "Total number of distinct analyses executed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Analyses CM"
      display_name: "Analyses (Current Month)"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT analysis_id)
      comment: "Analyses created in current month"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Analysis Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Analyses PM"
      display_name: "Analyses (Prior Month)"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT analysis_id)
      comment: "Analyses created in prior month"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Analysis Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month

  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`biostatistics`.`tlf_output`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Output Type"
      display_name: "Output Type"
      expr: output_type
      comment: "Type of output (table, listing, figure)"

      display_name: "Output Category"

      display_name: "QC Status"
      expr: qc_status
      comment: "Quality control status of the output"
    - name: "Approval Status"
      display_name: "Approval Status"
      expr: approval_status
      comment: "Approval status of the output"
    - name: "Blinding Status"
      display_name: "Blinding Status"
      expr: blinding_status
      comment: "Blinding status of the output (blinded, unblinded)"
    - name: "Production Year"
      display_name: "Production Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', production_run_timestamp)
      comment: "Year the output was produced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Production Quarter"
      display_name: "Production Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', production_run_timestamp)
      comment: "Quarter the output was produced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Production Month"
      display_name: "Production Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', production_run_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the output was produced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total TLF Outputs"
      display_name: "Total TLF Outputs"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tlf_output_id)
      comment: "Total number of TLF outputs produced"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Outputs CM"
      display_name: "Outputs (Current Month)"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tlf_output_id)
      comment: "TLF outputs produced in current month"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Production Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Outputs PM"
      display_name: "Outputs (Prior Month)"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tlf_output_id)
      comment: "TLF outputs produced in prior month"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Production Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Output Growth MoM Pct"
      display_name: "Output Growth MoM %"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth rate in TLF output production"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Discrepancies"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

        decimal_places:

        decimal_places:

          places: 2

      format:

        decimal_places:

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

      comment: "Percentage of all findings that are critical severity"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Audit execution and outcome metrics tracking audit performance, finding severity distribution, and CAPA requirements across audit types and organizational units.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_capa`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Corrective and preventive action (CAPA) effectiveness metrics tracking CAPA completion, timeliness, recurrence prevention, and regulatory impact."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`compliance`.`compliance_capa`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "CAPA Type"

      display_name: "CAPA Status"
      expr: compliance_capa_status
      comment: "Current status of the CAPA (open, in progress, completed, closed)"
    - name: "Priority"
      display_name: "Priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Priority level of the CAPA (critical, high, medium, low)"
    - name: "Source Type"
      display_name: "Source Type"
      expr: source_type
      comment: "Source type that triggered the CAPA (audit, inspection, deviation, etc.)"
    - name: "Root Cause Category"
      display_name: "Root Cause Category"
      expr: root_cause_category
      comment: "Root cause category of the issue addressed by CAPA"
    - name: "Responsible Department"
      display_name: "Responsible Department"
      expr: responsible_department
      comment: "Department responsible for CAPA execution"
    - name: "Regulatory Reportable Flag"
      display_name: "Regulatory Reportable"
      expr: regulatory_reportable_flag
      comment: "Whether the CAPA is reportable to regulatory authorities"
    - name: "Recurrence Flag"
      display_name: "Recurrence"
      expr: recurrence_flag
      comment: "Whether this CAPA addresses a recurring issue"
    - name: "Subject Safety Impact Flag"
      display_name: "Subject Safety Impact"
      expr: subject_safety_impact_flag
      comment: "Whether the issue impacts subject safety"
    - name: "Data Integrity Impact Flag"
      display_name: "Data Integrity Impact"
      expr: data_integrity_impact_flag
      comment: "Whether the issue impacts data integrity"
    - name: "CAPA Year"
      display_name: "CAPA Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', initiation_date)
      comment: "Year the CAPA was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "CAPA Quarter"
      display_name: "CAPA Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', initiation_date)
      comment: "Quarter the CAPA was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "CAPA Month"
      display_name: "CAPA Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', initiation_date)
      comment: "Month the CAPA was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total CAPAs"
      display_name: "Total CAPAs"
      expr: COUNT(compliance_capa_id)
      comment: "Total number of corrective and preventive actions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "On-Time Completion Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Completion Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN actual_completion_date <= target_completion_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN actual_completion_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of completed CAPAs finished on or before target date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Days to Complete"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Complete"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_completion_date, initiation_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from CAPA initiation to completion"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Recurrence Rate"
      display_name: "Recurrence Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN recurrence_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(compliance_capa_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of CAPAs addressing recurring issues"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Effectiveness Check Pass Rate"
      display_name: "Effectiveness Check Pass Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN effectiveness_check_result = 'Effective' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN effectiveness_check_result IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of effectiveness checks that passed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Subject Safety Impact Rate"
      display_name: "Subject Safety Impact Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN subject_safety_impact_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(compliance_capa_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of CAPAs with subject safety impact"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Regulatory Reportable Rate"
      display_name: "Regulatory Reportable Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN regulatory_reportable_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(compliance_capa_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of CAPAs requiring regulatory reporting"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Corrective and preventive action (CAPA) effectiveness metrics tracking CAPA completion, timeliness, recurrence prevention, and regulatory impact.

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

      expr: assessment_status
      comment: "Current status of the risk assessment (draft, approved, under review)"
    - name: "Inherent Risk Rating"
      display_name: "Inherent Risk Rating"
      expr: inherent_risk_rating
      comment: "Inherent risk rating before controls (critical, high, medium, low)"
    - name: "Residual Risk Rating"
      display_name: "Residual Risk Rating"
      expr: residual_risk_rating
      comment: "Residual risk rating after controls (critical, high, medium, low)"
    - name: "Risk Acceptance Decision"
      display_name: "Risk Acceptance Decision"
      expr: risk_acceptance_decision
      comment: "Decision on risk acceptance (accepted, mitigate, transfer, avoid)"
    - name: "Remediation Status"
      display_name: "Remediation Status"
      expr: remediation_status
      comment: "Status of risk remediation activities"
    - name: "CAPA Required Flag"
      display_name: "CAPA Required"
      expr: capa_required_flag
      comment: "Whether corrective and preventive action is required"
    - name: "Subject Safety Impact Flag"
      display_name: "Subject Safety Impact"
      expr: subject_safety_impact_flag
      comment: "Whether the risk impacts subject safety"
    - name: "Data Integrity Impact Flag"
      display_name: "Data Integrity Impact"
      expr: data_integrity_impact_flag
      comment: "Whether the risk impacts data integrity"
    - name: "Assessment Year"
      display_name: "Assessment Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', assessment_date)
      comment: "Year the risk assessment was performed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Assessment Quarter"
      display_name: "Assessment Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', assessment_date)
      comment: "Quarter the risk assessment was performed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Assessment Month"
      display_name: "Assessment Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', assessment_date)
      comment: "Month the risk assessment was performed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Risk Assessments"
      display_name: "Total Risk Assessments"
      expr: COUNT(risk_assessment_id)
      comment: "Total number of risk assessments performed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Inherent Risk Score"
      display_name: "Avg Inherent Risk Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(inherent_risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average inherent risk score before controls"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Residual Risk Score"
      display_name: "Avg Residual Risk Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(residual_risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average residual risk score after controls"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Risk Reduction"
      display_name: "Avg Risk Reduction"
      expr: AVG(CAST(inherent_risk_score AS DOUBLE) - CAST(residual_risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average reduction in risk score from inherent to residual"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Risk Mitigation Effectiveness"
      display_name: "Risk Mitigation Effectiveness"
      expr: 100.0 * AVG((CAST(inherent_risk_score AS DOUBLE) - CAST(residual_risk_score AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(CAST(inherent_risk_score AS DOUBLE), 0))
      comment: "Average percentage reduction in risk score from controls"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "High Residual Risk Rate"
      display_name: "High Residual Risk Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN residual_risk_rating IN ('Critical', 'High') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(risk_assessment_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of assessments with high or critical residual risk"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Subject Safety Impact Rate"
      display_name: "Subject Safety Impact Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN subject_safety_impact_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(risk_assessment_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of risk assessments with subject safety impact"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Days to Next Review"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Next Review"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(next_review_date, assessment_date))
      comment: "Average number of days until next scheduled risk review"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Risk assessment and mitigation effectiveness metrics tracking inherent vs residual risk, control effectiveness, and remediation performance.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_sop_training_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "SOP training compliance metrics tracking training completion rates, timeliness, assessment performance, and currency across staff and SOPs."

      display_name: "Training Type"
      expr: training_type
      comment: "Type of training (initial, refresher, retraining)"
    - name: "Training Method"
      display_name: "Training Method"
      expr: training_method
      comment: "Method of training delivery (classroom, online, read-and-sign)"
    - name: "SOP Category"
      display_name: "SOP Category"
      expr: sop_category
      comment: "Category of the SOP being trained on"
    - name: "Staff Role"
      display_name: "Staff Role"
      expr: staff_role
      comment: "Role of the staff member being trained"
    - name: "Department"
      display_name: "Department"
      expr: department
      comment: "Department of the staff member"
    - name: "Assessment Passed Flag"
      display_name: "Assessment Passed"

    - name: "Current Version Flag"
      display_name: "Current Version Training"
      expr: is_current_version_training
      comment: "Whether this training is for the current SOP version"
    - name: "Completion Year"
      display_name: "Completion Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', completion_date)
      comment: "Year the training was completed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Completion Quarter"
      display_name: "Completion Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', completion_date)
      comment: "Quarter the training was completed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Completion Month"
      display_name: "Completion Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', completion_date)
      comment: "Month the training was completed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Training Records"
      display_name: "Total Training Records"
      expr: COUNT(sop_training_record_id)
      comment: "Total number of SOP training records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Completion Rate"
      display_name: "Completion Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN training_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(sop_training_record_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of training records completed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "On-Time Completion Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Completion Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN completion_date <= due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN completion_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of training completed on or before due date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Assessment Pass Rate"
      display_name: "Assessment Pass Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN assessment_passed = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN assessment_passed IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of training assessments passed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Assessment Score"
      display_name: "Avg Assessment Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(assessment_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average assessment score across all training records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Training Duration Hours"
      display_name: "Avg Training Duration (Hours)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(training_duration_minutes AS DOUBLE)) / 60.0
      comment: "Average training duration in hours"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Current Version Training Rate"
      display_name: "Current Version Training Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_current_version_training = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(sop_training_record_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of training records for current SOP versions"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Attempt Number"
      display_name: "Avg Attempt Number"
      expr: AVG(CAST(attempt_number AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of attempts to pass training assessment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: SOP training compliance metrics tracking training completion rates, timeliness, assessment performance, and currency across staff and SOPs.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`consent_capacity_assessment`

  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`consent`.`capacity_assessment`"

      comment: "Type of capacity assessment (e.g., Initial, Reassessment, Triggered)"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Vulnerable Population Rate"
      display_name: "Vulnerable Population Rate"

      comment: "Percentage of assessments for vulnerable populations — ethical oversight and protection metric"

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Assessments Requiring Reassessment"
      display_name: "Assessments Requiring Reassessment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reassessment_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of assessments requiring future reassessment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Reassessment Requirement Rate"
      display_name: "Reassessment Requirement Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reassessment_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of assessments requiring reassessment — ongoing monitoring burden metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Assessments Requiring IRB Notification"
      display_name: "Assessments Requiring IRB Notification"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN irb_iec_notification_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of assessments requiring IRB/IEC notification"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "IRB Notification Requirement Rate"
      display_name: "IRB Notification Requirement Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN irb_iec_notification_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of assessments requiring IRB notification — ethics oversight compliance metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Average Assessment Score"
      display_name: "Average Assessment Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(assessment_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Mean capacity assessment score across all assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "IRB Notified Assessments"
      display_name: "IRB Notified Assessments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN irb_iec_notification_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of assessments for which IRB/IEC was actually notified"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Capacity assessment KPIs tracking assessment outcomes, vulnerable population identification, LAR requirement rates, and reassessment compliance.

      comment: "Whether the IRB or IEC was notified of the deviation"
    - name: "Reconsent Required Flag"
      display_name: "Reconsent Required"
      expr: reconsent_required
      comment: "Whether reconsent is required to resolve the deviation"
    - name: "Subject Rights Impacted Flag"
      display_name: "Subject Rights Impacted"
      expr: subject_rights_impacted
      comment: "Whether the deviation impacted subject rights or welfare"
    - name: "Data Integrity Impacted Flag"
      display_name: "Data Integrity Impacted"
      expr: data_integrity_impacted
      comment: "Whether the deviation impacted data integrity"
    - name: "Discovery Year"
      display_name: "Discovery Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', discovery_date)
      comment: "Year in which the deviation was discovered"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Discovery Month"
      display_name: "Discovery Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', discovery_date)
      comment: "Month in which the deviation was discovered"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Consent Deviations"
      display_name: "Total Consent Deviations"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of consent deviations recorded"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unique Subjects with Deviations"
      display_name: "Unique Subjects with Deviations"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Reportable Deviations"
      display_name: "Regulatory Reportable Deviations"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN regulatory_reportable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of deviations that are reportable to regulatory authorities"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Reportable Rate"
      display_name: "Regulatory Reportable Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN regulatory_reportable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations requiring regulatory reporting — compliance risk indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "IRB Notified Deviations"
      display_name: "IRB Notified Deviations"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN irb_iec_notified = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of deviations for which IRB/IEC was notified"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "IRB Notification Rate"
      display_name: "IRB Notification Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN irb_iec_notified = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations notified to IRB/IEC — ethics oversight compliance metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Deviations Requiring Reconsent"
      display_name: "Deviations Requiring Reconsent"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reconsent_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of deviations that require subject reconsent"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Reconsent Requirement Rate"
      display_name: "Reconsent Requirement Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reconsent_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations requiring reconsent — subject burden and protocol impact metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Deviations Impacting Subject Rights"
      display_name: "Deviations Impacting Subject Rights"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN subject_rights_impacted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of deviations that impacted subject rights or welfare"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Subject Rights Impact Rate"
      display_name: "Subject Rights Impact Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN subject_rights_impacted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations impacting subject rights — ethical compliance and subject protection metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Deviations Impacting Data Integrity"
      display_name: "Deviations Impacting Data Integrity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN data_integrity_impacted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of deviations that impacted data integrity"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Data Integrity Impact Rate"
      display_name: "Data Integrity Impact Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN data_integrity_impacted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations impacting data integrity — data quality and regulatory compliance metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Resolved Deviations"
      display_name: "Resolved Deviations"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN resolution_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of deviations that have been resolved"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Resolution Rate"
      display_name: "Resolution Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN resolution_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations resolved — CAPA effectiveness and process improvement metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Consent deviation and protocol compliance KPIs tracking deviation severity, regulatory reportability, IRB notification, and resolution timeliness.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`consent_subject_consent`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core consent KPIs tracking consent acquisition, reconsent activity, withdrawal rates, and comprehension assessment outcomes for clinical trial subjects."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`consent`.`consent_subject_consent`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Consent Status"
      display_name: "Consent Status"
      expr: consent_status
      comment: "Current status of the subject consent (e.g., Active, Withdrawn, Pending)"
    - name: "Consent Type"
      display_name: "Consent Type"
      expr: consent_type
      comment: "Type of consent obtained (e.g., Informed Consent, Assent, LAR Consent)"
    - name: "Consent Method"
      display_name: "Consent Method"
      expr: consent_method
      comment: "Method by which consent was obtained (e.g., eConsent, Paper, Verbal)"
    - name: "GDPR Lawful Basis"
      display_name: "GDPR Lawful Basis"
      expr: gdpr_lawful_basis
      comment: "GDPR Article 6 lawful basis for processing (e.g., Consent, Legitimate Interest)"
    - name: "Consent Year"
      display_name: "Consent Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', consent_date)
      comment: "Year in which consent was obtained"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Consent Quarter"
      display_name: "Consent Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', consent_date)
      comment: "Quarter in which consent was obtained"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Consent Month"
      display_name: "Consent Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', consent_date)
      comment: "Month in which consent was obtained"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "LAR Involved Flag"
      display_name: "LAR Involved"
      expr: lar_involved
      comment: "Whether a legally authorized representative was involved in the consent process"
    - name: "Reconsent Required Flag"
      display_name: "Reconsent Required"
      expr: reconsent_required
      comment: "Whether reconsent is required for this subject"
    - name: "Witness Required Flag"
      display_name: "Witness Required"
      expr: witness_required
      comment: "Whether a witness signature was required for this consent"
    - name: "Capacity Assessment Performed Flag"
      display_name: "Capacity Assessment Performed"
      expr: capacity_assessment_performed
      comment: "Whether a capacity assessment was performed prior to consent"
    - name: "HIPAA Authorization Obtained Flag"
      display_name: "HIPAA Authorization Obtained"
      expr: hipaa_authorization_obtained
      comment: "Whether HIPAA authorization was obtained as part of the consent process"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Consents"
      display_name: "Total Consents"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of subject consent records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unique Subjects Consented"
      display_name: "Unique Subjects Consented"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of trial subjects who have provided consent"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Consents Requiring Reconsent"
      display_name: "Consents Requiring Reconsent"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reconsent_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of consents flagged as requiring reconsent"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Reconsent Rate"
      display_name: "Reconsent Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reconsent_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consents requiring reconsent — key compliance and protocol amendment impact metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Withdrawn Consents"
      display_name: "Withdrawn Consents"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN withdrawal_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of consents that have been withdrawn by subjects"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Withdrawal Rate"
      display_name: "Withdrawal Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN withdrawal_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consents withdrawn — critical retention and subject satisfaction indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "LAR Consents"
      display_name: "LAR Consents"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN lar_involved = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of consents involving a legally authorized representative"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "LAR Involvement Rate"
      display_name: "LAR Involvement Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN lar_involved = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consents requiring LAR involvement — indicates vulnerable population enrollment"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Capacity Assessments Performed"
      display_name: "Capacity Assessments Performed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN capacity_assessment_performed = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of consents where capacity assessment was performed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Capacity Assessment Rate"
      display_name: "Capacity Assessment Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN capacity_assessment_performed = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consents with capacity assessment — compliance metric for vulnerable populations"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Average Comprehension Score"
      display_name: "Average Comprehension Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(comprehension_assessment_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Mean comprehension assessment score across all consents — quality of informed consent indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "HIPAA Authorizations Obtained"
      display_name: "HIPAA Authorizations Obtained"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN hipaa_authorization_obtained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of consents with HIPAA authorization obtained"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "HIPAA Authorization Rate"
      display_name: "HIPAA Authorization Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN hipaa_authorization_obtained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consents with HIPAA authorization — US regulatory compliance metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "eConsent Completion Percentage"
      display_name: "Average eConsent Completion %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(econsent_completion_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Mean eConsent completion percentage — digital consent process efficiency metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Core consent KPIs tracking consent acquisition, reconsent activity, withdrawal rates, and comprehension assessment outcomes for clinical trial subjects.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`consent_reconsent_trigger`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Reconsent trigger and campaign management KPIs tracking trigger types, affected subject populations, reconsent completion rates, and regulatory compliance."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`consent`.`reconsent_trigger`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Trigger Type"
      display_name: "Trigger Type"
      expr: trigger_type
      comment: "Type of reconsent trigger (e.g., Protocol Amendment, Safety Update, ICF Revision, Regulatory Directive)"
    - name: "Resolution Status"
      display_name: "Resolution Status"
      expr: resolution_status
      comment: "Current resolution status of the reconsent trigger (e.g., Open, In Progress, Completed, Closed)"
    - name: "Subject Scope"
      display_name: "Subject Scope"
      expr: subject_scope
      comment: "Scope of subjects affected (e.g., All Active Subjects, Specific Cohort, Single Site)"
    - name: "Escalation Required Flag"
      display_name: "Escalation Required"
      expr: escalation_required
      comment: "Whether escalation to senior management or sponsor is required"
    - name: "Capacity Assessment Required Flag"
      display_name: "Capacity Assessment Required"
      expr: capacity_assessment_required
      comment: "Whether capacity assessment is required as part of reconsent"
    - name: "Protocol Deviation Raised Flag"
      display_name: "Protocol Deviation Raised"
      expr: protocol_deviation_raised
      comment: "Whether a protocol deviation was raised in connection with this trigger"
    - name: "Subject Withdrawal Flag"
      display_name: "Subject Withdrawal Flag"
      expr: subject_withdrawal_flag
      comment: "Whether any subjects withdrew as a result of this reconsent trigger"
    - name: "Trigger Year"
      display_name: "Trigger Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', trigger_date)
      comment: "Year in which the reconsent trigger was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Trigger Month"
      display_name: "Trigger Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', trigger_date)
      comment: "Month in which the reconsent trigger was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Reconsent Triggers"
      display_name: "Total Reconsent Triggers"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of reconsent triggers initiated"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Affected Subjects"
      display_name: "Total Affected Subjects"
      expr: SUM(CAST(affected_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total count of subjects affected by reconsent triggers"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Reconsented Subjects"
      display_name: "Total Reconsented Subjects"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reconsented_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total count of subjects who completed reconsent"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Reconsent Completion Rate"
      display_name: "Reconsent Completion Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(reconsented_subject_count AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(affected_subject_count AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of affected subjects who completed reconsent — campaign effectiveness and subject retention metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Average Affected Subjects per Trigger"
      display_name: "Average Affected Subjects per Trigger"
      expr: AVG(CAST(affected_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Mean number of subjects affected per reconsent trigger — impact scope indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Triggers Requiring Escalation"
      display_name: "Triggers Requiring Escalation"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN escalation_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of reconsent triggers requiring escalation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Escalation Rate"
      display_name: "Escalation Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN escalation_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of reconsent triggers requiring escalation — complexity and risk indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Triggers with Protocol Deviation"
      display_name: "Triggers with Protocol Deviation"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN protocol_deviation_raised = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of reconsent triggers that resulted in protocol deviation"
      format:
        type: number

  dimensions:
    - name: "Action Type"

      comment: "Source data verification status (Not Required, Pending, Completed, Failed)"

      format:

      format:
        type: boolean
    - name: "Is Attributable"
      display_name: "Attributable"
      expr: is_attributable
      comment: "ALCOA principle: Data can be traced to the individual who generated it"
      format:
        type: boolean
    - name: "Is Contemporaneous"
      display_name: "Contemporaneous"
      expr: is_contemporaneous
      comment: "ALCOA principle: Data was recorded at the time the activity occurred"

        type: boolean

      format:
        type: boolean
    - name: "Is Legible"

      expr: is_legible
      comment: "ALCOA principle: Data is readable and understandable"
      format:
        type: boolean
    - name: "Is Complete"

      format:
        type: boolean

      format:
        type: boolean
    - name: "Is Enduring"

      format:
        type: boolean
    - name: "Is Available"

      comment: "ALCOA+ principle: Data is readily available for review and inspection"
      format:
        type: boolean
    - name: "Event Month"
      display_name: "Event Month"

      comment: "Month when the audit event occurred"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Event Quarter"
      display_name: "Event Quarter"

      comment: "Quarter when the audit event occurred"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Event Year"

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true

      comment: "Number of audit entries fully compliant with ALCOA+ principles"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Accurate Entries"
      display_name: "Accurate Entries"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_accurate = TRUE THEN alcoa_audit_entry_id END)
      comment: "Number of entries meeting the Accurate principle"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Attributable Entries"

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_attributable = TRUE THEN alcoa_audit_entry_id END)
      comment: "Number of entries meeting the Attributable principle"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Contemporaneous Entries"

    - name: "Original Entries"

      comment: "Number of entries meeting the Original principle"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Legible Entries"

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_legible = TRUE THEN alcoa_audit_entry_id END)
      comment: "Number of entries meeting the Legible principle"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Complete Entries"
      display_name: "Complete Entries"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_complete = TRUE THEN alcoa_audit_entry_id END)
      comment: "Number of entries meeting the Complete principle"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Consistent Entries"

      comment: "Number of entries meeting the Consistent principle"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Enduring Entries"

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_enduring = TRUE THEN alcoa_audit_entry_id END)

      comment: "Number of entries meeting the Available principle"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Data Entry Lag Minutes"
      display_name: "Avg Data Entry Lag Minutes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(data_entry_lag_minutes AS DOUBLE))

        type: number
        decimal_places:

    - name: "ALCOA Compliance Rate"
      display_name: "ALCOA Compliance Rate"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`datamanagement_data_quality_alcoa`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "ALCOA+ data integrity compliance metrics tracking attributability, legibility, contemporaneousness, originality, and accuracy of clinical trial data entries across all EDC systems and source data verification activities."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`datamanagement`.`alcoa_audit_entry`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Action Type"
      display_name: "Audit Action Type"
      expr: action_type
      comment: "Type of data action audited (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, VERIFY, LOCK, UNLOCK, SIGN)"
    - name: "ALCOA Overall Status"
      display_name: "ALCOA+ Compliance Status"
      expr: alcoa_overall_status
      comment: "Overall ALCOA+ compliance status for the audited entry (COMPLIANT, NON_COMPLIANT, PARTIAL, UNDER_REVIEW)"
    - name: "SDV Status"
      display_name: "Source Data Verification Status"
      expr: sdv_status
      comment: "Source data verification status (NOT_REQUIRED, PENDING, VERIFIED, DISCREPANCY_FOUND)"
    - name: "User Role"
      display_name: "User Role"
      expr: user_role
      comment: "Role of the user who performed the audited action (CRA, DATA_MANAGER, INVESTIGATOR, COORDINATOR)"
    - name: "EDC System"
      display_name: "EDC System Name"
      expr: edc_system_name
      comment: "Electronic data capture system where the action occurred (RAVE, INFORM, VEEVA_VAULT)"
    - name: "Event Month"
      display_name: "Event Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', event_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the audited event occurred"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Event Quarter"
      display_name: "Event Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', event_timestamp)
      comment: "Quarter when the audited event occurred"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Event Year"
      display_name: "Event Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', event_timestamp)
      comment: "Year when the audited event occurred"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Audit Entries"
      display_name: "Total Audit Entries"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of ALCOA+ audit trail entries recorded"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "ALCOA Compliant Entries"
      display_name: "ALCOA+ Compliant Entries"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_accurate = TRUE AND is_attributable = TRUE AND is_contemporaneous = TRUE AND is_legible = TRUE AND is_original = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of audit entries meeting all five core ALCOA principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "ALCOA Plus Compliant Entries"
      display_name: "ALCOA+ Compliant Entries (Full)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_accurate = TRUE AND is_attributable = TRUE AND is_contemporaneous = TRUE AND is_legible = TRUE AND is_original = TRUE AND is_complete = TRUE AND is_consistent = TRUE AND is_enduring = TRUE AND is_available = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of audit entries meeting all nine ALCOA+ principles including Complete, Consistent, Enduring, and Available"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "ALCOA Compliance Rate"
      display_name: "ALCOA Compliance Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_accurate = TRUE AND is_attributable = TRUE AND is_contemporaneous = TRUE AND is_legible = TRUE AND is_original = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of audit entries meeting all five core ALCOA principles — critical regulatory compliance KPI for Part 11 and GCP inspections"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "ALCOA Plus Compliance Rate"
      display_name: "ALCOA+ Compliance Rate (Full)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_accurate = TRUE AND is_attributable = TRUE AND is_contemporaneous = TRUE AND is_legible = TRUE AND is_original = TRUE AND is_complete = TRUE AND is_consistent = TRUE AND is_enduring = TRUE AND is_available = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of audit entries meeting all nine ALCOA+ principles — gold standard for data integrity in regulated clinical trials"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Data Entry Lag Minutes"
      display_name: "Average Data Entry Lag (Minutes)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(data_entry_lag_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average time lag in minutes between event occurrence and data entry — measures contemporaneousness and data freshness"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Non Attributable Entries"
      display_name: "Non-Attributable Entries"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_attributable = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of entries failing attributability (missing or invalid user signature/timestamp) — critical Part 11 violation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Non Contemporaneous Entries"
      display_name: "Non-Contemporaneous Entries"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_contemporaneous = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of entries failing contemporaneousness (excessive lag between event and recording) — GCP compliance risk"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "SDV Required Entries"
      display_name: "SDV Required Entries"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN sdv_status IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFIED', 'DISCREPANCY_FOUND') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of entries requiring source data verification per monitoring plan"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "SDV Completion Rate"
      display_name: "SDV Completion Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN sdv_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sdv_status IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFIED', 'DISCREPANCY_FOUND') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of required source data verification activities completed — operational monitoring KPI"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: ALCOA+ data integrity compliance metrics tracking attributability, legibility, contemporaneousness, originality, and accuracy of clinical trial data entries across all EDC systems and source data verification activities.

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all

      display_name: "Coded Assignments"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN coding_status IN ('Coded', 'Approved') THEN 1 END)

        decimal_places:
          type: all

        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Manual Coded Assignments"

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Recoded Assignments"
      display_name: "Recoded Assignments"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN prior_assigned_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Serious AE Assignments"
      display_name: "Serious AE Assignments"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Autocoding Confidence"
      display_name: "Avg Autocoding Confidence"

        decimal_places:

          places: 3
    - name: "Coding Completion Rate"
      display_name: "Coding Completion Rate"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN coding_status IN ('Coded', 'Approved') THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)

      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Approval Rate"
      display_name: "Approval Rate"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN coding_status IN ('Coded', 'Approved') THEN 1 END), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of coded assignments approved, quality metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Autocoding Rate"
      display_name: "Autocoding Rate"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN coding_method = 'Autocoding' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of assignments autocoded, automation efficiency metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Recoding Rate"
      display_name: "Recoding Rate"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN prior_assigned_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of assignments requiring recoding, quality indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Serious AE Rate"
      display_name: "Serious AE Rate"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_serious_ae = TRUE THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of assignments classified as serious AE, safety metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Medical coding productivity and quality KPIs tracking coding completion, approval rates, autocoding performance, and recoding frequency across MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`datamanagement_data_entry_productivity`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Data entry session productivity and efficiency metrics tracking session duration, field entry rates, error rates, and data entry quality across all EDC systems and clinical trial sites."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`datamanagement`.`data_entry_session`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Session Status"
      display_name: "Data Entry Session Status"
      expr: data_entry_session_status
      comment: "Status of the data entry session (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ABANDONED, TIMED_OUT)"
    - name: "Session Type"
      display_name: "Session Type"
      expr: session_type
      comment: "Type of data entry session (INITIAL_ENTRY, DOUBLE_DATA_ENTRY, CORRECTION, QUERY_RESPONSE)"
    - name: "Entry Method"
      display_name: "Entry Method"
      expr: entry_method
      comment: "Method of data entry (MANUAL, IMPORT, API, MOBILE)"
    - name: "User Role"
      display_name: "User Role"
      expr: user_role
      comment: "Role of the user performing data entry (CRA, DATA_MANAGER, SITE_COORDINATOR, INVESTIGATOR)"
    - name: "Is Double Data Entry"
      display_name: "Double Data Entry"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_double_data_entry = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether the session is part of double data entry quality control process"
    - name: "Is Locked"
      display_name: "Session Locked"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_locked = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether the data entry session has been locked"
    - name: "Is SDV"
      display_name: "Source Data Verified"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_source_data_verified = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether the session data has been source data verified"
    - name: "Protocol Deviation Flag"
      display_name: "Protocol Deviation Detected"
      expr: CASE WHEN protocol_deviation_flag = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether a protocol deviation was detected during data entry"
    - name: "Start Month"
      display_name: "Session Start Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', start_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the data entry session started"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Start Quarter"
      display_name: "Session Start Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', start_timestamp)
      comment: "Quarter when the data entry session started"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Start Year"
      display_name: "Session Start Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', start_timestamp)
      comment: "Year when the data entry session started"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Sessions"
      display_name: "Total Data Entry Sessions"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of data entry sessions initiated"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Completed Sessions"
      display_name: "Completed Sessions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN data_entry_session_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of data entry sessions successfully completed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Session Completion Rate"
      display_name: "Session Completion Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN data_entry_session_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of data entry sessions successfully completed — user experience and system usability KPI"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Session Duration Minutes"
      display_name: "Average Session Duration (Minutes)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(duration_seconds AS DOUBLE)) / 60.0
      comment: "Average duration of data entry sessions in minutes — productivity and efficiency indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Total Fields Entered"
      display_name: "Total Fields Entered"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fields_entered_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of fields entered across all sessions — data entry volume metric"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Fields Per Session"
      display_name: "Average Fields Per Session"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fields_entered_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of fields entered per session — session complexity indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Fields Per Minute"
      display_name: "Fields Entered Per Minute"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fields_entered_count AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(duration_seconds AS DOUBLE)) / 60.0, 0)
      comment: "Average number of fields entered per minute — data entry productivity KPI"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Fields With Errors"
      display_name: "Total Fields With Errors"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fields_with_errors_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of fields with validation errors — data quality indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Field Error Rate"
      display_name: "Field Error Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(fields_with_errors_count AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(fields_entered_count AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of entered fields with validation errors — data entry quality and training effectiveness KPI"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Queries Generated"
      display_name: "Total Queries Generated"
      expr: SUM(CAST(queries_generated_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of data queries generated during data entry sessions — data quality issue volume"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Query Generation Rate"
      display_name: "Query Generation Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(queries_generated_count AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(fields_entered_count AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of entered fields generating queries — data quality and site training KPI"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Save Count"
      display_name: "Average Save Count Per Session"
      expr: AVG(CAST(save_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of saves per session — user behavior and system interaction pattern"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Double Data Entry Sessions"
      display_name: "Double Data Entry Sessions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_double_data_entry = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of sessions using double data entry quality control — quality assurance effort"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Double Data Entry Rate"
      display_name: "Double Data Entry Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_double_data_entry = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of sessions using double data entry — quality control coverage metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Protocol Deviation Sessions"
      display_name: "Sessions With Protocol Deviations"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN protocol_deviation_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of sessions where protocol deviations were detected — compliance risk indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Protocol Deviation Rate"
      display_name: "Protocol Deviation Detection Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN protocol_deviation_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of sessions detecting protocol deviations — protocol compliance monitoring KPI"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Data entry session productivity and efficiency metrics tracking session duration, field entry rates, error rates, and data entry quality across all EDC systems and clinical trial sites.

      display_name: "Query Raised Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', raised_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the query was raised"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day

    - name: "Raised Quarter"

    - name: "DBL Blocking Queries"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Escalated Queries"
      display_name: "Escalated Queries"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_escalated = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of queries escalated due to aging or complexity — quality risk indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Escalation Rate"
      display_name: "Query Escalation Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_escalated = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of queries requiring escalation — site performance and data quality risk KPI"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Reopen Count"
