      expr: access_action
      comment: "Type of access action performed (view, download, print, export)"
    - name: "Access Result"
      display_name: "Access Result"
      expr: access_result
      comment: "Result of the access attempt (success, denied, error)"
    - name: "Access Channel"
      display_name: "Access Channel"
      expr: access_channel
      comment: "Channel through which document was accessed (web, mobile, API)"
    - name: "Access Device Type"
      display_name: "Access Device Type"
      expr: access_device_type
      comment: "Type of device used for access (desktop, tablet, mobile)"
    - name: "User Role"
      display_name: "User Role"
      expr: user_role
      comment: "Role of the user accessing the document"
    - name: "User Organization"
      display_name: "User Organization"
      expr: user_organization
      comment: "Organization of the user accessing the document"
    - name: "Document Type"
      display_name: "Document Type"
      expr: document_type
      comment: "Type of document accessed"
    - name: "Document Status at Access"
      display_name: "Document Status at Access"
      expr: document_status_at_access
      comment: "Status of the document at the time of access"
    - name: "Document Confidentiality Level"
      display_name: "Document Confidentiality Level"
      expr: document_confidentiality_level
      comment: "Confidentiality classification of the accessed document"
    - name: "TMF Zone"
      display_name: "TMF Zone"
      expr: tmf_zone
      comment: "Trial Master File zone of the accessed document"
    - name: "Regulatory Authority"
      display_name: "Regulatory Authority"
      expr: regulatory_authority
      comment: "Regulatory authority context for the access"
    - name: "Access Year"
      display_name: "Access Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', access_timestamp)
      comment: "Year of document access"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Access Month"
      display_name: "Access Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', access_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of document access"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Is Anomalous Access"
      display_name: "Is Anomalous Access"
      expr: is_anomalous_access
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether access was flagged as anomalous"
    - name: "Inspection Context"
      display_name: "Inspection Context"
      expr: inspection_context
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether access occurred during regulatory inspection"
    - name: "Justification Required"
      display_name: "Justification Required"
      expr: justification_required
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether access justification was required"
    - name: "Justification Provided"
      display_name: "Justification Provided"
      expr: justification_provided
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether access justification was provided"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Access Events"
      display_name: "Total Access Events"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of document access events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unique Users"
      display_name: "Unique Users"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id)
      comment: "Number of unique users who accessed documents"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unique Documents Accessed"
      display_name: "Unique Documents Accessed"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tmf_document_id)
      comment: "Number of unique documents accessed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Access Success Rate"
      display_name: "Access Success Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN access_result = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of access attempts that were successful"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Anomalous Access Rate"
      display_name: "Anomalous Access Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_anomalous_access = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of access events flagged as anomalous"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Download Count"
      display_name: "Download Count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN access_action = 'download' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total number of document download events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Print Count"
      display_name: "Print Count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN access_action = 'print' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total number of document print events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Print Copies"
      display_name: "Total Print Copies"
      expr: SUM(CAST(print_copy_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of printed copies across all print events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Inspection Context Access Rate"
      display_name: "Inspection Context Access Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN inspection_context = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of access events occurring during regulatory inspection"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Justification Compliance Rate"
      display_name: "Justification Compliance Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN justification_required = TRUE AND justification_provided = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN justification_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of required justifications that were provided"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Access Per User"
      display_name: "Avg Access Per User"
      expr: COUNT(1) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id), 0)
      comment: "Average number of access events per unique user"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Access Per Document"
      display_name: "Avg Access Per Document"
      expr: COUNT(1) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT tmf_document_id), 0)
      comment: "Average number of access events per unique document"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Document access audit KPIs tracking access patterns, anomalies, and regulatory inspection context

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`document_inspection_readiness`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Inspection readiness KPIs tracking regulatory inspection preparedness, gap counts, and remediation status"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`document`.`inspection_readiness`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Readiness Status"
      display_name: "Readiness Status"
      expr: readiness_status
      comment: "Current inspection readiness status (ready, not ready, in progress)"
    - name: "Inspection Type"
      display_name: "Inspection Type"
      expr: inspection_type
      comment: "Type of regulatory inspection (routine, for-cause, pre-approval)"
    - name: "Inspecting Authority"
      display_name: "Inspecting Authority"
      expr: inspecting_authority
      comment: "Regulatory authority conducting the inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.)"
    - name: "Inspection Outcome"
      display_name: "Inspection Outcome"
      expr: inspection_outcome
      comment: "Outcome of the inspection (NAI, VAI, OAI, pending)"
    - name: "TMF Scope"
      display_name: "TMF Scope"
      expr: tmf_scope
      comment: "Scope of TMF covered by readiness assessment"
    - name: "Tier"
      display_name: "Tier"
      expr: tier
      comment: "Priority tier for inspection readiness (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3)"
    - name: "Notification Year"
      display_name: "Notification Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', inspection_notification_date)
      comment: "Year of inspection notification"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Notification Month"
      display_name: "Notification Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', inspection_notification_date)
      comment: "Month of inspection notification"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "CAPA Required"
      display_name: "CAPA Required"
      expr: capa_required
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether corrective and preventive actions are required"
    - name: "Sponsor Notified"
      display_name: "Sponsor Notified"
      expr: sponsor_notified
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether sponsor has been notified of inspection"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Readiness Assessments"
      display_name: "Total Readiness Assessments"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of inspection readiness assessments performed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Readiness Score"
      display_name: "Avg Readiness Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(readiness_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average inspection readiness score across all assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Critical Gaps"
      display_name: "Total Critical Gaps"
      expr: SUM(CAST(critical_gaps_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of critical gaps identified across all readiness assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Major Gaps"
      display_name: "Total Major Gaps"
      expr: SUM(CAST(major_gaps_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of major gaps identified across all readiness assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Minor Gaps"
      display_name: "Total Minor Gaps"
      expr: SUM(CAST(minor_gaps_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of minor gaps identified across all readiness assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Missing Documents"
      display_name: "Total Missing Documents"
      expr: SUM(CAST(missing_documents_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of missing documents identified across all readiness assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Overdue Documents"
      display_name: "Total Overdue Documents"
      expr: SUM(CAST(overdue_documents_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of overdue documents identified across all readiness assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Open Findings"
      display_name: "Total Open Findings"
      expr: SUM(CAST(open_findings_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of open inspection findings across all readiness assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Critical Gap Rate"
      display_name: "Critical Gap Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(critical_gaps_count AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(critical_gaps_count AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(CAST(major_gaps_count AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(CAST(minor_gaps_count AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of critical gaps relative to total gaps identified"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "CAPA Required Rate"
      display_name: "CAPA Required Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN capa_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of readiness assessments requiring corrective and preventive actions"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "NAI Outcome Rate"
      display_name: "NAI Outcome Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN inspection_outcome = 'NAI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN inspection_outcome IS NOT NULL AND inspection_outcome != 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of completed inspections with No Action Indicated outcome"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Days to Inspection"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Inspection"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_inspection_start_date, inspection_notification_date))
      comment: "Average number of days between inspection notification and actual inspection start"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Inspection readiness KPIs tracking regulatory inspection preparedness, gap counts, and remediation status

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`document_regulatory_binder`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Regulatory submission binder KPIs tracking completeness, submission timelines, and agency action outcomes"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`document`.`regulatory_binder`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Binder Status"
      display_name: "Binder Status"
      expr: binder_status
      comment: "Current status of the regulatory binder (draft, in review, submitted, approved)"
    - name: "Binder Type"
      display_name: "Binder Type"
      expr: binder_type
      comment: "Type of regulatory binder (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, CTA)"
    - name: "Target Agency"
      display_name: "Target Agency"
      expr: target_agency
      comment: "Regulatory agency targeted for submission (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.)"
    - name: "Submission Category"
      display_name: "Submission Category"
      expr: submission_category
      comment: "Category of regulatory submission (clinical, CMC, nonclinical)"
    - name: "CTD Module"
      display_name: "CTD Module"
      expr: ctd_module
      comment: "Common Technical Document module (Module 1-5)"
    - name: "Review Pathway"
      display_name: "Review Pathway"
      expr: review_pathway
      comment: "Regulatory review pathway (standard, priority, accelerated, breakthrough)"
    - name: "Therapeutic Area"
      display_name: "Therapeutic Area"
      expr: therapeutic_area
      comment: "Therapeutic area for the regulatory submission"
    - name: "Agency Action Type"
      display_name: "Agency Action Type"
      expr: agency_action_type
      comment: "Type of agency action taken (approval, complete response, information request)"
    - name: "Submission Year"
      display_name: "Submission Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', submission_date)
      comment: "Year of regulatory submission"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submission Month"
      display_name: "Submission Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', submission_date)
      comment: "Month of regulatory submission"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Is eCTD Format"
      display_name: "Is eCTD Format"
      expr: is_ectd_format
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether submission is in electronic Common Technical Document format"
    - name: "Is Inspection Ready"
      display_name: "Is Inspection Ready"
      expr: is_inspection_ready
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether binder meets inspection readiness criteria"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Binders"
      display_name: "Total Binders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of regulatory binders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Submitted Binders"
      display_name: "Submitted Binders"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN submission_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total number of binders that have been submitted to regulatory agencies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approved Binders"
      display_name: "Approved Binders"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN approval_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total number of binders that have received regulatory approval"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Completeness Pct"
      display_name: "Avg Completeness %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(completeness_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average completeness percentage across all regulatory binders"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Document Count"
      display_name: "Total Document Count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(document_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of documents across all regulatory binders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Documents Per Binder"
      display_name: "Avg Documents Per Binder"
      expr: AVG(CAST(document_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of documents per regulatory binder"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Approval Rate"
      display_name: "Approval Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN approval_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN submission_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of submitted binders that received regulatory approval"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Days to Submission"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Submission"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(submission_date, created_timestamp))
      comment: "Average number of days from binder creation to regulatory submission"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Days to Approval"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Approval"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(approval_date, submission_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from submission to regulatory approval"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "eCTD Adoption Rate"
      display_name: "eCTD Adoption Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_ectd_format = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of binders using electronic Common Technical Document format"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Inspection Ready Rate"
      display_name: "Inspection Ready Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_inspection_ready = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of binders that meet inspection readiness criteria"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "On Time Submission Rate"
      display_name: "On Time Submission Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN submission_date <= planned_submission_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN planned_submission_date IS NOT NULL AND submission_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of binders submitted on or before planned submission date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Regulatory submission binder KPIs tracking completeness, submission timelines, and agency action outcomes

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`document_signature`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Electronic signature KPIs tracking signature completion rates, cycle times, and regulatory compliance"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`document`.`signature`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Signature Status"
      display_name: "Signature Status"
      expr: signature_status
      comment: "Current status of the electronic signature (pending, signed, voided, expired)"
    - name: "Signature Type"
      display_name: "Signature Type"
      expr: signature_type
      comment: "Type of electronic signature (approval, review, acknowledgement, consent)"
    - name: "Signature Method"
      display_name: "Signature Method"
      expr: method
      comment: "Method used for electronic signature (digital certificate, biometric, password)"
    - name: "Signature Meaning"
      display_name: "Signature Meaning"
      expr: meaning
      comment: "Meaning or purpose of the signature (authorship, review, approval)"
    - name: "Signer Role"
      display_name: "Signer Role"
      expr: signer_role
      comment: "Role of the person signing the document"
    - name: "Signer Organization"
      display_name: "Signer Organization"
      expr: signer_organization
      comment: "Organization of the person signing the document"
    - name: "TMF Zone"
      display_name: "TMF Zone"
      expr: tmf_zone
      comment: "Trial Master File zone for the signed document"
    - name: "Workflow Step Name"
      display_name: "Workflow Step Name"
      expr: workflow_step_name
      comment: "Name of the workflow step requiring signature"
    - name: "Requested Year"
      display_name: "Requested Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', requested_timestamp)
      comment: "Year the signature was requested"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Requested Month"
      display_name: "Requested Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the signature was requested"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Inspection Readiness"
      display_name: "Inspection Readiness"
      expr: inspection_readiness_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether signed document meets inspection readiness criteria"
    - name: "Regulatory Submission Applicable"
      display_name: "Regulatory Submission Applicable"
      expr: is_regulatory_submission_applicable
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether signature is for regulatory submission document"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Signature Requests"
      display_name: "Total Signature Requests"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of electronic signature requests"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Signed Count"
      display_name: "Signed Count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN signature_status = 'signed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total number of completed signatures"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Signature Completion Rate"
      display_name: "Signature Completion Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN signature_status = 'signed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of signature requests that have been completed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Signature Cycle Time Days"
      display_name: "Avg Signature Cycle Time (Days)"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(signed_timestamp, requested_timestamp))
      comment: "Average number of days from signature request to completion"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Voided Signature Rate"
      display_name: "Voided Signature Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN signature_status = 'voided' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of signatures that have been voided"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Expired Signature Rate"
      display_name: "Expired Signature Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN signature_status = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of signature requests that expired before completion"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Reminder Sent"
      display_name: "Total Reminders Sent"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reminder_sent_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of signature reminders sent across all requests"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Reminders Per Request"
      display_name: "Avg Reminders Per Request"
      expr: AVG(CAST(reminder_sent_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of reminders sent per signature request"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Overdue Signature Rate"
      display_name: "Overdue Signature Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN signature_status = 'pending' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN signature_status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of pending signatures that are past their due date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Regulatory Submission Signature Rate"
      display_name: "Regulatory Submission Signature Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_regulatory_submission_applicable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of signatures applicable to regulatory submissions"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Electronic signature KPIs tracking signature completion rates, cycle times, and regulatory compliance

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`document_tmf_completeness`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Trial Master File completeness KPIs tracking inspection readiness, artifact filing rates, and zone-level completeness across studies and sites"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`document`.`tmf_completeness`"
  parameters:
    - name: p_target_completeness_pct
      data_type: DECIMAL
      default: 95.0
  dimensions:
    - name: "Assessment Type"
      display_name: "Assessment Type"
      expr: assessment_type
      comment: "Type of TMF completeness assessment (scheduled, ad-hoc, pre-inspection)"
    - name: "Assessment Status"
      display_name: "Assessment Status"
      expr: assessment_status
      comment: "Current status of the completeness assessment"
    - name: "Study Phase"
      display_name: "Study Phase"
      expr: study_phase
      comment: "Clinical study phase at time of assessment"
    - name: "Inspection Readiness Risk"
      display_name: "Inspection Readiness Risk"
      expr: inspection_readiness_risk

    - name: "TMF Scope"

      expr: tmf_scope
      comment: "Scope of TMF assessment (study-level, site-level, global)"
    - name: "Completeness Trend"

      expr: completeness_trend

    - name: "Assessment Year"
      display_name: "Assessment Year"

      comment: "Year of completeness assessment"
      format:
        type: date

        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Assessment Quarter"
      display_name: "Assessment Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', assessment_date)

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Assessment Month"

      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', assessment_date)
      comment: "Month of completeness assessment"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day

    - name: "Is Inspection Ready"

    - name: "Remediation Required"

    - name: "Avg Overall Completeness Pct"

        decimal_places:

    - name: "Total Expected Artifacts"

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Filed Artifacts"
      display_name: "Total Filed Artifacts"
      expr: SUM(CAST(filed_artifact_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of filed TMF artifacts across all assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Missing Artifacts"

      expr: SUM(CAST(missing_artifact_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of missing TMF artifacts across all assessments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Overdue Artifacts"
      display_name: "Total Overdue Artifacts"

      comment: "Total number of overdue TMF artifacts across all assessments"
      format:

        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Critical Gaps"

      format:

        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Filing Rate"
      display_name: "Filing Rate"

      comment: "Overall filing rate calculated as filed artifacts divided by expected artifacts"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Inspection Ready Rate"
      display_name: "Inspection Ready Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_inspection_ready = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of assessments that meet inspection readiness criteria"
      format:

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Zone 1 Completeness Pct"

      format:

          type: exact

    - name: "Avg Zone 2 Completeness Pct"

      comment: "Average completeness percentage for TMF Zone 2 (Central Trial Documents)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Zone 3 Completeness Pct"
      display_name: "Avg Zone 3 Completeness %"

      format:

          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Zone 4 Completeness Pct"

          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Zone 5 Completeness Pct"

      comment: "Average completeness percentage for TMF Zone 5 (Site Management)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Remediation Required Rate"
      display_name: "Remediation Required Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN remediation_action_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of assessments requiring remediation actions"
      format:

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Trial Master File completeness KPIs tracking inspection readiness, artifact filing rates, and zone-level completeness across studies and sites

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`document_workflow`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Document workflow KPIs tracking approval cycle times, rejection rates, SLA compliance, and workflow efficiency"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`document`.`workflow`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Workflow Type"
      display_name: "Workflow Type"
      expr: workflow_type
      comment: "Type of document workflow (approval, review, distribution, archival)"
    - name: "Workflow Status"
      display_name: "Workflow Status"
      expr: workflow_status
      comment: "Current status of the workflow (in progress, completed, rejected, cancelled)"
    - name: "Document Type"
      display_name: "Document Type"
      expr: document_type
      comment: "Type of document being processed in the workflow"
    - name: "Priority Level"
      display_name: "Priority Level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Priority level of the workflow (low, medium, high, critical)"
    - name: "TMF Zone"
      display_name: "TMF Zone"
      expr: tmf_zone
      comment: "Trial Master File zone for the document"
    - name: "Current Step Name"
      display_name: "Current Step Name"
      expr: current_step_name
      comment: "Name of the current workflow step"
    - name: "Step Assignee Role"
      display_name: "Step Assignee Role"
      expr: step_assignee_role
      comment: "Role of the person assigned to the current workflow step"
    - name: "Initiated Year"
      display_name: "Initiated Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', initiated_timestamp)
      comment: "Year the workflow was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Initiated Month"
      display_name: "Initiated Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', initiated_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the workflow was initiated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "GCP Critical Document"
      display_name: "GCP Critical Document"
      expr: gcp_critical_document_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether document is GCP-critical"
    - name: "Inspection Readiness"
      display_name: "Inspection Readiness"
      expr: inspection_readiness_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether document meets inspection readiness criteria"
    - name: "Regulatory Submission"
      display_name: "Regulatory Submission"
      expr: regulatory_submission_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether document is part of regulatory submission"
    - name: "SLA Breach"
      display_name: "SLA Breach"
      expr: sla_breach_indicator
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether workflow has breached SLA"
    - name: "Escalation Flag"
      display_name: "Escalation Flag"
      expr: escalation_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether workflow has been escalated"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Workflows"
      display_name: "Total Workflows"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of document workflows"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Completed Workflows"
      display_name: "Completed Workflows"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN workflow_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total number of completed workflows"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Cycle Time Days"
      display_name: "Avg Cycle Time (Days)"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_completion_date, initiated_timestamp))
      comment: "Average number of days from workflow initiation to completion"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Total Rejections"
      display_name: "Total Rejections"
      expr: SUM(CAST(rejection_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of workflow rejections across all workflows"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Rejection Rate"
      display_name: "Rejection Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN rejection_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of workflows that experienced at least one rejection"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "SLA Breach Rate"
      display_name: "SLA Breach Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN sla_breach_indicator = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of workflows that breached service level agreement"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Escalation Rate"
      display_name: "Escalation Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN escalation_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of workflows that required escalation"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Completion Rate"
      display_name: "Completion Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN workflow_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of workflows that have been completed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Steps Per Workflow"
      display_name: "Avg Steps Per Workflow"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_steps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of steps per workflow"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Current Step Sequence"
      display_name: "Avg Current Step Sequence"
      expr: AVG(CAST(current_step_sequence AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average current step sequence number across active workflows"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Workflow Progress Rate"
      display_name: "Workflow Progress Rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(current_step_sequence AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(total_steps AS DOUBLE), 0))
      comment: "Average progress rate calculated as current step divided by total steps"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "GCP Critical Document Rate"
      display_name: "GCP Critical Document Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN gcp_critical_document_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of workflows processing GCP-critical documents"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Document workflow KPIs tracking approval cycle times, rejection rates, SLA compliance, and workflow efficiency

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`finance_accrual`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Financial accruals tracking for revenue recognition, cost matching, and period-end adjustments across studies, sites, and vendors"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`finance`.`accrual`"
  parameters:
    - name: p_reporting_currency
      data_type: STRING
      default: "'USD'"
  dimensions:
    - name: "accrual_type"
      display_name: "Accrual Type"
      expr: accrual_type
      comment: "Type of accrual (revenue, expense, pass-through, etc.)"
    - name: "accrual_status"
      display_name: "Accrual Status"
      expr: accrual_status
      comment: "Current status of the accrual (pending, approved, posted, reversed)"
    - name: "fiscal_year"
      display_name: "Fiscal Year"
      expr: fiscal_year
      comment: "Fiscal year of the accrual"
    - name: "period"
      display_name: "Fiscal Period"
      expr: period
      comment: "Fiscal period of the accrual"
    - name: "is_pass_through"
      display_name: "Pass-Through Flag"
      expr: is_pass_through
      comment: "Whether this accrual represents pass-through costs"
    - name: "is_sox_controlled"
      display_name: "SOX Controlled"
      expr: is_sox_controlled
      comment: "Whether this accrual is subject to SOX controls"
    - name: "posting_month"
      display_name: "Posting Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', posting_date)
      comment: "Month when the accrual was posted"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "posting_quarter"
      display_name: "Posting Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', posting_date)
      comment: "Quarter when the accrual was posted"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "posting_year"
      display_name: "Posting Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', posting_date)
      comment: "Year when the accrual was posted"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_accrual_amount"
      display_name: "Total Accrual Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total accrual amount in transaction currency"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_accrual_amount_usd"
      display_name: "Total Accrual Amount (USD)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total accrual amount converted to USD"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "cumulative_accrual_amount"
      display_name: "Cumulative Accrual Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cumulative_accrual_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Cumulative accrual balance across periods"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "variance_amount"
      display_name: "Accrual Variance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(variance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total variance between accrued and actual amounts"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "accrual_count"
      display_name: "Accrual Count"
      expr: COUNT(accrual_id)
      comment: "Number of accrual transactions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_accrual_amount"
      display_name: "Average Accrual Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average accrual amount per transaction in USD"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "accrual_reversal_count"
      display_name: "Reversal Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reversal_date IS NOT NULL THEN accrual_id END)
      comment: "Number of accruals that have been reversed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "accrual_reversal_rate"
      display_name: "Accrual Reversal Rate"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reversal_date IS NOT NULL THEN accrual_id END) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(accrual_id) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of accruals that have been reversed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Financial accruals tracking for revenue recognition, cost matching, and period-end adjustments across studies, sites, and vendors

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`finance_budget_line`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Budget line-item performance tracking for planned vs actual spend, commitments, and variance analysis across studies and cost categories"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`finance`.`budget_line`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "cost_category"
      display_name: "Cost Category"
      expr: cost_category
      comment: "Primary cost category for the budget line"
    - name: "cost_subcategory"
      display_name: "Cost Subcategory"
      expr: cost_subcategory
      comment: "Detailed cost subcategory"
    - name: "activity_type"
      display_name: "Activity Type"
      expr: activity_type
      comment: "Type of activity being budgeted"
    - name: "line_status"
      display_name: "Line Status"
      expr: line_status
      comment: "Current status of the budget line"
    - name: "is_milestone_based"
      display_name: "Milestone-Based"
      expr: is_milestone_based
      comment: "Whether this budget line is tied to milestone completion"
    - name: "is_pass_through"
      display_name: "Pass-Through"
      expr: is_pass_through
      comment: "Whether this represents pass-through costs"
    - name: "fiscal_year"
      display_name: "Fiscal Year"
      expr: fiscal_year
      comment: "Fiscal year of the budget line"
    - name: "fiscal_period"
      display_name: "Fiscal Period"
      expr: fiscal_period
      comment: "Fiscal period of the budget line"
    - name: "period_month"
      display_name: "Period Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', period_start_date)
      comment: "Month of the budget period start"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_planned_amount"
      display_name: "Total Planned Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned budget amount"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_actual_amount"
      display_name: "Total Actual Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual spend against budget"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_committed_amount"
      display_name: "Total Committed Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(committed_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total committed but not yet spent amount"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_accrual_amount"
      display_name: "Total Accrual Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(accrual_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total accrued amount for the budget line"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "budget_variance"
      display_name: "Budget Variance"
      expr: SUM((CAST(planned_amount AS DOUBLE)) - (CAST(actual_amount AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Total variance between planned and actual (positive = under budget)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "budget_utilization_rate"
      display_name: "Budget Utilization Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(planned_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of planned budget actually spent"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "commitment_rate"
      display_name: "Commitment Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(committed_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(planned_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of planned budget committed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "budget_line_count"
      display_name: "Budget Line Count"
      expr: COUNT(budget_line_id)
      comment: "Number of budget line items"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_line_planned_amount"
      display_name: "Average Planned Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(planned_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average planned amount per budget line"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Budget line-item performance tracking for planned vs actual spend, commitments, and variance analysis across studies and cost categories

  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`finance`.`sponsor_invoice`"
  dimensions:

      display_name: "Payment Status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Current payment status of the invoice"
    - name: "document_type"
      display_name: "Document Type"
      expr: document_type
      comment: "Type of billing document (invoice, credit memo, etc.)"
    - name: "is_pass_through"
      display_name: "Pass-Through"
      expr: is_pass_through
      comment: "Whether this invoice includes pass-through costs"
    - name: "revenue_recognition_method"
      display_name: "Revenue Recognition Method"
      expr: revenue_recognition_method
      comment: "Method used for revenue recognition"
    - name: "invoice_month"
      display_name: "Invoice Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)
      comment: "Month when the invoice was issued"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "invoice_quarter"
      display_name: "Invoice Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', invoice_date)
      comment: "Quarter when the invoice was issued"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "invoice_year"
      display_name: "Invoice Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', invoice_date)
      comment: "Year when the invoice was issued"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "aging_bucket"
      display_name: "Aging Bucket"
      expr: CASE WHEN payment_received_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Paid' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), due_date) <= 0 THEN 'Current' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), due_date) <= 30 THEN '1-30 Days' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60 Days' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), due_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90 Days' ELSE '90+ Days' END
      comment: "Aging bucket for accounts receivable analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_amount"
      display_name: "Total Gross Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross invoice amount before discounts and taxes"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_net_amount"
      display_name: "Total Net Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net invoice amount after discounts"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      display_name: "Total Tax Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount on invoices"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_amount_paid"
      display_name: "Total Amount Paid"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_paid AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount received from sponsors"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_outstanding_balance"
      display_name: "Total Outstanding Balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total outstanding accounts receivable balance"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_pass_through_amount"
      display_name: "Total Pass-Through Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pass_through_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total pass-through costs billed to sponsors"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "invoice_count"
      display_name: "Invoice Count"
      expr: COUNT(sponsor_invoice_id)
      comment: "Number of sponsor invoices"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_invoice_amount"
      display_name: "Average Invoice Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average net invoice amount"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "collection_rate"
      display_name: "Collection Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_paid AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of invoiced amount collected"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_days_to_payment"
      display_name: "Average Days to Payment"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(payment_received_date, invoice_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from invoice to payment receipt"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "paid_invoice_count"
      display_name: "Paid Invoice Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_received_date IS NOT NULL THEN sponsor_invoice_id END)
      comment: "Number of invoices that have been paid"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "overdue_invoice_count"
      display_name: "Overdue Invoice Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_received_date IS NULL AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN sponsor_invoice_id END)
      comment: "Number of invoices past due date"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`finance_vendor_invoice`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Vendor payables and cost management metrics tracking invoice processing, payment timing, and accounts payable performance"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`finance`.`vendor_invoice`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "invoice_status"
      display_name: "Invoice Status"
      expr: invoice_status
      comment: "Current processing status of the vendor invoice"
    - name: "invoice_type"
      display_name: "Invoice Type"
      expr: invoice_type
      comment: "Type of vendor invoice"
    - name: "is_pass_through"
      display_name: "Pass-Through"
      expr: is_pass_through
      comment: "Whether this is a pass-through cost to be rebilled"
    - name: "payment_method"
      display_name: "Payment Method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Method used for payment"
    - name: "three_way_match_status"
      display_name: "Three-Way Match Status"
      expr: three_way_match_status
      comment: "Status of three-way match (PO, receipt, invoice)"
    - name: "sponsor_reimbursement_status"
      display_name: "Sponsor Reimbursement Status"
      expr: sponsor_reimbursement_status
      comment: "Status of sponsor reimbursement for pass-through costs"
    - name: "invoice_month"
      display_name: "Invoice Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)
      comment: "Month when the invoice was received"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "invoice_quarter"
      display_name: "Invoice Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', invoice_date)
      comment: "Quarter when the invoice was received"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "payment_aging_bucket"
      display_name: "Payment Aging Bucket"
      expr: CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Paid' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), due_date) <= 0 THEN 'Current' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), due_date) <= 30 THEN '1-30 Days' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60 Days' ELSE '60+ Days' END
      comment: "Aging bucket for accounts payable analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_amount"
      display_name: "Total Gross Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross invoice amount from vendors"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_net_amount"
      display_name: "Total Net Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net invoice amount after discounts"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      display_name: "Total Tax Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount on vendor invoices"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_early_payment_discount"
      display_name: "Total Early Payment Discount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(early_payment_discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total early payment discounts captured"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "vendor_invoice_count"
      display_name: "Vendor Invoice Count"
      expr: COUNT(vendor_invoice_id)
      comment: "Number of vendor invoices"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_invoice_amount"
      display_name: "Average Invoice Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average net invoice amount per vendor invoice"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_days_to_payment"
      display_name: "Average Days to Payment"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(payment_date, invoice_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from invoice receipt to payment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "early_payment_discount_capture_rate"
      display_name: "Early Payment Discount Capture Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(early_payment_discount_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of potential early payment discounts captured"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "three_way_match_success_rate"
      display_name: "Three-Way Match Success Rate"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN three_way_match_status = 'Matched' THEN vendor_invoice_id END) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(vendor_invoice_id) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of invoices successfully three-way matched"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "paid_invoice_count"
      display_name: "Paid Invoice Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL THEN vendor_invoice_id END)
      comment: "Number of vendor invoices that have been paid"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "overdue_invoice_count"
      display_name: "Overdue Invoice Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN vendor_invoice_id END)
      comment: "Number of vendor invoices past due date"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Vendor payables and cost management metrics tracking invoice processing, payment timing, and accounts payable performance

        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "Calibration Curve Acceptance Rate"
      display_name: "Calibration Curve Acceptance Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN calibration_curve_accepted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of results with accepted calibration curves"
      format:

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`program_clinical_program`

    - name: "Start Year"

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Programs"
      display_name: "Total Programs"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of clinical programs"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Program Budget"
      display_name: "Total Program Budget"
      expr: SUM(CAST(program_budget AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of all program budgets in program currency"

        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Average Program Budget"
      display_name: "Average Program Budget"
      expr: AVG(CAST(program_budget AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average budget per clinical program"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Global Study Count"
      display_name: "Total Global Study Count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(global_study_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of all studies across all programs"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Average Studies Per Program"
      display_name: "Average Studies Per Program"
      expr: AVG(CAST(global_study_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of studies per clinical program"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Programs with Breakthrough Designation"
      display_name: "Programs with Breakthrough Designation"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN breakthrough_therapy_designation = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of programs with FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Programs with Fast Track Designation"
      display_name: "Programs with Fast Track Designation"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN fast_track_designation = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of programs with FDA Fast Track designation"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Programs with Orphan Drug Designation"
      display_name: "Programs with Orphan Drug Designation"

      comment: "Count of programs with Orphan Drug designation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Designation Rate"

      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (breakthrough_therapy_designation = TRUE OR fast_track_designation = TRUE OR orphan_drug_designation = TRUE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of programs with at least one regulatory designation (Breakthrough, Fast Track, or Orphan)"

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$

    - name: "Phase To"

    - name: "Dissenting Opinion Flag"

      comment: "Whether there was a dissenting opinion"
    - name: "Sponsor Concurrence Flag"
      display_name: "Sponsor Concurrence Flag"

      comment: "Whether the sponsor concurred with the decision"
    - name: "Decision Year"

        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Rejected Decisions"

      comment: "Count of rejected decisions"

        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Conditional Decisions"

      comment: "Count of conditional decisions"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Deferred Decisions"

      comment: "Count of deferred decisions"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Safety Signal Decisions"

    - name: "Dissenting Opinion Decisions"

        decimal_places:

    - name: "Total Investment Amount"

    - name: "Average Investment Amount"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Approval Rate"

    - name: "Rejection Rate"

          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Sponsor Concurrence Rate"
      display_name: "Sponsor Concurrence Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN sponsor_concurrence_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of decisions with sponsor concurrence"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

      expr: discovery_date
      comment: "Date when the deviation was discovered"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Discovery Month"
      display_name: "Discovery Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', discovery_date)
      comment: "Month when deviation was discovered for trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Occurrence Date"
      display_name: "Occurrence Date"
      expr: occurrence_date
      comment: "Date when the deviation actually occurred"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Deviations"
      display_name: "Total Deviations"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of randomization deviations across all studies and sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Open Deviations"
      display_name: "Open Deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN deviation_status = 'open' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations currently open and requiring action"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Resolved Deviations"
      display_name: "Resolved Deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN deviation_status = 'resolved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations that have been resolved"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Critical Deviations"
      display_name: "Critical Deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'critical' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of critical severity deviations requiring immediate escalation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Major Deviations"
      display_name: "Major Deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'major' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of major severity deviations with significant impact"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Minor Deviations"
      display_name: "Minor Deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'minor' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of minor severity deviations with limited impact"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Critical Deviation Rate"
      display_name: "Critical Deviation Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'critical' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations classified as critical, a key quality and risk indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "IRB IEC Reportable Count"
      display_name: "IRB/IEC Reportable Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN irb_iec_reportable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations requiring IRB/IEC reporting"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Reportable Count"
      display_name: "Regulatory Reportable Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_reportable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations requiring regulatory authority reporting"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Reportable Rate"
      display_name: "Regulatory Reportable Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_reportable = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations requiring regulatory reporting, a compliance risk metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Blinding Breach Count"
      display_name: "Blinding Breach Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN blinding_impact IN ('partial', 'complete breach') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations that resulted in blinding breaches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Blinding Breach Rate"
      display_name: "Blinding Breach Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN blinding_impact IN ('partial', 'complete breach') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations causing blinding breaches, a study integrity metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Subject Safety Impact Count"
      display_name: "Subject Safety Impact Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN subject_safety_impact IN ('potential', 'actual') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations with potential or actual subject safety impact"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Subject Discontinuation Count"
      display_name: "Subject Discontinuation Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN subject_continued_in_study = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations resulting in subject discontinuation from study"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Subject Discontinuation Rate"
      display_name: "Subject Discontinuation Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN subject_continued_in_study = FALSE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations leading to subject discontinuation, an enrollment impact metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Sponsor Notified Count"
      display_name: "Sponsor Notified Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN sponsor_notified = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations where sponsor was notified"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Randomization deviation and protocol compliance KPIs tracking deviations, root causes, severity, and impact on study integrity.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`randomization_rand_scheme`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Randomization scheme design and configuration KPIs tracking scheme complexity, stratification, allocation methods, and scheme lifecycle."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`randomization`.`rand_scheme`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study ID"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical study"
    - name: "Rand Scheme ID"
      display_name: "Rand Scheme ID"
      expr: rand_scheme_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the randomization scheme"
    - name: "Scheme Status"
      display_name: "Scheme Status"
      expr: scheme_status
      comment: "Current status of the randomization scheme (draft, approved, active, retired)"
    - name: "Blinding Type"
      display_name: "Blinding Type"
      expr: blinding_type
      comment: "Type of blinding implemented in the scheme (single-blind, double-blind, open-label)"
    - name: "Allocation Algorithm"
      display_name: "Allocation Algorithm"
      expr: allocation_algorithm
      comment: "Algorithm used for treatment allocation (block, stratified, minimization, adaptive)"
    - name: "Generation Method Description"
      display_name: "Generation Method"
      expr: generation_method_description
      comment: "Description of the randomization list generation method"
    - name: "Generation Software"
      display_name: "Generation Software"
      expr: generation_software
      comment: "Software used to generate the randomization scheme"
    - name: "Is Centralized"
      display_name: "Centralized"
      expr: is_centralized
      comment: "Flag indicating whether randomization is centralized (IRT/IWRS)"
    - name: "Is Stratified By Site"
      display_name: "Stratified By Site"
      expr: is_stratified_by_site
      comment: "Flag indicating whether randomization is stratified by site"
    - name: "Is Variable Block"
      display_name: "Variable Block"
      expr: is_variable_block
      comment: "Flag indicating whether variable block sizes are used"
    - name: "IRB IEC Approval Required"
      display_name: "IRB/IEC Approval Required"
      expr: irb_iec_approval_required
      comment: "Flag indicating whether IRB/IEC approval is required for the scheme"
    - name: "Regulatory Submission Flag"
      display_name: "Regulatory Submission"
      expr: regulatory_submission_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating whether scheme is included in regulatory submissions"
    - name: "Geographic Scope"
      display_name: "Geographic Scope"
      expr: geographic_scope
      comment: "Geographic scope of the randomization scheme (global, regional, country-specific)"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Rand Schemes"
      display_name: "Total Rand Schemes"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of randomization schemes defined across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Active Rand Schemes"
      display_name: "Active Rand Schemes"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN scheme_status = 'active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of randomization schemes currently active"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approved Rand Schemes"
      display_name: "Approved Rand Schemes"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN scheme_status = 'approved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of randomization schemes approved but not yet active"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Retired Rand Schemes"
      display_name: "Retired Rand Schemes"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN scheme_status = 'retired' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of randomization schemes retired from use"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Randomization Slots"
      display_name: "Total Randomization Slots"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_randomization_slots AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of total randomization slots across all schemes"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Randomization Slots Per Scheme"
      display_name: "Avg Randomization Slots Per Scheme"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_randomization_slots AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of randomization slots per scheme, indicating study size"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Treatment Arms Per Scheme"
      display_name: "Avg Treatment Arms Per Scheme"
      expr: AVG(CAST(treatment_arm_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of treatment arms per scheme, indicating study complexity"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Strata Per Scheme"
      display_name: "Avg Strata Per Scheme"
      expr: AVG(CAST(strata_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of stratification strata per scheme, indicating design complexity"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Centralized Schemes Count"
      display_name: "Centralized Schemes Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_centralized = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of schemes using centralized randomization (IRT/IWRS)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Centralized Schemes Rate"
      display_name: "Centralized Schemes Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_centralized = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of schemes using centralized randomization, a technology adoption metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Site Stratified Schemes Count"
      display_name: "Site-Stratified Schemes Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_stratified_by_site = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of schemes stratified by site"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Variable Block Schemes Count"
      display_name: "Variable Block Schemes Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_variable_block = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of schemes using variable block sizes for allocation concealment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "IRB IEC Approval Required Count"
      display_name: "IRB/IEC Approval Required Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN irb_iec_approval_required = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of schemes requiring IRB/IEC approval"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Submission Count"
      display_name: "Regulatory Submission Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_submission_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of schemes included in regulatory submissions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Minimization Probability"
      display_name: "Avg Minimization Probability"
      expr: AVG(CAST(minimization_probability AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average minimization probability across schemes using minimization algorithms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
$$
metric_views.description: Randomization scheme design and configuration KPIs tracking scheme complexity, stratification, allocation methods, and scheme lifecycle.
