CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`randomization_stratification_cell`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Stratification cell balance and enrollment KPIs tracking actual vs target enrollment, allocation balance, and cell-level operational status to ensure randomization integrity."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`randomization`.`stratification_cell`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study ID"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical study"
    - name: "Stratification Cell ID"
      display_name: "Stratification Cell ID"
      expr: stratification_cell_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the stratification cell"
    - name: "Cell Status"
      display_name: "Cell Status"
      expr: cell_status
      comment: "Current operational status of the stratification cell (active, suspended, closed)"
    - name: "Cell Balance Status"
      display_name: "Cell Balance Status"
      expr: cell_balance_status
      comment: "Balance status of the cell relative to allocation targets (balanced, imbalanced, critical)"
    - name: "Geographic Region"
      display_name: "Geographic Region"
      expr: geographic_region
      comment: "Geographic region associated with the stratification cell"
    - name: "Is Active for Enrollment"
      display_name: "Active for Enrollment"
      expr: is_active_for_enrollment
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the cell is currently active for enrollment"
    - name: "Is Blinded"
      display_name: "Is Blinded"
      expr: is_blinded
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the cell allocation is blinded"
    - name: "Randomization Method"
      display_name: "Randomization Method"
      expr: randomization_method
      comment: "Randomization method used for the cell (block, adaptive, minimization)"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Stratification Cells"
      display_name: "Total Stratification Cells"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of stratification cells defined across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Active Cells"
      display_name: "Active Cells"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN cell_status = 'active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of stratification cells currently active for enrollment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Closed Cells"
      display_name: "Closed Cells"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN cell_status = 'closed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of stratification cells closed to enrollment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Imbalanced Cells"
      display_name: "Imbalanced Cells"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN cell_balance_status IN ('imbalanced', 'critical') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of stratification cells with allocation imbalance"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Imbalanced Cell Rate"
      display_name: "Imbalanced Cell Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN cell_balance_status IN ('imbalanced', 'critical') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of stratification cells with allocation imbalance, indicating randomization quality"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Target Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Target Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(target_enrollment_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of target enrollment counts across all stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Actual Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Actual Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_enrolled_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of actual enrolled subjects across all stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Randomized"
      display_name: "Total Randomized"
      expr: SUM(CAST(randomized_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of randomized subjects across all stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Screened"
      display_name: "Total Screened"
      expr: SUM(CAST(screened_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of screened subjects across all stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Withdrawn"
      display_name: "Total Withdrawn"
      expr: SUM(CAST(withdrawn_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of withdrawn subjects across all stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Minimum Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Minimum Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(minimum_enrollment_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of minimum enrollment thresholds across all stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Maximum Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Maximum Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(maximum_enrollment_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of maximum enrollment caps across all stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Average Block Size"
      display_name: "Avg Block Size"
      expr: AVG(CAST(block_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average block size used across stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Average Balance Tolerance Pct"
      display_name: "Avg Balance Tolerance %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(balance_tolerance_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average balance tolerance percentage across stratification cells"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Unique Studies"
      display_name: "Unique Studies"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT study_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of studies with defined stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unique Treatment Arms"
      display_name: "Unique Treatment Arms"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT treatment_arm_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of treatment arms associated with stratification cells"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Stratification cell balance and enrollment KPIs tracking actual vs target enrollment, allocation balance, and cell-level operational status to ensure randomization integrity.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`randomization_subject_randomization`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core randomization KPIs tracking subject enrollment, randomization velocity, treatment allocation balance, and protocol compliance across studies and sites."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`randomization`.`subject_randomization`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study ID"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical study"
    - name: "Study Site ID"
      display_name: "Study Site ID"
      expr: study_site_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the study site where randomization occurred"
    - name: "Treatment Arm ID"
      display_name: "Treatment Arm ID"
      expr: treatment_arm_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the assigned treatment arm"
    - name: "Randomization Status"
      display_name: "Randomization Status"
      expr: randomization_status
      comment: "Current status of the randomization record (active, cancelled, completed)"
    - name: "Randomization Type"
      display_name: "Randomization Type"
      expr: randomization_type
      comment: "Type of randomization performed (initial, re-randomization, emergency)"
    - name: "Blinding Type"
      display_name: "Blinding Type"
      expr: blinding_type
      comment: "Type of blinding applied (single-blind, double-blind, open-label)"
    - name: "Country Code"
      display_name: "Country"
      expr: country_code
      comment: "ISO country code where randomization occurred"
    - name: "Randomization Date"
      display_name: "Randomization Date"
      expr: randomization_date
      comment: "Date when subject was randomized"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Randomization Year"
      display_name: "Randomization Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', randomization_date)
      comment: "Year of randomization for annual trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Randomization Quarter"
      display_name: "Randomization Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', randomization_date)
      comment: "Quarter of randomization for quarterly trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Randomization Month"
      display_name: "Randomization Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', randomization_date)
      comment: "Month of randomization for monthly trending and time-intelligence"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Randomization Week"
      display_name: "Randomization Week"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('week', randomization_date)
      comment: "Week of randomization for weekly trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Is Unblinded"
      display_name: "Unblinded Flag"
      expr: is_unblinded
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the randomization has been unblinded"
    - name: "Eligibility Confirmed"
      display_name: "Eligibility Confirmed"
      expr: eligibility_confirmed
      comment: "Flag indicating whether subject eligibility was confirmed prior to randomization"
    - name: "Block Number"
      display_name: "Block Number"
      expr: block_number
      comment: "Randomization block number for stratified designs"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Randomizations"
      display_name: "Total Randomizations"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of subject randomization events across all studies and sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unique Subjects Randomized"
      display_name: "Unique Subjects Randomized"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of subjects who have been randomized, excluding re-randomizations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Active Randomizations"
      display_name: "Active Randomizations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN randomization_status = 'active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of randomizations currently in active status"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Cancelled Randomizations"
      display_name: "Cancelled Randomizations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN randomization_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of randomizations that were cancelled after assignment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Cancellation Rate"
      display_name: "Cancellation Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN randomization_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of randomizations that were cancelled, indicating protocol deviations or enrollment issues"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Re-Randomizations"
      display_name: "Re-Randomizations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN rerandomization_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of subjects who required re-randomization due to protocol deviations or other issues"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Re-Randomization Rate"
      display_name: "Re-Randomization Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN rerandomization_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of randomizations requiring re-randomization, a quality indicator for protocol execution"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Unblinded Randomizations"
      display_name: "Unblinded Randomizations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_unblinded = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of randomizations that have been unblinded for safety or other reasons"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unblinding Rate"
      display_name: "Unblinding Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_unblinded = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of randomizations unblinded, a critical safety and protocol compliance metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Eligibility Confirmed Count"
      display_name: "Eligibility Confirmed Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN eligibility_confirmed = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of randomizations where subject eligibility was confirmed prior to randomization"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Eligibility Confirmation Rate"
      display_name: "Eligibility Confirmation Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN eligibility_confirmed = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of randomizations with confirmed eligibility, a protocol compliance quality metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Randomizations CM"
      display_name: "Randomizations (Current Month)"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Current month randomizations for time-intelligence comparison"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Randomization Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Randomizations PM"
      display_name: "Randomizations (Prior Month)"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Prior month randomizations for month-over-month growth calculation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Randomization Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Randomizations MoM Growth"
      display_name: "Randomizations MoM Growth (%)"
      expr: SUM(CAST((ROUND(100.0 * (AGG(Randomizations CM) - AGG(Randomizations PM)) / NULLIF(AGG(Randomizations PM), 0), 2)) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Month-over-month growth rate in randomizations, a key enrollment velocity indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Randomizations MTD"
      display_name: "Randomizations (MTD)"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Month-to-date cumulative randomizations for in-month tracking"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Randomization Date
          range: cumulative
          semiadditive: last
        - order: Randomization Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Randomizations 7D Rolling"
      display_name: "Randomizations (7-Day Rolling)"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "7-day rolling sum of randomizations for short-term velocity tracking"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Randomization Date
          range: trailing 7 day inclusive
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Randomizations 30D Rolling"
      display_name: "Randomizations (30-Day Rolling)"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "30-day rolling sum of randomizations for medium-term velocity trending"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Randomization Date
          range: trailing 30 day inclusive
          semiadditive: last
$$
metric_views.description: Core randomization KPIs tracking subject enrollment, randomization velocity, treatment allocation balance, and protocol compliance across studies and sites.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`randomization_treatment_arm`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Treatment arm allocation and balance KPIs tracking planned vs actual enrollment, allocation ratios, and arm-level performance across studies."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`randomization`.`treatment_arm`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study ID"
      expr: study_id

    - name: "Treatment Arm ID"
      display_name: "Treatment Arm ID"
      expr: treatment_arm_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the treatment arm"
    - name: "Arm Type"
      display_name: "Arm Type"
      expr: arm_type
      comment: "Type of treatment arm (experimental, control, placebo, active comparator)"
    - name: "Arm Status"
      display_name: "Arm Status"
      expr: arm_status
      comment: "Current status of the treatment arm (active, suspended, closed)"
    - name: "Is Control Arm"
      display_name: "Control Arm Flag"
      expr: is_control_arm
      comment: "Flag indicating whether this is the control arm"
    - name: "Blinding Role"
      display_name: "Blinding Role"
      expr: blinding_role
      comment: "Blinding role for this treatment arm (blinded, unblinded, open-label)"
    - name: "Randomization Method"
      display_name: "Randomization Method"
      expr: randomization_method
      comment: "Randomization method used for this arm (block, stratified, adaptive)"
    - name: "Route of Administration"
      display_name: "Route of Administration"
      expr: route_of_administration
      comment: "Route of administration for the treatment (oral, IV, subcutaneous)"
    - name: "Dose Level"
      display_name: "Dose Level"
      expr: dose_level
      comment: "Dose level for this treatment arm"
    - name: "Analysis Population"
      display_name: "Analysis Population"
      expr: analysis_population
      comment: "Analysis population designation for this arm (ITT, PP, safety)"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Treatment Arms"
      display_name: "Total Treatment Arms"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of treatment arms defined across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Active Treatment Arms"
      display_name: "Active Treatment Arms"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN arm_status = 'active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of treatment arms currently active for enrollment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Suspended Treatment Arms"
      display_name: "Suspended Treatment Arms"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN arm_status = 'suspended' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of treatment arms temporarily suspended from enrollment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Planned Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Planned Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of planned subject counts across all treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Min Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Min Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(min_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of minimum required subject counts across all treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Max Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Max Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(max_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of maximum allowed subject counts across all treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Planned Enrollment Per Arm"
      display_name: "Avg Planned Enrollment Per Arm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(planned_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average planned enrollment per treatment arm, indicating study size and complexity"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Target Allocation Pct"
      display_name: "Avg Target Allocation (%)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_allocation_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target allocation percentage across treatment arms, should balance to 100% within study"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Allocation Ratio Numerator"
      display_name: "Avg Allocation Ratio Numerator"
      expr: AVG(CAST(allocation_ratio_numerator AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average allocation ratio numerator across treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Allocation Ratio Denominator"
      display_name: "Avg Allocation Ratio Denominator"
      expr: AVG(CAST(allocation_ratio_denominator AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average allocation ratio denominator across treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Control Arms Count"
      display_name: "Control Arms Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_control_arm = TRUE THEN 1 END)

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Experimental Arms Count"
      display_name: "Experimental Arms Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_control_arm = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of experimental (non-control) arms across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Washout Period Days"
      display_name: "Avg Washout Period (Days)"

      comment: "Average washout period in days across treatment arms with crossover designs"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`randomization_unblinding_request`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Unblinding request and emergency unblinding KPIs tracking request volume, approval rates, turnaround time, and reasons for unblinding."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`randomization`.`unblinding_request`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study ID"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical study"
    - name: "Study Site ID"
      display_name: "Study Site ID"
      expr: study_site_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the study site submitting the request"
    - name: "Request Status"
      display_name: "Request Status"
      expr: request_status
      comment: "Current status of the unblinding request (submitted, under review, approved, denied)"
    - name: "Unblinding Reason"
      display_name: "Unblinding Reason"
      expr: unblinding_reason
      comment: "Primary reason for the unblinding request (SAE, medical emergency, protocol deviation)"
    - name: "Unblinding Scope"
      display_name: "Unblinding Scope"
      expr: unblinding_scope
      comment: "Scope of unblinding requested (subject-level, site-level, study-level)"
    - name: "Urgency Level"
      display_name: "Urgency Level"
      expr: urgency_level
      comment: "Urgency classification of the request (routine, urgent, emergency)"
    - name: "Final Outcome"
      display_name: "Final Outcome"
      expr: final_outcome
      comment: "Final outcome of the unblinding request (approved, denied, withdrawn)"
    - name: "Requestor Role"
      display_name: "Requestor Role"
      expr: requestor_role
      comment: "Role of the person requesting unblinding (investigator, CRA, medical monitor)"
    - name: "Approver 1 Decision"
      display_name: "Approver 1 Decision"
      expr: approver_1_decision
      comment: "Decision of the first approver (approved, denied, escalated)"
    - name: "Approver 2 Decision"
      display_name: "Approver 2 Decision"
      expr: approver_2_decision
      comment: "Decision of the second approver if escalation required"
    - name: "Blinding Broken Flag"
      display_name: "Blinding Broken"
      expr: blinding_broken_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating whether blinding was actually broken"
    - name: "Protocol Deviation Raised"
      display_name: "Protocol Deviation Raised"
      expr: protocol_deviation_raised
      comment: "Flag indicating whether a protocol deviation was raised as a result"
    - name: "IRB IEC Notification Required"
      display_name: "IRB/IEC Notification Required"
      expr: irb_iec_notification_required
      comment: "Flag indicating whether IRB/IEC notification is required"
    - name: "DSMB DMC Referral Flag"
      display_name: "DSMB/DMC Referral"
      expr: dsmb_dmc_referral_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating whether case was referred to DSMB/DMC"
    - name: "Submitted Date"
      display_name: "Submitted Date"
      expr: submitted_timestamp
      comment: "Timestamp when the unblinding request was submitted"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submitted Month"
      display_name: "Submitted Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', submitted_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when request was submitted for trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Unblinding Requests"
      display_name: "Total Unblinding Requests"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of unblinding requests submitted across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approved Requests"
      display_name: "Approved Requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN final_outcome = 'approved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of unblinding requests that were approved"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Denied Requests"
      display_name: "Denied Requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN final_outcome = 'denied' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of unblinding requests that were denied"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approval Rate"
      display_name: "Approval Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN final_outcome = 'approved' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN final_outcome IN ('approved', 'denied') THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of unblinding requests approved, indicating appropriateness of requests"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Emergency Requests"
      display_name: "Emergency Requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN urgency_level = 'emergency' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of emergency unblinding requests requiring immediate action"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Emergency Request Rate"
      display_name: "Emergency Request Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN urgency_level = 'emergency' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of requests classified as emergency, a safety signal metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "SAE Related Requests"
      display_name: "SAE-Related Requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN unblinding_reason LIKE '%SAE%' OR unblinding_reason LIKE '%adverse%' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of unblinding requests related to serious adverse events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Blinding Actually Broken Count"
      display_name: "Blinding Broken Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN blinding_broken_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of requests where blinding was actually broken"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Blinding Broken Rate"
      display_name: "Blinding Broken Rate (%)"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN blinding_broken_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of requests resulting in actual blinding breach, a study integrity metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Protocol Deviation Raised Count"
      display_name: "Protocol Deviation Raised Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN protocol_deviation_raised = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of unblinding requests that triggered protocol deviation reporting"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "IRB IEC Notification Count"
      display_name: "IRB/IEC Notification Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN irb_iec_notification_required = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of requests requiring IRB/IEC notification"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "DSMB DMC Referral Count"
      display_name: "DSMB/DMC Referral Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN dsmb_dmc_referral_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of requests referred to DSMB/DMC for review"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Multi Level Approval Count"
      display_name: "Multi-Level Approval Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_level_count > 1 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of requests requiring multiple approval levels"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Withdrawn Requests"
      display_name: "Withdrawn Requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN final_outcome = 'withdrawn' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of unblinding requests withdrawn before decision"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Unblinding request and emergency unblinding KPIs tracking request volume, approval rates, turnaround time, and reasons for unblinding.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`regulatory_agency_meeting`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Regulatory agency meeting metrics tracking meeting outcomes, action item closure, response timeliness, and strategic engagement effectiveness"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`regulatory`.`agency_meeting`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Meeting Type"
      display_name: "Meeting Type"
      expr: meeting_type
      comment: "Type of agency meeting (Type A, Type B, Type C, pre-IND, EOP2, pre-NDA, etc.)"
    - name: "Meeting Status"
      display_name: "Meeting Status"
      expr: meeting_status
      comment: "Current status of the meeting (requested, scheduled, held, cancelled)"
    - name: "Meeting Stage"
      display_name: "Meeting Stage"
      expr: meeting_stage
      comment: "Development stage at which the meeting occurs"
    - name: "Outcome Classification"
      display_name: "Outcome Classification"
      expr: outcome_classification
      comment: "Classification of the meeting outcome (favorable, neutral, unfavorable)"
    - name: "Meeting Format"
      display_name: "Meeting Format"
      expr: meeting_format
      comment: "Format of the meeting (face-to-face, teleconference, written response only)"
    - name: "Therapeutic Area"
      display_name: "Therapeutic Area"
      expr: therapeutic_area
      comment: "Therapeutic area discussed in the meeting"
    - name: "Meeting Year"
      display_name: "Meeting Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', confirmed_meeting_date)
      comment: "Year of confirmed meeting date for annual trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Meetings"
      display_name: "Total Meetings"
      expr: COUNT(agency_meeting_id)
      comment: "Total count of regulatory agency meetings"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Held Meetings"
      display_name: "Held Meetings"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN meeting_status = 'Held' THEN agency_meeting_id END)
      comment: "Count of meetings that have been held"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Action Items"
      display_name: "Total Action Items"
      expr: SUM(CAST(action_items_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of action items generated from all meetings"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Open Action Items"
      display_name: "Open Action Items"
      expr: SUM(CAST(open_action_items_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of open action items not yet closed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Action Item Closure Rate"
      display_name: "Action Item Closure Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CAST(action_items_count AS DOUBLE)) - SUM(CAST(open_action_items_count AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(action_items_count AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of action items that have been closed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Action Items Per Meeting"
      display_name: "Avg Action Items Per Meeting"
      expr: AVG(CAST(action_items_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of action items generated per meeting"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Favorable Outcome Rate"
      display_name: "Favorable Outcome Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN outcome_classification = 'Favorable' THEN agency_meeting_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN outcome_classification IS NOT NULL THEN agency_meeting_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of meetings with favorable outcome classification"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Request to Meeting Days"
      display_name: "Avg Request to Meeting (Days)"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(confirmed_meeting_date, request_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from meeting request to confirmed meeting date"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Agency Response Days"
      display_name: "Avg Agency Response (Days)"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(agency_response_date, confirmed_meeting_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from meeting date to agency response"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Follow-Up Required Rate"
      display_name: "Follow-Up Required Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN follow_up_submission_required = TRUE THEN agency_meeting_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(agency_meeting_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of meetings requiring follow-up submission"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Regulatory agency meeting metrics tracking meeting outcomes, action item closure, response timeliness, and strategic engagement effectiveness

      comment: "Percentage of applications that have experienced a clinical hold at any point"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:

          places: 2
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`regulatory_commitment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Post-marketing commitment and requirement tracking metrics measuring completion rates, timeliness, and compliance with agency-mandated obligations"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`regulatory`.`commitment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Commitment Type"
      display_name: "Commitment Type"
      expr: commitment_type
      comment: "Type of regulatory commitment (PMR, PMC, REMS, pediatric study, etc.)"
    - name: "Commitment Status"
      display_name: "Commitment Status"
      expr: commitment_status
      comment: "Current status of the commitment (pending, ongoing, completed, delayed, released)"
    - name: "Commitment Category"
      display_name: "Commitment Category"
      expr: commitment_category
      comment: "Category classification of the commitment"
    - name: "Priority Level"
      display_name: "Priority Level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Priority level assigned to the commitment"
    - name: "Is Binding"
      display_name: "Binding Commitment"
      expr: is_binding
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the commitment is legally binding"
    - name: "Is Pediatric"
      display_name: "Pediatric Commitment"
      expr: is_pediatric
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the commitment is pediatric-related"
    - name: "Accelerated Approval Condition"
      display_name: "Accelerated Approval Condition"
      expr: accelerated_approval_condition
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the commitment is a condition of accelerated approval"
    - name: "Due Year"
      display_name: "Due Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', due_date)
      comment: "Year of commitment due date for trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Commitments"
      display_name: "Total Commitments"
      expr: COUNT(commitment_id)
      comment: "Total count of regulatory commitments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Completed Commitments"
      display_name: "Completed Commitments"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN commitment_status = 'Completed' THEN commitment_id END)
      comment: "Count of commitments that have been completed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Completion Rate"
      display_name: "Completion Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN commitment_status = 'Completed' THEN commitment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(commitment_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commitments that have been completed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Overdue Commitments"
      display_name: "Overdue Commitments"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND commitment_status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Released') THEN commitment_id END)
      comment: "Count of commitments past their due date that are not yet completed or released"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Overdue Rate"
      display_name: "Overdue Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND commitment_status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Released') THEN commitment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN commitment_status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Released') THEN commitment_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of active commitments that are overdue"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Binding Commitments"
      display_name: "Binding Commitments"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_binding = TRUE THEN commitment_id END)
      comment: "Count of legally binding commitments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Pediatric Commitments"
      display_name: "Pediatric Commitments"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_pediatric = TRUE THEN commitment_id END)
      comment: "Count of pediatric-related commitments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Completion Time Days"
      display_name: "Avg Completion Time (Days)"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(completion_date, approval_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from commitment approval to completion for completed commitments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "On-Time Completion Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Completion Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN completion_date <= due_date THEN commitment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN completion_date IS NOT NULL THEN commitment_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of completed commitments that were completed on or before the due date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Post-marketing commitment and requirement tracking metrics measuring completion rates, timeliness, and compliance with agency-mandated obligations

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`regulatory_inspection`

    - name: "Warning Letter Rate"

    - name: "CAPA Required Rate"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`regulatory_program_milestone`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Regulatory program milestone performance metrics tracking on-time delivery, variance, critical path adherence, and probability-weighted forecasting"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`regulatory`.`regulatory_program_milestone`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Milestone Type"
      display_name: "Milestone Type"
      expr: milestone_type
      comment: "Type of regulatory milestone (submission, approval, meeting, report, etc.)"
    - name: "Milestone Status"
      display_name: "Milestone Status"
      expr: milestone_status
      comment: "Current status of the milestone (planned, in progress, completed, delayed, cancelled)"
    - name: "Milestone Category"
      display_name: "Milestone Category"
      expr: milestone_category
      comment: "Category classification of the milestone"
    - name: "Phase"
      display_name: "Phase"
      expr: phase
      comment: "Development phase associated with the milestone"
    - name: "Is Critical Path"
      display_name: "Critical Path Milestone"
      expr: is_critical_path
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the milestone is on the critical path"
    - name: "Is Agency Committed"
      display_name: "Agency Committed"
      expr: is_agency_committed
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the agency has committed to a date"
    - name: "Priority Designation"
      display_name: "Priority Designation"
      expr: priority_designation
      comment: "Priority designation assigned to the milestone"
    - name: "Planned Year"
      display_name: "Planned Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', planned_date)
      comment: "Year of planned milestone date for trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Actual Year"
      display_name: "Actual Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', actual_date)
      comment: "Year of actual milestone completion for trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Milestones"
      display_name: "Total Milestones"
      expr: COUNT(regulatory_program_milestone_id)
      comment: "Total count of regulatory program milestones"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Completed Milestones"
      display_name: "Completed Milestones"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN milestone_status = 'Completed' THEN regulatory_program_milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of milestones that have been completed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "On-Time Milestones"
      display_name: "On-Time Milestones"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_date <= planned_date THEN regulatory_program_milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of milestones completed on or before the planned date"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "On-Time Delivery Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Delivery Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_date <= planned_date THEN regulatory_program_milestone_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_date IS NOT NULL THEN regulatory_program_milestone_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of completed milestones delivered on or before the planned date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Delayed Milestones"
      display_name: "Delayed Milestones"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN milestone_status = 'Delayed' OR (actual_date > planned_date) THEN regulatory_program_milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of milestones that are delayed or were completed late"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Critical Path Milestones"
      display_name: "Critical Path Milestones"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_critical_path = TRUE THEN regulatory_program_milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of milestones on the critical path"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Variance Days"
      display_name: "Avg Variance (Days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(variance_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average variance in days between planned and actual milestone dates (positive = late, negative = early)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Total Variance Days"
      display_name: "Total Variance (Days)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(variance_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cumulative variance in days across all completed milestones"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Probability of Success"
      display_name: "Avg Probability of Success"
      expr: AVG(CAST(probability_of_success_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average probability of success percentage across all milestones"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "At-Risk Milestones"
      display_name: "At-Risk Milestones"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN planned_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND milestone_status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled') THEN regulatory_program_milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of milestones past their planned date that are not yet completed or cancelled"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Regulatory program milestone performance metrics tracking on-time delivery, variance, critical path adherence, and probability-weighted forecasting

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`regulatory_submission`

    - name: "Submission Type"

    - name: "Submission Status"
      display_name: "Submission Status"
      expr: submission_status
      comment: "Current status of the submission (submitted, under review, approved, rejected, withdrawn)"

    - name: "Submission Quarter"

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submission Month"

        leading_zeros: true

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`safety_adverse_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Core adverse event KPIs tracking incidence, severity, seriousness, and regulatory reporting performance across studies and sites"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`safety`.`adverse_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study ID"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical study"
    - name: "Site ID"
      display_name: "Site ID"
      expr: investigational_site_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the investigational site"
    - name: "Is Serious"
      display_name: "Serious AE Flag"
      expr: is_serious
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the adverse event meets seriousness criteria"
    - name: "Is SUSAR"
      display_name: "SUSAR Flag"
      expr: is_susar
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the event is a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction"
    - name: "Is TEAE"
      display_name: "TEAE Flag"
      expr: is_teae
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the event is a Treatment-Emergent Adverse Event"
    - name: "Severity"
      display_name: "Severity"
      expr: severity
      comment: "Severity or intensity grade of the adverse event"
    - name: "Outcome"
      display_name: "Outcome"
      expr: outcome
      comment: "Final outcome of the adverse event"
    - name: "CTCAE Grade"
      display_name: "CTCAE Grade"
      expr: ctcae_grade
      comment: "Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events grade (1-5)"
    - name: "MedDRA SOC"
      display_name: "MedDRA SOC"
      expr: meddra_soc_name
      comment: "MedDRA System Organ Class name for the adverse event"
    - name: "MedDRA PT"
      display_name: "MedDRA PT"
      expr: meddra_pt_name
      comment: "MedDRA Preferred Term name for the adverse event"
    - name: "Onset Year"
      display_name: "Onset Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', onset_date)
      comment: "Year of adverse event onset"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Onset Quarter"
      display_name: "Onset Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', onset_date)
      comment: "Quarter of adverse event onset"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Onset Month"
      display_name: "Onset Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', onset_date)
      comment: "Month of adverse event onset"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Report Type"
      display_name: "Report Type"
      expr: report_type
      comment: "Type of regulatory report (initial, follow-up, etc.)"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Adverse Events"
      display_name: "Total AEs"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of adverse event records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unique Subjects with AEs"
      display_name: "Subjects with AEs"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Count of unique subjects experiencing at least one adverse event"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Serious Adverse Events"
      display_name: "SAEs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_serious = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of adverse events meeting seriousness criteria"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "SUSAR Count"
      display_name: "SUSARs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions requiring expedited reporting"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Treatment-Emergent AEs"

      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_teae = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of adverse events emerging during or after treatment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Grade 3-5 Events"
      display_name: "Grade 3+ AEs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN ctcae_grade >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of severe, life-threatening, or fatal adverse events (CTCAE grade 3 or higher)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Seriousness Rate"
      display_name: "SAE Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_serious = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of adverse events meeting seriousness criteria"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "SUSAR Rate"
      display_name: "SUSAR Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of adverse events classified as SUSARs"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Regulatory Reports Overdue"
      display_name: "Overdue Reports"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN regulatory_report_due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND regulatory_report_submitted_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of adverse events with overdue regulatory reports"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "On-Time Reporting Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN regulatory_report_submitted_date <= regulatory_report_due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN regulatory_report_submitted_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of regulatory reports submitted by deadline"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Core adverse event KPIs tracking incidence, severity, seriousness, and regulatory reporting performance across studies and sites

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`safety_serious_adverse_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Serious adverse event metrics tracking SAE incidence, causality, expectedness, and regulatory reporting timeliness"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`safety`.`adverse_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Clinical study identifier"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Is SUSAR"
      display_name: "SUSAR Flag"
      expr: is_susar
      comment: "Whether the SAE is a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction"
    - name: "Causality Assessment"
      display_name: "Causality"
      expr: causality_assessment
      comment: "Investigator causality assessment (related, not related, possibly related, etc.)"
    - name: "Outcome"
      display_name: "SAE Outcome"
      expr: outcome
      comment: "Final outcome of the serious adverse event"
    - name: "CTCAE Grade"
      display_name: "CTCAE Grade"
      expr: ctcae_grade
      comment: "CTCAE severity grade (1-5)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "DSMB Reported"
      display_name: "DSMB Reported"
      expr: dsmb_reported
      comment: "Whether the SAE was reported to the Data Safety Monitoring Board"
    - name: "Onset Year"
      display_name: "Onset Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', onset_date)
      comment: "Year of SAE onset"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Onset Month"
      display_name: "Onset Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', onset_date)
      comment: "Month of SAE onset"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total SAEs"
      display_name: "Total SAEs"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of serious adverse event records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Unique Subjects with SAEs"
      display_name: "Subjects with SAEs"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct trial subjects experiencing at least one serious adverse event"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "SUSAR Count"
      display_name: "SUSARs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of SUSARs (Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Related SAEs"
      display_name: "Related SAEs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN causality_assessment LIKE '%related%' OR causality_assessment LIKE '%Related%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of SAEs assessed as related to investigational product"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Grade 4-5 SAEs"
      display_name: "Grade 4-5 SAEs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN ctcae_grade >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of SAEs with CTCAE grade 4 (life-threatening) or 5 (death)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "DSMB Reported SAEs"
      display_name: "DSMB Reported SAEs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN dsmb_reported = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of SAEs reported to Data Safety Monitoring Board"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Reports Overdue"
      display_name: "Overdue Reports"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN regulatory_report_due_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of SAEs with overdue regulatory reports"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "SUSAR Rate"
      display_name: "SUSAR Rate"
      expr: CAST(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(1) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Proportion of SAEs that are SUSARs (SUSAR count / total SAE count)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Related SAE Rate"
      display_name: "Related SAE Rate"
      expr: CAST(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN causality_assessment LIKE '%related%' OR causality_assessment LIKE '%Related%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(1) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Proportion of SAEs assessed as related to investigational product"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Serious adverse event metrics tracking SAE incidence, causality, expectedness, and regulatory reporting timeliness

    - name: "Avg Days Overdue"
      display_name: "Avg Days Overdue"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_overdue AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days overdue for late reports"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Applicable Deadline Days"
      display_name: "Avg Deadline Days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(applicable_deadline_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average reporting deadline in days (typically 7 or 15)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "On-Time Reporting Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Reporting Rate"
      expr: CAST(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_on_time = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(1) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Proportion of reports submitted on or before the deadline"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Overdue Reporting Rate"
      display_name: "Overdue Reporting Rate"
      expr: CAST(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_on_time = FALSE OR days_overdue > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(1) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Proportion of reports submitted after the deadline or currently overdue"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Fatal or Life-Threatening Rate"
      display_name: "Fatal/Life-Threatening Rate"
      expr: CAST(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_fatal_or_life_threatening = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(1) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Proportion of reports for fatal or life-threatening events"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Unexpected Event Rate"
      display_name: "Unexpected Event Rate"
      expr: CAST(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_unexpected = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(1) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Proportion of reports for unexpected events"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "DSMB Notification Rate"
      display_name: "DSMB Notification Rate"
      expr: CAST(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN dsmb_notified = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(1) AS DOUBLE), 0)
      comment: "Proportion of reports where DSMB was notified"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Expedited safety reporting deadline metrics tracking regulatory reporting timeliness, compliance, and overdue reports

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`safety_icsr`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Individual Case Safety Report KPIs tracking regulatory submission timeliness, acknowledgement rates, and SUSAR reporting compliance"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`safety`.`icsr`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Study identifier for study-specific ICSR tracking"
    - name: "Health Authority ID"
      display_name: "Health Authority"
      expr: health_authority_id
      comment: "Health authority identifier for authority-specific submission tracking"
    - name: "Submission Status"
      display_name: "Submission Status"
      expr: submission_status
      comment: "Current status of the ICSR submission (draft, submitted, acknowledged, rejected)"
    - name: "Report Type"
      display_name: "Report Type"
      expr: report_type
      comment: "Type of ICSR report (initial, follow-up, final)"
    - name: "Submission Method"
      display_name: "Submission Method"
      expr: submission_method
      comment: "Method used for ICSR submission (E2B, gateway, portal)"
    - name: "Is SUSAR"
      display_name: "SUSAR Flag"
      expr: is_susar
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether the ICSR is for a SUSAR"
    - name: "Is Fatal"
      display_name: "Fatal Flag"
      expr: is_fatal
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether the case resulted in death"
    - name: "Is Life Threatening"
      display_name: "Life-Threatening Flag"
      expr: is_life_threatening
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether the case was life-threatening"
    - name: "Is On Time"
      display_name: "On-Time Flag"
      expr: is_on_time
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether submission met regulatory deadline"
    - name: "DSMB Notified"
      display_name: "DSMB Notified"
      expr: dsmb_notified
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether DSMB was notified of the case"
    - name: "IRB IEC Notified"
      display_name: "IRB/IEC Notified"
      expr: irb_iec_notified
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether IRB/IEC was notified of the case"
    - name: "Is Current Version"
      display_name: "Current Version"
      expr: is_current_version
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current version of the ICSR"
    - name: "MedDRA SOC"
      display_name: "SOC Code"
      expr: meddra_soc_code
      comment: "MedDRA System Organ Class code for therapeutic area grouping"
    - name: "MedDRA PT"
      display_name: "PT Code"
      expr: meddra_pt_code
      comment: "MedDRA Preferred Term code for standardized case classification"
    - name: "Submission Month"
      display_name: "Submission Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', submission_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of submission date for temporal trend analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Awareness Month"
      display_name: "Awareness Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', awareness_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of awareness date for reporting timeline tracking"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Total ICSRs"
      expr: COUNT(icsr_id)
      comment: "Total number of Individual Case Safety Reports submitted"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "SUSAR ICSR Count"
      display_name: "SUSAR ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs for SUSARs requiring expedited reporting"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Fatal ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Fatal ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_fatal = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs for fatal cases, highest severity outcome"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Life Threatening ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Life-Threatening ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_life_threatening = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs for life-threatening cases requiring immediate attention"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "On Time Submission Count"
      display_name: "On-Time Submissions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_on_time = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs submitted within regulatory deadline"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Acknowledged ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Acknowledged ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN acknowledgement_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs acknowledged by health authority"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Rejected ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Rejected ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN submission_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs rejected by health authority, quality indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "On Time Submission Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_on_time = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs submitted on time, key regulatory compliance metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Acknowledgement Rate"
      display_name: "Acknowledgement %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN acknowledgement_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs acknowledged by health authority, measures submission quality"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Rejection Rate"
      display_name: "Rejection %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN submission_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs rejected, inverse quality indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "SUSAR Rate"
      display_name: "SUSAR %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs for SUSARs, key safety signal indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Fatal Case Rate"
      display_name: "Fatality %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_fatal = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs for fatal cases, highest severity metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Days to Submission"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Submission"
      expr: AVG(CAST(CAST(DATEDIFF(submission_date, awareness_date) AS DOUBLE) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days from awareness to submission, measures reporting efficiency"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Days to Acknowledgement"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Acknowledgement"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(acknowledgement_date, submission_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days from submission to health authority acknowledgement"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Distinct Subjects in ICSRs"
      display_name: "Subjects with ICSRs"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Number of unique subjects with ICSRs submitted"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
$$
metric_views.description: Individual Case Safety Report KPIs tracking regulatory submission timeliness, acknowledgement rates, and SUSAR reporting compliance

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`safety_signal`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Safety signal detection and evaluation KPIs tracking signal identification, assessment cycle time, and regulatory action outcomes"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`safety`.`signal`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study ID"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical study"
    - name: "Clinical Program ID"
      display_name: "Program ID"
      expr: clinical_program_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical development program"
    - name: "Signal Status"
      display_name: "Signal Status"
      expr: signal_status
      comment: "Current status of the safety signal (open, under evaluation, closed, etc.)"
    - name: "Priority"
      display_name: "Priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Priority level assigned to the safety signal"
    - name: "Detection Method"
      display_name: "Detection Method"
      expr: detection_method
      comment: "Method used to detect the safety signal (statistical, clinical review, etc.)"
    - name: "Final Disposition"
      display_name: "Final Disposition"
      expr: final_disposition
      comment: "Final outcome of signal evaluation (confirmed, refuted, requires further monitoring)"
    - name: "DSMB Referred"
      display_name: "DSMB Referred"
      expr: is_dsmb_referred
      comment: "Flag indicating whether signal was referred to Data Safety Monitoring Board"
    - name: "Expedited Reporting Required"
      display_name: "Expedited Reporting"
      expr: is_expedited_reporting_required
      comment: "Flag indicating whether signal requires expedited regulatory reporting"
    - name: "Detection Year"
      display_name: "Detection Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', detection_date)
      comment: "Year of signal detection"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Detection Quarter"
      display_name: "Detection Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', detection_date)
      comment: "Quarter of signal detection"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Detection Month"
      display_name: "Detection Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', detection_date)
      comment: "Month of signal detection"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Signals"
      display_name: "Total Signals"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of safety signals detected"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Open Signals"
      display_name: "Open Signals"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN signal_status IN ('Open', 'Under Evaluation') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of signals currently open or under evaluation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Confirmed Signals"
      display_name: "Confirmed Signals"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN final_disposition = 'Confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of signals confirmed as true safety concerns"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Refuted Signals"
      display_name: "Refuted Signals"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN final_disposition = 'Refuted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of signals refuted after evaluation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "DSMB Referrals"
      display_name: "DSMB Referrals"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_dsmb_referred = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of signals referred to Data Safety Monitoring Board"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Signals Requiring Expedited Reporting"
      display_name: "Expedited Signals"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_expedited_reporting_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of signals requiring expedited regulatory reporting"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Evaluation Cycle Days"
      display_name: "Avg Eval Days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(evaluation_completion_date, evaluation_start_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days to complete signal evaluation from start to completion"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Contributing Cases"
      display_name: "Total Cases"
      expr: SUM(CAST(case_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of adverse event cases contributing to all signals"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Cases per Signal"
      display_name: "Avg Cases/Signal"
      expr: AVG(CAST(case_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of adverse event cases per safety signal"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Overdue Evaluations"
      display_name: "Overdue Evals"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN evaluation_due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND evaluation_completion_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of signals with overdue evaluation completion dates"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Confirmation Rate"
      display_name: "Confirmation Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN final_disposition = 'Confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN final_disposition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of evaluated signals confirmed as true safety concerns"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Safety signal detection and evaluation KPIs tracking signal identification, assessment cycle time, and regulatory action outcomes

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`safety_susar`

LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

        leading_zeros: true

        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day

        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true

          type: all

        decimal_places:
