CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`sponsor_bid_request`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Bid and proposal performance KPIs tracking win rates, competitive positioning, and pipeline conversion across RFP opportunities."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`sponsor`.`bid_request`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Bid Status"
      display_name: "Bid Status"
      expr: bid_status
      comment: "Current status of the bid (submitted, awarded, lost, no-bid)"
    - name: "Study Phase"
      display_name: "Study Phase"
      expr: study_phase
      comment: "Clinical trial phase for the bid request"
    - name: "Study Type"
      display_name: "Study Type"
      expr: study_type
      comment: "Type of clinical study (interventional, observational, etc.)"
    - name: "Service Model"
      display_name: "Service Model"
      expr: service_model
      comment: "Service delivery model (FSP, full-service, hybrid)"
    - name: "Region Scope"
      display_name: "Region"
      expr: region_scope
      comment: "Geographic region scope for the bid"
    - name: "Is Resubmission"
      display_name: "Submission Type"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_resubmission = TRUE THEN 'Resubmission' ELSE 'Initial' END
      comment: "Whether this is a resubmission of a prior bid"
    - name: "Receipt Month"
      display_name: "Receipt Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', receipt_date)
      comment: "Month bucket for RFP receipt date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Award Month"
      display_name: "Award Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', award_date)
      comment: "Month bucket for bid award date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Receipt Year"
      display_name: "Receipt Year"
      expr: YEAR(receipt_date)
      comment: "Year the RFP was received"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
  measures:
    - name: "Total Bid Requests"
      display_name: "Total Bids"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of bid requests received"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Bids Won"
      display_name: "Bids Won"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN bid_status = 'Awarded' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of bids awarded to the organization"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Bids Lost"
      display_name: "Bids Lost"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN bid_status = 'Lost' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of bids lost to competitors"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "No-Bid Count"
      display_name: "No-Bid Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN bid_status = 'No-Bid' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of RFPs declined (no-bid decision)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Win Rate"
      display_name: "Win Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN bid_status = 'Awarded' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN bid_status IN ('Awarded', 'Lost') THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of submitted bids that were won (excludes no-bids and pending)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "No-Bid Rate"
      display_name: "No-Bid Rate"

        decimal_places:

        decimal_places:

          places: 2

        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "Average Bid Amount"

        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

      format:

        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "Total Estimated Subject Count"
      display_name: "Total Est. Subjects"

      format:

        decimal_places:

      format:

        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Average Estimated Duration Months"
      display_name: "Avg Duration (Months)"

      comment: "Average estimated study duration in months"
      format:

        decimal_places:

    - name: "Average Competing CRO Count"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`sponsor_escalation`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Sponsor escalation management KPIs tracking issue severity, resolution performance, and regulatory impact across sponsor relationships."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`sponsor`.`escalation`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Escalation Status"
      display_name: "Status"
      expr: escalation_status
      comment: "Current status of the escalation (open, in-progress, resolved, closed)"
    - name: "Severity Level"
      display_name: "Severity"
      expr: severity_level
      comment: "Severity classification of the escalation (critical, high, medium, low)"
    - name: "Priority"
      display_name: "Priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Priority level for resolution (urgent, high, normal, low)"
    - name: "Escalation Type"
      display_name: "Type"
      expr: escalation_type
      comment: "Type or category of escalation"
    - name: "Source"
      display_name: "Source"
      expr: source
      comment: "Source or origin of the escalation"
    - name: "Channel"
      display_name: "Channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Communication channel through which escalation was raised"
    - name: "Impacted Functional Area"
      display_name: "Functional Area"
      expr: impacted_functional_area
      comment: "Functional area impacted by the escalation"
    - name: "Root Cause Category"
      display_name: "Root Cause"
      expr: root_cause_category
      comment: "Root cause category classification"
    - name: "Is Safety Related"
      display_name: "Safety Flag"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_safety_related = TRUE THEN 'Safety-Related' ELSE 'Non-Safety' END
      comment: "Whether the escalation is safety-related"
    - name: "Is Regulatory Reportable"
      display_name: "Regulatory Reportable"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_regulatory_reportable = TRUE THEN 'Reportable' ELSE 'Non-Reportable' END
      comment: "Whether the escalation is regulatory reportable"
    - name: "Governance Review Required"
      display_name: "Governance Review"
      expr: CASE WHEN governance_review_required = TRUE THEN 'Required' ELSE 'Not Required' END
      comment: "Whether governance review is required"
    - name: "Escalation Month"
      display_name: "Escalation Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', escalation_date)
      comment: "Month bucket for escalation date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Resolution Month"
      display_name: "Resolution Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', actual_resolution_date)
      comment: "Month bucket for actual resolution date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Escalations"
      display_name: "Total Escalations"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of escalations raised"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Open Escalations"
      display_name: "Open Escalations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN escalation_status IN ('Open', 'In-Progress') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of escalations currently open or in-progress"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Resolved Escalations"
      display_name: "Resolved Escalations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN escalation_status IN ('Resolved', 'Closed') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of escalations that have been resolved or closed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Critical Escalations"
      display_name: "Critical Escalations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN severity_level = 'Critical' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of escalations with critical severity"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Safety-Related Escalations"
      display_name: "Safety Escalations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_safety_related = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of escalations that are safety-related"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Reportable Escalations"
      display_name: "Reportable Escalations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_regulatory_reportable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of escalations that are regulatory reportable"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Financial Impact"
      display_name: "Total Financial Impact"
      expr: SUM(CAST(financial_impact_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of financial impact across all escalations"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Average Financial Impact"
      display_name: "Avg Financial Impact"
      expr: AVG(CAST(financial_impact_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average financial impact per escalation"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Timeline Impact Days"
      display_name: "Total Timeline Impact (Days)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(timeline_impact_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of timeline impact in days across all escalations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Average Timeline Impact Days"
      display_name: "Avg Timeline Impact (Days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(timeline_impact_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average timeline impact in days per escalation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Resolution Rate"
      display_name: "Resolution Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN escalation_status IN ('Resolved', 'Closed') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of escalations that have been resolved or closed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Critical Escalation Rate"
      display_name: "Critical Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN severity_level = 'Critical' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of escalations classified as critical severity"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Safety-Related Rate"
      display_name: "Safety Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_safety_related = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of escalations that are safety-related"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Recurrence Rate"
      display_name: "Recurrence Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN recurrence_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of escalations that are recurrences of prior issues"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Distinct Sponsors"
      display_name: "Distinct Sponsors"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT organization_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct sponsor organizations with escalations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Distinct Studies"
      display_name: "Distinct Studies"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT study_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct studies with escalations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Sponsor escalation management KPIs tracking issue severity, resolution performance, and regulatory impact across sponsor relationships.

      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', award_date)
      comment: "Month bucket for proposal award date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submission Year"
      display_name: "Submission Year"
      expr: YEAR(submission_date)
      comment: "Year the proposal was submitted"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
  measures:
    - name: "Total Proposals"
      display_name: "Total Proposals"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of proposals submitted"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Proposals Awarded"
      display_name: "Awarded Proposals"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN proposal_status = 'Awarded' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of proposals that were awarded"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Proposals Lost"
      display_name: "Lost Proposals"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN proposal_status = 'Lost' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of proposals that were lost"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Proposal Win Rate"
      display_name: "Win Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN proposal_status = 'Awarded' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN proposal_status IN ('Awarded', 'Lost') THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of submitted proposals that were awarded (excludes pending)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Proposed Budget"
      display_name: "Total Proposed Budget"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_proposed_budget AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of total proposed budget amounts across all proposals"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Won Proposal Value"
      display_name: "Won Proposal Value"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN proposal_status = 'Awarded' THEN CAST(total_proposed_budget AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total value of proposals that were awarded"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Average Proposed Budget"
      display_name: "Avg Proposed Budget"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_proposed_budget AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average proposed budget per proposal"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Direct Cost"
      display_name: "Total Direct Cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(direct_cost_total AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of direct costs across all proposals"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Pass-Through Cost"
      display_name: "Total Pass-Through Cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pass_through_cost_total AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of pass-through costs across all proposals"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Average Win Probability"
      display_name: "Avg Win Probability"
      expr: AVG(CAST(win_probability_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average win probability percentage across all proposals"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Proposed Subject Count"
      display_name: "Total Proposed Subjects"
      expr: SUM(CAST(proposed_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of proposed subject counts across all proposals"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Proposed Site Count"
      display_name: "Total Proposed Sites"
      expr: SUM(CAST(proposed_site_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of proposed site counts across all proposals"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Average Study Duration Months"
      display_name: "Avg Duration (Months)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(study_duration_months AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average proposed study duration in months"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Average Proposed Country Count"
      display_name: "Avg Country Count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(proposed_country_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of countries per proposal"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Competitive Bid Rate"
      display_name: "Competitive Bid Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_competitive_bid = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of proposals that are competitive bids"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Rebid Rate"
      display_name: "Rebid Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_rebid = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of proposals that are rebids"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Distinct Sponsors"
      display_name: "Distinct Sponsors"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT organization_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct sponsor organizations receiving proposals"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Proposal and pricing performance KPIs tracking proposal volume, pricing strategy, and conversion effectiveness across sponsor opportunities.

    - name: "Total Pipeline Opportunity Value"

      display_name: "Study Phase"
      expr: study_phase
      comment: "Clinical development phase associated with the milestone"

      display_name: "Is Critical Path"

      comment: "Whether the milestone is on the critical path"
    - name: "Is Regulatory Milestone"
      display_name: "Is Regulatory Milestone"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_regulatory_milestone THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether the milestone is a regulatory commitment"
    - name: "Planned Month"
      display_name: "Planned Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', planned_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of planned milestone date for time-series analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Actual Month"
      display_name: "Actual Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', actual_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of actual milestone achievement date for time-series analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Milestone Count"
      display_name: "Milestone Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of milestones"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Achieved Milestone Count"
      display_name: "Achieved Milestone Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of milestones with actual achievement date"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Milestone Achievement Rate"
      display_name: "Milestone Achievement Rate"

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:

          places: 2

        decimal_places:

        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "On-Time Delivery Rate"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

        type: number

          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Milestone Count"

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_regulatory_milestone THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of regulatory commitment milestones"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:

    - name: "Average Window Before Days"

      format:

        decimal_places:

          places: 1
$$

      expr: visit_type
      comment: "Type of visit (Screening, Baseline, Treatment, Follow-up, Unscheduled)"
    - name: "Visit Code"
      display_name: "Visit Code"
      expr: visit_code
      comment: "Protocol-defined visit code"
    - name: "Window Compliance Status"
      display_name: "Window Compliance"
      expr: window_compliance_status
      comment: "Whether visit occurred within protocol-defined window"
    - name: "Protocol Deviation Flag"
      display_name: "Protocol Deviation"
      expr: protocol_deviation_flag
      comment: "Whether visit had a protocol deviation"
    - name: "Data Entry Status"
      display_name: "Data Entry Status"
      expr: data_entry_status
      comment: "Status of data entry for the visit"
    - name: "Is Scheduled"
      display_name: "Scheduled Visit"
      expr: is_scheduled
      comment: "Whether visit was scheduled or unscheduled"
    - name: "Missed Reason"
      display_name: "Missed Reason"
      expr: missed_reason
      comment: "Reason for missed visit if applicable"
    - name: "Early Termination Reason"
      display_name: "Early Termination Reason"
      expr: early_termination_reason
      comment: "Reason for early termination if applicable"
    - name: "Visit Year"
      display_name: "Visit Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', actual_visit_date)
      comment: "Year of actual visit"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Visit Quarter"
      display_name: "Visit Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', actual_visit_date)
      comment: "Quarter of actual visit"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Visit Month"
      display_name: "Visit Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', actual_visit_date)
      comment: "Month of actual visit"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Visits"
      display_name: "Total Visits"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT subject_visit_id)
      comment: "Total number of subject visits"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Completed Visits"
      display_name: "Completed Visits"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN visit_status = 'Completed' THEN subject_visit_id END)
      comment: "Number of completed visits"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Missed Visits"
      display_name: "Missed Visits"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN visit_status = 'Missed' THEN subject_visit_id END)
      comment: "Number of missed visits"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Cancelled Visits"
      display_name: "Cancelled Visits"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN visit_status = 'Cancelled' THEN subject_visit_id END)
      comment: "Number of cancelled visits"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Within Window Visits"
      display_name: "Within Window Visits"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN window_compliance_status = 'Within Window' THEN subject_visit_id END)
      comment: "Number of visits completed within protocol window"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Out of Window Visits"
      display_name: "Out of Window Visits"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN window_compliance_status = 'Out of Window' THEN subject_visit_id END)
      comment: "Number of visits completed outside protocol window"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Visits with Protocol Deviation"
      display_name: "Visits with Deviation"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN protocol_deviation_flag = TRUE THEN subject_visit_id END)
      comment: "Number of visits with protocol deviations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Visit Duration Minutes"
      display_name: "Avg Visit Duration (min)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average visit duration in minutes"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Days from Planned"
      display_name: "Avg Days from Planned"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_from_planned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days actual visit deviated from planned date (positive = late, negative = early)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Query Count per Visit"
      display_name: "Avg Queries per Visit"
      expr: AVG(CAST(query_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of data queries per visit"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Total Query Count"
      display_name: "Total Queries"
      expr: SUM(CAST(query_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of data queries across all visits"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Subject visit compliance and protocol adherence metrics for operational monitoring and quality oversight

WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

    - name: "Safety Population Flag"

    - name: "PP Population Flag"

    - name: "Serious AE Flag"

    - name: "Protocol Deviation Flag"

      comment: "Whether subject has any protocol deviations"
    - name: "Enrollment Year"

      comment: "Year of subject enrollment for temporal analysis"
      format:

        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Enrollment Quarter"

      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', enrollment_date)
      comment: "Quarter of subject enrollment for temporal analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Enrollment Month"

      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', enrollment_date)

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Screen Failure Reason"
      display_name: "Screen Failure Reason"
      expr: screen_failure_reason
      comment: "Reason for screening failure if applicable"
    - name: "Withdrawal Reason"

  measures:

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Enrolled Subjects"
      display_name: "Enrolled Subjects"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN enrollment_status = 'Enrolled' THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects currently enrolled in the trial"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Completed Subjects"
      display_name: "Completed Subjects"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN enrollment_status = 'Completed' THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects who completed the trial"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Withdrawn Subjects"
      display_name: "Withdrawn Subjects"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN enrollment_status = 'Withdrawn' THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects who withdrew from the trial"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Screen Failed Subjects"
      display_name: "Screen Failed Subjects"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN enrollment_status = 'Screen Failed' THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects who failed screening"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "ITT Population Count"
      display_name: "ITT Population"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN itt_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in Intent-to-Treat analysis population"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Safety Population Count"
      display_name: "Safety Population"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN safety_population_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in Safety analysis population"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "PP Population Count"
      display_name: "PP Population"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pp_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in Per-Protocol analysis population"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Subjects with SAE"
      display_name: "Subjects with SAE"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN serious_adverse_event_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects who experienced at least one serious adverse event"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Subjects with Protocol Deviation"
      display_name: "Subjects with Deviation"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN protocol_deviation_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects with at least one protocol deviation"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Age at Enrollment"
      display_name: "Avg Age at Enrollment"
      expr: AVG(CAST(age_at_enrollment AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average age of subjects at enrollment in years"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Median Age at Enrollment"
      display_name: "Median Age at Enrollment"
      expr: PERCENTILE(CAST(age_at_enrollment AS DOUBLE), 0.5)
      comment: "Median age of subjects at enrollment in years"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Core subject enrollment and population metrics for clinical trial oversight and regulatory reporting

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`supply_depot_inventory`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Depot-level IMP inventory and stock management KPIs for supply chain optimization"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`supply`.`depot_inventory`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Inventory Status"
      display_name: "Inventory Status"
      expr: inventory_status
      comment: "Current status of inventory (available, quarantined, expired, destroyed)"
    - name: "QP Release Status"
      display_name: "QP Release Status"
      expr: qp_release_status
      comment: "Qualified Person release status (released, pending, rejected)"
    - name: "Kit Type"
      display_name: "Kit Type"
      expr: kit_type
      comment: "Type of kit in inventory (treatment, placebo, rescue)"
    - name: "Cold Chain Required"
      display_name: "Cold Chain Required"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_cold_chain THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether the inventory item requires cold chain storage"
    - name: "Controlled Substance"
      display_name: "Controlled Substance"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_controlled_substance THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether the inventory item is a controlled substance"
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Flag"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion"
      expr: CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_flag THEN 'Excursion' ELSE 'Compliant' END
      comment: "Whether a temperature excursion has been recorded for this inventory"
    - name: "Receipt Year"
      display_name: "Receipt Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', receipt_date)
      comment: "Year of inventory receipt"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Receipt Month"
      display_name: "Receipt Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', receipt_date)
      comment: "Month of inventory receipt"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Expiry Year"
      display_name: "Expiry Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', expiry_date)
      comment: "Year of inventory expiry"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Expiry Month"
      display_name: "Expiry Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', expiry_date)
      comment: "Month of inventory expiry"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Inventory Records"
      display_name: "Total Inventory Records"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of inventory records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty On Hand"
      display_name: "Total Qty On Hand"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_on_hand AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity of IMP currently on hand across all depots (closing balance)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Receipt Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Qty Available"
      display_name: "Total Qty Available"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_available AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity available for allocation (on-hand minus quarantined)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Receipt Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Qty Allocated"
      display_name: "Total Qty Allocated"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_allocated AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity allocated to sites or shipments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Receipt Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Qty Quarantined"
      display_name: "Total Qty Quarantined"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_quarantined AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity in quarantine status"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Receipt Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Qty Expired"
      display_name: "Total Qty Expired"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_expired AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity expired (waste KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Destroyed"
      display_name: "Total Qty Destroyed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_destroyed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity destroyed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Returned"
      display_name: "Total Qty Returned"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_returned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity returned from sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Expiry Rate"
      display_name: "Expiry Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(qty_expired AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(qty_on_hand AS DOUBLE) + CAST(qty_expired AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of inventory that expired (critical waste and cost KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Quarantine Rate"
      display_name: "Quarantine Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(qty_quarantined AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(qty_on_hand AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of on-hand inventory in quarantine"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Availability Rate"
      display_name: "Availability Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(qty_available AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(qty_on_hand AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of on-hand inventory available for allocation (supply readiness KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Allocation Rate"
      display_name: "Allocation Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(qty_allocated AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(qty_available AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of available inventory that is allocated (utilization KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Rate"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of inventory records with temperature excursions"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      display_name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN accountability_reconciliation_status = 'Reconciled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of inventory records with completed accountability reconciliation"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Physical Count Discrepancy"
      display_name: "Avg Physical Count Discrepancy"
      expr: AVG(CAST(physical_count_discrepancy AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average discrepancy between system and physical count (inventory accuracy KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Depot-level IMP inventory and stock management KPIs for supply chain optimization

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`supply_destruction_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "IMP destruction and waste management KPIs for regulatory compliance and cost control"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`supply`.`destruction_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Destruction Status"
      display_name: "Destruction Status"
      expr: destruction_status
      comment: "Current status of the destruction record (pending, completed, certified)"
    - name: "Destruction Reason"
      display_name: "Destruction Reason"
      expr: destruction_reason
      comment: "Reason for destruction (expired, damaged, protocol deviation, study closure)"
    - name: "Destruction Method"
      display_name: "Destruction Method"
      expr: destruction_method
      comment: "Method used for destruction (incineration, chemical, landfill)"
    - name: "Blinded Destruction"
      display_name: "Blinded Destruction"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_blinded_destruction THEN 'Blinded' ELSE 'Unblinded' END
      comment: "Whether destruction was performed under blinded conditions"
    - name: "Cold Chain Maintained"
      display_name: "Cold Chain Maintained"
      expr: CASE WHEN cold_chain_maintained THEN 'Maintained' ELSE 'Broken' END
      comment: "Whether cold chain was maintained until destruction"
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Noted"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion Noted"
      expr: CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_noted THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether temperature excursion was noted prior to destruction"
    - name: "Regulatory Notification Required"
      display_name: "Regulatory Notification Required"
      expr: CASE WHEN regulatory_notification_required THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether regulatory notification is required for this destruction"
    - name: "Reconciliation Status"
      display_name: "Reconciliation Status"
      expr: reconciliation_status
      comment: "Status of accountability reconciliation for destroyed items"
    - name: "Destruction Year"
      display_name: "Destruction Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', destruction_date)
      comment: "Year of destruction"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Destruction Quarter"
      display_name: "Destruction Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', destruction_date)
      comment: "Quarter of destruction"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Destruction Month"
      display_name: "Destruction Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', destruction_date)
      comment: "Month of destruction"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Destruction Records"
      display_name: "Total Destruction Records"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of destruction records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Destroyed"
      display_name: "Total Qty Destroyed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_destroyed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity of IMP destroyed (waste and cost KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Kits Destroyed"
      display_name: "Total Kits Destroyed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(kit_count_destroyed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of kits destroyed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Weight Destroyed Kg"
      display_name: "Total Weight Destroyed (kg)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(weight_destroyed_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total weight of IMP destroyed in kilograms (environmental impact indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Expiry Destruction Rate"
      display_name: "Expiry Destruction Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN destruction_reason = 'Expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions due to expiry (waste management KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Damage Destruction Rate"
      display_name: "Damage Destruction Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN destruction_reason = 'Damaged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions due to damage (quality and handling KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Regulatory Notification Rate"
      display_name: "Regulatory Notification Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN regulatory_notification_required THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions requiring regulatory notification (compliance indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Reconciliation Completed Rate"
      display_name: "Reconciliation Completed Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions with completed accountability reconciliation"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Certificate Issued Rate"
      display_name: "Certificate Issued Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN certificate_of_destruction_ref IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions with issued certificate (documentation compliance KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Blinded Destruction Rate"
      display_name: "Blinded Destruction Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_blinded_destruction THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions performed under blinded conditions (trial integrity KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Noted Rate"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion Noted Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_noted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions where temperature excursion was noted (quality indicator)"
      format:

    - name: "Dispensing Year"

    - name: "Dispensing Quarter"

    - name: "Dispensing Month"

        decimal_places:

    - name: "Total Quantity Returned"

        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Subject Compliance Pct"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Protocol Deviation Rate"

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Cold Chain Compliance Rate"
      display_name: "Cold Chain Compliance Rate"

      comment: "Percentage of dispensing events where cold chain was maintained"

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Rate"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of dispensing events with temperature excursions"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      display_name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"

        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Dose Amount"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Return Rate"
      display_name: "Return Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(quantity_returned AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(quantity_dispensed AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of dispensed quantity that was returned (inverse compliance indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`supply_manufacture_batch`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Manufacturing batch KPIs: batch size, available quantity, release status, recall rate, quarantine rate, and destruction metrics for investigational medicinal product manufacturing quality and inventory management."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`supply`.`manufacture_batch`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Batch Type"
      display_name: "Batch Type"
      expr: batch_type
      comment: "Type of manufacturing batch (e.g., Clinical, Commercial, Validation)"
    - name: "Release Status"
      display_name: "Release Status"
      expr: release_status
      comment: "Release status of the batch (e.g., Released, Pending, Rejected)"
    - name: "Blinding Type"
      display_name: "Blinding Type"
      expr: blinding_type
      comment: "Blinding type for the batch (e.g., Open-label, Single-blind, Double-blind)"
    - name: "Dosage Form"
      display_name: "Dosage Form"
      expr: dosage_form
      comment: "Dosage form of the manufactured product (e.g., Tablet, Capsule, Injection)"
    - name: "Packaging Configuration"
      display_name: "Packaging Configuration"
      expr: packaging_configuration
      comment: "Packaging configuration for the batch (e.g., Blister, Bottle, Vial)"
    - name: "Manufacturing Site Country"
      display_name: "Manufacturing Site Country"
      expr: manufacturing_site_country
      comment: "Country of the manufacturing site"
    - name: "Is Comparator"
      display_name: "Is Comparator"
      expr: is_comparator
      comment: "Indicates whether the batch is a comparator product"
    - name: "Is Placebo"
      display_name: "Is Placebo"
      expr: is_placebo
      comment: "Indicates whether the batch is a placebo"
    - name: "Recall Flag"
      display_name: "Recall Flag"
      expr: recall_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the batch has been recalled"
    - name: "Manufacture Year"
      display_name: "Manufacture Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', manufacture_date)
      comment: "Year of batch manufacture"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Manufacture Quarter"
      display_name: "Manufacture Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', manufacture_date)
      comment: "Quarter of batch manufacture"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Manufacture Month"
      display_name: "Manufacture Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', manufacture_date)
      comment: "Month of batch manufacture"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Expiry Year"
      display_name: "Expiry Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', expiry_date)
      comment: "Year of batch expiry"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Release Year"
      display_name: "Release Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', release_date)
      comment: "Year of batch release"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Manufacture Batch Count"
      display_name: "Manufacture Batch Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Batch Size"
      display_name: "Total Batch Size"
      expr: SUM(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of batch size across all manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Batch Size"
      display_name: "Avg Batch Size"
      expr: AVG(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average batch size across manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Available Quantity"
      display_name: "Total Available Quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(available_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of available quantity across all manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Manufacture Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Quarantine Quantity"
      display_name: "Total Quarantine Quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quarantine_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of quarantine quantity across all manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Manufacture Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Destroyed Quantity"
      display_name: "Total Destroyed Quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(destroyed_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of destroyed quantity across all manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Batch Release Rate"
      display_name: "Batch Release Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN release_status = 'Released' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of manufacturing batches that have been released"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Batch Recall Rate"
      display_name: "Batch Recall Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN recall_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of manufacturing batches that have been recalled"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Quarantine Rate"
      display_name: "Quarantine Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(quarantine_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batch size that is quarantined"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Destruction Rate"
      display_name: "Destruction Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(destroyed_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batch size that has been destroyed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Availability Rate"
      display_name: "Availability Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(available_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batch size that is available for use"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Shelf Life Months"
      display_name: "Avg Shelf Life Months"
      expr: AVG(CAST(shelf_life_months AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average shelf life in months across manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Units Per Kit"
      display_name: "Avg Units Per Kit"
      expr: AVG(CAST(units_per_kit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average units per kit across manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Manufacturing batch KPIs: batch size, available quantity, release status, recall rate, quarantine rate, and destruction metrics for investigational medicinal product manufacturing quality and inventory management.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`supply_resupply_order`

LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Site resupply order and fulfillment KPIs for trial supply chain responsiveness and efficiency"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`supply`.`resupply_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Order Status"
      display_name: "Order Status"
      expr: order_status
      comment: "Current status of the resupply order (pending, approved, shipped, delivered, cancelled)"
    - name: "Trigger Type"
      display_name: "Trigger Type"
      expr: trigger_type
      comment: "Type of trigger that initiated the order (automatic, manual, emergency)"
    - name: "Urgency Level"
      display_name: "Urgency Level"
      expr: urgency_level
      comment: "Urgency level of the resupply order (routine, urgent, emergency)"

      comment: "Blinding level for the resupply (single, double, open-label)"

      comment: "Whether cold chain is required for this resupply"

      display_name: "Emergency Override"

      comment: "Whether this is an emergency override order"
    - name: "Accountability Reconciled"
      display_name: "Accountability Reconciled"
      expr: CASE WHEN accountability_reconciled THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether accountability has been reconciled for this order"
    - name: "Order Year"
      display_name: "Order Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', CAST(order_date AS DATE))
      comment: "Year when order was placed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Order Quarter"
      display_name: "Order Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAST(order_date AS DATE))
      comment: "Quarter when order was placed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Order Month"
      display_name: "Order Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_date AS DATE))
      comment: "Month when order was placed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Resupply Orders"
      display_name: "Total Resupply Orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of resupply orders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Requested"
      display_name: "Total Qty Requested"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_requested AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity requested across all resupply orders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Approved"
      display_name: "Total Qty Approved"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_approved AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity approved for resupply"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Shipped"
      display_name: "Total Qty Shipped"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_shipped AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity actually shipped"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approval Rate"
      display_name: "Approval Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(quantity_approved AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(quantity_requested AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of requested quantity that was approved (demand fulfillment KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Fulfillment Rate"
      display_name: "Fulfillment Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(quantity_shipped AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(quantity_approved AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of approved quantity that was shipped (supply chain efficiency KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Emergency Order Rate"
      display_name: "Emergency Order Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_emergency_override THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders that are emergency overrides (planning effectiveness indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Fulfillment Lead Time Days"
      display_name: "Avg Fulfillment Lead Time (days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(actual_delivery_date, order_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days from order to delivery (supply chain responsiveness KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Approval Lead Time Days"
      display_name: "Avg Approval Lead Time (days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(approval_date, order_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days from order to approval"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "On-Time Fulfillment Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Fulfillment Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= expected_fulfillment_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders fulfilled on or before expected date (service level KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Cancellation Rate"
      display_name: "Cancellation Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN order_status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of resupply orders that were cancelled"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      display_name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN accountability_reconciled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of resupply orders with completed accountability reconciliation"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Stock At Trigger"
      display_name: "Avg Stock At Trigger"
      expr: AVG(CAST(stock_at_trigger AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average stock level when resupply was triggered (reorder point optimization KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Site resupply order and fulfillment KPIs for trial supply chain responsiveness and efficiency

      comment: "Average number of days from dispatch to actual delivery"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "On-Time Delivery Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Delivery Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= expected_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipments delivered on or before expected delivery date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Excursion Duration Minutes"
      display_name: "Avg Excursion Duration (min)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(excursion_duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average duration of temperature excursions in minutes (for shipments with excursions)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Customs Clearance Required Pct"
      display_name: "Customs Clearance Required %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN customs_clearance_required THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipments requiring customs clearance"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Shipment logistics and cold-chain compliance KPIs for investigational medicinal product distribution

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`supply_site_inventory`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Site-level IMP inventory and resupply trigger KPIs for trial site supply management"
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`supply`.`site_inventory`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Inventory Status"
      display_name: "Inventory Status"
      expr: inventory_status
      comment: "Current status of site inventory (active, depleted, expired)"
    - name: "Location Type"
      display_name: "Location Type"
      expr: location_type
      comment: "Type of storage location at site (pharmacy, investigator, central)"
    - name: "Blinding Level"
      display_name: "Blinding Level"
      expr: blinding_level
      comment: "Level of blinding for this inventory (single, double, open-label)"
    - name: "Storage Condition Compliant"
      display_name: "Storage Condition Compliance"
      expr: CASE WHEN storage_condition_compliant THEN 'Compliant' ELSE 'Non-Compliant' END
      comment: "Whether storage conditions are compliant with protocol requirements"
    - name: "Resupply Triggered"
      display_name: "Resupply Triggered"
      expr: CASE WHEN resupply_triggered THEN 'Triggered' ELSE 'Not Triggered' END
      comment: "Whether a resupply order has been triggered for this inventory"
    - name: "Destruction Authorized"
      display_name: "Destruction Authorized"
      expr: CASE WHEN destruction_authorized THEN 'Authorized' ELSE 'Not Authorized' END
      comment: "Whether destruction of expired/returned inventory is authorized"
    - name: "Last Shipment Year"
      display_name: "Last Shipment Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', last_shipment_date)
      comment: "Year of last shipment to site"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Last Shipment Month"
      display_name: "Last Shipment Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', last_shipment_date)
      comment: "Month of last shipment to site"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Expiry Year"
      display_name: "Expiry Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', expiry_date)
      comment: "Year of inventory expiry"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Expiry Month"
      display_name: "Expiry Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', expiry_date)
      comment: "Month of inventory expiry"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Site Inventory Records"
      display_name: "Total Site Inventory Records"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of site inventory records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty On Hand"
      display_name: "Total Qty On Hand"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_on_hand AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity of IMP currently on hand at sites (closing balance)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Last Shipment Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Qty Received"
      display_name: "Total Qty Received"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_received AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity received by sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Dispensed"
      display_name: "Total Qty Dispensed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_dispensed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity dispensed to subjects at sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Returned"
      display_name: "Total Qty Returned"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_returned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity returned by subjects to sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Expired"
      display_name: "Total Qty Expired"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_expired AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity expired at sites (waste KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Destroyed"
      display_name: "Total Qty Destroyed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_destroyed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity destroyed at sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Quarantined"
      display_name: "Total Qty Quarantined"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_quarantined AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity in quarantine at sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Last Shipment Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Qty Allocated"
      display_name: "Total Qty Allocated"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_allocated AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity allocated to subjects at sites"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Last Shipment Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Qty Adjusted"
      display_name: "Total Qty Adjusted"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qty_adjusted AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity adjusted (reconciliation adjustments)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Dispensing Rate"
      display_name: "Dispensing Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(qty_dispensed AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(qty_received AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of received inventory that has been dispensed (utilization KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Expiry Rate"
      display_name: "Expiry Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(qty_expired AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(qty_received AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of received inventory that expired at sites (critical waste and cost KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Return Rate"
      display_name: "Return Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(qty_returned AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(qty_dispensed AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of dispensed inventory that was returned (inverse compliance indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Resupply Trigger Rate"
      display_name: "Resupply Trigger Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN resupply_triggered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of site inventory records that have triggered resupply (demand signal)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Storage Compliance Rate"
      display_name: "Storage Compliance Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN storage_condition_compliant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of site inventory with compliant storage conditions (GCP compliance KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      display_name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN accountability_reconciled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of site inventory with completed accountability reconciliation"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Temperature Excursion Count"
      display_name: "Avg Temperature Excursion Count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(temperature_excursion_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of temperature excursions per site inventory record"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Sites Below Minimum Stock"
      display_name: "Sites Below Minimum Stock"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN qty_on_hand < minimum_stock_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Number of site inventory records below minimum stock threshold (stockout risk KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Site-level IMP inventory and resupply trigger KPIs for trial site supply management

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`supply_plan`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Strategic supply planning KPIs: forecasted enrollment, buffer stock, overage, dropout rates, and manufacturing batch planning for investigational medicinal products across clinical trials."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`supply`.`supply_plan`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Supply Plan Number"
      display_name: "Supply Plan Number"
      expr: plan_number
      comment: "Unique identifier for the supply plan"
    - name: "Supply Plan Status"
      display_name: "Supply Plan Status"
      expr: supply_plan_status
      comment: "Current status of the supply plan (e.g., Draft, Approved, Active, Closed)"
    - name: "Blinding Type"
      display_name: "Blinding Type"
      expr: blinding_type
      comment: "Type of blinding applied to the supply (e.g., Open-label, Single-blind, Double-blind)"
    - name: "Geographic Scope"
      display_name: "Geographic Scope"
      expr: geographic_scope
      comment: "Geographic scope of the supply plan (e.g., Global, Regional, Country-specific)"
    - name: "Planning Cycle"
      display_name: "Planning Cycle"
      expr: planning_cycle
      comment: "Planning cycle frequency (e.g., Annual, Quarterly, Monthly)"
    - name: "Randomization Method"

    - name: "Cold Chain Required"
      display_name: "Cold Chain Required"
      expr: cold_chain_required
      comment: "Indicates whether cold chain logistics are required for this supply plan"
    - name: "Plan Year"
      display_name: "Plan Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', plan_date)
      comment: "Year of the supply plan date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Plan Quarter"
      display_name: "Plan Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', plan_date)
      comment: "Quarter of the supply plan date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Plan Month"
      display_name: "Plan Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', plan_date)
      comment: "Month of the supply plan date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Horizon Start Year"
      display_name: "Horizon Start Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', horizon_start_date)
      comment: "Year of the planning horizon start date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Supply Plan Count"
      display_name: "Supply Plan Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of supply plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Forecasted Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Forecasted Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(forecasted_enrollment AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of forecasted patient enrollment across all supply plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Forecasted Enrollment"
      display_name: "Avg Forecasted Enrollment"
      expr: AVG(CAST(forecasted_enrollment AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average forecasted patient enrollment per supply plan"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Planned Units"
      display_name: "Total Planned Units"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_units_planned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of total units planned across all supply plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Planned Units Per Plan"
      display_name: "Avg Planned Units Per Plan"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_units_planned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average total units planned per supply plan"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Planned Manufacturing Batches"
      display_name: "Total Planned Manufacturing Batches"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_manufacturing_batches AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of planned manufacturing batches across all supply plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Dropout Rate Pct"
      display_name: "Avg Dropout Rate %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(dropout_rate_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average dropout rate percentage across supply plans"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Overage Pct"
      display_name: "Avg Overage %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(overage_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average overage percentage (buffer stock above forecasted need) across supply plans"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Buffer Stock Weeks"
      display_name: "Avg Buffer Stock Weeks"
      expr: AVG(CAST(buffer_stock_weeks AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average buffer stock duration in weeks across supply plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Shelf Life Months"
      display_name: "Avg Shelf Life Months"
      expr: AVG(CAST(shelf_life_months AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average shelf life in months for investigational products in supply plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Treatment Arms Count"
      display_name: "Avg Treatment Arms Count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(treatment_arms_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of treatment arms per supply plan"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Resupply Trigger Threshold"
      display_name: "Avg Resupply Trigger Threshold"
      expr: AVG(CAST(resupply_trigger_threshold AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average resupply trigger threshold (minimum stock level before reorder) across supply plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Resupply Quantity"
      display_name: "Avg Resupply Quantity"
      expr: AVG(CAST(resupply_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average resupply quantity per order across supply plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Cold Chain Required Pct"
      display_name: "Cold Chain Required %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN cold_chain_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of supply plans requiring cold chain logistics"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Destruction Plan Included Pct"
      display_name: "Destruction Plan Included %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN destruction_plan_included = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of supply plans that include a destruction plan for expired or unused product"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic supply planning KPIs: forecasted enrollment, buffer stock, overage, dropout rates, and manufacturing batch planning for investigational medicinal products across clinical trials.
